original_sql: SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, clinical_status.person_neoplasm_cancer_status, COUNT(clinical_status.person_neoplasm_cancer_status) AS cancer_status_count FROM patients JOIN clinical_status ON patients.patient_id = clinical_status.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND clinical_status.person_neoplasm_cancer_status = 'With tumor' GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, clinical_status.person_neoplasm_cancer_status ORDER BY patients.patient_id;
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id2 = atom.atom_id WHERE atom.element = 'barium' AND atom.molecule_id LIKE 'ALKALINE%'

SELECT raceid, name AS modal_name FROM (SELECT raceid, name, COUNT(*) AS freq, MIN(raceid) AS first_occurrence, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(raceid) ASC) AS rn FROM races GROUP BY raceid, name) sub WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY raceid;
SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id WHERE c.district_id BETWEEN 240 AND 250 AND d.type = 'OWNER' LIMIT 1500;

SELECT s.district, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numge1500 FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.county = 'San Diego' AND sa.rtype = 'D' ORDER BY sa.avgscrread ASC LIMIT 4;

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplaypassing, ta.buildupplaypassingclass, ta.chancecreationshooting, ta.chancecreationshootingclass, ta.defenceaggression, ta.defenceaggressionclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2017-08-22 00:00:00'

SELECT RACEID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 1 THEN DRIVERID END) AS WINNER, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 2 THEN DRIVERID END) AS RUNNER_UP, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 3 THEN DRIVERID END) AS THIRD_PLACE FROM results WHERE POSITIONORDER <= 3 AND LAPS BETWEEN 10 AND 20 AND POINTS > 10 GROUP BY RACEID

SELECT link_to_member, SUM(hours) AS total_volunteer_hours FROM attendance JOIN member ON attendance.link_to_member = member.member_id WHERE hours >= 3 AND member.position = 'Volunteer' AND member.zip BETWEEN 30000 AND 60000 GROUP BY link_to_member
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id WHERE atom.element = 'germanium' AND atom.molecule_id LIKE 'SEMICONDUCTOR%'

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS total_expenses FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2023-10-01' AND '2024-03-31' AND e.type = 'Seminar' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 2000 ORDER BY total_expenses DESC LIMIT 4

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_id, bl.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'C' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, bl.bond_id NULLS LAST

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.fastestlapspeed FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL AND r.position <= 3 ORDER BY r.fastestlaptime DESC LIMIT 8;

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type = 'hydrogen' THEN 1 END) AS hydrogen_bonds, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type IN ('covalent', 'polar') THEN molecule_id END) AS covalent_bonds FROM bond GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.defensive_work_rate FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.defensive_work_rate = 'very high' AND Player_Attributes.overall_rating > 80

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Zn' AND b.bond_type = 'covalent' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.bond_type ASC

WITH member_privileges_analysis AS (SELECT privilege_level, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total_privileges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY privilege_level ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Privilege Top 3' AS result_type FROM member_privileges WHERE is_active = true AND privilege_scope = 'Alumni' AND approval_status = 'Approved' GROUP BY privilege_level, member_id), privilege_members AS (SELECT privilege_level, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total_privileges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top Privilege' AS result_type FROM member_privileges WHERE is_active = true AND privilege_scope = 'Alumni' AND approval_status = 'Approved' GROUP BY privilege_level, member_id) SELECT privilege_level, member_id, total_privileges, result_type FROM member_privileges_analysis WHERE rank <= 3 UNION ALL SELECT privilege_level, member_id, total_privileges, result_type FROM privilege_members WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, privilege_level, member_id

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.gk_positioning FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.gk_positioning > 90

SELECT s.superhero_name, a.alignment, p.power_name FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower p ON hp.power_id = p.id WHERE s.weight_kg BETWEEN 85 AND 105 AND s.gender_id = 2 AND s.height_cm > 175
SELECT C.name, C.flavortext FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Brawl' AND C.convertedmanacost BETWEEN 3.0 AND 5.0

SELECT RACEID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 1 THEN CONSTRUCTORID END) AS CHAMPION, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 2 THEN CONSTRUCTORID END) AS RUNNER_UP, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 3 THEN CONSTRUCTORID END) AS THIRD_PLACE FROM results GROUP BY RACEID
SELECT bond_type, bond_seq FROM bond_ref WHERE bond_type LIKE 'U%' ORDER BY bond_seq ASC NULLS FIRST

SELECT RACEID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 1 THEN DRIVERID END) AS WINNER, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 2 THEN DRIVERID END) AS RUNNER_UP, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 3 THEN DRIVERID END) AS THIRD_PLACE FROM results WHERE POSITIONORDER <= 3 AND LAPS BETWEEN 171 AND 180 GROUP BY RACEID
SELECT * FROM cards WHERE 3 = (CASE WHEN artist LIKE 'K%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN convertedmanacost = 2.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN hasfoil = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);
SELECT player_id FROM player_stats_temp GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) > 15 AND (MAX(minutes_played) - MIN(minutes_played)) > 1000;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'As' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, b.bond_id NULLS FIRST
SELECT player_id FROM player_stats GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) > 5 AND (MAX(yellow_cards) - MIN(yellow_cards)) > 2;
SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Perception' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 15 AND 35)

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Explainer' WHERE u.reputation >= 25000 AND u.creationdate > '2018-01-01'
SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.transact_dt_tm ASC) AS rnk FROM bond_list a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 3

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'B' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, br.bond_seq ASC
SELECT bond_type, bond_seq FROM bond_ref WHERE bond_type LIKE 'X%' ORDER BY bond_seq DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.standing_tackle FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.standing_tackle > 90 AND Player_Attributes.marking > 85
SELECT cards.types, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT * FROM card_type WHERE card_type.cardid = cards.id AND card_type.type = 'Instant') THEN 'instant' ELSE 'not instant' END FROM cards

SELECT TA.ID, TA.BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING, TA.CHANCECREATIONCROSSING, TA.DEFENCEPRESSURE, TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH FROM team_attributes AS TA WHERE TA.BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING < (SELECT AVG(BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.CHANCECREATIONCROSSING > (SELECT AVG(CHANCECREATIONCROSSING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCEPRESSURE < (SELECT AVG(DEFENCEPRESSURE) FROM team_attributes)
SELECT av1.atom_id, av2.atom_id FROM atom_view AS av1 INNER JOIN atom_view AS av2 ON (av1.atom_id, av2.atom_id) IN (('AV300', 'AV301'), ('AV300', 'AV302'), ('AV301', 'AV302'))

SELECT p.player_name, p.height, COUNT(pa.id) AS defensive_count FROM player p JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.marking > 75 AND p.height > 180 GROUP BY p.player_name, p.height HAVING COUNT(pa.id) > 5;

SELECT m.phone, e.location, b.category, z.county FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.amount BETWEEN 600 AND 1200 ORDER BY b.amount ASC NULLS FIRST

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.potential FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.potential > 80
SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS total_elements FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 8;

WITH SUPERHERO_GROUP_RANK AS (SELECT ID, SUBGROUP2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUBGROUP1 DESC NULLS LAST) AS RANK FROM SUPERHERO_GROUP) SELECT S1.SUBGROUP2 AS CURRENT_SUBGROUP, S2.SUBGROUP2 AS SUBGROUP_AFTER_15 FROM SUPERHERO_GROUP_RANK AS S1 LEFT JOIN SUPERHERO_GROUP_RANK AS S2 ON S2.RANK = S1.RANK + 15

SELECT s.constructorresultsid, s.raceid, c.constructorid FROM constructorresults AS s INNER JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorid = s.constructorid WHERE s.raceid = 63 AND s.points > 240 AND c.nationality = 'Brazilian'
SELECT m.member_id FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN member_privileges AS mp ON m.member_id = mp.member_id WHERE mp.member_id IS NULL AND mp.privilege_level = 'admin' AND m.position = 'Secretary'
SELECT C.name, C.flavortext FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Legacy' AND C.convertedmanacost BETWEEN 5.0 AND 7.0

SELECT s.superhero_name, a.alignment, p.power_name FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower p ON hp.power_id = p.id WHERE s.weight_kg BETWEEN 105 AND 125 AND s.gender_id = 2 AND s.height_cm > 185
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'H%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS LAST, a.atom_id NULLS LAST
SELECT bond_type, bond_seq FROM bond_ref WHERE bond_type LIKE 'E%' ORDER BY bond_seq DESC NULLS FIRST

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS Total_Event_Spending FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.event_status = 'Approved' AND b.category = 'Fundraiser' AND e.status = 'Active' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 2200

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'As' AND b.bond_type = 'dative' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.bond_type DESC
SELECT team_api_id, team_short_name FROM team WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM team WHERE team_short_name LIKE 'AS%' AND team_fifa_api_id > 160000);

SELECT m.member_id FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN income AS i ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member WHERE i.link_to_member IS NULL AND i.amount > 200 AND i.source = 'donation' AND m.position = 'Vice President' AND m.zip > 90000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS member_count, zip_code.state FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'alumni' AND zip_code.type = 'standard' GROUP BY zip_code.state, member.position

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS hair_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.hair_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Burgundy%' AND sh.weight_kg BETWEEN 70 AND 90 ORDER BY sh.id DESC

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.lat AS circuitlatitude, d.code AS drivercode, co.nationality AS constructornationality, res.position AS finishposition, res.fastestlapspeed FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2015 AND res.points > 10 AND res.positionorder <= 5 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.fastestlapspeed DESC
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.agility FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 165 AND 175 AND PA.agility > 80

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond.bond_type FROM atom LEFT JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'disulfide' AND atom.element = 'Sulfur'

SELECT r.raceid, r.name, COUNT(lt.driverid) AS driver_count, MAX(lt.milliseconds) AS slowest_lap FROM races r JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid WHERE r.year > 2019 GROUP BY r.raceid, r.name HAVING COUNT(lt.driverid) > 18

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(b.spent) AS Total_Spent_On_Conferences FROM member AS m JOIN budget AS b ON m.member_id = b.link_to_event JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.type = 'Conference' AND e.status = 'Planned' GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 1000
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Au%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS LAST, a.atom_id NULLS LAST

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count, COUNT(primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count) AS lymph_node_examined_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count BETWEEN 300 AND 500 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_list ON atom.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'K' AND bond_list.bond_type = 'ionic' ORDER BY molecule.label ASC, atom.atom_id ASC

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'U' AND power = '7' AND toughness = '6') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '9195') WHEN (colors = 'B' AND power = '6' AND toughness = '5') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '9196') WHEN (colors = 'R' AND power = '5' AND toughness = '4') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '9197') WHEN (colors = 'G' AND power = '4' AND toughness = '3') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '9198') END) AS watermark FROM cards

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 118 THEN 118 WHEN s.id = 119 THEN 119 WHEN s.id = 120 THEN 120 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, sp.power_name FROM superhero AS s JOIN hero_power AS hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE s.id IN (118, 119, 120) AND sp.power_name LIKE 'Strength%'
SELECT m.member_id FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN income AS i ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member WHERE i.link_to_member IS NULL AND i.amount > 300 AND i.source = 'sponsorship' AND m.position = 'President'

SELECT RACEID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 1 THEN DRIVERID END) AS WINNER, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 2 THEN DRIVERID END) AS RUNNER_UP, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 3 THEN DRIVERID END) AS THIRD_PLACE FROM results WHERE POSITIONORDER <= 3 AND LAPS > 100 GROUP BY RACEID
SELECT raceid, fastestlapspeed FROM (SELECT raceid, fastestlapspeed, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC) AS rank FROM results GROUP BY raceid, fastestlapspeed) subq WHERE rank = 1

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Publicist' WHERE u.reputation >= 13000 AND u.creationdate > '2018-01-01'
SELECT s.resultid, s.raceid, d.driverid FROM results AS s INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = s.driverid WHERE s.raceid = 46 AND s.points > 150 AND d.nationality = 'Belgian'
SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 70 AND 90)

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'glycosidic' AND molecule.label LIKE 'Fiber%'
SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'u' THEN 1 END) AS u_atoms, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element IN ('pu', 'am') THEN molecule_id END) AS pu_atoms FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.cpk FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'PSS' AND l.cpk > 300 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.cpk HAVING COUNT(*) > 2) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.cpk = j.cpk)
SELECT * FROM packages WHERE 3 = (CASE WHEN status = 'processing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN weight_kg < 2.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN is_fragile = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);
SELECT p.id, p.sex, p.admission, AVG(l.plt) AS avg_platelet_count FROM patient AS p INNER JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id GROUP BY p.id, p.sex, p.admission

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.country AS circuitcountry, d.forename AS driverfirstname, d.surname AS driverlastname, co.name AS teamname, res.grid AS qualifyingposition, res.fastestlaptime FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005 AND res.points > 5 AND res.positionorder <= 8 ORDER BY r.raceid DESC, res.grid ASC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq BETWEEN 25 AND 30 AND m.label LIKE 'Si%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Be' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 1 AND 4 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST
SELECT AVG(amount) FROM (SELECT amount, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM trans) AS E WHERE (Rank = 5)

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.agility FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.agility > 88 AND Player_Attributes.reactions > 85

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS composite_key, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS molecule_ref, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond_list AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Ta%' OR b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-06-01' AND '2023-11-30' ORDER BY composite_key DESC, molecule_ref ASC

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(a.hours) AS total_volunteer_hours FROM event e LEFT JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-06-30' AND e.type = 'Volunteer' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(a.hours) > 15 ORDER BY total_volunteer_hours DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS silicon_amide_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'amide' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'Si%' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY silicon_amide_bonds DESC

SELECT t1.* FROM cards t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM cards GROUP BY artist, asciiname, name, setcode, rarity, convertedmanacost, power, toughness, colors, keywords, subtypes, types, layout, frameversion, bordercolor, watermark, multiverseid, originaltype, originaltext, originalreleasedate, flavortext, frameeffects, hand, life, loyalty, leadershipskills, manacost, coloridentity, colorindicator) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_neoplasm_histologic_grade, COUNT(pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_neoplasm_histologic_grade) AS histologic_grade_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_neoplasm_histologic_grade = 'G3' GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_neoplasm_histologic_grade ORDER BY patients.patient_id;
SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex, COALESCE(l.igm, 0) AS igm_status FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 600 THEN 600 WHEN s.id = 601 THEN 601 WHEN s.id = 602 THEN 602 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, c.colour FROM superhero AS s JOIN colour AS c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.id IN (600, 601, 602) AND c.colour = 'Blue'
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Ca%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS LAST, a.atom_id NULLS LAST

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 800 THEN 800 WHEN s.id = 801 THEN 801 WHEN s.id = 802 THEN 802 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, c.colour FROM superhero AS s JOIN colour AS c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.id IN (800, 801, 802) AND c.colour = 'Green'

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Great Answer' WHERE u.reputation >= 30000

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_list ON atom.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Pt' AND bond_list.bond_type = 'coordinate' ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id DESC
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN connected AS c ON m.molecule_id = c.atom_id WHERE c.atom_id2 LIKE 'H%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS LAST, c.bond_id NULLS LAST
SELECT t1.* FROM cards t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM cards GROUP BY colors) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id

SELECT m.email, e.event_name, b.remaining, z.short_state FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.remaining > 1200 ORDER BY b.remaining DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT circuitid, COUNT(*) FROM races GROUP BY circuitid HAVING COUNT(*) > 3;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Zn' ORDER BY m.label DESC, a.atom_id DESC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS FIRST
SELECT t1.* FROM card_choice t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM card_choice GROUP BY card_id) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.amount) AS total_budget FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2023-10-01' AND '2024-03-31' AND e.type = 'Conference' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.amount) > 4500 ORDER BY total_budget DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT t1.team_short_name, t2.chancecreationshooting FROM team t1 INNER JOIN team_attributes t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.chancecreationshooting BETWEEN 30 AND 50

SELECT raceid, driverid AS modal_driverid FROM (SELECT raceid, driverid, COUNT(*) AS freq, MIN(resultid) AS first_occurrence, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(resultid) ASC) AS rn FROM results GROUP BY raceid, driverid) sub WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY raceid;

SELECT cards.artist, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT * FROM card_type WHERE card_type.cardid = cards.id AND card_type.type = 'Artifact Creature') THEN 'artifact_creature' ELSE 'not_artifact_creature' END FROM cards
SELECT t1.team_short_name, t2.chancecreationpassing FROM team t1 INNER JOIN team_attributes t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.chancecreationpassing BETWEEN 25 AND 45
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'MOL007') AS molecule_id_count, element, COUNT(*) AS element_count FROM atom GROUP BY ROLLUP (element)

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS Total_Expenses FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.event_status = 'In Progress' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 750
SELECT a1.atom_id, a2.atom_id FROM atom AS a1 INNER JOIN atom AS a2 ON (a1.atom_id, a2.atom_id) IN (('AT1200', 'AT1201'), ('AT1200', 'AT1202'), ('AT1201', 'AT1202'))
SELECT * FROM expense WHERE cost >= 75.0 AND cost <= 400.0 AND link_to_member = 'recggMW2eyCYceNcy' ORDER BY cost NULLS FIRST

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplayspeed, ta.buildupplayspeedclass, ta.chancecreationpassing, ta.chancecreationpassingclass, ta.defenceteamwidth, ta.defenceteamwidthclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2016-12-15 00:00:00'
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MIN(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'And%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 410000);

WITH POWER_RANK AS (SELECT ID, POWER_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ID DESC NULLS LAST) AS RANKING FROM SUPERPOWER) SELECT P1.POWER_NAME AS CURRENT_POWER, P2.POWER_NAME AS POWER_AFTER_5 FROM POWER_RANK AS P1 LEFT JOIN POWER_RANK AS P2 ON P2.RANKING = P1.RANKING + 5

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 700 THEN 700 WHEN s.id = 701 THEN 701 WHEN s.id = 702 THEN 702 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, sp.power_name FROM superhero AS s JOIN hero_power AS hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE s.id IN (700, 701, 702) AND sp.power_name LIKE 'Lightning%'
SELECT t1.* FROM packages t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM packages GROUP BY metadata) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS eye_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Topaz%' AND sh.height_cm BETWEEN 160 AND 180 ORDER BY sh.id DESC

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'B' AND power = '5') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '1108') WHEN (colors = 'U' AND power = '4') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '1109') WHEN (colors = 'R' AND power = '3') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '1110') WHEN (colors = 'G' AND power = '2') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '1111') END) AS watermark FROM cards

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.aptt FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'PSS' AND l.aptt > 85 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.aptt HAVING COUNT(*) > 2) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.aptt = j.aptt)

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Ti' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, br.bond_seq NULLS LAST

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.lng AS circuitlongitude, d.dob AS driverbirthdate, co.nationality AS constructornationality, res.position AS finishposition, res.fastestlapspeed FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2011 AND 2016 AND res.points > 14 AND res.positionorder <= 4 ORDER BY r.raceid DESC, res.fastestlapspeed ASC

SELECT sqR.race_count AS total_by_race, R.race AS race, A.alignment AS alignment, sqRA.race_alignment_count AS count_by_race_alignment FROM (SELECT race_id, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM superhero WHERE race_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY race_id) sqR INNER JOIN (SELECT race_id, alignment_id, COUNT(*) AS race_alignment_count FROM superhero WHERE alignment_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY race_id, alignment_id) sqRA ON sqR.race_id = sqRA.race_id INNER JOIN race R ON sqR.race_id = R.id INNER JOIN alignment A ON sqRA.alignment_id = A.id WHERE A.alignment LIKE 'Evil%' ORDER BY R.race, A.alignment;
SELECT * FROM atom LEFT JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'sodium' AND molecule.label LIKE 'CHEM%'

WITH member_attendance_analysis AS (SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, SUM(hours) AS total_hours, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_member ORDER BY SUM(hours) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top Hours' AS result_type FROM attendance WHERE hours > 3.5 GROUP BY link_to_member, link_to_event), event_attendance AS (SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, SUM(hours) AS total_hours, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_event ORDER BY SUM(hours) DESC) AS rank, 'Event Top Hours' AS result_type FROM attendance WHERE hours > 3.5 GROUP BY link_to_member, link_to_event) SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, total_hours, result_type FROM member_attendance_analysis WHERE rank <= 4 UNION ALL SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, total_hours, result_type FROM event_attendance WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, link_to_member, link_to_event

WITH member_events AS (SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, SUM(hours) AS total_hours, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_member ORDER BY SUM(hours) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top Hours' AS result_type FROM attendance WHERE hours > 2 GROUP BY link_to_member, link_to_event), event_members AS (SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, SUM(hours) AS total_hours, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_event ORDER BY SUM(hours) DESC) AS rank, 'Event Top Hours' AS result_type FROM attendance WHERE hours > 2 GROUP BY link_to_member, link_to_event) SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, total_hours, result_type FROM member_events WHERE rank <= 3 UNION ALL SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, total_hours, result_type FROM event_members WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, link_to_member, link_to_event

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.country AS circuitcountry, d.forename AS driverfirstname, d.surname AS driverlastname, co.name AS teamname, res.grid AS qualifyingposition, res.fastestlaptime FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2015 AND res.points > 10 AND res.positionorder <= 3 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.grid DESC

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.fastestlapspeed FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL AND r.position <= 5 AND r.points > 25 ORDER BY r.fastestlapspeed DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, connected.atom_id2 FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id WHERE atom.element = 'Ba' AND connected.bond_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY molecule.label ASC, atom.atom_id ASC

WITH cte AS (SELECT driverid, points, (points * 100) as earnings FROM driverstandings) SELECT driverid, points, earnings, CASE WHEN earnings > 5000 THEN earnings * 0.2 WHEN earnings > 3000 THEN earnings * 0.15 ELSE null END AS bonus FROM cte
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'glycosidic' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'ORG%' AND connected.atom_id2 LIKE 'ATM%'

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bond.bond_id) AS unique_ester_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'ester' GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id;
SELECT player_id FROM player_stats GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) > 22 AND (MAX(yellow_cards) - MIN(yellow_cards)) > 9;

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_ihc, AVG(primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_ihc) AS avg_positive_ihc_lymph_nodes FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_ihc > 0 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_ihc ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT atom.atom_id) AS unique_silicon_atoms FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Si' GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id;

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_list ON atom.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Fe' AND bond_list.bond_type = 'coordinate' ORDER BY molecule.label ASC, atom.atom_id ASC
SELECT raceid, q1 FROM (SELECT raceid, q1, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM qualifying GROUP BY raceid, q1) subq WHERE rank = 1 AND q1 IS NOT NULL

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.remaining) AS unspent_budget FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2024-04-01' AND '2024-09-30' AND e.type = 'Workshop' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.remaining) > 2000 ORDER BY unspent_budget ASC LIMIT 4

SELECT M.member_id, M.first_name, M.last_name FROM member AS M WHERE M.member_id IN (SELECT link_to_member FROM expense WHERE cost > 200 AND approved = 'Yes' AND link_to_budget = 'recBUD54321') AND M.position = 'Financial Compliance Officer'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, bl.bond_id, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Ga' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS combined_key, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS molecule_key, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property_type FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond AS b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Cl%' OR b.bond_type IN ('peptide', 'disulfide') ORDER BY combined_key ASC, molecule_key DESC

SELECT raceid, positiontext AS modal_positiontext FROM (SELECT raceid, positiontext, COUNT(*) AS freq, MIN(resultid) AS first_occurrence, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(resultid) ASC) AS rn FROM results GROUP BY raceid, positiontext) sub WHERE rn = 1 AND positiontext NOT IN ('1', '2', '3', '4') ORDER BY raceid;
SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.transact_dt_tm DESC) AS rnk FROM bond_list a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 24

SELECT raceid, q3 FROM (SELECT raceid, q3, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM qualifying GROUP BY raceid, q3) subq WHERE rank = 1 AND q3 IS NOT NULL AND q3 <> '0' AND q3 LIKE '3%'

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS total_expenses FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2023-10-01' AND '2024-03-31' AND e.type = 'Seminar' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 1800 ORDER BY total_expenses DESC LIMIT 4
SELECT cdscode, COUNT(mailzip) FROM schools WHERE county = 'San Bernardino County' GROUP BY cdscode LIMIT 14

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond_list.bond_id) AS recent_ester_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond_list ON molecule.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE bond_list.bond_type = 'ester' AND bond_list.transact_dt_tm > '2024-01-01' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY recent_ester_bonds DESC
SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.bond_type ASC) AS rnk FROM bond_list a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 5

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'amide' AND molecule.label LIKE 'Polymer%' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'MOL%'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS member_count, zip_code.state FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'active' AND zip_code.type = 'military' GROUP BY zip_code.state

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type = 'van der waals' THEN 1 END) AS vdw_bonds, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type IN ('hydrogen', 'dipole') THEN molecule_id END) AS weak_bonds FROM bond GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'van der Waals' AND molecule.label LIKE 'Wax%'

WITH member_privileges_analysis AS (SELECT privilege_level, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total_privileges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY privilege_level ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Privilege Top 3' AS result_type FROM member_privileges WHERE is_active = true AND privilege_scope = 'Leadership' GROUP BY privilege_level, member_id), privilege_members AS (SELECT privilege_level, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total_privileges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top Privilege' AS result_type FROM member_privileges WHERE is_active = true AND privilege_scope = 'Leadership' GROUP BY privilege_level, member_id) SELECT privilege_level, member_id, total_privileges, result_type FROM member_privileges_analysis WHERE rank <= 3 UNION ALL SELECT privilege_level, member_id, total_privileges, result_type FROM privilege_members WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, privilege_level, member_id

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN igg > 25 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_IgG, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN iga > 25 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_IgA, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN igm > 25 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_IgM FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Pb' AND b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-07-01' AND '2023-12-31' ORDER BY m.label DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST

SELECT RACEID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 1 THEN DRIVERID END) AS WINNER, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 2 THEN DRIVERID END) AS RUNNER_UP, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 3 THEN DRIVERID END) AS THIRD_PLACE FROM results WHERE POSITIONORDER <= 3 AND LAPS BETWEEN 41 AND 50 GROUP BY RACEID

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN bond_list AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type LIKE 'q%' AND b.transact_dt_tm > '2023-01-01' ORDER BY m.label NULLS LAST, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST

WITH PUBLISHER_RANK AS (SELECT ID, PUBLISHER_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ID ASC NULLS FIRST) AS RANK FROM PUBLISHER) SELECT P1.PUBLISHER_NAME AS CURRENT_PUBLISHER, P2.PUBLISHER_NAME AS PUBLISHER_BEFORE_3 FROM PUBLISHER_RANK AS P1 LEFT JOIN PUBLISHER_RANK AS P2 ON P2.RANK = P1.RANK - 3
SELECT p.id, p.sex, p.admission, AVG(l.c4) AS avg_complement_c4_level FROM patient AS p INNER JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.c4 > 20 GROUP BY p.id, p.sex, p.admission

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, bl.bond_id, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'H' AND bl.transact_dt_tm > '2023-01-01' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST
SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS total_elements FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 4 AND 9;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'He' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id ASC, b.bond_type DESC

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence, COUNT(pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence) AS metastasis_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = FALSE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence = FALSE GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence ORDER BY patients.patient_id;
SELECT MAX(a9) FROM (SELECT a9, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a9 DESC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM district) AS E WHERE (Rank = 3)

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_id, bl.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Zn' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, bl.bond_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type = 'disulfide' THEN 1 END) AS disulfide_bonds, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type IN ('amide', 'peptide') THEN molecule_id END) AS protein_bonds FROM bond_list GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS eye_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Sapphire%' AND sh.height_cm BETWEEN 175 AND 195 ORDER BY sh.id DESC
SELECT s.qualifyid, s.raceid, d.driverid FROM qualifying AS s INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = s.driverid WHERE s.raceid = 90 AND s.position < 12 AND d.nationality = 'South Korean'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Mg' AND br.bond_seq > 2 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, br.bond_seq DESC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Si' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 2 AND 4 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, e.event_name, b.remaining FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.remaining BETWEEN 900 AND 1600 ORDER BY b.remaining DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS fusion_id, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS substance_ref, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS characteristic FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Na%' OR b.bond_type IN ('amide', 'ester') ORDER BY fusion_id DESC, substance_ref ASC
SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS hair_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.hair_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Red%' ORDER BY sh.id DESC

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.lat AS circuitlatitude, d.dob AS driverbirthdate, co.nationality AS constructornationality, res.position AS finishposition, res.fastestlaptime FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2011 AND 2016 AND res.points > 14 AND res.positionorder <= 4 ORDER BY r.raceid DESC, res.fastestlaptime ASC

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, connected.bond_id FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id WHERE atom.element = 'Rn' AND connected.atom_id2 IS NULL ORDER BY molecule.label ASC, atom.atom_id DESC

SELECT s.superhero_name, c.colour, p.power_name FROM superhero s JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower p ON hp.power_id = p.id JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.gender_id = 2 AND s.weight_kg BETWEEN 80 AND 100 AND s.alignment_id = 1

SELECT r.raceid, r.name, COUNT(lt.driverid) AS driver_participation, AVG(lt.position) AS avg_finish_position, CASE WHEN AVG(lt.position) <= 5 THEN 'Top Performers' WHEN AVG(lt.position) <= 10 THEN 'Mid Field' ELSE 'Back Markers' END AS performance_category FROM races r JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid WHERE r.year > 2016 GROUP BY r.raceid, r.name HAVING COUNT(lt.driverid) > 12

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.lng AS circuitlongitude, d.dob AS driverbirthdate, co.constructorref AS constructorreference, res.positiontext AS positiontext, res.fastestlapspeed FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2012 AND res.points > 10 AND res.positionorder <= 5 ORDER BY r.raceid DESC, res.fastestlapspeed ASC

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bond.bond_id) AS unique_double_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'double' GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id;

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond_list.bond_id) AS recent_aromatic_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond_list ON molecule.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE bond_list.bond_type = 'aromatic' AND bond_list.transact_dt_tm > '2024-01-01' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY recent_aromatic_bonds DESC

SELECT molecule_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN transact_dt_tm END) AS transact_dt_tm_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN transact_dt_tm END) AS transact_dt_tm_2 FROM (SELECT molecule_id, transact_dt_tm, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY molecule_id ORDER BY transact_dt_tm DESC) AS rn FROM bond_list) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 2 GROUP BY molecule_id ORDER BY molecule_id

SELECT TA.ID, TA.BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING, TA.CHANCECREATIONPASSING, TA.DEFENCEPRESSURE, TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH FROM team_attributes AS TA WHERE TA.BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING < (SELECT AVG(BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.CHANCECREATIONPASSING > (SELECT AVG(CHANCECREATIONPASSING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCEPRESSURE < (SELECT AVG(DEFENCEPRESSURE) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH > (SELECT AVG(DEFENCETEAMWIDTH) FROM team_attributes)

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'ge' THEN 1 END) AS ge_atoms, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element IN ('si', 'sn') THEN molecule_id END) AS semiconductor_atoms FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count, COUNT(primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count) AS lymph_node_examined_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count BETWEEN 140 AND 160 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count ORDER BY patients.patient_id;
SELECT MAX(a11) FROM (SELECT a11, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a11 ASC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM district) AS E WHERE (Rank = 5)

SELECT raceid, positionorder AS modal_positionorder FROM (SELECT raceid, positionorder, COUNT(*) AS freq, MIN(resultid) AS first_occurrence, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(resultid) ASC) AS rn FROM results GROUP BY raceid, positionorder) sub WHERE rn = 1 AND positionorder BETWEEN 3 AND 8 ORDER BY raceid;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Fe' AND br.bond_seq > 3 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, br.bond_seq NULLS FIRST

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS member_count, zip_code.short_state FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'volunteer' AND zip_code.type = 'military' GROUP BY zip_code.short_state
SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'pt' THEN 1 END) AS pt_atoms, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element IN ('pd', 'rh') THEN molecule_id END) AS pd_atoms FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bond.bond_id) AS unique_aromatic_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'aromatic' GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id;
SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Stealth' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 10 AND 20)

SELECT m.email, e.event_name, b.spent, z.county FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.spent BETWEEN 50 AND 250 ORDER BY b.spent ASC NULLS FIRST
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE bond_type = 'QUADRUPLE') AS bond_type_count, molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS molecule_id_count FROM bond GROUP BY ROLLUP (molecule_id)
SELECT s.district FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('San Francisco', 'Marin') GROUP BY s.district HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 2;

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'B' AND toughness = '7') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '8888') WHEN (colors = 'W' AND toughness = '6') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '8889') WHEN (colors = 'U' AND toughness = '5') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '8890') WHEN (colors = 'R' AND toughness = '4') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '8891') END) AS watermark FROM cards

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS Events_Organized FROM member AS m JOIN event AS e ON m.member_id = e.event_id WHERE e.status = 'Approved' GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 3

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 85 THEN 85 WHEN s.id = 86 THEN 86 WHEN s.id = 87 THEN 87 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, c.colour FROM superhero AS s JOIN colour AS c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.id IN (85, 86, 87) AND c.colour = 'Black'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, bl.bond_id, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'He' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST
SELECT link_to_event, MIN(spent) AS min_spent FROM budget WHERE spent > 50 GROUP BY link_to_event HAVING MIN(spent) < 300

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence, AVG(demographics.weight) AS avg_weight FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence = TRUE AND demographics.gender = 'Female' AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_he > 4 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT m.phone, e.event_date, b.category, z.short_state FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.amount BETWEEN 1300 AND 1700 ORDER BY b.amount DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE element = 'HELIUM') AS element_count, molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS molecule_id_count FROM atom GROUP BY ROLLUP (molecule_id)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS member_count, zip_code.state FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'active' AND zip_code.type = 'standard' GROUP BY zip_code.state

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS merged_key, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS chem_id, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property_value FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond AS b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Br%' OR b.bond_type IN ('sigma', 'pi') ORDER BY merged_key DESC, chem_id ASC
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = 'GLUCOSE') AS label_count, molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS molecule_id_count FROM molecule GROUP BY ROLLUP (molecule_id)

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(atom.element) AS phosphorus_atoms FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'P' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY phosphorus_atoms DESC
SELECT t1.* FROM cards t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM cards GROUP BY artist, asciiname, name, setcode, rarity, convertedmanacost, power, toughness, colors, keywords, subtypes) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id
SELECT M.member_id, M.first_name, M.last_name FROM member AS M WHERE M.member_id IN (SELECT link_to_member FROM expense WHERE cost BETWEEN 50 AND 100) AND M.position = 'Volunteer Coordinator'

SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.country LIKE 'C%') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.name LIKE '%Street%')

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.country AS circuitcountry, d.forename AS driverfirstname, d.surname AS driverlastname, co.name AS teamname, res.grid AS qualifyingposition, res.fastestlaptime FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2003 AND 2007 AND res.points > 7 AND res.positionorder <= 9 ORDER BY r.raceid DESC, res.grid ASC
SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Reflexes' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 15 AND 35)

SELECT c.name, c.nationality, cs.wins FROM constructors c INNER JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE cs.points > 180 AND cs.wins > 5 ORDER BY cs.points DESC LIMIT 8;
SELECT cdscode, COUNT(phone) FROM schools WHERE county = 'Sacramento County' GROUP BY cdscode LIMIT 7

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS nitrogen_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'nitrogen' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'N%' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY nitrogen_bonds DESC

SELECT p.player_id, p.match_id, p.assists FROM player_stats p JOIN player_rate pr ON p.player_id = pr.id WHERE p.assists > 2 AND pr.overall_rating BETWEEN 80 AND 90 AND pr.potential_rating > 85 LIMIT 170;

SELECT year_created, profileimageurl, cnt_postlinks FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(pl.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.profileimageurl, COUNT(pl.id) AS cnt_postlinks, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(pl.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(pl.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM postlinks AS pl INNER JOIN users AS u ON pl.postid = u.id WHERE u.profileimageurl LIKE 'http%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(pl.creationdate AS DATE)), u.profileimageurl) AS pl WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_postlinks DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT MAX(a14) FROM (SELECT a14, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a14 ASC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM district) AS E WHERE (Rank = 3)
SELECT t1.team_long_name, t2.buildupplaypassing FROM team t1 INNER JOIN team_attributes t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.buildupplaypassing < 45

SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex, COALESCE(l.aptt, 0) AS aptt_level FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND l.aptt BETWEEN 20 AND 30 ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST

WITH member_events AS (SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, SUM(hours) AS total_hours, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_member ORDER BY SUM(hours) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top Hours' AS result_type FROM attendance WHERE hours > 0 GROUP BY link_to_member, link_to_event), event_members AS (SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, SUM(hours) AS total_hours, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_event ORDER BY SUM(hours) DESC) AS rank, 'Event Top Hours' AS result_type FROM attendance WHERE hours > 0 GROUP BY link_to_member, link_to_event) SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, total_hours, result_type FROM member_events WHERE rank <= 4 UNION ALL SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, total_hours, result_type FROM event_members WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, link_to_member, link_to_event

SELECT p.player_name, p.height, COUNT(pa.id) AS defensive_count FROM player p JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.interceptions > 80 AND p.height > 175 GROUP BY p.player_name, p.height HAVING COUNT(pa.id) > 5;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = 'hydrogen' AND m.label LIKE 'CH4%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.bond_type ASC

SELECT constructorid, name FROM (SELECT constructorid, name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY constructorid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM constructors GROUP BY constructorid, name) subq WHERE rank = 1

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.lng AS circuitlongitude, d.code AS drivercode, co.nationality AS constructornationality, res.position AS finishposition, res.fastestlaptime FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2017 AND 2022 AND res.points > 18 AND res.positionorder <= 3 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.fastestlaptime DESC
SELECT C.name, C.watermark FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Modern' AND C.convertedmanacost BETWEEN 3.0 AND 5.0

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplayspeed, ta.buildupplayspeedclass, ta.chancecreationshooting, ta.chancecreationshootingclass, ta.defenceaggression, ta.defenceaggressionclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2019-06-15 00:00:00'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Zn' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 2 AND 5 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.c4 FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'RA' AND l.c4 < 20 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.c4 HAVING COUNT(*) > 2) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.c4 = j.c4)

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq <= 2 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex, COALESCE(l.igg, 0) AS immunoglobulin_g_status FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.date BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Pt' AND bond.bond_type = 'coordinate' ORDER BY molecule.label ASC, atom.atom_id DESC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Pb' AND b.bond_type = 'double' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.bond_type DESC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Cd' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 3 AND 6 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, br.bond_seq DESC
SELECT bond_type, bond_seq FROM bond_ref WHERE bond_type LIKE 'Z%' ORDER BY bond_seq DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'MOL002') AS molecule_id_count, bond_type, COUNT(*) AS bond_type_count FROM bond GROUP BY ROLLUP (bond_type)

SELECT s.superhero_name, a.alignment, p.power_name FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower p ON hp.power_id = p.id WHERE s.weight_kg BETWEEN 95 AND 115 AND s.gender_id = 1 AND s.height_cm > 180
SELECT * FROM bond LEFT JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'triple' AND molecule.label LIKE 'BIO%'

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS chlorine_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'chlorine' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'Cl%' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY chlorine_bonds DESC

SELECT s.county, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numtsttakr FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.district = 'San Diego Unified' AND sa.rtype = 'D' ORDER BY sa.avgscrmath DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT atom_id as current_atom, LEAD(atom_id) OVER (ORDER BY bond_type) as next_atom, bond_id as bond_description FROM connected c

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS Total_Event_Expenses FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.event_status = 'Approved' AND b.category = 'Workshop' AND e.status = 'Planned' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 2500

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS single_bond_count FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'single' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'S%' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY single_bond_count DESC

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.short_passing FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.short_passing > 85

SELECT year_created, profileimageurl, cnt_comments FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.profileimageurl, COUNT(c.id) AS cnt_comments, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(c.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM comments AS c INNER JOIN users AS u ON c.userid = u.id WHERE u.profileimageurl IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.creationdate AS DATE)), u.profileimageurl) AS c WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_comments DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.gk_handling FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 175 AND 185 AND PA.gk_handling > 85
SELECT s.district FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('Los Angeles', 'Orange') GROUP BY s.district HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 2;
SELECT * FROM major WHERE major_name >= 'Political Science' AND major_name <= 'International Relations' AND college = 'Social Sciences' ORDER BY department DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplaypassing, ta.buildupplaypassingclass, ta.chancecreationshooting, ta.chancecreationshootingclass, ta.defenceteamwidth, ta.defenceteamwidthclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2025-12-15 00:00:00'
SELECT * FROM packages WHERE 3 = (CASE WHEN status = 'delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN weight_kg BETWEEN 1.0 AND 2.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN is_fragile = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, e.event_name, b.remaining FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.remaining BETWEEN 300 AND 900 ORDER BY b.remaining DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT t1.* FROM cards t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM cards GROUP BY toughness) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id
SELECT p.id, p.sex, p.admission, AVG(l.ldh) AS avg_ldh_level FROM patient AS p INNER JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.ldh > 200 GROUP BY p.id, p.sex, p.admission

SELECT year_created, websiteurl, cnt_badges FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.websiteurl, COUNT(b.id) AS cnt_badges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(b.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM badges AS b INNER JOIN users AS u ON b.userid = u.id WHERE u.websiteurl LIKE '%.io%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)), u.websiteurl) AS b WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_badges DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'H' AND br.bond_seq < 4 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, br.bond_seq ASC
SELECT C.name, C.rarity FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Legacy' AND C.convertedmanacost = 4.0
SELECT e.event_id FROM event AS e LEFT JOIN new_attendance AS na ON e.event_id = na.link_to_event WHERE na.link_to_event IS NULL AND e.status = 'planned' AND e.type = 'workshop'

SELECT s.dname AS district, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.5 + s.avgscrread * 0.3 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.2) AS balanced_sat_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.dname IN (SELECT s.dname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.dname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.5 + s.avgscrread * 0.3 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.2) ASC nulls last LIMIT 8) GROUP BY s.dname, sch.school ORDER BY s.dname, balanced_sat_score ASC;

SELECT bond_type, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN bond_seq END) AS bond_seq_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN bond_seq END) AS bond_seq_2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN bond_seq END) AS bond_seq_3 FROM (SELECT bond_type, bond_seq, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bond_type ORDER BY bond_seq DESC) AS rn FROM bond_ref) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 3 GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY bond_type

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.amount) AS Total_Event_Budget FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.event_status = 'Approved' AND b.category = 'Workshop' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.amount) > 2000
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.ball_control FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 180 AND 190 AND PA.ball_control > 85

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Ca' ORDER BY m.label DESC, a.atom_id DESC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST
SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id WHERE c.district_id BETWEEN 270 AND 280 AND d.type = 'OWNER' LIMIT 1650;

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS total_expenses FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-06-30' AND e.type = 'Workshop' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 1000 ORDER BY total_expenses DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'K' AND br.bond_seq > 2 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, br.bond_seq DESC

SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS total_budget FROM budget WHERE amount BETWEEN 200 AND 500 GROUP BY link_to_event HAVING SUM(amount) > 1000

SELECT bond_type, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN bond_seq END) AS bond_seq_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN bond_seq END) AS bond_seq_2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN bond_seq END) AS bond_seq_3 FROM (SELECT bond_type, bond_seq, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bond_type ORDER BY bond_seq DESC) AS rn FROM bond_ref) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 5 GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY bond_type
