SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Pb' AND b.bond_type = 'triple' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.bond_type DESC

WITH HERO_ATTRIBUTE_RANK AS (SELECT HERO_ID, ATTRIBUTE_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ATTRIBUTE_VALUE ASC NULLS FIRST) AS RANK FROM HERO_ATTRIBUTE) SELECT H1.HERO_ID AS CURRENT_HERO, H2.HERO_ID AS HERO_AFTER_4 FROM HERO_ATTRIBUTE_RANK AS H1 LEFT JOIN HERO_ATTRIBUTE_RANK AS H2 ON H2.RANK = H1.RANK + 4
SELECT * FROM packages WHERE 2 = (CASE WHEN status = 'processing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN weight_kg > 1.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN is_fragile = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, av.cnt FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN atom_view AS av ON a.atom_id = av.atom_id WHERE a.element = 'Kr' AND av.cnt BETWEEN 6 AND 9 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq BETWEEN 4 AND 6 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond_list.bond_id, bond_list.bond_type, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list ON connected.bond_id = bond_list.bond_id WHERE atom.element = 'Pb' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id ASC, atom.atom_id DESC, bond_list.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = 'hydrogen' AND m.label LIKE 'H2O%' AND a.element = 'H' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.bond_type DESC

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bond.bond_id) AS unique_carbon_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id INNER JOIN atom ON (bond.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id AND atom.element = 'C') GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Fe' AND br.bond_seq < 3 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, br.bond_seq NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = 'hydrogen' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id DESC, b.bond_type ASC
SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Perception' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 60 AND 80)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS member_count, zip_code.city FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'active' AND zip_code.type = 'military' GROUP BY zip_code.city

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS silicon_polar_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'polar' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'Si%' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY silicon_polar_bonds DESC

SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex, COALESCE(l.c3, 0) AS complement_c3_level FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND l.c3 > 100 ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT av1.cnt, av2.cnt FROM atom_view AS av1 INNER JOIN atom_view AS av2 ON (av1.cnt, av2.cnt) IN ((4, 5), (4, 6), (5, 6))

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS member_count, zip_code.state FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'officer' AND zip_code.type = 'standard' GROUP BY zip_code.state

WITH member_privileges_analysis AS (SELECT privilege_level, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total_privileges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY privilege_level ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Privilege Top 3' AS result_type FROM member_privileges WHERE is_active = true AND privilege_scope = 'Technology' GROUP BY privilege_level, member_id), privilege_members AS (SELECT privilege_level, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total_privileges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top Privilege' AS result_type FROM member_privileges WHERE is_active = true AND privilege_scope = 'Technology' GROUP BY privilege_level, member_id) SELECT privilege_level, member_id, total_privileges, result_type FROM member_privileges_analysis WHERE rank <= 3 UNION ALL SELECT privilege_level, member_id, total_privileges, result_type FROM privilege_members WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, privilege_level, member_id

WITH zip_members AS (SELECT state, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total_members, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY state ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'State Top 2' AS result_type FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code GROUP BY state, member_id), member_zips AS (SELECT state, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total_members, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top State' AS result_type FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code GROUP BY state, member_id) SELECT state, member_id, total_members, result_type FROM zip_members WHERE rank <= 2 UNION ALL SELECT state, member_id, total_members, result_type FROM member_zips WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, state, member_id
SELECT MIN(a11) FROM (SELECT a11, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a11 ASC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM district) AS E WHERE (Rank = 2)
SELECT * FROM budget WHERE amount >= 1500 AND amount <= 3000 AND link_to_event = 'recggMW2eyCYceNcy' ORDER BY spent DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(b.spent) AS Total_Spent_On_Workshops FROM member AS m JOIN budget AS b ON m.member_id = b.link_to_event JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.type = 'Workshop' AND e.status = 'Approved' AND b.spent > 200 GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 1200

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN igg > 32 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Extremely_High_IgG, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN iga > 32 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Extremely_High_IgA, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN igm > 32 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Extremely_High_IgM FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_type, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE bl.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-06-30' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, bl.transact_dt_tm ASC

WITH member_income_analysis AS (SELECT link_to_member, income_id, SUM(amount) AS total_income, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_member ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top Income' AS result_type FROM income GROUP BY link_to_member, income_id), income_members AS (SELECT link_to_member, income_id, SUM(amount) AS total_income, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY income_id ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC) AS rank, 'Income Top Member' AS result_type FROM income GROUP BY link_to_member, income_id) SELECT link_to_member, income_id, total_income, result_type FROM member_income_analysis WHERE rank <= 2 UNION ALL SELECT link_to_member, income_id, total_income, result_type FROM income_members WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, link_to_member, income_id

SELECT s.superhero_name, g.gender, p.power_name FROM superhero s JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower p ON hp.power_id = p.id WHERE s.alignment_id = 1 AND s.weight_kg > 100
SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Perception' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 25 AND 45)

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(b.spent) AS Total_Spent_On_Conferences FROM member AS m JOIN budget AS b ON m.member_id = b.link_to_event JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.type = 'Conference' AND e.status = 'Completed' AND b.spent > 300 GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 1500

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count, MIN(primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count) AS min_lymph_nodes_examined FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = FALSE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count < 5 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count ORDER BY patients.patient_id;
SELECT s.qualifyid, s.raceid, d.driverid FROM qualifying AS s INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = s.driverid WHERE s.raceid = 88 AND s.position < 11 AND d.nationality = 'Czech'

SELECT '2023-09-01' AS reporting_date, COUNT(CASE WHEN opendate < '2023-09-01' AND (closeddate IS NULL OR closeddate >= '2023-09-01') THEN 1 END) AS active_schools_in_san_luis_obispo FROM schools WHERE county = 'San Luis Obispo';

SELECT molecule_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN label END) AS label_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN label END) AS label_2 FROM (SELECT molecule_id, label, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY molecule_id ORDER BY label ASC) AS rn FROM molecule) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 2 GROUP BY molecule_id ORDER BY molecule_id

SELECT p.player_id, p.match_id, p.goals FROM player_stats p JOIN player_rate pr ON p.player_id = pr.id WHERE p.goals > 3 AND pr.overall_rating BETWEEN 90 AND 100 AND pr.potential_rating > 92 LIMIT 240;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Au' AND b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-06-30' ORDER BY m.label ASC, a.atom_id ASC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS FIRST

SELECT molecule_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN label END) AS label_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN label END) AS label_2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN label END) AS label_3 FROM (SELECT molecule_id, label, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY molecule_id ORDER BY label DESC) AS rn FROM molecule) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 5 GROUP BY molecule_id ORDER BY molecule_id
SELECT raceid, milliseconds FROM (SELECT raceid, milliseconds, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM laptimes GROUP BY raceid, milliseconds) subq WHERE rank = 1

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.expense_id) AS High_Value_Pending_Expenses FROM member AS m JOIN expense AS e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member WHERE e.approved = 'Pending' AND e.cost > 150 GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.expense_id) > 3
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.aggression FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 160 AND 170 AND PA.aggression > 85
SELECT driverid, laps FROM (SELECT driverid, laps, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY driverid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM results GROUP BY driverid, laps) subq WHERE rank = 1

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, lifestyle_and_risk_factors.history_of_esophageal_cancer, COUNT(lifestyle_and_risk_factors.history_of_esophageal_cancer) AS esophageal_cancer_count FROM patients JOIN lifestyle_and_risk_factors ON patients.patient_id = lifestyle_and_risk_factors.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND lifestyle_and_risk_factors.history_of_esophageal_cancer = TRUE GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, lifestyle_and_risk_factors.history_of_esophageal_cancer ORDER BY patients.patient_id;
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Hg%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS LAST, a.atom_id NULLS LAST

SELECT year_created, displayname, cnt_badges FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.displayname, COUNT(b.id) AS cnt_badges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(b.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM badges AS b INNER JOIN users AS u ON b.userid = u.id WHERE u.displayname LIKE 'J%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)), u.id, u.displayname) AS b WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_badges DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT year_created, displayname, cnt_votes FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(v.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.displayname, COUNT(v.id) AS cnt_votes, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(v.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(v.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM votes AS v INNER JOIN users AS u ON v.userid = u.id WHERE u.displayname LIKE 'Y%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(v.creationdate AS DATE)), u.id, u.displayname) AS v WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_votes DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'G' AND power = '7' AND toughness = '6') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '9195') WHEN (colors = 'W' AND power = '6' AND toughness = '5') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '9196') WHEN (colors = 'U' AND power = '5' AND toughness = '4') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '9197') WHEN (colors = 'B' AND power = '4' AND toughness = '3') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '9198') END) AS watermark FROM cards

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN hgb < 8 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Critical_Anemia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN plt < 50 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Critical_Thrombocytopenia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN wbc > 25 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Extreme_Leukocytosis FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'B' AND power = '5' AND toughness = '4') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7074') WHEN (colors = 'R' AND power = '4' AND toughness = '3') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7075') WHEN (colors = 'G' AND power = '3' AND toughness = '2') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7076') WHEN (colors = 'W' AND power = '2' AND toughness = '1') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7077') END) AS watermark FROM cards

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Editor' WHERE u.reputation >= 5000

SELECT raceid, positiontext AS modal_positiontext FROM (SELECT raceid, positiontext, COUNT(*) AS freq, MIN(resultid) AS first_occurrence, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(resultid) ASC) AS rn FROM results GROUP BY raceid, positiontext) sub WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY raceid;

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Good Answer' WHERE u.reputation >= 5000 AND u.creationdate > '2015-01-01'

SELECT player_id FROM player_stats_temp GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) > 10 AND (MAX(yellow_cards) - MIN(yellow_cards)) > 5;

WITH ATTRIBUTE_RANK AS (SELECT ID, ATTRIBUTE_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ID ASC NULLS FIRST) AS RANK FROM ATTRIBUTE) SELECT A1.ATTRIBUTE_NAME AS CURRENT_ATTRIBUTE, A2.ATTRIBUTE_NAME AS ATTRIBUTE_AFTER_3 FROM ATTRIBUTE_RANK AS A1 LEFT JOIN ATTRIBUTE_RANK AS A2 ON A2.RANK = A1.RANK + 3

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'O' ORDER BY m.label ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.bond_type NULLS FIRST

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.agility FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.agility > 85

SELECT s.dname AS district, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.5 + s.avgscrread * 0.3 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.2) AS balanced_sat_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.dname IN (SELECT s.dname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.dname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.5 + s.avgscrread * 0.3 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.2) DESC nulls last LIMIT 12) GROUP BY s.dname, sch.school ORDER BY s.dname, balanced_sat_score DESC;

SELECT link_to_member, SUM(cost) AS total_expense FROM expense WHERE cost > 45 GROUP BY link_to_member HAVING SUM(cost) > 180

SELECT bond_type, bond_seq FROM bond_ref WHERE bond_type LIKE 'R%' ORDER BY bond_seq DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT nationality, COUNT(*) FROM drivers GROUP BY nationality HAVING COUNT(*) > 25;

SELECT * FROM expense WHERE cost >= 250.0 AND cost <= 750.0 AND link_to_budget = 'recggMW2eyCYceNcy' ORDER BY expense_date DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.bond_type ASC) AS rnk FROM bond a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 4

WITH member_privileges_analysis AS (SELECT privilege_level, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total_privileges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY privilege_level ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Privilege Top 4' AS result_type FROM member_privileges WHERE is_active = false GROUP BY privilege_level, member_id), privilege_members AS (SELECT privilege_level, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total_privileges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top Privilege' AS result_type FROM member_privileges WHERE is_active = false GROUP BY privilege_level, member_id) SELECT privilege_level, member_id, total_privileges, result_type FROM member_privileges_analysis WHERE rank <= 4 UNION ALL SELECT privilege_level, member_id, total_privileges, result_type FROM privilege_members WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, privilege_level, member_id
SELECT atom_id, element FROM atom WHERE element LIKE 'H%' ORDER BY atom_id ASC NULLS FIRST

SELECT year_created, displayname, cnt_posts FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.displayname, COUNT(p.id) AS cnt_posts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(p.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM posts_backup AS p INNER JOIN users AS u ON p.owneruserid = u.id WHERE u.displayname LIKE 'O%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS DATE)), u.id, u.displayname) AS p WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_posts DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT * FROM cards WHERE 2 = (CASE WHEN artist LIKE 'V%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN convertedmanacost = 1.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN hasnonfoil = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);

SELECT year_created, aboutme, cnt_comments FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.aboutme, COUNT(c.id) AS cnt_comments, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(c.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM comments AS c INNER JOIN users AS u ON c.userid = u.id WHERE u.aboutme LIKE 'T%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.creationdate AS DATE)), u.aboutme) AS c WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_comments DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT a1.atom_id, a2.atom_id FROM test AS a1 INNER JOIN test AS a2 ON (a1.atom_id, a2.atom_id) IN (('T200', 'T201'), ('T200', 'T202'), ('T201', 'T202'))

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_ref.bond_seq FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_ref ON atom.element = 'Si' AND bond_ref.bond_type = 'polar' ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id DESC
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Rh%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS FIRST, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond_list.bond_id, bond_list.bond_type, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list ON connected.bond_id = bond_list.bond_id WHERE atom.element = 'Rn' AND bond_list.transact_dt_tm > '2028-01-01' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id DESC, atom.atom_id ASC, bond_list.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST

SELECT s.county, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numtsttakr FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.district = 'San Francisco Unified' AND sa.rtype = 'D' ORDER BY sa.avgscrmath DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS member_count, zip_code.county FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'inactive' AND zip_code.type = 'standard' GROUP BY zip_code.county

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, connected.atom_id2 FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id WHERE atom.element = 'V' AND connected.bond_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id ASC

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, connected.atom_id2 FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id WHERE atom.element = 'Pd' AND connected.bond_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY molecule.label ASC, atom.atom_id DESC

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.country AS circuitcountry, d.forename AS driverfirstname, d.surname AS driverlastname, co.name AS teamname, res.grid AS qualifyingposition, res.fastestlaptime FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2020 AND res.points > 18 AND res.positionorder <= 3 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.fastestlaptime DESC

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'U' AND power = '1') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '1016') WHEN (colors = 'B' AND power = '2') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '1017') WHEN (colors = 'R' AND power = '3') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '1018') WHEN (colors = 'G' AND power = '4') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '1019') END) AS watermark FROM cards

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Pt' AND b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-12-31' ORDER BY m.label DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence, AVG(demographics.weight) AS avg_weight FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence = TRUE AND demographics.gender = 'Female' AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_ihc > 2 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond_list.bond_id) AS recent_carbon_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond_list ON molecule.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE bond_list.bond_type = 'covalent' AND bond_list.transact_dt_tm > '2024-01-01' AND bond_list.molecule_id LIKE 'C%' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY recent_carbon_bonds DESC

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(b.amount) AS Total_Budget_Allocated FROM member AS m JOIN budget AS b ON m.member_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.event_status = 'Planned' AND b.amount > 400 GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING SUM(b.amount) > 2500
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MIN(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Joh%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 210000 AND height > 178 AND weight < 82);

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, connected.bond_id FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id WHERE atom.element = 'Ge' AND connected.atom_id2 IS NULL ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id ASC
SELECT bl1.bond_type, bl2.bond_type FROM bond_list AS bl1 INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl2 ON (bl1.bond_type, bl2.bond_type) IN (('AMIDE', 'ETHER'), ('AMIDE', 'HYDROPHOBIC'), ('ETHER', 'HYDROPHOBIC'))

WITH SUPERHERO_RANK AS (SELECT ID, SUPERHERO_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY WEIGHT_KG ASC NULLS FIRST) AS RANK FROM SUPERHERO) SELECT S1.SUPERHERO_NAME AS CURRENT_HERO, S2.SUPERHERO_NAME AS HERO_BEFORE_4 FROM SUPERHERO_RANK AS S1 LEFT JOIN SUPERHERO_RANK AS S2 ON S2.RANK = S1.RANK - 4
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MIN(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Vir%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 670000 AND height > 186 AND weight < 87);
SELECT * FROM member WHERE zip >= 10000 AND zip <= 20000 AND link_to_major = 'recggMW2eyCYceNcy' ORDER BY email DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT * FROM member WHERE zip >= 70000 AND zip <= 90000 AND link_to_major = 'recggMW2eyCYceNcy' ORDER BY first_name DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id WHERE atom.element = 'silver' AND atom.molecule_id LIKE 'METAL%'

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN igg > 28 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_IgG, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN iga > 28 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_IgA, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN igm > 28 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_IgM FROM laboratory GROUP BY id
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE element = 'FLUORINE') AS element_count, molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS molecule_id_count FROM atom GROUP BY ROLLUP (molecule_id)
SELECT m.member_id FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN income AS i ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member WHERE i.link_to_member IS NULL AND i.amount > 50

SELECT p.player_name, p.height, COUNT(pa.id) AS defensive_count FROM player p JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.interceptions > 65 AND p.height > 165 GROUP BY p.player_name, p.height HAVING COUNT(pa.id) > 4;

SELECT RACEID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 1 THEN DRIVERID END) AS WINNER, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 2 THEN DRIVERID END) AS RUNNER_UP, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 3 THEN DRIVERID END) AS THIRD_PLACE FROM results WHERE POSITIONORDER <= 3 AND LAPS > 15 GROUP BY RACEID

SELECT '2024-07-01' AS reporting_date, COUNT(CASE WHEN opendate < '2024-07-01' AND (closeddate IS NULL OR closeddate >= '2024-07-01') THEN 1 END) AS active_schools_in_san_diego FROM schools WHERE county = 'San Diego';

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.country AS circuitcountry, d.code AS drivercode, co.url AS constructorurl, res.grid AS startposition, res.fastestlaptime FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year < 2010 AND res.positionorder <= 5 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.grid DESC
SELECT * FROM zip_code WHERE zip_code >= 35000 AND zip_code <= 55000 AND state = 'Texas' ORDER BY county DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.element ASC) AS rnk FROM atom a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 10

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Pt' AND b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-06-30' ORDER BY m.label DESC, a.atom_id DESC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS FIRST

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplaydribbling, ta.buildupplaydribblingclass, ta.chancecreationshooting, ta.chancecreationshootingclass, ta.defenceaggression, ta.defenceaggressionclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2019-03-15 00:00:00'
SELECT M.member_id, M.first_name, M.last_name FROM member AS M WHERE M.member_id IN (SELECT link_to_member FROM attendance WHERE hours > 8) AND M.position = 'Senior Event Coordinator'
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.preferred_foot FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 170 AND 180 AND PA.preferred_foot = 'left'

SELECT sqA.alignment_count AS total_by_alignment, A.alignment AS alignment, C.colour AS skin_colour, sqAC.alignment_colour_count AS count_by_alignment_colour FROM (SELECT alignment_id, COUNT(*) AS alignment_count FROM superhero WHERE alignment_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY alignment_id) sqA INNER JOIN (SELECT alignment_id, skin_colour_id, COUNT(*) AS alignment_colour_count FROM superhero WHERE skin_colour_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY alignment_id, skin_colour_id) sqAC ON sqA.alignment_id = sqAC.alignment_id INNER JOIN alignment A ON sqA.alignment_id = A.id INNER JOIN colour C ON sqAC.skin_colour_id = C.id WHERE C.colour LIKE 'Blue%' ORDER BY A.alignment, C.colour;

SELECT year_created, displayname, cnt_posts FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.displayname, COUNT(p.id) AS cnt_posts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(p.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM posts_backup AS p INNER JOIN users AS u ON p.owneruserid = u.id WHERE u.displayname LIKE 'D%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS DATE)), u.id, u.displayname) AS p WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_posts DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT M.member_id, M.first_name, M.last_name FROM member AS M WHERE M.member_id IN (SELECT link_to_member FROM attendance WHERE hours < 3) AND M.position = 'Event Volunteer'

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.hct FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'RA' AND l.hct < 35 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.hct HAVING COUNT(*) > 2) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.hct = j.hct)

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS silicon_single_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'single' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'Si%' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY silicon_single_bonds DESC

SELECT p.player_name, p.height, COUNT(pa.id) AS dribbling_count FROM player p JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.dribbling > 80 AND p.height > 170 GROUP BY p.player_name, p.height HAVING COUNT(pa.id) > 5;

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_list ON atom.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Ru' AND bond_list.bond_type = 'coordinate' ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id ASC

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.aptt FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'PSS' AND l.aptt > 45 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.aptt HAVING COUNT(*) > 2) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.aptt = j.aptt)

SELECT m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(a.hours) AS Total_Event_Hours FROM member AS m JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.type = 'Conference' GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING SUM(a.hours) > 30

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS total_expenses FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2024-10-01' AND '2025-03-31' AND e.type = 'Conference' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 3000 ORDER BY total_expenses DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN bond_list AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = 'double' ORDER BY m.label NULLS FIRST, b.bond_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.country AS circuitcountry, d.forename AS driverfirstname, d.surname AS driverlastname, co.name AS teamname, res.grid AS qualifyingposition, res.fastestlaptime FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2022 AND res.points > 18 AND res.positionorder <= 4 ORDER BY r.raceid DESC, res.grid ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 700 THEN 700 WHEN s.id = 701 THEN 701 WHEN s.id = 702 THEN 702 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, c.colour FROM superhero AS s JOIN colour AS c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.id IN (700, 701, 702) AND c.colour = 'Pink'
SELECT * FROM cards WHERE 3 = (CASE WHEN artist LIKE 'C%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN convertedmanacost = 4.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN hasfoil = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);
SELECT a1.atom_id, a2.atom_id FROM atom AS a1 INNER JOIN atom AS a2 ON (a1.atom_id, a2.atom_id) IN (('AT700', 'AT701'), ('AT700', 'AT702'), ('AT701', 'AT702'))

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type = 'carbonyl' THEN 1 END) AS carbonyl_bonds, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type IN ('hydroxyl', 'carboxyl') THEN molecule_id END) AS functional_bonds FROM bond GROUP BY molecule_id;
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'triple' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'CHEM%'
SELECT p.id, p.sex, p.diagnosis, MAX(l.igg) AS max_igg_level FROM patient AS p INNER JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id GROUP BY p.id, p.sex, p.diagnosis

SELECT p.player_name, p.height, COUNT(pa.id) AS short_passing_count FROM player p JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.short_passing > 80 AND p.height > 170 GROUP BY p.player_name, p.height HAVING COUNT(pa.id) > 6;
SELECT p.id, p.sex, p.admission, AVG(l.aptt) AS avg_aptt_level FROM patient AS p INNER JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.aptt < 25 GROUP BY p.id, p.sex, p.admission

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Zn' AND br.bond_seq < 2 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, br.bond_seq ASC

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.amount) AS Total_Budget_Allocated FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.event_status = 'Approved' AND b.category = 'Networking' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.amount) > 2000

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.short_passing FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.short_passing > 88 AND Player_Attributes.vision > 82
SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS total_bonds FROM bond GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 15;

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS composite_id, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS chemical_id, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS trait FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond AS b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'F%' OR b.bond_type IN ('dative', 'coordinate') ORDER BY composite_id DESC, chemical_id ASC

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.short_passing FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.short_passing > 90
SELECT constructorId FROM constructorstandings WHERE points > 30 AND wins > 2;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq BETWEEN 22 AND 27 AND m.label LIKE 'Cu%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT TA.ID, TA.BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING, TA.CHANCECREATIONSHOOTING, TA.DEFENCEPRESSURE, TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH FROM team_attributes AS TA WHERE TA.BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING > (SELECT AVG(BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.CHANCECREATIONSHOOTING > (SELECT AVG(CHANCECREATIONSHOOTING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCEPRESSURE < (SELECT AVG(DEFENCEPRESSURE) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH > (SELECT AVG(DEFENCETEAMWIDTH) FROM team_attributes)

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.overall_rating FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.overall_rating > 85
SELECT atom_id, molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element LIKE 'Zr%' ORDER BY atom_id ASC NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Pt%' AND a.atom_id LIKE 'A%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS LAST, a.atom_id NULLS LAST
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Ada%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 400000 AND height > 175 AND weight < 80);

SELECT SUM(e.cost) AS total_expenses, SUM(b.remaining) AS remaining_budget, b.link_to_event FROM budget b JOIN (SELECT e.link_to_budget, SUM(e.cost) AS cost FROM expense e WHERE e.approved = 'yes' GROUP BY e.link_to_budget) AS e ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id WHERE b.event_status = 'active' GROUP BY b.link_to_event
SELECT * FROM expense WHERE cost >= 150.0 AND cost <= 450.0 AND link_to_member = 'recggMW2eyCYceNcy' ORDER BY expense_description NULLS FIRST

SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.country LIKE 'A%') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.name LIKE '%Acropolis%')
SELECT raceid, COUNT(*) FROM pitstops GROUP BY raceid HAVING COUNT(*) > 15;

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rbc < 4.0 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Low_RBC, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN hct < 35 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Low_Hematocrit, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN pt > 14 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS High_PT FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN got < 20 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Low_GOT, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN gpt < 20 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Low_GPT, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN ldh < 150 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Low_LDH FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

SELECT * FROM cards WHERE  3 = (CASE WHEN availability = 'paper' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN bordercolor = 'black' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN rarity = 'uncommon' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN types = 'Creature' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);

SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.country LIKE 'A%') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.name LIKE '%Raceway%')
SELECT link_to_member, SUM(cost) AS total_expense FROM expense WHERE cost > 10 GROUP BY link_to_member HAVING SUM(cost) > 30
SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS total_elements FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 5 AND 15;
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'peptide' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'BIO%'

SELECT raceid, points AS modal_points FROM (SELECT raceid, points, COUNT(*) AS freq, MIN(resultid) AS first_occurrence, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(resultid) ASC) AS rn FROM results GROUP BY raceid, points) sub WHERE rn = 1 AND points BETWEEN 8 AND 12 ORDER BY raceid;

SELECT RACEID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 1 THEN DRIVERID END) AS WINNER, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 2 THEN DRIVERID END) AS RUNNER_UP, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 3 THEN DRIVERID END) AS THIRD_PLACE FROM results WHERE POSITIONORDER <= 3 AND LAPS BETWEEN 51 AND 60 AND POINTS > 10 GROUP BY RACEID
SELECT t1.* FROM packages t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM packages GROUP BY internal_notes) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id
SELECT t1.* FROM legalities t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM legalities GROUP BY status) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = 'ionic' AND m.label LIKE 'MgCl2%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.bond_type DESC
SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id WHERE c.district_id BETWEEN 5 AND 15 AND d.type = 'DISPONENT' LIMIT 500;
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond_list WHERE bond_type = 'METALLIC') AS bond_type_count, transact_dt_tm, COUNT(*) AS transact_dt_tm_count FROM bond_list GROUP BY ROLLUP (transact_dt_tm)
SELECT s.constructorstandingsid, s.raceid, c.constructorid FROM constructorstandings AS s RIGHT JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorid = s.constructorid WHERE s.raceid = 25 AND s.points > 40

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Al' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST
SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race, c.colour FROM superhero s JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.weight_kg > 100 AND s.alignment_id = 2

SELECT TA.ID, TA.BUILDUPPLAYSPEED, TA.CHANCECREATIONPASSING, TA.DEFENCEAGGRESSION, TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH FROM team_attributes AS TA WHERE TA.BUILDUPPLAYSPEED < (SELECT AVG(BUILDUPPLAYSPEED) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.CHANCECREATIONPASSING > (SELECT AVG(CHANCECREATIONPASSING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCEAGGRESSION > (SELECT AVG(DEFENCEAGGRESSION) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH < (SELECT AVG(DEFENCETEAMWIDTH) FROM team_attributes)

SELECT t1.* FROM cards t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM cards GROUP BY artist, asciiname, name, setcode, rarity, convertedmanacost, power, toughness, colors, keywords, subtypes, types, layout, frameversion, bordercolor, watermark, multiverseid, originaltype) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id

WITH SUPERHERO_GROUP_RANK AS (SELECT ID, SUBGROUP2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUBGROUP1 DESC NULLS LAST) AS RANK FROM SUPERHERO_GROUP) SELECT S1.SUBGROUP2 AS CURRENT_SUBGROUP, S2.SUBGROUP2 AS SUBGROUP_AFTER_16 FROM SUPERHERO_GROUP_RANK AS S1 LEFT JOIN SUPERHERO_GROUP_RANK AS S2 ON S2.RANK = S1.RANK + 16

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT atom.atom_id) AS unique_gold_atoms FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Au' GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq BETWEEN 41 AND 45 AND m.label LIKE 'Pt%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Ag' AND b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-12-31' ORDER BY m.label DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(a.hours) AS Total_Hours FROM member AS m JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member WHERE a.hours BETWEEN 5 AND 15 GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING SUM(a.hours) > 8

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Ne' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 3 AND 6 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'B' AND power = '8') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '1048') WHEN (colors = 'U' AND power = '7') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '1049') WHEN (colors = 'R' AND power = '6') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '1050') WHEN (colors = 'G' AND power = '5') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '1051') END) AS watermark FROM cards

SELECT cards.asciiname, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT * FROM legalities WHERE legalities.format = cards.setcode AND legalities.status = 'Restricted' AND legalities.uuid = cards.uuid) THEN 'restricted_in_format' ELSE 'legal_in_format' END FROM cards

SELECT TA.ID, TA.BUILDUPPLAYSPEED, TA.CHANCECREATIONCROSSING, TA.DEFENCEPRESSURE, TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH FROM team_attributes AS TA WHERE TA.BUILDUPPLAYSPEED < (SELECT AVG(BUILDUPPLAYSPEED) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.CHANCECREATIONCROSSING > (SELECT AVG(CHANCECREATIONCROSSING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCEPRESSURE < (SELECT AVG(DEFENCEPRESSURE) FROM team_attributes)

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.lng AS circuitlongitude, d.code AS drivercode, co.constructorref AS constructorreference, res.positionorder AS finalposition, res.fastestlapspeed FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2012 AND 2017 AND res.points > 16 AND res.positionorder <= 6 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.fastestlapspeed DESC

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.glu FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'RA' AND l.glu > 150 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.glu HAVING COUNT(*) > 2) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.glu = j.glu)

SELECT m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(i.amount) AS Total_Scholarship_Income FROM member AS m JOIN income AS i ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member WHERE i.source = 'Scholarship' GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING SUM(i.amount) > 2500
SELECT C.name, C.artist FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Modern' AND C.convertedmanacost BETWEEN 5.0 AND 7.0

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_type, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE bl.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' AND m.label LIKE 'H2SO4%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, bl.transact_dt_tm ASC

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_ihc, MAX(primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_ihc) AS max_positive_ihc_lymph_nodes FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_ihc > 0 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_ihc ORDER BY patients.patient_id;
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE element = 'NITROGEN') AS element_count, molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS molecule_id_count FROM atom GROUP BY ROLLUP (molecule_id)

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'G' AND power = '4' AND toughness = '3') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '8088') WHEN (colors = 'W' AND power = '3' AND toughness = '2') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '8089') WHEN (colors = 'U' AND power = '2' AND toughness = '1') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '8090') WHEN (colors = 'B' AND power = '1' AND toughness = '0') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '8091') END) AS watermark FROM cards

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.location AS circuitlocation, d.number AS drivernumber, co.nationality AS teamnationality, res.positiontext AS positiontext, res.milliseconds AS racetime FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2008 AND 2012 AND res.points > 8 AND res.positionorder <= 6 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.milliseconds DESC

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN got > 45 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Elevated_GOT, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN gpt > 45 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Elevated_GPT, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN ldh > 275 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Elevated_LDH FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS hair_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.hair_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Crimson%' AND sh.height_cm > 180 ORDER BY sh.id DESC

SELECT s.city, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numge1500 FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.county = 'San Joaquin' AND sa.rtype = 'D' ORDER BY sa.avgscrmath DESC LIMIT 4;

SELECT q.qualifyid, q.raceid, q.driverid, q.position, CASE WHEN q.position <= 3 THEN 'Top 3' WHEN q.position <= 10 THEN 'Top 10' ELSE 'Other' END AS qualifying_performance FROM qualifying q WHERE q.position IS NOT NULL GROUP BY q.qualifyid, q.raceid, q.driverid, q.position HAVING q.position <= 15

SELECT p.player_name, p.weight, COUNT(pa.id) AS high_potential_count FROM player p JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.potential > 90 AND p.weight > 75 GROUP BY p.player_name, p.weight HAVING COUNT(pa.id) > 20;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = 'hydrogen' AND m.label LIKE 'HCl%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.bond_type DESC
SELECT p.id, p.sex, p.admission, AVG(l.igm) AS avg_igm_level FROM patient AS p INNER JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id GROUP BY p.id, p.sex, p.admission

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS alumni_count, zip_code.short_state FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'alumni' AND zip_code.type = 'military' GROUP BY zip_code.short_state
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.long_passing FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height > 185 AND PA.long_passing > 80

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, connected.atom_id2 FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id WHERE atom.element = 'Br' AND connected.bond_id IS NULL ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id ASC

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.cpk FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'RA' AND l.cpk > 180 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.cpk HAVING COUNT(*) > 2) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.cpk = j.cpk)

SELECT RACEID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 4 THEN DRIVERID END) AS FOURTH_PLACE, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 5 THEN DRIVERID END) AS FIFTH_PLACE, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 6 THEN DRIVERID END) AS SIXTH_PLACE FROM results GROUP BY RACEID

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'metallic' AND molecule.label LIKE 'Alloy%' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'MOL%'
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN bond_ref AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.bond_type WHERE b.bond_seq > 5 ORDER BY m.label NULLS FIRST, b.bond_seq NULLS FIRST

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond_list.bond_type FROM atom LEFT JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id2 LEFT JOIN bond_list ON connected.bond_id = bond_list.bond_id WHERE bond_list.bond_type = 'triple' AND bond_list.transact_dt_tm < '2023-06-01'

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS eye_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Onyx%' AND sh.height_cm BETWEEN 180 AND 200 ORDER BY sh.id DESC

SELECT s.city, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numge1500 FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.county = 'San Luis Obispo' AND sa.rtype = 'D' ORDER BY sa.avgscrwrite DESC LIMIT 4;
SELECT * FROM cards WHERE 3 = (CASE WHEN artist LIKE 'J%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN convertedmanacost > 4.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN hasfoil = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);
SELECT C.name, C.power FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Commander' AND C.convertedmanacost BETWEEN 5.0 AND 7.0

SELECT t1.* FROM cards t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM cards GROUP BY artist, asciiname, name, setcode, rarity, convertedmanacost, power, toughness, colors, keywords, subtypes, types, layout, frameversion) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id
SELECT bond_type, bond_seq FROM bond_ref WHERE bond_type LIKE 'X%' ORDER BY bond_seq DESC NULLS FIRST
SELECT link_to_member, SUM(hours) AS total_attendance_hours FROM attendance WHERE hours > 4 GROUP BY link_to_member HAVING SUM(hours) > 20

SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.country LIKE 'T%') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.name LIKE '%Test%')

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, bl.bond_id, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Ti' AND bl.transact_dt_tm < '2023-06-01' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplaypassing, ta.buildupplaypassingclass, ta.chancecreationcrossing, ta.chancecreationcrossingclass, ta.defencepressure, ta.defencepressureclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2016-03-15 00:00:00'

SELECT raceid, duration AS modal_duration FROM (SELECT raceid, duration, COUNT(*) AS freq, MIN(raceid) AS first_occurrence, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(raceid) ASC) AS rn FROM pitstops GROUP BY raceid, duration) sub WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY raceid;

SELECT s.cname AS county, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.5 + s.avgscrread * 0.25 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.25) AS balanced_sat_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.cname IN (SELECT s.cname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.cname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.5 + s.avgscrread * 0.25 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.25) DESC nulls last LIMIT 5) GROUP BY s.cname, sch.school ORDER BY s.cname, balanced_sat_score DESC;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Pb%' AND a.atom_id LIKE 'B%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS LAST, a.atom_id NULLS LAST
SELECT player_id FROM player_stats_temp GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) > 2 AND (MAX(red_cards) - MIN(red_cards)) > 1;

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.ethnicity, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count, COUNT(primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count) AS lymph_node_examined_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count BETWEEN 80 AND 90 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.ethnicity, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count ORDER BY patients.patient_id;
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Jam%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 280000 AND height > 178 AND weight < 82);

SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.attacking_work_rate FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 180 AND 190 AND PA.attacking_work_rate = 'High'

SELECT year_created, displayname, cnt_posthistory FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ph.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.displayname, COUNT(ph.id) AS cnt_posthistory, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ph.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(ph.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM posthistory AS ph INNER JOIN users AS u ON ph.userid = u.id WHERE u.displayname LIKE 'D%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ph.creationdate AS DATE)), u.id, u.displayname) AS ph WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_posthistory DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom_view WHERE cnt > 5) AS cnt_count, atom_id, COUNT(*) AS atom_id_count FROM atom_view GROUP BY ROLLUP (atom_id)
SELECT s.resultid, s.raceid, d.driverid FROM results AS s INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = s.driverid WHERE s.raceid = 78 AND s.points > 350 AND d.nationality = 'Swedish'
SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Durability' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 45 AND 65)
SELECT C.name, C.artist FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Pioneer' AND C.convertedmanacost BETWEEN 2.0 AND 4.0 AND C.rarity = 'Rare' AND C.hasfoil = 1

SELECT s.cname AS county, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.6 + s.avgscrread * 0.3 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.1) AS weighted_sat_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.cname IN (SELECT s.cname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.cname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.6 + s.avgscrread * 0.3 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.1) DESC nulls last LIMIT 5) GROUP BY s.cname, sch.school ORDER BY s.cname, weighted_sat_score DESC;
SELECT p.id, p.sex, p.admission, MIN(l.got) AS min_got_level FROM patient AS p INNER JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id GROUP BY p.id, p.sex, p.admission
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MIN(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Ber%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 790000 AND height > 177 AND weight < 81);
SELECT molecule_id, bond_type FROM bond_list WHERE bond_type = 'Double' ORDER BY transact_dt_tm ASC NULLS FIRST

SELECT c.constructorid, c.name, COUNT(q.qualifyid) AS qualifying_entries, CASE WHEN COUNT(q.qualifyid) > 40 THEN 'Elite' WHEN COUNT(q.qualifyid) > 20 THEN 'Established' ELSE 'Emerging' END AS team_status FROM constructors c JOIN qualifying q ON c.constructorid = q.constructorid WHERE q.position <= 10 GROUP BY c.constructorid, c.name HAVING COUNT(q.qualifyid) > 8

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS ionic_bond_count FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'ionic' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'I%' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY ionic_bond_count ASC
SELECT circuitid, COUNT(*) FROM circuits GROUP BY circuitid HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex, COALESCE(l.cpk, 0) AS creatine_phosphokinase_level FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-06-30' AND l.cpk > 180 ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT m1.molecule_id, m2.molecule_id FROM molecule AS m1 INNER JOIN molecule AS m2 ON (m1.molecule_id, m2.molecule_id) IN (('TR700', 'TR701'), ('TR700', 'TR702'), ('TR701', 'TR702'))

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond.bond_id, bond.bond_type FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE atom.element = 'H' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id ASC, atom.atom_id DESC, bond.bond_id NULLS LAST

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond_list.bond_id) AS recent_amide_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond_list ON molecule.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE bond_list.bond_type = 'amide' AND bond_list.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY recent_amide_bonds DESC

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS merged_key, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS compound_code, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS feature_type FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Cr%' OR b.bond_type IN ('covalent', 'ionic') ORDER BY merged_key DESC, compound_code ASC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Ar' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 4 AND 7 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT s.county, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numge1500 FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.district = 'San Diego Unified' AND sa.rtype = 'D' ORDER BY sa.avgscrwrite DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT hour_created, displayname, cnt_posts FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS TIMESTAMP)) AS hour_created, u.displayname, COUNT(p.id) AS cnt_posts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS TIMESTAMP)) ORDER BY COUNT(p.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM posts_backup AS p INNER JOIN users AS u ON p.owneruserid = u.id GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS TIMESTAMP)), u.id, u.displayname) AS p WHERE rn <= 6 ORDER BY hour_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_posts DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Cl' AND br.bond_seq > 4 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, br.bond_seq DESC

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, connected.bond_id FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id WHERE atom.element = 'Kr' AND connected.atom_id2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id ASC

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count, SUM(primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count) AS total_lymph_nodes_examined FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count > 5 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count ORDER BY patients.patient_id;
SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex, COALESCE(l.hct, 0) AS hematocrit_status FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT year_created, displayname, cnt_comments
FROM (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created,
        u.displayname,
        COUNT(c.id) AS cnt_comments,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.creationdate AS DATE))
            ORDER BY COUNT(c.id) DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
    FROM comments AS c
    INNER JOIN users AS u ON c.userid = u.id
    GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.creationdate AS DATE)), u.id, u.displayname
) AS c
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_comments DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT s.cname AS county, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.7 + s.avgscrread * 0.2 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.1) AS math_focused_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.cname IN (SELECT s.cname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.cname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.7 + s.avgscrread * 0.2 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.1) DESC nulls last LIMIT 4) GROUP BY s.cname, sch.school ORDER BY s.cname, math_focused_score DESC;

SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id WHERE c.district_id BETWEEN 80 AND 90 AND d.type = 'DISPONENT' LIMIT 850;

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_list ON atom.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Rb' AND bond_list.bond_type = 'ionic' ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id ASC
SELECT s.school FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('San Francisco', 'Alameda') GROUP BY s.school HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 2;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond_list.bond_id, bond_list.bond_type, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list ON connected.bond_id = bond_list.bond_id WHERE atom.element = 'Pb' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id DESC, atom.atom_id ASC, bond_list.transact_dt_tm NULLS FIRST

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.weight, treatment_and_followup.primary_pathology_eastern_cancer_oncology_group, MAX(primary_pathology_eastern_cancer_oncology_group) AS max_oncology_group FROM patients JOIN treatment_and_followup ON patients.patient_id = treatment_and_followup.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = FALSE AND treatment_and_followup.primary_pathology_eastern_cancer_oncology_group IS NOT NULL GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.weight, treatment_and_followup.primary_pathology_eastern_cancer_oncology_group ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Be' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 2 AND 4 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Cl' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 4 AND 7 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_list ON atom.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Ta' AND bond_list.bond_type = 'metallic' ORDER BY molecule.label ASC, atom.atom_id DESC
SELECT driverid, COUNT(*) FROM results GROUP BY driverid HAVING COUNT(*) > 50;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Hg' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 9 AND 11 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, br.bond_seq ASC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'S' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, br.bond_seq NULLS FIRST
SELECT s.resultid, s.raceid, d.driverid FROM results AS s INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = s.driverid WHERE s.raceid = 44 AND s.points > 135 AND d.nationality = 'Mexican'

SELECT s.dname AS district, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.3 + s.avgscrread * 0.5 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.2) AS reading_weighted_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.dname IN (SELECT s.dname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.dname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.3 + s.avgscrread * 0.5 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.2) DESC nulls last LIMIT 7) GROUP BY s.dname, sch.school ORDER BY s.dname, reading_weighted_score DESC;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq BETWEEN 1 AND 3 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST
SELECT link_to_event, AVG(hours) AS avg_hours FROM attendance WHERE hours > 1 GROUP BY link_to_event HAVING AVG(hours) > 3

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bond.bond_id) AS unique_ether_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'ether' GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'I' AND br.bond_seq < 3 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'glycosidic' AND molecule.label LIKE 'Polysaccharide%' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'CHEM%'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Cu' AND br.bond_seq < 3 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, br.bond_seq ASC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'O' AND br.bond_seq > 3 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, br.bond_seq DESC

SELECT e.event_name, COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS volunteer_count FROM event e LEFT JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2023-03-01' AND '2023-09-30' AND e.type = 'Volunteer' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING COUNT(a.link_to_member) > 2 ORDER BY volunteer_count ASC LIMIT 4
SELECT raceid, q3 FROM (SELECT raceid, q3, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM qualifying GROUP BY raceid, q3) subq WHERE rank = 1 AND q3 IS NOT NULL AND q3 <> '0'

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.aptt FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'PSS' AND l.aptt > 65 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.aptt HAVING COUNT(*) > 2) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.aptt = j.aptt)
SELECT * FROM superhero JOIN hero_power ON hero_power.hero_id = superhero.id WHERE NOT (superhero_name = 'Thor' AND height_cm BETWEEN 190 AND 210)
SELECT * FROM member_email WHERE email >= 'a' AND email <= 'm' AND member_id = 'recggMW2eyCYceNcy' ORDER BY first_name NULLS FIRST

WITH member_privileges_analysis AS (SELECT privilege_level, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total_privileges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY privilege_level ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Privilege Top 3' AS result_type FROM member_privileges WHERE is_active = true AND privilege_scope = 'Athletics' GROUP BY privilege_level, member_id), privilege_members AS (SELECT privilege_level, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total_privileges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top Privilege' AS result_type FROM member_privileges WHERE is_active = true AND privilege_scope = 'Athletics' GROUP BY privilege_level, member_id) SELECT privilege_level, member_id, total_privileges, result_type FROM member_privileges_analysis WHERE rank <= 3 UNION ALL SELECT privilege_level, member_id, total_privileges, result_type FROM privilege_members WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, privilege_level, member_id

SELECT * FROM cards WHERE 3 = (CASE WHEN artist LIKE 'F%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN convertedmanacost = 1.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN hasfoil = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_type, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE bl.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2025-06-01' AND '2025-12-31' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, bl.transact_dt_tm DESC
SELECT bond_id, bond_type FROM bond ORDER BY bond_type ASC NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_id, bl.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE bl.bond_type = 'covalent' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, bl.bond_id ASC

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS hair_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.hair_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Ginger%' AND sh.weight_kg BETWEEN 65 AND 85 ORDER BY sh.id ASC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Au' AND b.bond_type = 'metallic' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.bond_type DESC

SELECT link_to_member, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(event_date AS DATE)) AS total_attendance_days FROM attendance JOIN event ON attendance.link_to_event = event.event_id WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' GROUP BY link_to_member

SELECT raceid, constructorid AS modal_constructorid FROM (SELECT raceid, constructorid, COUNT(*) AS freq, MIN(resultid) AS first_occurrence, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(resultid) ASC) AS rn FROM results GROUP BY raceid, constructorid) sub WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY raceid;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS member_count, zip_code.state FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'volunteer' AND zip_code.type = 'standard' AND member.t_shirt_size = 'XXL' GROUP BY zip_code.state, member.position, zip_code.type, member.t_shirt_size, member.email, member.phone, member.first_name, member.last_name, member.link_to_major

SELECT sqP.publisher_count AS total_by_publisher, P.publisher_name AS publisher, R.race AS race, sqPR.publisher_race_count AS count_by_publisher_race FROM (SELECT publisher_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_count FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id) sqP INNER JOIN (SELECT publisher_id, race_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_race_count FROM superhero WHERE race_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id, race_id) sqPR ON sqP.publisher_id = sqPR.publisher_id INNER JOIN publisher P ON sqP.publisher_id = P.id INNER JOIN race R ON sqPR.race_id = R.id WHERE R.race LIKE 'Cyborg%' ORDER BY P.publisher_name, R.race;

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.amount) AS Total_Event_Budget FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.event_status = 'Approved' AND b.category = 'Charity' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.amount) > 2800
SELECT s.driverStandingsId, s.raceId, d.driverId FROM driverstandings AS s INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = s.driverId WHERE s.raceId = 30 AND s.points > 65 AND d.nationality = 'British'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS member_count, zip_code.short_state FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'alumni' AND zip_code.type = 'standard' GROUP BY zip_code.short_state

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Enthusiast' WHERE u.reputation >= 3000
SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Reflexes' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 20 AND 40)
