SELECT t1.team_long_name, t2.defencepressure FROM team t1 INNER JOIN team_attributes t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.defencepressure < 30
SELECT atom_id, molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element LIKE 'Pd%' ORDER BY atom_id DESC NULLS FIRST
SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, g.gender AS hero_gender FROM superhero AS sh JOIN gender AS g ON sh.gender_id = g.id WHERE g.gender LIKE '%Non-Binary%' ORDER BY sh.id DESC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_type, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE bl.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-07-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND m.label LIKE 'O2%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, bl.transact_dt_tm DESC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Ar' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.bond_type ASC

SELECT sqP.publisher_count AS total_by_publisher, P.publisher_name AS publisher, S.superhero_name AS superhero, sqPS.publisher_superhero_count AS count_by_publisher_superhero FROM (SELECT publisher_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_count FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id) sqP INNER JOIN (SELECT publisher_id, id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_superhero_count FROM superhero WHERE id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id, id) sqPS ON sqP.publisher_id = sqPS.publisher_id INNER JOIN publisher P ON sqP.publisher_id = P.id INNER JOIN superhero S ON sqPS.id = S.id WHERE P.publisher_name LIKE 'Image%' ORDER BY P.publisher_name, S.superhero_name;

SELECT bond_type, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN bond_seq END) AS bond_seq_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN bond_seq END) AS bond_seq_2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN bond_seq END) AS bond_seq_3 FROM (SELECT bond_type, bond_seq, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bond_type ORDER BY bond_seq ASC) AS rn FROM bond_ref) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 3 GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY bond_type

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, bl.bond_id, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Fe' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST
SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.full_name, g.gender AS sex FROM superhero AS sh JOIN gender AS g ON sh.gender_id = g.id WHERE g.gender LIKE '%Female%' ORDER BY sh.id DESC
SELECT b1.molecule_id, b2.molecule_id FROM bond AS b1 INNER JOIN bond AS b2 ON (b1.molecule_id, b2.molecule_id) IN (('MOL400', 'MOL401'), ('MOL400', 'MOL402'), ('MOL401', 'MOL402'))

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.amount) AS Total_Budget_Allocated FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.event_status = 'Approved' AND b.category = 'Charity' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.amount) > 3000
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.sprint_speed FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 190 AND 200 AND PA.sprint_speed > 85

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.remaining) AS remaining_budget FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2023-04-01' AND '2023-09-30' AND e.type = 'Workshop' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.remaining) > 500 ORDER BY remaining_budget DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, av.cnt FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN atom_view AS av ON a.atom_id = av.atom_id WHERE av.cnt = 2 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, av.cnt DESC

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.remaining) AS Total_Remaining_Budget FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.status = 'Planned' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.remaining) > 800
SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'metallic'
SELECT driverid, COUNT(*) FROM results GROUP BY driverid HAVING COUNT(*) > 40;

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, MIN(a.hours) AS Min_Hours FROM member AS m JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member WHERE a.hours < 8 GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING MIN(a.hours) < 5

SELECT s.superhero_name, a.attribute_name, ha.attribute_value FROM superhero s JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE ha.attribute_value BETWEEN 60 AND 80 AND s.alignment_id = 3

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond.bond_id, bond.bond_type FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id INNER JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE atom.element = 'Li' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id ASC, atom.atom_id DESC, bond.bond_id NULLS LAST

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'zr' THEN 1 END) AS zr_atoms, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element IN ('hf', 'rf') THEN molecule_id END) AS transition_metals FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT sqP.publisher_count AS total_by_publisher, P.publisher_name AS publisher, C.colour AS eye_colour, sqPC.publisher_colour_count AS count_by_publisher_colour FROM (SELECT publisher_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_count FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id) sqP INNER JOIN (SELECT publisher_id, eye_colour_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_colour_count FROM superhero WHERE eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id, eye_colour_id) sqPC ON sqP.publisher_id = sqPC.publisher_id INNER JOIN publisher P ON sqP.publisher_id = P.id INNER JOIN colour C ON sqPC.eye_colour_id = C.id WHERE C.colour LIKE 'Amber%' ORDER BY P.publisher_name, C.colour;

SELECT s.superhero_name, a.alignment, p.publisher_name FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE s.height_cm > 190 AND s.gender_id = 3 AND s.weight_kg < 90
SELECT driverid, grid FROM (SELECT driverid, grid, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY driverid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM results GROUP BY driverid, grid) subq WHERE rank = 1

WITH RACE_RANK AS (SELECT ID, RACE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ID DESC NULLS LAST) AS RANK FROM RACE) SELECT R1.RACE AS CURRENT_RACE, R2.RACE AS RACE_AFTER_5 FROM RACE_RANK AS R1 LEFT JOIN RACE_RANK AS R2 ON R2.RANK = R1.RANK + 5

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Ne' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 1 AND 4 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST
SELECT * FROM cards WHERE 2 = (CASE WHEN artist LIKE 'Q%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN convertedmanacost = 4.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN hasnonfoil = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Illuminator' WHERE u.reputation >= 32000 AND u.creationdate > '2018-01-01'

SELECT RACEID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 1 THEN DRIVERID END) AS WINNER, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 2 THEN DRIVERID END) AS RUNNER_UP, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 3 THEN DRIVERID END) AS THIRD_PLACE FROM results WHERE POSITIONORDER <= 3 AND LAPS BETWEEN 211 AND 220 GROUP BY RACEID

SELECT s.cname AS county, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 1.35 + s.avgscrread * 0.65) AS weighted_math_read_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.cname IN (SELECT s.cname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.cname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 1.35 + s.avgscrread * 0.65) DESC nulls last LIMIT 5) GROUP BY s.cname, sch.school ORDER BY s.cname, weighted_math_read_score DESC;

WITH member_events AS (SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, SUM(hours) AS total_hours, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_member ORDER BY SUM(hours) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top Hours' AS result_type FROM attendance WHERE hours > 3 GROUP BY link_to_member, link_to_event), event_members AS (SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, SUM(hours) AS total_hours, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_event ORDER BY SUM(hours) DESC) AS rank, 'Event Top Hours' AS result_type FROM attendance WHERE hours > 3 GROUP BY link_to_member, link_to_event) SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, total_hours, result_type FROM member_events WHERE rank <= 3 UNION ALL SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, total_hours, result_type FROM event_members WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, link_to_member, link_to_event

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN igg > 24 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_IgG, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN iga > 24 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_IgA, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN igm > 24 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_IgM FROM laboratory GROUP BY id
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id2 = atom.atom_id WHERE atom.element = 'titanium' AND atom.molecule_id LIKE 'ALLOY%'

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'G' AND power = '4' AND toughness = '3') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7074') WHEN (colors = 'W' AND power = '3' AND toughness = '2') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7075') WHEN (colors = 'U' AND power = '2' AND toughness = '1') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7076') WHEN (colors = 'B' AND power = '1' AND toughness = '0') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7077') END) AS watermark FROM cards

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Ne' AND br.bond_seq > 2 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, br.bond_seq DESC

SELECT s.cname AS county, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.6 + s.avgscrread * 0.3 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.1) AS weighted_sat_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.cname IN (SELECT s.cname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.cname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.6 + s.avgscrread * 0.3 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.1) ASC nulls last LIMIT 5) GROUP BY s.cname, sch.school ORDER BY s.cname, weighted_sat_score ASC;

WITH SUPERHERO_RANK AS (SELECT ID, SUPERHERO_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY WEIGHT_KG ASC NULLS FIRST) AS RANK FROM SUPERHERO) SELECT S1.SUPERHERO_NAME AS CURRENT_HERO, S2.SUPERHERO_NAME AS HERO_BEFORE_11 FROM SUPERHERO_RANK AS S1 LEFT JOIN SUPERHERO_RANK AS S2 ON S2.RANK = S1.RANK - 11

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.fastestlapspeed FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL AND r.position <= 5 AND r.points > 25 ORDER BY r.fastestlapspeed DESC LIMIT 12;

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_ref.bond_seq FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_ref ON atom.element = 'Cl' AND bond_ref.bond_type = 'ionic' ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id DESC

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS merged_identifier, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS chemical_code, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property_value FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond_list AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Ga%' OR b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-01-15' AND '2023-06-15' ORDER BY merged_identifier ASC, chemical_code DESC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Tc' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 11 AND 14 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, br.bond_seq DESC

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS composite_key, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS molecule_ref, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond_list AS b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Rh%' OR b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' ORDER BY composite_key ASC, molecule_ref DESC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq BETWEEN 5 AND 10 AND m.label LIKE 'N%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST
SELECT AVG(cost) AS avg_cost, link_to_budget FROM expense GROUP BY link_to_budget

SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex, COALESCE(l.aptt, 0) AS aptt_level FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND l.aptt BETWEEN 65 AND 75 ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS total_expenses FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-06-30' AND e.type = 'Seminar' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 1000 ORDER BY total_expenses DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT raceid, positiontext FROM (SELECT raceid, positiontext, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC) AS rank FROM results GROUP BY raceid, positiontext) subq WHERE rank = 1

SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex, COALESCE(l.c3, 0) AS complement_c3_level FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31' AND l.c3 > 110 ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT * FROM cards WHERE 3 = (CASE WHEN artist LIKE 'R%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN convertedmanacost = 2.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN hasfoil = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);

SELECT player_id FROM player_stats GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) > 25 AND (MAX(yellow_cards) - MIN(yellow_cards)) > 12;
SELECT atom_id, molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element LIKE 'Sr%' ORDER BY molecule_id DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT bond_type, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN bond_seq END) AS bond_seq_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN bond_seq END) AS bond_seq_2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN bond_seq END) AS bond_seq_3 FROM (SELECT bond_type, bond_seq, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bond_type ORDER BY bond_seq) AS rn FROM bond_ref) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 3 GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY bond_type

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 153 THEN 153 WHEN s.id = 154 THEN 154 WHEN s.id = 155 THEN 155 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, sg.subgroup1 FROM superhero AS s JOIN superhero_group AS sg ON s.id = sg.id WHERE s.id IN (153, 154, 155) AND sg.subgroup1 < 3

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, av.cnt FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN atom_view AS av ON a.atom_id = av.atom_id WHERE av.cnt BETWEEN 6 AND 8 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST
SELECT s.district FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('San Joaquin', 'Stanislaus') AND s.charter = 0 AND s.magnet = 0 AND s.virtual = 'N' GROUP BY s.district HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 2;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, av.cnt FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN atom_view AS av ON a.atom_id = av.atom_id WHERE a.element = 'Ne' AND av.cnt BETWEEN 4 AND 7 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST
SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Creativity' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 10 AND 30)

SELECT atom_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN element END) AS element_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN element END) AS element_2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN element END) AS element_3 FROM (SELECT atom_id, element, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY atom_id ORDER BY element) AS rn FROM atom) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 3 GROUP BY atom_id ORDER BY atom_id
SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Agility' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 40 AND 60)
SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM circuits GROUP BY country HAVING COUNT(*) > 2;

SELECT c.name, c.nationality, cs.points FROM constructors c INNER JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE cs.points > 500 AND cs.wins > 35 ORDER BY cs.points DESC LIMIT 20;
SELECT link_to_member, SUM(hours) AS total_volunteer_hours FROM attendance WHERE hours BETWEEN 2 AND 5 GROUP BY link_to_member HAVING SUM(hours) > 15

SELECT m.phone, e.location, b.category, z.state FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.amount BETWEEN 1000 AND 2000 ORDER BY b.amount DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race, p.power_name FROM superhero s JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower p ON hp.power_id = p.id WHERE s.weight_kg BETWEEN 80 AND 100 AND s.alignment_id = 2

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond_list.bond_id, bond_list.bond_type, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list ON connected.bond_id = bond_list.bond_id WHERE atom.element = 'Rn' AND bond_list.transact_dt_tm > '2029-01-01' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id DESC, atom.atom_id ASC, bond_list.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.ua FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'RA' AND l.ua > 7.0 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.ua HAVING COUNT(*) > 2) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.ua = j.ua)

SELECT s.county, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numtsttakr FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.district = 'Oakland Unified' AND sa.rtype = 'S' ORDER BY sa.avgscrread DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT * FROM member_privileges WHERE privilege_level >= 'Trainee' AND privilege_level <= 'Supervisor' AND member_id = 'recggMW2eyCYceNcy' ORDER BY last_verified_date DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.country AS circuitcountry, d.forename AS driverfirstname, d.surname AS driverlastname, co.name AS teamname, res.grid AS qualifyingposition, res.fastestlaptime FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2014 AND 2019 AND res.points > 12 AND res.positionorder <= 5 ORDER BY r.raceid DESC, res.fastestlaptime ASC
SELECT * FROM cards WHERE 3 = (CASE WHEN artist LIKE 'D%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN convertedmanacost = 5.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN hasnonfoil = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);

WITH test (
    col1,
    col2,
    col3
) AS (
    VALUES
        ('pers1', 'nom', 'Aurelie'),
        ('pers1', 'prenom', 'Dupont'),
        ('pers1', 'age', '25'),
        ('pers2', 'nom', 'Stephane'),
        ('pers2', 'prenom', 'Blanc'),
        ('pers2', 'age', '45')
)

SELECT
    col1,
    MAX(CASE
        WHEN col2 = 'nom' THEN col3
    END) AS nom,
    MAX(CASE
        WHEN col2 = 'prenom' THEN col3
    END) AS prenom,
    MAX(CASE
        WHEN col2 = 'age' THEN col3
    END) AS age
FROM test
GROUP BY col1;

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS Total_Expenses FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.event_status = 'In Review' AND b.category = 'Social' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 600

SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.curve FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 165 AND 175 AND PA.curve > 80

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = 'hydrogen' AND m.label LIKE 'H2O%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.bond_type DESC

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS Total_Event_Expenses FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.event_status = 'Approved' AND b.category = 'Training' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 1200

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 650 THEN 650 WHEN s.id = 651 THEN 651 WHEN s.id = 652 THEN 652 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, c.colour FROM superhero AS s JOIN colour AS c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.id IN (650, 651, 652) AND c.colour = 'Silver'

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_list ON atom.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Ne' AND bond_list.bond_type = 'hydrogen' ORDER BY molecule.label ASC, atom.atom_id DESC
SELECT t1.* FROM cards t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM cards GROUP BY isstoryspotlight) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = 'ionic' AND m.label LIKE 'MgO%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.bond_type DESC

SELECT t1.* FROM card_choice t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM card_choice GROUP BY non_valid_cards) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.lat AS circuitlatitude, d.code AS drivercode, co.nationality AS constructornationality, res.position AS finishposition, res.fastestlapspeed FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2021 AND res.points > 18 AND res.positionorder <= 3 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.fastestlapspeed DESC
SELECT s.resultid, s.raceid, d.driverid FROM results AS s INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = s.driverid WHERE s.raceid = 36 AND s.points > 95 AND d.nationality = 'Dutch'
SELECT a1.element, a2.element FROM atom AS a1 INNER JOIN atom AS a2 ON (a1.element, a2.element) IN (('N', 'P'), ('N', 'S'), ('P', 'S'))

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, bl.bond_id, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Kr' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST
SELECT bl1.bond_id, bl2.bond_id FROM bond_list AS bl1 INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl2 ON (bl1.bond_id, bl2.bond_id) IN (('BL700', 'BL701'), ('BL700', 'BL702'), ('BL701', 'BL702'))

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS hair_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.hair_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Purple%' AND sh.weight_kg > 80 ORDER BY sh.id ASC
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.position FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.position <= 3 ORDER BY r.points ASC LIMIT 5;

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS merged_id, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS compound_ref, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS feature FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond_list AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Mn%' OR b.transact_dt_tm > '2023-03-15' ORDER BY merged_id DESC, compound_ref ASC
SELECT * FROM packages WHERE 3 = (CASE WHEN status = 'shipped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN weight_kg > 1.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN is_fragile = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);
SELECT link_to_major, AVG(zip) AS avg_zip_code FROM member WHERE zip BETWEEN 40000 AND 80000 GROUP BY link_to_major HAVING AVG(zip) > 55000

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.aptt FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'RA' AND l.aptt > 38 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.aptt HAVING COUNT(*) > 2) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.aptt = j.aptt)

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS combined_id, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS molecule_name, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond_list AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'As%' OR b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-07-01' AND '2023-12-31' ORDER BY combined_id ASC, molecule_name DESC
SELECT p.id, p.sex, p.admission, AVG(l.got) AS avg_got_level FROM patient AS p INNER JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.got < 50 GROUP BY p.id, p.sex, p.admission

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 10 THEN 10 WHEN s.id = 11 THEN 11 WHEN s.id = 12 THEN 12 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, r.race FROM superhero AS s JOIN race AS r ON s.race_id = r.id WHERE s.id IN (10, 11, 12)
SELECT av1.atom_id, av2.atom_id FROM atom_view AS av1 INNER JOIN atom_view AS av2 ON (av1.atom_id, av2.atom_id) IN (('AV200', 'AV201'), ('AV200', 'AV202'), ('AV201', 'AV202'))

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = 'double' AND m.label LIKE 'CO2%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.bond_type DESC

SELECT year_created, profileimageurl, cnt_posts FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.profileimageurl, COUNT(p.id) AS cnt_posts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(p.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM posts_backup AS p INNER JOIN users AS u ON p.owneruserid = u.id WHERE u.profileimageurl LIKE '%.jpg%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS DATE)), u.profileimageurl) AS p WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_posts DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(b.remaining) AS Total_Available_Budget FROM member AS m JOIN budget AS b ON m.member_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.event_status = 'Approved' AND b.remaining > 250 GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING SUM(b.remaining) > 2000
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.heading_accuracy FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 180 AND 190 AND PA.heading_accuracy > 85

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 300 THEN 300 WHEN s.id = 301 THEN 301 WHEN s.id = 302 THEN 302 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, sp.power_name FROM superhero AS s JOIN hero_power AS hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE s.id IN (300, 301, 302) AND sp.power_name LIKE 'Teleportation%'
SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id WHERE c.district_id BETWEEN 3 AND 8 AND d.type = 'OWNER' LIMIT 550;

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.alb FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'SLE' AND l.alb < 3.0 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.alb HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.alb = j.alb)

SELECT bond_type, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN transact_dt_tm END) AS transact_dt_tm_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN transact_dt_tm END) AS transact_dt_tm_2 FROM (SELECT bond_type, transact_dt_tm, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bond_type ORDER BY transact_dt_tm ASC) AS rn FROM bond_list) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 2 GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY bond_type

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.reactions FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.reactions > 95

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS combined_id, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS molecule_ref, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond AS b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'H%' OR b.bond_type IN ('triple', 'aromatic') ORDER BY combined_id DESC, molecule_ref ASC

SELECT sqA.alignment_count AS total_by_alignment, A.alignment AS alignment, C.colour AS skin_colour, sqAC.alignment_colour_count AS count_by_alignment_colour FROM (SELECT alignment_id, COUNT(*) AS alignment_count FROM superhero WHERE alignment_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY alignment_id) sqA INNER JOIN (SELECT alignment_id, skin_colour_id, COUNT(*) AS alignment_colour_count FROM superhero WHERE skin_colour_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY alignment_id, skin_colour_id) sqAC ON sqA.alignment_id = sqAC.alignment_id INNER JOIN alignment A ON sqA.alignment_id = A.id INNER JOIN colour C ON sqAC.skin_colour_id = C.id WHERE C.colour LIKE 'Pink%' ORDER BY A.alignment, C.colour;
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected WHERE atom_id2 = 'ATOM011') AS atom_id2_count, bond_id, COUNT(*) AS bond_id_count FROM connected GROUP BY ROLLUP (bond_id)

SELECT year_created, displayname, cnt_votes FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(v.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.displayname, COUNT(v.id) AS cnt_votes, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(v.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(v.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM votes AS v INNER JOIN users AS u ON v.userid = u.id WHERE u.displayname LIKE 'J%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(v.creationdate AS DATE)), u.id, u.displayname) AS v WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_votes DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Reflexes' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 40 AND 60)

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Pb' ORDER BY m.label DESC, a.atom_id DESC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST

WITH SUPERHERO_RANK AS (SELECT ID, SUPERHERO_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY HEIGHT_CM DESC NULLS LAST) AS RANK FROM SUPERHERO) SELECT S1.SUPERHERO_NAME AS CURRENT_HERO, S2.SUPERHERO_NAME AS HERO_BEFORE_13 FROM SUPERHERO_RANK AS S1 LEFT JOIN SUPERHERO_RANK AS S2 ON S2.RANK = S1.RANK - 13
SELECT * FROM member_privileges WHERE privilege_level >= 'Intern' AND privilege_level <= 'Manager' AND member_id = 'recggMW2eyCYceNcy' ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT s.superhero_name, g.gender, p.power_name FROM superhero s JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower p ON hp.power_id = p.id WHERE s.alignment_id = 3 AND s.weight_kg BETWEEN 60 AND 80

SELECT cards.asciiname, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT * FROM legalities WHERE legalities.format = cards.setcode AND legalities.status = 'Banned' AND legalities.uuid = cards.uuid AND legalities.id = cards.id AND legalities.format = 'Commander') THEN 'banned_in_commander' ELSE 'legal_in_commander' END FROM cards

SELECT bond_type, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN bond_seq END) AS bond_seq_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN bond_seq END) AS bond_seq_2 FROM (SELECT bond_type, bond_seq, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bond_type ORDER BY bond_seq DESC) AS rn FROM bond_ref) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 3 GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY bond_type

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS combined_key, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS molecule_ref, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property_type FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Hg%' OR b.bond_type IN ('hydrogen', 'ionic') ORDER BY combined_key DESC, molecule_ref ASC

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond_list.bond_id) AS recent_metal_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond_list ON molecule.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE bond_list.bond_type = 'metallic' AND bond_list.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY recent_metal_bonds DESC

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'ag' THEN 1 END) AS silver_atoms, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element IN ('au', 'pt') THEN molecule_id END) AS precious_metal_atoms FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT TA.ID, TA.BUILDUPPLAYSPEED, TA.CHANCECREATIONSHOOTING, TA.DEFENCEPRESSURE, TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH FROM team_attributes AS TA WHERE TA.BUILDUPPLAYSPEED > (SELECT AVG(BUILDUPPLAYSPEED) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.CHANCECREATIONSHOOTING > (SELECT AVG(CHANCECREATIONSHOOTING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCEPRESSURE < (SELECT AVG(DEFENCEPRESSURE) FROM team_attributes)

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_type, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE bl.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND m.label LIKE 'NaCl%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, bl.transact_dt_tm DESC

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN hgb < 9 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Severe_Anemia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN plt < 80 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Critical_Thrombocytopenia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN wbc > 20 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Extreme_Leukocytosis FROM laboratory GROUP BY id
SELECT m.member_id FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN income AS i ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member WHERE i.link_to_member IS NULL AND i.amount > 100 AND m.position = 'Officer' AND i.source = 'fundraiser'
SELECT cdscode, COUNT(closeddate) FROM schools WHERE county = 'Marin County' GROUP BY cdscode LIMIT 12
SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'ester' AND molecule.label LIKE 'Resin%'
SELECT atom_id, element FROM atom WHERE element LIKE 'S%' ORDER BY molecule_id ASC NULLS FIRST

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bond.bond_id) AS unique_germanium_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id INNER JOIN atom ON (bond.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id AND atom.element = 'Ge') GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id;
SELECT s.district FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('San Mateo', 'Santa Cruz') AND s.charter = 1 AND s.magnet = 0 AND s.virtual = 'N' GROUP BY s.district HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 3;

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'ru' THEN 1 END) AS ru_atoms, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element IN ('rh', 'pd') THEN molecule_id END) AS platinum_group_atoms FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.lat AS circuitlatitude, d.code AS drivercode, co.nationality AS constructornationality, res.position AS finishposition, res.fastestlaptime FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2012 AND 2017 AND res.points > 8 AND res.positionorder <= 5 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.fastestlaptime DESC

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(b.spent) AS Total_Spent_On_Conferences FROM member AS m JOIN budget AS b ON m.member_id = b.link_to_event JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.type = 'Conference' AND e.status = 'Completed' AND b.spent > 1000 GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 6000

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS total_expenses FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2023-07-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND e.type = 'Workshop' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 500 ORDER BY total_expenses ASC LIMIT 4
SELECT atom_id as current_atom, LEAD(atom_id) OVER (ORDER BY bond_seq) as next_atom, bond_type as bond_description FROM bond_ref b JOIN connected c ON b.bond_type = c.bond_id

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Si' AND br.bond_seq > 2 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, br.bond_seq ASC
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'peptide' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'PHARM%'

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, COUNT(r.raceid) AS race_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.raceid) > 20 THEN 'Historic' WHEN COUNT(r.raceid) > 10 THEN 'Classic' ELSE 'Modern' END AS circuit_category FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid WHERE r.year > 2005 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country HAVING COUNT(r.raceid) > 8

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'pu' THEN 1 END) AS pu_atoms, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element IN ('am', 'cm') THEN molecule_id END) AS actinide_atoms FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplayspeed, ta.buildupplayspeedclass, ta.chancecreationpassing, ta.chancecreationpassingclass, ta.defenceteamwidth, ta.defenceteamwidthclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2025-05-15 00:00:00'
SELECT b1.molecule_id, b2.molecule_id FROM bond AS b1 INNER JOIN bond AS b2 ON (b1.molecule_id, b2.molecule_id) IN (('MOL300', 'MOL301'), ('MOL300', 'MOL302'), ('MOL301', 'MOL302'))

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'rh' THEN 1 END) AS rh_atoms, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element IN ('pd', 'pt') THEN molecule_id END) AS platinum_group_atoms FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT s.superhero_name, a.attribute_name, ha.attribute_value FROM superhero s JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE ha.attribute_value BETWEEN 25 AND 45 AND s.alignment_id = 2

SELECT molecule_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN bond_id END) AS bond_id_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN bond_id END) AS bond_id_2 FROM (SELECT molecule_id, bond_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY molecule_id ORDER BY bond_id DESC) AS rn FROM bond) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 2 GROUP BY molecule_id ORDER BY molecule_id
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.gk_reflexes FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 195 AND 205 AND PA.gk_reflexes > 97
SELECT * FROM cards WHERE 2 = (CASE WHEN artist LIKE 'U%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN convertedmanacost = 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN hasfoil = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Ca' AND br.bond_seq > 2 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, br.bond_seq DESC

SELECT t1.team_short_name, t2.buildupplaypositioningclass FROM team t1 INNER JOIN team_attributes t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.buildupplayspeed BETWEEN 60 AND 80 AND t2.chancecreationcrossing > 70
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Mar%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 300000 AND height > 182 AND weight < 85);
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MIN(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Mar%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 300000 AND weight > 75);

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Curious' WHERE u.reputation >= 8000 AND u.creationdate > '2020-01-01'

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(b.spent) AS Total_Spent_On_Meetings FROM member AS m JOIN budget AS b ON m.member_id = b.link_to_event JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.type = 'Meeting' AND e.status = 'Approved' AND b.spent > 75 GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 600

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_type, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE bl.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND m.label LIKE 'H2SO4%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, bl.transact_dt_tm DESC

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN got > 150 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Critical_High_GOT, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN gpt > 150 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Critical_High_GPT, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN ldh > 900 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Critical_High_LDH FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

SELECT TA.ID, TA.BUILDUPPLAYSPEED, TA.CHANCECREATIONCROSSING, TA.DEFENCEAGGRESSION, TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH FROM team_attributes AS TA WHERE TA.BUILDUPPLAYSPEED < (SELECT AVG(BUILDUPPLAYSPEED) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.CHANCECREATIONCROSSING > (SELECT AVG(CHANCECREATIONCROSSING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCEAGGRESSION < (SELECT AVG(DEFENCEAGGRESSION) FROM team_attributes)
SELECT player_id FROM player_stats_temp GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) > 28 AND (MAX(goals) - MIN(goals)) > 22;
SELECT b1.bond_type, b2.bond_type FROM bond AS b1 INNER JOIN bond AS b2 ON (b1.bond_type, b2.bond_type) IN (('AROMATIC', 'HYDROGEN'), ('AROMATIC', 'DATIVE'), ('HYDROGEN', 'DATIVE'))

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, lifestyle_and_risk_factors.alcohol_history_documented, COUNT(alcohol_history_documented) AS alcohol_history_count FROM patients JOIN lifestyle_and_risk_factors ON patients.patient_id = lifestyle_and_risk_factors.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND lifestyle_and_risk_factors.alcohol_history_documented = TRUE GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, lifestyle_and_risk_factors.alcohol_history_documented ORDER BY patients.patient_id;
SELECT atom_id, molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element LIKE 'Pb%' ORDER BY atom_id DESC NULLS FIRST

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS total_expenses FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2024-04-01' AND '2024-09-30' AND e.type = 'Social' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 800 ORDER BY total_expenses ASC LIMIT 4
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.penalties FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 185 AND 195 AND PA.penalties > 90
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Xe%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS FIRST, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS member_count, zip_code.state FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'active' GROUP BY zip_code.state

SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.country LIKE 'R%') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.name LIKE '%Racecourse%')

SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex, COALESCE(l.aptt, 0) AS aptt_level FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31' AND l.aptt BETWEEN 65 AND 75 ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT atom.atom_id) AS unique_lithium_atoms FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Li' GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id;

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN hgb < 17 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Mild_Anemia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN plt < 170 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Mild_Thrombocytopenia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN wbc > 7 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Mild_Leukocytosis FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.defensive_work_rate FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 150 AND 160 AND PA.defensive_work_rate = 'Medium'
SELECT team_api_id, team_long_name FROM team WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM team WHERE team_long_name LIKE 'Bay%' AND team_fifa_api_id > 170000);

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_id, bl.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Mg' AND bl.transact_dt_tm > '2023-01-01' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, bl.bond_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN diagnosis = 'DM' THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS DM, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN diagnosis = 'PM' THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS PM, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN diagnosis = 'MCTD' THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS MCTD FROM examination GROUP BY id

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, av.cnt FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN atom_view AS av ON a.atom_id = av.atom_id WHERE av.cnt > 10 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST
SELECT * FROM member WHERE zip >= 20000 AND zip <= 40000 AND link_to_major = 'recggMW2eyCYceNcy' ORDER BY email NULLS FIRST

SELECT year_created, tagname, cnt_posts FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS DATE)) AS year_created, t.tagname, COUNT(p.id) AS cnt_posts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(p.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM posts_backup AS p INNER JOIN tags AS t ON p.tags LIKE '%' || t.tagname || '%' WHERE p.tags IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS DATE)), t.id, t.tagname) AS p WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_posts DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT raceid, q1 FROM (SELECT raceid, q1, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM qualifying GROUP BY raceid, q1) subq WHERE rank = 1 AND q1 IS NOT NULL AND q1 <> '0' AND q1 LIKE '2%' AND q1 NOT LIKE '1%' AND q1 NOT LIKE '3%'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Ca' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 2 AND 4 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST
SELECT player_id FROM player_stats GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) > 19 AND (MAX(yellow_cards) - MIN(yellow_cards)) > 7;

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Photogenic' WHERE u.reputation >= 15000 AND u.creationdate > '2019-01-01'
SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.transact_dt_tm ASC) AS rnk FROM bond_list a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 6

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Zn' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 5 AND 7 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, br.bond_seq ASC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Li' ORDER BY m.label DESC, a.atom_id DESC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS FIRST

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.amount) AS Total_Budget FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.event_status = 'Approved' AND b.category = 'Outreach' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.amount) > 2000

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Be' AND br.bond_seq > 4 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT s.superhero_name, a.attribute_name, ha.attribute_value FROM superhero s JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE ha.attribute_value BETWEEN 10 AND 30 AND s.alignment_id = 2
SELECT constructorid, COUNT(*) FROM constructorstandings GROUP BY constructorid HAVING COUNT(*) > 3;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bond.bond_id) AS double_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'double' GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id;

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.alt AS circuitaltitude, d.nationality AS drivernationality, co.url AS teamurl, res.time AS racetime, res.statusid FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2018 AND 2023 AND res.positionorder <= 6 AND res.points > 12 ORDER BY r.raceid DESC, res.time ASC
SELECT bond_type, bond_seq FROM bond_ref WHERE bond_type LIKE 'I%' ORDER BY bond_seq ASC NULLS LAST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, bl.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Li' AND bl.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-06-30' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, bl.bond_type DESC
SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, r.race AS species FROM superhero AS sh JOIN race AS r ON sh.race_id = r.id WHERE r.race LIKE '%Human%' ORDER BY sh.id ASC

SELECT raceid, q1 FROM (SELECT raceid, q1, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM qualifying GROUP BY raceid, q1) subq WHERE rank = 1 AND q1 IS NOT NULL AND q1 <> '0' AND q1 LIKE '5%' AND q1 NOT LIKE '1%' AND q1 NOT LIKE '2%' AND q1 NOT LIKE '3%' AND q1 NOT LIKE '4%'
SELECT b1.bond_seq, b2.bond_seq FROM bond_ref AS b1 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS b2 ON (b1.bond_seq, b2.bond_seq) IN ((13, 14), (13, 15), (14, 15))

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 88 THEN 88 WHEN s.id = 89 THEN 89 WHEN s.id = 90 THEN 90 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, g.gender FROM superhero AS s JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id WHERE s.id IN (88, 89, 90) AND g.gender = 'Female'

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.weight, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_he, SUM(primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_he) AS total_positive_lymph_nodes FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_he > 0 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.weight, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_he ORDER BY patients.patient_id;
SELECT bond_id as previous_bond, LAG(bond_id) OVER (ORDER BY transact_dt_tm) as current_bond, molecule_id as molecule_identifier FROM bond_list b

WITH SUPERHERO_RANK AS (SELECT ID, SUPERHERO_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY WEIGHT_KG ASC NULLS FIRST) AS RANK FROM SUPERHERO) SELECT S1.SUPERHERO_NAME AS CURRENT_HERO, S2.SUPERHERO_NAME AS HERO_AFTER_16 FROM SUPERHERO_RANK AS S1 LEFT JOIN SUPERHERO_RANK AS S2 ON S2.RANK = S1.RANK + 16

WITH HERO_POWER_RANK AS (SELECT HERO_ID, POWER_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY POWER_ID DESC NULLS LAST) AS RANK FROM HERO_POWER) SELECT H1.HERO_ID AS CURRENT_HERO, H2.HERO_ID AS HERO_AFTER_6 FROM HERO_POWER_RANK AS H1 LEFT JOIN HERO_POWER_RANK AS H2 ON H2.RANK = H1.RANK + 6

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, treatment_and_followup.primary_pathology_radiation_therapy, COUNT(primary_pathology_radiation_therapy) AS radiation_count FROM patients JOIN treatment_and_followup ON patients.patient_id = treatment_and_followup.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND treatment_and_followup.primary_pathology_radiation_therapy = TRUE GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, treatment_and_followup.primary_pathology_radiation_therapy ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_id, bl.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'O' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, bl.bond_id NULLS FIRST
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Roo%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 770000 AND height > 179 AND weight < 83);
SELECT MIN(a10) FROM (SELECT a10, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a10 ASC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM district) AS E WHERE (Rank = 4)
SELECT * FROM cards WHERE 3 = (CASE WHEN artist LIKE 'I%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN convertedmanacost = 3.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN hasfoil = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN got > 50 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_GOT, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN gpt > 50 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_GPT, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN ldh > 300 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_LDH FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

SELECT s.cname AS county, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.5 + s.avgscrread * 0.4 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.1) AS weighted_sat_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.cname IN (SELECT s.cname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.cname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.5 + s.avgscrread * 0.4 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.1) DESC nulls last LIMIT 5) GROUP BY s.cname, sch.school ORDER BY s.cname, weighted_sat_score DESC;

SELECT s.dname AS district, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.6 + s.avgscrread * 0.3 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.1) AS weighted_sat_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.dname IN (SELECT s.dname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.dname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.6 + s.avgscrread * 0.3 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.1) DESC nulls last LIMIT 5) GROUP BY s.dname, sch.school ORDER BY s.dname, weighted_sat_score DESC;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Mg' AND b.bond_type = 'hydrogen' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.bond_type DESC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Au' AND b.transact_dt_tm > '2023-01-01' ORDER BY m.label DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS fusion_key, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS substance_code, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS characteristic_type FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Br%' OR b.bond_type IN ('sigma', 'pi') ORDER BY fusion_key DESC, substance_code ASC
SELECT t1.* FROM cards t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM cards GROUP BY originalreleasedate) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'G' AND power = '5' AND toughness = '4') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7074') WHEN (colors = 'R' AND power = '4' AND toughness = '3') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7075') WHEN (colors = 'B' AND power = '3' AND toughness = '2') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7076') WHEN (colors = 'W' AND power = '2' AND toughness = '1') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7077') END) AS watermark FROM cards

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS composite_identifier, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS molecular_id, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS descriptor FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond AS b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Mg%' OR b.bond_type IN ('hydrogen', 'ionic') ORDER BY composite_identifier DESC, molecular_id ASC
SELECT MAX(a12) FROM (SELECT a12, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a12 ASC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM district) AS E WHERE (Rank = 3)
SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 's' THEN 1 END) AS s_atoms, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element IN ('f', 'br') THEN molecule_id END) AS f_atoms FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'mo' THEN 1 END) AS molybdenum_atoms, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element IN ('nb', 'tc') THEN molecule_id END) AS refractory_metals FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id;
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id2 = atom.atom_id WHERE atom.element = 'carbon' AND atom.molecule_id LIKE 'ORG%'

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_list ON atom.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Hg' AND bond_list.bond_type = 'dative' ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id ASC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Ti' AND b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-06-30' ORDER BY m.label ASC, a.atom_id ASC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.aptt FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'PSS' AND l.aptt > 90 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.aptt HAVING COUNT(*) > 2) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.aptt = j.aptt)

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond_ref.bond_type, bond_ref.bond_seq FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list ON connected.bond_id = bond_list.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref ON bond_list.bond_type = bond_ref.bond_type WHERE atom.element = 'W' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id ASC, atom.atom_id DESC, bond_ref.bond_seq NULLS FIRST

SELECT s.district, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numge1500 FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.county = 'San Diego' AND sa.rtype = 'D' ORDER BY sa.avgscrmath DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.remaining) AS available_funds FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-12-31' AND e.type = 'Seminar' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.remaining) > 2000 ORDER BY available_funds DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT * FROM cards WHERE 3 = (CASE WHEN artist LIKE 'X%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN convertedmanacost = 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN hasfoil = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);
SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Flexibility' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 70 AND 90)

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'ionic' AND molecule.label LIKE 'Mineral%' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'CHEM%'

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 100 THEN 100 WHEN s.id = 101 THEN 101 WHEN s.id = 102 THEN 102 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, p.publisher_name FROM superhero AS s JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE s.id IN (100, 101, 102) AND p.publisher_name LIKE 'DC%'

SELECT m.email, e.event_name, b.spent, z.county FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.spent BETWEEN 100 AND 300 ORDER BY b.spent ASC NULLS FIRST
SELECT c1.atom_id, c2.atom_id2 FROM connected AS c1 INNER JOIN connected AS c2 ON (c1.atom_id, c2.atom_id2) IN (('AT2500', 'AT2501'), ('AT2500', 'AT2502'), ('AT2501', 'AT2502'))
SELECT m1.molecule_id, m2.molecule_id FROM molecule AS m1 INNER JOIN molecule AS m2 ON (m1.molecule_id, m2.molecule_id) IN (('MOL700', 'MOL701'), ('MOL700', 'MOL702'), ('MOL701', 'MOL702'))

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.country_of_birth, clinical_status.vital_status, COUNT(clinical_status.vital_status) AS vital_status_count FROM patients JOIN clinical_status ON patients.patient_id = clinical_status.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND clinical_status.vital_status = 'Alive' GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.country_of_birth, clinical_status.vital_status ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Se' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, br.bond_seq DESC

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS eye_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Emerald%' AND sh.weight_kg > 100 ORDER BY sh.id DESC

SELECT s.district, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numtsttakr FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.county = 'Ventura' AND sa.rtype = 'S' ORDER BY sa.avgscrmath ASC LIMIT 4;

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplaydribbling, ta.buildupplaydribblingclass, ta.chancecreationpassing, ta.chancecreationpassingclass, ta.defenceteamwidth, ta.defenceteamwidthclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2017-06-15 00:00:00'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Cl' AND b.bond_type = 'single' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.bond_type ASC
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'ionic'
SELECT t1.* FROM cards t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM cards GROUP BY artist, asciiname, name, setcode, rarity, convertedmanacost, power, toughness, colors) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(b.spent) AS Total_Spent_On_Workshops FROM member AS m JOIN budget AS b ON m.member_id = b.link_to_event JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.type = 'Workshop' AND e.status = 'Planned' GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 300

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence, AVG(demographics.weight) AS avg_weight FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence = TRUE AND demographics.gender = 'Female' AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_ihc > 4 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence ORDER BY patients.patient_id;
SELECT MAX(yellow_cards) FROM (SELECT yellow_cards, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY yellow_cards DESC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM player_stats_temp) AS E WHERE (Rank = 3)

SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.country LIKE 'R%') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.name LIKE '%Riviera%')

SELECT year_created, aboutme, cnt_posthistory FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ph.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.aboutme, COUNT(ph.id) AS cnt_posthistory, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ph.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(ph.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM posthistory AS ph INNER JOIN users AS u ON ph.userid = u.id WHERE u.aboutme LIKE 'G%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ph.creationdate AS DATE)), u.aboutme) AS ph WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_posthistory DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT C.name, C.artist FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Vintage' AND C.convertedmanacost BETWEEN 8.0 AND 10.0

SELECT '2024-12-01' AS reporting_date, COUNT(CASE WHEN opendate < '2024-12-01' AND (closeddate IS NULL OR closeddate >= '2024-12-01') THEN 1 END) AS active_schools_in_santa_barbara FROM schools WHERE county = 'Santa Barbara';

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS Total_Event_Expenses FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.event_status = 'Approved' AND b.category = 'Workshop' AND e.status = 'Planned' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 2000
SELECT * FROM cards WHERE 3 = (CASE WHEN artist LIKE 'U%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN convertedmanacost = 1.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN hasfoil = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);
SELECT MIN(goals) FROM (SELECT goals, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY goals ASC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM player_stats) AS E WHERE (Rank = 4)

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.c3 FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'SLE' AND l.c3 < 90 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.c3 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.c3 = j.c3)
SELECT c1.atom_id, c2.atom_id2 FROM connected AS c1 INNER JOIN connected AS c2 ON (c1.atom_id, c2.atom_id2) IN (('AT2600', 'AT2601'), ('AT2600', 'AT2602'), ('AT2601', 'AT2602'))

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond_ref.bond_type, bond_ref.bond_seq FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref ON bond.bond_type = bond_ref.bond_type WHERE atom.element = 'Pt' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id ASC, atom.atom_id DESC, bond_ref.bond_seq NULLS LAST

SELECT year_created, aboutme, cnt_badges FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.aboutme, COUNT(b.id) AS cnt_badges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(b.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM badges AS b INNER JOIN users AS u ON b.userid = u.id WHERE u.aboutme LIKE 'D%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)), u.aboutme) AS b WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_badges DESC NULLS LAST

WITH cte AS (
    SELECT
        cdscode,
        school,
        fundingtype,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cdscode
            ORDER BY lastupdate
        ) AS rn
    FROM schools
)

SELECT
    c.cdscode,
    'School' AS columnname,
    p.school AS oldvalue,
    c.school AS newvalue
FROM cte c
LEFT JOIN cte p
    ON
        c.cdscode = p.cdscode
        AND p.rn + 1 = c.rn
WHERE COALESCE(c.school, '') <> COALESCE(p.school, '')
UNION ALL
SELECT
    c.cdscode,
    'FundingType' AS columnname,
    p.fundingtype AS oldvalue,
    c.fundingtype AS newvalue
FROM cte c
LEFT JOIN cte p
    ON
        c.cdscode = p.cdscode
        AND p.rn + 1 = c.rn
WHERE COALESCE(c.fundingtype, '') <> COALESCE(p.fundingtype, '')
ORDER BY
    cdscode,
    columnname;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, av.cnt FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN atom_view AS av ON a.atom_id = av.atom_id WHERE a.element = 'N' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'amide' AND molecule.label LIKE 'Kevlar%'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Sr' AND b.bond_type = 'ionic' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.bond_type ASC
