SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Persuasion' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 25 AND 45)
SELECT t1.* FROM cards t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM cards GROUP BY ispromo) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.aptt FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'SLE' AND l.aptt > 45 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.aptt HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.aptt = j.aptt)
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Gab%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 800000 AND height > 182 AND weight < 84);
SELECT s.school, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.county = 'Orange' AND sa.rtype = 'S' ORDER BY sa.avgscrmath ASC LIMIT 2;
SELECT bond_id as previous_bond, LAG(bond_id) OVER (ORDER BY bond_id) as current_bond, bond_type as bond_category FROM bond_list b

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'S' AND b.bond_type = 'hydrogen' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.bond_type DESC

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS silicon_metallic_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'metallic' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'Si%' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY silicon_metallic_bonds DESC
SELECT e.event_id FROM event AS e LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.link_to_event IS NULL AND e.type = 'social'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Pt' AND b.bond_type = 'metallic' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.bond_type DESC

SELECT atom_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN atom_id2 END) AS atom_id2_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN atom_id2 END) AS atom_id2_2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN atom_id2 END) AS atom_id2_3 FROM (SELECT atom_id, atom_id2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY atom_id ORDER BY atom_id2 DESC) AS rn FROM connected) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 3 GROUP BY atom_id ORDER BY atom_id

SELECT year_created, displayname, cnt_posthistory FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ph.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.displayname, COUNT(ph.id) AS cnt_posthistory, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ph.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(ph.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM posthistory AS ph INNER JOIN users AS u ON ph.userid = u.id WHERE u.displayname LIKE 'N%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ph.creationdate AS DATE)), u.id, u.displayname) AS ph WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_posthistory DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS member_count, zip_code.county FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'inactive' AND zip_code.type = 'military' GROUP BY zip_code.county

WITH molecule_bonds AS (SELECT molecule_id AS mol FROM bond UNION ALL SELECT molecule_id AS mol FROM bond_list) SELECT mol AS id, COUNT(*) AS num FROM molecule_bonds GROUP BY mol HAVING COUNT(*) <> (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM molecule_bonds GROUP BY mol) AS avg_bonds);
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.potential FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height > 190 AND PA.potential < 75

SELECT raceid, fastestlapspeed AS modal_fastestlapspeed FROM (SELECT raceid, fastestlapspeed, COUNT(*) AS freq, MIN(resultid) AS first_occurrence, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(resultid) ASC) AS rn FROM results GROUP BY raceid, fastestlapspeed) sub WHERE rn = 1 AND fastestlapspeed BETWEEN '215' AND '245' ORDER BY raceid;

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.plt FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'SLE' AND l.plt < 100000 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.plt HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.plt = j.plt)

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count, COUNT(primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count) AS lymph_node_examined_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count BETWEEN 25 AND 75 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count ORDER BY patients.patient_id;
SELECT br1.bond_seq, br2.bond_seq FROM bond_ref AS br1 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br2 ON (br1.bond_seq, br2.bond_seq) IN ((19, 20), (19, 21), (20, 21))

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.remaining) AS unallocated_budget FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-06-30' AND e.type = 'Training' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.remaining) > 2000 ORDER BY unallocated_budget DESC LIMIT 3

WITH SUPERHERO_RANK AS (SELECT ID, SUPERHERO_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY HEIGHT_CM DESC NULLS LAST) AS RANK FROM SUPERHERO) SELECT S1.SUPERHERO_NAME AS CURRENT_HERO, S2.SUPERHERO_NAME AS HERO_AFTER_18 FROM SUPERHERO_RANK AS S1 LEFT JOIN SUPERHERO_RANK AS S2 ON S2.RANK = S1.RANK + 18
SELECT player_id FROM player_stats GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) > 60 AND (MAX(minutes_played) - MIN(minutes_played)) > 4000;
SELECT e.event_name, SUM(a.hours) AS Total_Hours FROM event AS e JOIN attendance AS a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event WHERE e.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(a.hours) > 20
SELECT t1.team_short_name, t2.chancecreationpositioningclass FROM team t1 INNER JOIN team_attributes t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.chancecreationshooting BETWEEN 60 AND 80

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Ne' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 2 AND 5 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, bl.bond_id, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'He' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST
SELECT s.district FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('San Diego', 'Imperial') AND s.charter = 1 GROUP BY s.district HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 2;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'van der Waals' AND molecule.label LIKE 'Lipid%'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq BETWEEN 4 AND 7 AND m.label LIKE 'N%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS hair_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.hair_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Strawberry%' AND sh.height_cm BETWEEN 160 AND 180 ORDER BY sh.id ASC
SELECT C.name, C.flavortext FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Modern' AND C.convertedmanacost BETWEEN 2.0 AND 4.0

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'peptide' AND molecule.label LIKE 'Antibiotic%'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Hg' AND br.bond_seq > 2 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, br.bond_seq NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = 'ionic' AND m.label LIKE 'NaCl%' AND a.element = 'Na' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.bond_type DESC
SELECT m.member_id FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN income AS i ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member WHERE i.amount > 100 AND i.link_to_member IS NULL

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond_list.bond_id, bond_list.bond_type, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list ON connected.bond_id = bond_list.bond_id WHERE atom.element = 'Fr' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id DESC, atom.atom_id ASC, bond_list.transact_dt_tm NULLS FIRST

SELECT sqA.alignment_count AS total_by_alignment, A.alignment AS alignment, S.superhero_name AS superhero, sqAS.alignment_superhero_count AS count_by_alignment_superhero FROM (SELECT alignment_id, COUNT(*) AS alignment_count FROM superhero WHERE alignment_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY alignment_id) sqA INNER JOIN (SELECT alignment_id, id, COUNT(*) AS alignment_superhero_count FROM superhero WHERE id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY alignment_id, id) sqAS ON sqA.alignment_id = sqAS.alignment_id INNER JOIN alignment A ON sqA.alignment_id = A.id INNER JOIN superhero S ON sqAS.id = S.id WHERE A.alignment = 'Good' AND S.superhero_name LIKE 'Iron%' ORDER BY A.alignment, S.superhero_name;

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.remaining) AS remaining_budget FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-06-30' AND e.type = 'Seminar' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.remaining) > 1200 ORDER BY remaining_budget ASC LIMIT 4

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, clinical_status.days_to_last_followup, AVG(days_to_last_followup) AS avg_days_to_followup FROM patients JOIN clinical_status ON patients.patient_id = clinical_status.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND clinical_status.days_to_last_followup IS NOT NULL GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, clinical_status.days_to_last_followup ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplaypositioningclass, ta.chancecreationpositioningclass, ta.defencedefenderlineclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2016-07-01 00:00:00'

SELECT s.county, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numge1500 FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.district = 'San Diego Unified' AND sa.rtype = 'D' ORDER BY sa.avgscrmath DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.amount) AS total_allocated FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2023-10-01' AND '2024-03-31' AND e.type = 'Seminar' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.amount) > 4000 ORDER BY total_allocated DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS hair_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.hair_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Rose Gold%' AND sh.height_cm BETWEEN 165 AND 185 ORDER BY sh.id DESC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN bond_list AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type LIKE 'o%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS FIRST, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS FIRST
SELECT t1.team_short_name, t2.buildupplayspeed FROM team t1 INNER JOIN team_attributes t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.buildupplayspeed < 50
SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 65 AND 85)

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_list ON atom.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Ne' AND bond_list.bond_type = 'covalent' ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id ASC

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.location AS circuitlocation, d.number AS drivernumber, co.constructorref AS constructorreference, res.positiontext AS positiontext, res.fastestlapspeed FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2015 AND res.points > 5 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.positiontext DESC

SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.country LIKE 'M%') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.name LIKE '%International%')

WITH SUPERHERO_RANK AS (SELECT ID, FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY HEIGHT_CM DESC NULLS LAST) AS RANK FROM SUPERHERO) SELECT S1.FULL_NAME AS CURRENT_HERO, S2.FULL_NAME AS HERO_BEFORE_8 FROM SUPERHERO_RANK AS S1 LEFT JOIN SUPERHERO_RANK AS S2 ON S2.RANK = S1.RANK - 8
SELECT p.id, p.sex, p.diagnosis, MIN(l.date) AS earliest_test_date FROM patient AS p INNER JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id GROUP BY p.id, p.sex, p.diagnosis

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'O' AND b.bond_type = 'double' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.bond_type ASC

SELECT sqR.race_count AS total_by_race, R.race AS race, C.colour AS eye_colour, sqRC.race_colour_count AS count_by_race_colour FROM (SELECT race_id, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM superhero WHERE race_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY race_id) sqR INNER JOIN (SELECT race_id, eye_colour_id, COUNT(*) AS race_colour_count FROM superhero WHERE eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY race_id, eye_colour_id) sqRC ON sqR.race_id = sqRC.race_id INNER JOIN race R ON sqR.race_id = R.id INNER JOIN colour C ON sqRC.eye_colour_id = C.id WHERE C.colour LIKE 'Green%' ORDER BY R.race, C.colour;

WITH SUPERHERO_RANK AS (SELECT ID, SUPERHERO_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY HEIGHT_CM DESC NULLS LAST) AS RANK FROM SUPERHERO) SELECT S1.SUPERHERO_NAME AS CURRENT_HERO, S2.SUPERHERO_NAME AS HERO_BEFORE_4 FROM SUPERHERO_RANK AS S1 LEFT JOIN SUPERHERO_RANK AS S2 ON S2.RANK = S1.RANK - 4
SELECT p.player_id, p.match_id, p.goals FROM player_stats p JOIN player_rate pr ON p.player_id = pr.id WHERE p.goals > 1 AND pr.overall_rating BETWEEN 75 AND 85 LIMIT 180;
SELECT C.name, C.rarity FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Historic' AND C.convertedmanacost = 16.0

SELECT p.player_id, p.match_id, p.goals FROM player_stats p JOIN player_rate pr ON p.player_id = pr.id WHERE p.goals > 2 AND pr.overall_rating BETWEEN 88 AND 92 AND pr.potential_rating > 89 LIMIT 195;
SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'au' THEN 1 END) AS au_atoms, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element IN ('pt', 'ir') THEN molecule_id END) AS pt_atoms FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.country LIKE 'Y%') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.name LIKE '%Yacht%')

SELECT s.cname AS county, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.4 + s.avgscrread * 0.4 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.2) AS balanced_sat_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.cname IN (SELECT s.cname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.cname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.4 + s.avgscrread * 0.4 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.2) DESC nulls last LIMIT 5) GROUP BY s.cname, sch.school ORDER BY s.cname, balanced_sat_score DESC;
SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.bond_type ASC) AS rnk FROM bond a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 5

SELECT raceid, q3 FROM (SELECT raceid, q3, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM qualifying GROUP BY raceid, q3) subq WHERE rank = 1 AND q3 IS NOT NULL AND q3 <> '0' AND q3 LIKE '2%' AND q3 NOT LIKE '1%' AND q3 NOT LIKE '3%' AND q3 NOT LIKE '4%'
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Fra%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 400000);
SELECT c.name, c.location, r.year FROM circuits c INNER JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid WHERE c.alt > 200 ORDER BY r.year ASC LIMIT 7;

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'G' AND power = '5' AND toughness = '4') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7074') WHEN (colors = 'B' AND power = '4' AND toughness = '3') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7075') WHEN (colors = 'R' AND power = '3' AND toughness = '2') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7076') WHEN (colors = 'W' AND power = '2' AND toughness = '1') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7077') END) AS watermark FROM cards

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Ti' AND b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-12-31' ORDER BY m.label ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST

SELECT molecule_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN bond_id END) AS bond_id_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN bond_id END) AS bond_id_2 FROM (SELECT molecule_id, bond_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY molecule_id ORDER BY bond_id ASC) AS rn FROM bond_list) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 2 GROUP BY molecule_id ORDER BY molecule_id
SELECT player_id FROM player_stats_temp GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) > 45 AND (MAX(assists) - MIN(assists)) > 20;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Pt' AND b.transact_dt_tm > '2023-06-01' ORDER BY m.label ASC, a.atom_id ASC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.amount) AS Total_Budget FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.event_status = 'Approved' AND b.category = 'Workshop' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.amount) > 2500
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Fe%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS FIRST, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond_ref.bond_type FROM atom LEFT JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_ref ON connected.bond_id = bond_ref.bond_type WHERE bond_ref.bond_seq < 3
SELECT driverid, COUNT(*) FROM results GROUP BY driverid HAVING COUNT(*) > 60;
SELECT link_to_member, SUM(cost) AS total_expense FROM expense WHERE cost BETWEEN 25 AND 75 GROUP BY link_to_member HAVING SUM(cost) > 150

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = 'hydrogen' AND m.label LIKE 'NH3%' AND a.element = 'H' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.bond_type DESC
SELECT raceid, COUNT(*) FROM results GROUP BY raceid HAVING COUNT(*) > 10;

WITH member_attendance_analysis AS (SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, SUM(hours) AS total_hours, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_member ORDER BY SUM(hours) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top Hours' AS result_type FROM attendance WHERE hours > 2.5 GROUP BY link_to_member, link_to_event), event_attendance AS (SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, SUM(hours) AS total_hours, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_event ORDER BY SUM(hours) DESC) AS rank, 'Event Top Hours' AS result_type FROM attendance WHERE hours > 2.5 GROUP BY link_to_member, link_to_event) SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, total_hours, result_type FROM member_attendance_analysis WHERE rank <= 4 UNION ALL SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, total_hours, result_type FROM event_attendance WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, link_to_member, link_to_event

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence, AVG(demographics.height) AS avg_height FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence = FALSE AND demographics.gender = 'Female' AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_ihc > 3 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type = 'cyclic' THEN 1 END) AS cyclic_bonds, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type IN ('linear', 'branched') THEN molecule_id END) AS linear_bonds FROM bond GROUP BY molecule_id;
SELECT a1.element, a2.element FROM atom AS a1 INNER JOIN atom AS a2 ON (a1.element, a2.element) IN (('C', 'H'), ('C', 'O'), ('H', 'O'))
SELECT m.member_id FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN expense AS e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member WHERE e.link_to_member IS NULL AND e.cost > 150 AND e.approved = 'approved'

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 615 THEN 615 WHEN s.id = 616 THEN 616 WHEN s.id = 617 THEN 617 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, c.colour FROM superhero AS s JOIN colour AS c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.id IN (615, 616, 617) AND c.colour = 'Green'

WITH GENDER_RANK AS (SELECT ID, GENDER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ID DESC NULLS LAST) AS RANK FROM GENDER) SELECT G1.GENDER AS CURRENT_GENDER, G2.GENDER AS GENDER_AFTER_7 FROM GENDER_RANK AS G1 LEFT JOIN GENDER_RANK AS G2 ON G2.RANK = G1.RANK + 7

SELECT p.player_name, p.height, COUNT(pa.id) AS defensive_count FROM player p JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.standing_tackle > 90 AND p.height > 190 GROUP BY p.player_name, p.height HAVING COUNT(pa.id) > 15;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Fe' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 1 AND 3 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id ASC, br.bond_seq DESC

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.country AS circuitcountry, d.forename AS driverfirstname, d.surname AS driverlastname, co.name AS teamname, res.grid AS qualifyingposition, res.fastestlaptime FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2012 AND 2017 AND res.points > 12 AND res.positionorder <= 4 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.fastestlaptime DESC
SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Vision' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 45 AND 65)
SELECT raceid, COUNT(*) FROM results GROUP BY raceid HAVING COUNT(*) > 5;

SELECT m.position, e.type, b.category, z.city FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.amount > 2000 AND b.amount < 3000 ORDER BY b.amount DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT atom_id, molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element LIKE 'Cr%' ORDER BY atom_id ASC NULLS FIRST

SELECT e.event_name, COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS Total_Attendees FROM event AS e LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event WHERE e.type = 'Workshop' AND e.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING COUNT(a.link_to_member) > 10
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id WHERE atom.element = 'gold' AND atom.molecule_id LIKE 'METAL%'

SELECT p.player_name, p.height, COUNT(pa.id) AS defensive_count FROM player p JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.standing_tackle > 82 AND p.height > 182 GROUP BY p.player_name, p.height HAVING COUNT(pa.id) > 7;

SELECT s.school, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.avgscrwrite
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds
WHERE s.county = 'Alameda' AND sa.rtype = 'S'
ORDER BY sa.avgscrread DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, connected.bond_id FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id WHERE atom.element = 'F' AND connected.atom_id2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id ASC

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_list ON atom.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Kr' AND bond_list.bond_type = 'covalent' ORDER BY molecule.label ASC, atom.atom_id DESC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Ag' AND b.transact_dt_tm < '2023-01-01' ORDER BY m.label ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST

WITH molecule_bond_dates AS (SELECT molecule_id AS mol, transact_dt_tm AS bdate FROM bond_list UNION ALL SELECT molecule_id AS mol, NULL AS bdate FROM bond) SELECT mol AS id, COUNT(*) AS num FROM molecule_bond_dates GROUP BY mol HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM molecule_bond_dates GROUP BY mol) AS avg_dates);

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, bl.bond_id, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Ba' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Pioneer' WHERE u.reputation >= 20000 AND u.creationdate < '2014-01-01'
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id2 = atom.atom_id WHERE atom.element = 'selenium' AND atom.molecule_id LIKE 'ORG%'
SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex, COALESCE(l.c4, 0) AS complement_c4_status FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT s.district FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('Nevada', 'Sierra') GROUP BY s.district HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 2;
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Zn%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS FIRST, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS unified_key, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS chemical_reference, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property_description FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond_list AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Rn%' OR b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-06-30' ORDER BY unified_key DESC, chemical_reference ASC
SELECT e.event_id FROM event AS e LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.link_to_event IS NULL AND e.type = 'charity'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_id, bl.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Li' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, bl.bond_id NULLS LAST
SELECT * FROM member WHERE zip >= 50000 AND zip <= 60000 AND link_to_major = 'recggMW2eyCYceNcy' ORDER BY last_name DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id WHERE c.district_id BETWEEN 220 AND 230 AND d.type = 'DISPONENT' LIMIT 1450;

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Fanatic' WHERE u.reputation >= 15000 AND u.lastaccessdate > '2020-01-01'

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.pt FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'APS' AND l.pt > 14.0 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.pt HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.pt = j.pt)

SELECT p.player_name, p.height, COUNT(pa.id) AS heading_count FROM player p JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.heading_accuracy > 80 AND p.height > 185 GROUP BY p.player_name, p.height HAVING COUNT(pa.id) > 5;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Fe' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 2 AND 5 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT s.superhero_name, a.attribute_name, ha.attribute_value FROM superhero s JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE ha.attribute_value BETWEEN 100 AND 120 AND s.alignment_id = 3 AND s.height_cm > 210

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_ref.bond_seq FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_ref ON atom.element = 'Al' AND bond_ref.bond_type = 'metallic' ORDER BY molecule.label ASC, atom.atom_id DESC
SELECT t1.* FROM packages t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM packages GROUP BY name, status, priority, is_fragile) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.long_shots FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.long_shots > 88 AND Player_Attributes.shot_power > 85
SELECT * FROM member WHERE zip >= 80000 AND zip <= 95000 AND link_to_major = 'recggMW2eyCYceNcy' ORDER BY email DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.remaining) AS unallocated_funds FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-06-30' AND e.type = 'Workshop' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.remaining) > 1500 ORDER BY unallocated_funds DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'H' AND bond.bond_type = 'aromatic' ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id DESC
SELECT s.district FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('San Joaquin', 'Stanislaus') AND s.charter = 1 AND s.magnet = 1 AND s.virtual = 'N' GROUP BY s.district HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 3;

SELECT s.constructorstandingsid, s.raceid, c.constructorid FROM constructorstandings AS s INNER JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorid = s.constructorid WHERE s.raceid = 64 AND s.points > 250 AND c.nationality = 'Austrian'

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, connected.atom_id2 FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id WHERE atom.element = 'Cs' AND connected.bond_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id ASC

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS Total_Event_Spending FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.event_status = 'Approved' AND b.category = 'Workshop' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 1500
SELECT raceid, COUNT(*) FROM results GROUP BY raceid HAVING COUNT(*) > 25;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Fe' AND br.bond_seq < 3 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, br.bond_seq ASC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, bl.bond_id, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Ti' AND bl.transact_dt_tm > '2023-06-01' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST
SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'aromatic' AND molecule.label LIKE 'Sugar%'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m LEFT OUTER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT OUTER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT OUTER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id ORDER BY m.molecule_id NULLS FIRST, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, b.bond_id NULLS FIRST
SELECT * FROM packages WHERE 3 = (CASE WHEN status = 'shipped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN weight_kg < 2.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN is_fragile = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN got > 180 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Critical_High_GOT, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN gpt > 180 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Critical_High_GPT, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN ldh > 1200 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Critical_High_LDH FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Pt' AND b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-07-01' AND '2023-12-31' ORDER BY m.label ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST
SELECT bond_type, bond_seq FROM bond_ref ORDER BY bond_seq ASC NULLS FIRST

SELECT year_created, aboutme, cnt_comments FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.aboutme, COUNT(c.id) AS cnt_comments, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(c.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM comments AS c INNER JOIN users AS u ON c.userid = u.id WHERE u.aboutme IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.creationdate AS DATE)), u.aboutme) AS c WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_comments DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT MAX(assists) FROM (SELECT assists, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY assists ASC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM player_stats_temp) AS E WHERE (Rank = 4)

SELECT year_created, websiteurl, cnt_posts FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.websiteurl, COUNT(p.id) AS cnt_posts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(p.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM posts_backup AS p INNER JOIN users AS u ON p.owneruserid = u.id WHERE u.websiteurl IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS DATE)), u.websiteurl) AS p WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_posts DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT cards.asciiname, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT * FROM legalities WHERE legalities.format = cards.setcode AND legalities.status = 'Banned' AND legalities.uuid = cards.uuid AND legalities.id = cards.id AND legalities.format = 'Modern') THEN 'banned_in_modern' ELSE 'legal_in_modern' END FROM cards

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, av.cnt FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN atom_view AS av ON a.atom_id = av.atom_id WHERE a.element = 'B' AND av.cnt BETWEEN 3 AND 6 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT s.cname AS county, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.6 + s.avgscrread * 0.4) AS weighted_math_read_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.cname IN (SELECT s.cname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.cname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.6 + s.avgscrread * 0.4) DESC nulls last LIMIT 5) GROUP BY s.cname, sch.school ORDER BY s.cname, weighted_math_read_score DESC;
SELECT driverid, code FROM (SELECT driverid, code, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY driverid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM drivers GROUP BY driverid, code) subq WHERE rank = 1
SELECT raceid, q1 FROM (SELECT raceid, q1, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM qualifying GROUP BY raceid, q1) subq WHERE rank = 1 AND q1 LIKE '1%'

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence, AVG(demographics.weight) AS avg_weight FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence = TRUE AND demographics.gender = 'Female' AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_he > 8 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT bond_type, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN molecule_id END) AS molecule_id_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN molecule_id END) AS molecule_id_2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN molecule_id END) AS molecule_id_3 FROM (SELECT bond_type, molecule_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bond_type ORDER BY molecule_id DESC) AS rn FROM bond_list) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 4 GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY bond_type

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Excavator' WHERE u.reputation >= 3000 AND u.creationdate < '2015-01-01'

SELECT driverid, constructorid FROM (SELECT driverid, constructorid, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY driverid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM results GROUP BY driverid, constructorid) subq WHERE rank = 1
SELECT s.qualifyid, s.raceid, d.driverid FROM qualifying AS s INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = s.driverid WHERE s.raceid = 62 AND s.position < 4 AND d.nationality = 'Swedish'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS member_count, zip_code.state FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'active' AND zip_code.type = 'standard' AND member.t_shirt_size = 'XXL' GROUP BY zip_code.state, member.position, zip_code.type

SELECT m.phone, e.location, b.category, z.state FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.amount BETWEEN 700 AND 1400 ORDER BY b.amount DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT MIN(a16) FROM (SELECT a16, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a16 DESC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM district) AS E WHERE (Rank = 4)
SELECT player_id FROM player_stats GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) > 12 AND (MAX(assists) - MIN(assists)) > 5;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Al' AND br.bond_seq < 4 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST
SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Determination' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 65 AND 85)
SELECT * FROM packages WHERE 3 = (CASE WHEN status = 'delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN weight_kg > 2.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN is_fragile = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Be' AND b.bond_type = 'polar covalent' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.bond_type ASC

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.gk_reflexes FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.gk_reflexes > 90

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'rn' THEN 1 END) AS rn_atoms, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element IN ('og', 'ts') THEN molecule_id END) AS superheavy_atoms FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT c.name, c.nationality, cs.wins FROM constructors c INNER JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE cs.points > 400 AND cs.wins > 30 ORDER BY cs.wins DESC LIMIT 15;

SELECT atom_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN cnt END) AS cnt_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN cnt END) AS cnt_2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN cnt END) AS cnt_3 FROM (SELECT atom_id, cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY atom_id ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS rn FROM atom_view) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 4 GROUP BY atom_id ORDER BY atom_id

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS fusion_key, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS substance_code, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS characteristic_type FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Si%' OR b.bond_type IN ('covalent', 'metallic') ORDER BY fusion_key ASC, substance_code DESC
SELECT link_to_budget, AVG(cost) AS avg_cost FROM expense WHERE cost < 30 GROUP BY link_to_budget HAVING AVG(cost) < 50
SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Intuition' AND attribute_value > 70)
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.jumping FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 180 AND 190 AND PA.jumping > 85

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS fusion_key, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS substance_code, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS characteristic_type FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Ne%' OR b.bond_type IN ('single', 'double') ORDER BY fusion_key ASC, substance_code DESC

SELECT bl1.transact_dt_tm, bl2.transact_dt_tm FROM bond_list AS bl1 INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl2 ON (bl1.transact_dt_tm, bl2.transact_dt_tm) IN (('2023-03-01', '2023-03-02'), ('2023-03-01', '2023-03-03'), ('2023-03-02', '2023-03-03'))
SELECT * FROM packages WHERE 3 = (CASE WHEN status = 'processing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN weight_kg > 1.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN is_fragile = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);
SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.bond_type DESC) AS rnk FROM bond_list a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 8

SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MIN(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Pat%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 320000);
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'N' ORDER BY m.label NULLS FIRST, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST

WITH MY_TABLE AS (
    SELECT
        '1111' AS TECHNICAL_ID,
        'NOTIONALCR' AS ASSET_TYPE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        '1111' AS TECHNICAL_ID,
        '50000' AS ASSET_TYPE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        '2222' AS TECHNICAL_ID,
        'FWDNOTLCR' AS ASSET_TYPE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        '2222' AS TECHNICAL_ID,
        '50000' AS ASSET_TYPE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        '3333' AS TECHNICAL_ID,
        '50000' AS ASSET_TYPE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        '3333' AS TECHNICAL_ID,
        'DUMMY' AS ASSET_TYPE
),

MAP_RECRF_ASSET_TYPE AS (
    SELECT
        'SW' AS APPLICATION,
        'NOTIONALCR' AS ASSET_TYPE,
        1 AS PRIORITY
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'SW' AS APPLICATION,
        'NOTIONALDB' AS ASSET_TYPE,
        1 AS PRIORITY
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'SW' AS APPLICATION,
        'FWDNOTLCR' AS ASSET_TYPE,
        2 AS PRIORITY
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'SW' AS APPLICATION,
        'FWDNOTLDR' AS ASSET_TYPE,
        2 AS PRIORITY
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'SW' AS APPLICATION,
        'SWOFFBALCR' AS ASSET_TYPE,
        2 AS PRIORITY
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'SW' AS APPLICATION,
        'SWOFFBALDR' AS ASSET_TYPE,
        2 AS PRIORITY
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'SW' AS APPLICATION,
        'SWFWNOTLCR' AS ASSET_TYPE,
        2 AS PRIORITY
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'SW' AS APPLICATION,
        'SWFWNOTLDB' AS ASSET_TYPE,
        2 AS PRIORITY
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'SW' AS APPLICATION,
        '50000' AS ASSET_TYPE,
        3 AS PRIORITY
),

CTE AS (
    SELECT
        X.TECHNICAL_ID,
        X.ASSET_TYPE,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY X.TECHNICAL_ID
            ORDER BY MRAT.PRIORITY
        ) AS rn
    FROM MY_TABLE X
    INNER JOIN MAP_RECRF_ASSET_TYPE MRAT ON X.ASSET_TYPE = MRAT.ASSET_TYPE
    WHERE MRAT.APPLICATION = 'SW'
)

SELECT
    TECHNICAL_ID,
    ASSET_TYPE
FROM CTE
WHERE rn = 1

SELECT MAX(assists) FROM (SELECT assists, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY assists DESC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM player_stats_temp) AS E WHERE (Rank = 5)

SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.element ASC) AS rnk FROM atom a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 8

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS total_expenses FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2023-04-01' AND '2023-09-30' AND e.type = 'Social' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 700 ORDER BY total_expenses DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(atom.element) AS oxygen_atoms FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'O' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY oxygen_atoms DESC

SELECT molecule.label, MAX(atom.element) AS max_element FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id GROUP BY molecule.label;

SELECT constructorid, nationality FROM (SELECT constructorid, nationality, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY constructorid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM constructors GROUP BY constructorid, nationality) subq WHERE rank = 1

SELECT raceid, fastestlap AS modal_fastestlap FROM (SELECT raceid, fastestlap, COUNT(*) AS freq, MIN(resultid) AS first_occurrence, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(resultid) ASC) AS rn FROM results GROUP BY raceid, fastestlap) sub WHERE rn = 1 AND fastestlap BETWEEN 7 AND 12 ORDER BY raceid;

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = 'ETHANOL') AS label_count, molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS molecule_id_count FROM molecule GROUP BY ROLLUP (molecule_id)

SELECT raceid, fastestlapspeed AS modal_fastestlapspeed FROM (SELECT raceid, fastestlapspeed, COUNT(*) AS freq, MIN(resultid) AS first_occurrence, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(resultid) ASC) AS rn FROM results GROUP BY raceid, fastestlapspeed) sub WHERE rn = 1 AND fastestlapspeed BETWEEN '220' AND '250' ORDER BY raceid;

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count, COUNT(primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count) AS lymph_node_examined_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count BETWEEN 30 AND 40 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT s.school FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('San Francisco', 'Santa Clara') AND s.charter = 1 AND s.magnet = 0 AND s.virtual = 'Y' GROUP BY s.school HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 2;

SELECT c1.atom_id, c2.atom_id2 FROM connected AS c1 INNER JOIN connected AS c2 ON (c1.atom_id, c2.atom_id2) IN (('AT1700', 'AT1701'), ('AT1700', 'AT1702'), ('AT1701', 'AT1702'))
SELECT * FROM legalities WHERE 2 = (CASE WHEN format = 'Commander' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN status = 'Legal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);

SELECT t1.* FROM cards t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM cards GROUP BY originaltype) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'G' AND power = '5') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '1004') WHEN (colors = 'W' AND power = '4') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '1005') WHEN (colors = 'U' AND power = '3') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '1006') WHEN (colors = 'R' AND power = '2') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '1007') END) AS watermark FROM cards
SELECT a1.molecule_id, a2.molecule_id FROM atom AS a1 INNER JOIN atom AS a2 ON (a1.molecule_id, a2.molecule_id) IN (('MOL100', 'MOL101'), ('MOL100', 'MOL102'), ('MOL101', 'MOL102'))

SELECT bond_type, bond_seq FROM bond_ref WHERE bond_type LIKE 'T%' ORDER BY bond_seq ASC NULLS LAST

SELECT b1.bond_seq, b2.bond_seq FROM bond_ref AS b1 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS b2 ON (b1.bond_seq, b2.bond_seq) IN ((1, 2), (1, 3), (2, 3))

SELECT MIN(amount) FROM (SELECT amount, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM trans) AS E WHERE (Rank = 3)

SELECT raceid FROM results WHERE milliseconds > 180000 AND positionorder < 5;

SELECT C.asciiname, C.manacost FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Commander' AND C.convertedmanacost > 3.0

SELECT p.id, p.sex, p.admission, AVG(l.cpk) AS avg_creatine_phosphokinase FROM patient AS p INNER JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.cpk > 100 GROUP BY p.id, p.sex, p.admission

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'U' ORDER BY m.label ASC, a.atom_id ASC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS FIRST

SELECT atom_id, molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element LIKE 'Sn%' ORDER BY atom_id ASC NULLS FIRST

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, connected.bond_id FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id WHERE atom.element = 'Ga' AND connected.atom_id2 IS NULL ORDER BY molecule.label ASC, atom.atom_id DESC

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.lat AS circuitlatitude, d.code AS drivercode, co.nationality AS constructornationality, res.position AS finishposition, res.fastestlapspeed FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 AND res.points > 20 AND res.positionorder <= 3 ORDER BY r.raceid DESC, res.fastestlapspeed ASC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Si' AND b.bond_type = 'triple' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.bond_type DESC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = 'hydrogen' AND m.label LIKE 'H2O%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.bond_type ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS member_count, zip_code.state FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'active' AND zip_code.type = 'standard' AND member.t_shirt_size = 'XL' GROUP BY zip_code.state
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Kr%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS LAST, a.atom_id NULLS LAST
SELECT t1.team_short_name, t2.buildupplaypassing FROM team t1 INNER JOIN team_attributes t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.buildupplaypassing BETWEEN 50 AND 70

SELECT cards.convertedmanacost, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT * FROM legalities WHERE legalities.format = cards.setcode AND legalities.status = 'Banned') THEN 'banned_card' ELSE 'legal_card' END FROM cards
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'MOL001') AS molecule_id_count, bond_type, COUNT(*) AS bond_type_count FROM bond GROUP BY ROLLUP (bond_type)

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, connected.atom_id2 FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id WHERE atom.element = 'Ni' AND connected.bond_id IS NULL ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id DESC

SELECT RACEID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 1 THEN DRIVERID END) AS WINNER, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 2 THEN DRIVERID END) AS RUNNER_UP, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 3 THEN DRIVERID END) AS THIRD_PLACE FROM results WHERE POSITIONORDER <= 3 AND LAPS BETWEEN 16 AND 25 AND POINTS > 12 GROUP BY RACEID
SELECT cdscode, COUNT(gsserved) FROM schools WHERE county = 'Santa Cruz County' GROUP BY cdscode LIMIT 40
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'aromatic' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'ORG%'

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond_ref.bond_type, bond_ref.bond_seq FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list ON connected.bond_id = bond_list.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref ON bond_list.bond_type = bond_ref.bond_type WHERE atom.element = 'Pt' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id ASC, atom.atom_id DESC, bond_ref.bond_seq NULLS FIRST
SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS total_bonds FROM bond_list GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 10 AND 20;

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'G' AND power = '7') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '9004') WHEN (colors = 'B' AND power = '6') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '9005') WHEN (colors = 'U' AND power = '5') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '9006') WHEN (colors = 'R' AND power = '4') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '9007') END) AS watermark FROM cards
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MIN(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Moh%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 540000 AND weight > 80);

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplaypassing, ta.buildupplaypassingclass, ta.chancecreationshooting, ta.chancecreationshootingclass, ta.defencepressure, ta.defencepressureclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2019-09-15 00:00:00'
SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id WHERE c.district_id BETWEEN 50 AND 60 AND d.type = 'DISPONENT' LIMIT 800;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Mn' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, e.event_name, b.spent FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.spent > 250 AND b.spent < 350 ORDER BY b.spent DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Citizen Patrol' WHERE u.reputation >= 4000 AND u.creationdate > '2018-01-01'
SELECT MIN(a14) FROM (SELECT a14, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a14 ASC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM district) AS E WHERE (Rank = 5)
SELECT p.player_id, p.match_id, p.goals FROM player_stats p JOIN player_rate pr ON p.player_id = pr.id WHERE p.goals > 2 AND pr.potential_rating > 90 LIMIT 180;

SELECT year_created, aboutme, cnt_postlinks FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(pl.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.aboutme, COUNT(pl.id) AS cnt_postlinks, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(pl.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(pl.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM postlinks AS pl INNER JOIN users AS u ON pl.relatedpostid = u.id WHERE u.aboutme LIKE 'E%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(pl.creationdate AS DATE)), u.aboutme) AS pl WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_postlinks DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS skin_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.skin_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Orange%' ORDER BY sh.id DESC

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_ref.bond_seq FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_ref ON atom.element = 'He' AND bond_ref.bond_type = 'van der Waals' ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id ASC
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'glycosidic' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'PHARM%'
SELECT bond_type, bond_seq FROM bond_ref WHERE bond_type LIKE 'H%' ORDER BY bond_seq DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT m.phone, e.event_date, b.category, z.state FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.amount BETWEEN 800 AND 1600 ORDER BY b.amount ASC NULLS FIRST
SELECT cards.bordercolor, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT * FROM legalities WHERE legalities.format = cards.setcode) THEN 'format_match' ELSE 'no_format_match' END FROM cards

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'W' AND power = '4') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '996') WHEN (colors = 'B' AND power = '3') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '997') WHEN (colors = 'U' AND power = '2') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '998') WHEN (colors = 'R' AND power = '0') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '999') END) AS watermark FROM cards

SELECT cards.asciiname, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT * FROM legalities WHERE legalities.format = cards.setcode AND legalities.status = 'Banned' AND legalities.uuid = cards.uuid AND legalities.id = cards.id) THEN 'banned_in_format' ELSE 'legal_in_format' END FROM cards

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(b.spent) AS Total_Spent_On_Workshops FROM member AS m JOIN budget AS b ON m.member_id = b.link_to_event JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.type = 'Workshop' AND e.status = 'Approved' AND b.spent > 450 GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 3000

SELECT '2023-12-31' AS reporting_date, COUNT(CASE WHEN opendate < '2023-12-31' AND (closeddate IS NULL OR closeddate >= '2023-12-31') THEN 1 END) AS active_charter_virtual_schools FROM schools WHERE charter = 1 AND virtual = 'Y';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Fe' AND br.bond_seq < 5 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, br.bond_seq NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Pt' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, br.bond_seq NULLS LAST

SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.loan_amount, CASE WHEN l.loan_amount > 50000 THEN 'Large' WHEN l.loan_amount > 20000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Small' END AS loan_size FROM loan l WHERE l.loan_status = 'approved' GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.loan_amount HAVING l.loan_amount > 10000

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Mn' AND br.bond_seq > 4 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Cl' AND br.bond_seq > 5 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, br.bond_seq DESC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'He' AND br.bond_seq > 1 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, br.bond_seq ASC

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'os' THEN 1 END) AS os_atoms, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element IN ('ir', 'pt') THEN molecule_id END) AS platinum_group_atoms FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.amount) AS total_allocated_funds FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-12-31' AND e.type = 'Conference' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.amount) > 4000 ORDER BY total_allocated_funds DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond.bond_id, bond.bond_type FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id INNER JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE atom.element = 'Zn' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id DESC, atom.atom_id ASC, bond.bond_id DESC

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN pt < 12 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Low_PT, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN aptt < 30 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Low_APTT, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN fg > 400 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS High_Fibrinogen FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS hair_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.hair_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Copper%' AND sh.height_cm > 190 ORDER BY sh.id DESC

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count, COUNT(primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count) AS lymph_node_examined_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count BETWEEN 50 AND 60 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count ORDER BY patients.patient_id;
SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'zn' THEN 1 END) AS zn_atoms, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element IN ('ag', 'au') THEN molecule_id END) AS ag_atoms FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT year_created, displayname, cnt_votes FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(v.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.displayname, COUNT(v.id) AS cnt_votes, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(v.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(v.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM votes AS v INNER JOIN users AS u ON v.userid = u.id WHERE u.displayname LIKE 'T%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(v.creationdate AS DATE)), u.id, u.displayname) AS v WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_votes DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond.bond_type FROM atom LEFT JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'covalent' AND atom.element = 'Sulfur' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'MOL%'

WITH bond_types AS (SELECT bond_type AS bond FROM bond UNION ALL SELECT bond_type AS bond FROM bond_list) SELECT bond AS type, COUNT(*) AS num FROM bond_types GROUP BY bond HAVING COUNT(*) < (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM bond_types GROUP BY bond) AS avg_bonds);
SELECT link_to_major, AVG(zip) AS avg_zip FROM member WHERE zip < 80000 GROUP BY link_to_major HAVING AVG(zip) > 50000
SELECT p.player_id, p.match_id, p.assists FROM player_stats p JOIN player_rate pr ON p.player_id = pr.id WHERE p.assists > 2 AND pr.overall_rating > 85 LIMIT 175;

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN got > 55 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_GOT, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN gpt > 55 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_GPT, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN ldh > 325 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_LDH FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq BETWEEN 7 AND 11 AND m.label LIKE 'Si%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST
SELECT atom_id, molecule_id FROM atom ORDER BY atom_id DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.rbc FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'APS' AND l.rbc < 3.5 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.rbc HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.rbc = j.rbc)

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.interceptions FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.interceptions > 90 AND Player_Attributes.marking > 85

SELECT m.phone, e.location, b.category, z.short_state FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.amount BETWEEN 1200 AND 1800 ORDER BY b.amount DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT m.email, e.event_name, b.remaining, z.state FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.remaining BETWEEN 300 AND 1000 ORDER BY b.remaining DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS eye_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Crimson%' AND sh.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190 ORDER BY sh.id DESC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Ne' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 4 AND 7 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS composite_id, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS molecule_code, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond_list AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'W%' OR b.transact_dt_tm = '2023-08-15' ORDER BY composite_id DESC, molecule_code ASC

WITH college_majors AS (SELECT college, major_id, COUNT(1) AS total_majors, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY college ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'College Top 3' AS result_type FROM major GROUP BY college, major_id), major_colleges AS (SELECT college, major_id, COUNT(1) AS total_majors, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY major_id ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Major Top College' AS result_type FROM major GROUP BY college, major_id) SELECT college, major_id, total_majors, result_type FROM college_majors WHERE rank <= 3 UNION ALL SELECT college, major_id, total_majors, result_type FROM major_colleges WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, college, major_id

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.aptt FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'SLE' AND l.aptt > 50 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.aptt HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.aptt = j.aptt)
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Be%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS LAST, a.atom_id NULLS LAST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq BETWEEN 8 AND 11 AND m.label LIKE 'Ne%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT s.dname AS district, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrread + s.avgscrmath) / 2 AS avg_math_read_sat FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.dname IN (SELECT s.dname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.dname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrread + s.avgscrmath) / 2 DESC nulls last LIMIT 10) GROUP BY s.dname, sch.school ORDER BY s.dname, avg_math_read_sat DESC;

SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR000_1_2') AS bond_id_count,
    bond_type,
    COUNT(*) AS bond_type_count
FROM bond

SELECT MIN(a8) FROM (SELECT a8, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a8 ASC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM district) AS E WHERE (Rank = 3)
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.standing_tackle FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 175 AND 185 AND PA.standing_tackle > 80

WITH member_events AS (SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, SUM(hours) AS total_hours, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_member ORDER BY SUM(hours) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top Hours' AS result_type FROM attendance WHERE hours > 1.5 GROUP BY link_to_member, link_to_event), event_members AS (SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, SUM(hours) AS total_hours, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_event ORDER BY SUM(hours) DESC) AS rank, 'Event Top Hours' AS result_type FROM attendance WHERE hours > 1.5 GROUP BY link_to_member, link_to_event) SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, total_hours, result_type FROM member_events WHERE rank <= 4 UNION ALL SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, total_hours, result_type FROM event_members WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, link_to_member, link_to_event

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.remaining) AS Total_Available_Budget FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.event_status = 'Approved' AND b.category = 'Workshop' AND e.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.remaining) > 1000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS officer_count, zip_code.state FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'officer' AND zip_code.type = 'standard' GROUP BY zip_code.state

SELECT RACEID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 13 THEN DRIVERID END) AS THIRTEENTH_PLACE, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 14 THEN DRIVERID END) AS FOURTEENTH_PLACE, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 15 THEN DRIVERID END) AS FIFTEENTH_PLACE FROM results GROUP BY RACEID

SELECT s.district, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numtsttakr FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.county = 'Yolo' AND sa.rtype = 'S' ORDER BY sa.avgscrwrite ASC LIMIT 3;

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence, AVG(demographics.height) AS avg_height FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence = TRUE AND demographics.gender = 'Male' AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_he > 9 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT s.superhero_name, a.alignment, c.colour FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.gender_id = 1 AND s.height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 170
SELECT a1.element, a2.element FROM atom AS a1 INNER JOIN atom AS a2 ON (a1.element, a2.element) IN (('Na', 'Cl'), ('Na', 'K'), ('Cl', 'K'))
SELECT br1.bond_type, br2.bond_type FROM bond_ref AS br1 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br2 ON (br1.bond_type, br2.bond_type) IN (('BT700', 'BT701'), ('BT700', 'BT702'), ('BT701', 'BT702'))
