SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.country LIKE 'C%') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.name LIKE '%City%')

SELECT m.email, e.event_name, b.spent, z.county FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.spent BETWEEN 350 AND 750 ORDER BY b.spent DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT sqA.alignment_count AS total_by_alignment, A.alignment AS alignment, S.superhero_name AS superhero, sqAS.alignment_superhero_count AS count_by_alignment_superhero FROM (SELECT alignment_id, COUNT(*) AS alignment_count FROM superhero WHERE alignment_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY alignment_id) sqA INNER JOIN (SELECT alignment_id, id, COUNT(*) AS alignment_superhero_count FROM superhero WHERE id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY alignment_id, id) sqAS ON sqA.alignment_id = sqAS.alignment_id INNER JOIN alignment A ON sqA.alignment_id = A.id INNER JOIN superhero S ON sqAS.id = S.id WHERE A.alignment = 'Good' AND S.superhero_name LIKE 'Spider%' ORDER BY A.alignment, S.superhero_name;
SELECT a1.atom_id, a2.atom_id FROM atom AS a1 INNER JOIN atom AS a2 ON (a1.atom_id, a2.atom_id) IN (('AT1400', 'AT1401'), ('AT1400', 'AT1402'), ('AT1401', 'AT1402'))
SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Adaptability' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 35 AND 55)

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, av.cnt FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN atom_view AS av ON a.atom_id = av.atom_id WHERE av.cnt = 6 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST
SELECT * FROM packages WHERE 3 = (CASE WHEN status = 'processing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN weight_kg > 2.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN is_fragile = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);
SELECT * FROM expense WHERE cost >= 200.0 AND cost <= 600.0 AND link_to_member = 'recggMW2eyCYceNcy' ORDER BY expense_description DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT year_created, displayname, cnt_postlinks FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(pl.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.displayname, COUNT(pl.id) AS cnt_postlinks, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(pl.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(pl.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM postlinks AS pl INNER JOIN users AS u ON pl.relatedpostid = u.id WHERE u.displayname LIKE 'B%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(pl.creationdate AS DATE)), u.id, u.displayname) AS pl WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_postlinks DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 130 THEN 130 WHEN s.id = 131 THEN 131 WHEN s.id = 132 THEN 132 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, c.colour FROM superhero AS s JOIN colour AS c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.id IN (130, 131, 132) AND c.colour = 'Green'

SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex, COALESCE(l.aptt, 0) AS aptt_level FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' AND l.aptt BETWEEN 30 AND 40 ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.fastestlaptime FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.fastestlaptime IS NOT NULL AND r.position <= 3 ORDER BY r.fastestlaptime DESC LIMIT 4;

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(a.hours) AS total_hours FROM event e LEFT JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date < '2023-01-01' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(a.hours) > 10 ORDER BY total_hours ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT player_id FROM player_stats GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) > 9 AND (MAX(goals) - MIN(goals)) > 8;

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_list ON atom.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Os' AND bond_list.bond_type = 'dative' ORDER BY molecule.label ASC, atom.atom_id DESC

WITH PUBLISHER_RANK AS (SELECT ID, PUBLISHER_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ID DESC NULLS LAST) AS RANK FROM PUBLISHER) SELECT P1.PUBLISHER_NAME AS CURRENT_PUBLISHER, P2.PUBLISHER_NAME AS PUBLISHER_AFTER_1 FROM PUBLISHER_RANK AS P1 LEFT JOIN PUBLISHER_RANK AS P2 ON P2.RANK = P1.RANK + 1
SELECT player_id FROM player_stats GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) > 3 AND (MAX(goals) - MIN(goals)) > 5;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = 'metallic' AND m.label LIKE 'Au%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.bond_type ASC
SELECT * FROM cards WHERE 3 = (CASE WHEN artist LIKE 'P%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN convertedmanacost = 6.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN hasfoil = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);

SELECT year_created, tagname, cnt_comments FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created, t.tagname, COUNT(c.id) AS cnt_comments, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(c.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM comments AS c INNER JOIN posts_backup AS p ON c.postid = p.id INNER JOIN tags AS t ON p.tags LIKE '%' || t.tagname || '%' WHERE t.tagname LIKE 'J%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.creationdate AS DATE)), t.id, t.tagname) AS c WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_comments DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_type, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE bl.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, bl.transact_dt_tm DESC

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, COUNT(r.raceid) AS race_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.raceid) > 15 THEN 'Iconic' WHEN COUNT(r.raceid) > 8 THEN 'Established' ELSE 'New' END AS circuit_status FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid WHERE r.year > 2014 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country HAVING COUNT(r.raceid) > 5

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Pundit' WHERE u.reputation >= 9000

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.fastestlaptime FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.fastestlaptime IS NOT NULL AND r.position <= 5 AND r.points > 10 ORDER BY r.fastestlaptime DESC LIMIT 6;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq <= 2 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, br.bond_seq ASC

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.lng AS circuitlongitude, d.code AS drivercode, co.constructorref AS constructorreference, res.positionorder AS finalposition, res.fastestlapspeed FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2015 AND res.points > 12 AND res.positionorder <= 4 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.fastestlapspeed DESC

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN ssa = 'Negative' THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS SSA_Negative, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN ssb = 'Negative' THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS SSB_Negative, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN dna = 'Negative' THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS DNA_Negative FROM laboratory GROUP BY id
SELECT account_id FROM loan GROUP BY account_id HAVING COUNT(loan_id) > 3 AND (MAX(loan_term_months) - MIN(loan_term_months)) > 12;
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'double' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'MOL%'
SELECT * FROM (SELECT b.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.molecule_id ORDER BY b.bond_id) AS rnk FROM bond b) subquery WHERE rnk <= 3

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.igm FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'RA' AND l.igm > 120 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.igm HAVING COUNT(*) > 2) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.igm = j.igm)

SELECT bl1.transact_dt_tm, bl2.transact_dt_tm FROM bond_list AS bl1 INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl2 ON (bl1.transact_dt_tm, bl2.transact_dt_tm) IN (('2023-05-01', '2023-05-02'), ('2023-05-01', '2023-05-03'), ('2023-05-02', '2023-05-03'))
SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element) AS unique_elements FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id GROUP BY molecule.label;

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN hgb < 5.5 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Critical_Anemia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN plt < 20 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Severe_Thrombocytopenia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN wbc > 40 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Extreme_Leukocytosis FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplaypassing, ta.buildupplaypassingclass, ta.chancecreationcrossing, ta.chancecreationcrossingclass, ta.defencepressure, ta.defencepressureclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2014-11-15 00:00:00'

WITH SUPERHERO_GROUP_RANK AS (SELECT ID, SUBGROUP2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUBGROUP1 ASC NULLS FIRST) AS RANK FROM SUPERHERO_GROUP) SELECT S1.SUBGROUP2 AS CURRENT_SUBGROUP, S2.SUBGROUP2 AS SUBGROUP_AFTER_13 FROM SUPERHERO_GROUP_RANK AS S1 LEFT JOIN SUPERHERO_GROUP_RANK AS S2 ON S2.RANK = S1.RANK + 13

SELECT TA.ID, TA.BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING, TA.CHANCECREATIONSHOOTING, TA.DEFENCEPRESSURE, TA.DEFENCEAGGRESSION FROM team_attributes AS TA WHERE TA.BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING < (SELECT AVG(BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.CHANCECREATIONSHOOTING > (SELECT AVG(CHANCECREATIONSHOOTING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCEAGGRESSION > (SELECT AVG(DEFENCEAGGRESSION) FROM team_attributes)

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.strength FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.strength > 85

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.aptt FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'APS' AND l.aptt > 50 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.aptt HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.aptt = j.aptt)
SELECT driverid, COUNT(*) FROM pitstops GROUP BY driverid HAVING COUNT(*) > 5;

SELECT t1.team_short_name, t2.defencepressureclass FROM team t1 INNER JOIN team_attributes t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.defencepressure BETWEEN 40 AND 60 AND t2.chancecreationshooting > 65
SELECT * FROM atom LEFT JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
SELECT * FROM attendance_trunc WHERE link_to_member >= 'a' AND link_to_member <= 'm' AND link_to_event = 'recggMW2eyCYceNcy' ORDER BY link_to_member NULLS FIRST
SELECT s.district FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('San Joaquin', 'Stanislaus') AND s.charter = 1 AND s.magnet = 0 AND s.virtual = 'Y' GROUP BY s.district HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 2;

SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex, COALESCE(l.igg, 0) AS immunoglobulin_g_level FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND l.igg > 1000 ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST

WITH member_expenses AS (SELECT link_to_member, expense_id, SUM(cost) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_member ORDER BY SUM(cost) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top 3' AS result_type FROM expense WHERE approved = 'Pending' AND cost > 100 GROUP BY link_to_member, expense_id), expense_members AS (SELECT link_to_member, expense_id, SUM(cost) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY expense_id ORDER BY SUM(cost) DESC) AS rank, 'Expense Top Member' AS result_type FROM expense WHERE approved = 'Pending' AND cost > 100 GROUP BY link_to_member, expense_id) SELECT link_to_member, expense_id, total_cost, result_type FROM member_expenses WHERE rank <= 3 UNION ALL SELECT link_to_member, expense_id, total_cost, result_type FROM expense_members WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, link_to_member, expense_id
SELECT MAX(loan_amount) FROM (SELECT loan_amount, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY loan_amount DESC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM loan) AS E WHERE (Rank = 5)

SELECT s.cname AS county, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.6 + s.avgscrread * 0.2 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.2) AS balanced_sat_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.cname IN (SELECT s.cname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.cname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.6 + s.avgscrread * 0.2 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.2) DESC nulls last LIMIT 8) GROUP BY s.cname, sch.school ORDER BY s.cname, balanced_sat_score DESC;

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.stamina FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.stamina > 75

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS total_expenses FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-06-30' AND e.type = 'Conference' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 1500 ORDER BY total_expenses DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT link_to_member, SUM(cost) AS total_expense FROM expense WHERE cost BETWEEN 15 AND 90 GROUP BY link_to_member HAVING SUM(cost) > 180

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, av.cnt FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN atom_view AS av ON a.atom_id = av.atom_id WHERE av.cnt BETWEEN 6 AND 9 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, av.cnt DESC

SELECT raceid, q3 FROM (SELECT raceid, q3, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM qualifying GROUP BY raceid, q3) subq WHERE rank = 1 AND q3 IS NOT NULL AND q3 <> '0' AND q3 LIKE '2%' AND q3 NOT LIKE '1%' AND q3 NOT LIKE '3%'
SELECT player_id FROM player_stats GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) > 42 AND (MAX(minutes_played) - MIN(minutes_played)) > 2800;

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS Total_Event_Expenses FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.event_status = 'Approved' AND b.category = 'Retreat' AND e.status = 'Active' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 1800

SELECT year_created, displayname, cnt_badges FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.displayname, COUNT(b.id) AS cnt_badges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(b.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM badges AS b INNER JOIN users AS u ON b.userid = u.id WHERE u.displayname LIKE 'A%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)), u.id, u.displayname) AS b WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_badges DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT RACEID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 1 THEN DRIVERID END) AS WINNER, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 2 THEN DRIVERID END) AS RUNNER_UP, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 3 THEN DRIVERID END) AS THIRD_PLACE FROM results WHERE POSITIONORDER <= 3 AND LAPS BETWEEN 181 AND 190 GROUP BY RACEID

SELECT sqP.publisher_count AS total_by_publisher, P.publisher_name AS publisher, A.alignment AS alignment, sqPA.publisher_alignment_count AS count_by_publisher_alignment FROM (SELECT publisher_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_count FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id) sqP INNER JOIN (SELECT publisher_id, alignment_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_alignment_count FROM superhero WHERE alignment_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id, alignment_id) sqPA ON sqP.publisher_id = sqPA.publisher_id INNER JOIN publisher P ON sqP.publisher_id = P.id INNER JOIN alignment A ON sqPA.alignment_id = A.id WHERE A.alignment LIKE 'Good%' ORDER BY P.publisher_name, A.alignment;
SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS eye_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Heterochromia%' ORDER BY sh.id DESC

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type = 'ionic' THEN 1 END) AS ionic_bonds, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type IN ('hydrogen', 'disulfide') THEN molecule_id END) AS weak_bonds FROM bond_list GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Great Question' WHERE u.reputation >= 45000 AND u.creationdate > '2017-01-01'

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_participations, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.resultid) > 40 THEN 'Legendary' WHEN COUNT(r.resultid) > 20 THEN 'Experienced' ELSE 'Rookie' END AS driver_experience FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.position <= 10 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(r.resultid) > 15

SELECT c.constructorid, c.name, c.nationality, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins, CASE WHEN AVG(cs.wins) > 5 THEN 'Dominant' WHEN AVG(cs.wins) > 2 THEN 'Competitive' ELSE 'Developing' END AS team_performance FROM constructors c JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE cs.position <= 10 GROUP BY c.constructorid, c.name, c.nationality HAVING AVG(cs.wins) > 1
SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS eye_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Brown%' ORDER BY sh.id ASC

SELECT e.event_name, AVG(a.hours) AS avg_hours FROM event e LEFT JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING AVG(a.hours) > 2 ORDER BY avg_hours DESC LIMIT 4

SELECT m.email, e.event_name, b.remaining, z.city FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.remaining BETWEEN 1000 AND 2000 ORDER BY b.remaining DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, bl.bond_id, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Cu' AND bl.transact_dt_tm < '2023-07-01' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_histological_type, COUNT(pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_histological_type) AS histology_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_histological_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_histological_type ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.location AS circuitlocation, d.number AS drivernumber, co.nationality AS teamnationality, res.positiontext AS positiontext, res.milliseconds AS racetime FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2009 AND 2014 AND res.points > 9 AND res.positionorder <= 7 ORDER BY r.raceid DESC, res.milliseconds ASC
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.sliding_tackle FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 185 AND 195 AND PA.sliding_tackle > 85
SELECT MAX(loan_term_months) FROM (SELECT loan_term_months, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY loan_term_months DESC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM loan) AS E WHERE (Rank = 3)

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.lat AS circuitlatitude, d.number AS drivernumber, co.nationality AS constructornationality, res.positiontext AS positiontext, res.fastestlapspeed FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2020 AND res.points > 12 AND res.positionorder <= 5 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.fastestlapspeed DESC

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bond_list.transact_dt_tm) AS unique_transaction_dates FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond_list ON molecule.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id;

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.remaining) AS unused_funds FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-12-31' AND e.type = 'Conference' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.remaining) > 1500 ORDER BY unused_funds ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT s.district FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('San Joaquin', 'Stanislaus') AND s.charter = 1 AND s.magnet = 0 AND s.virtual = 'N' GROUP BY s.district HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 2;
SELECT p.id, p.sex, p.admission, MAX(l.cpk) AS max_cpk_level FROM patient AS p INNER JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id GROUP BY p.id, p.sex, p.admission
SELECT player_id FROM player_stats_temp GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) > 25 AND (MAX(goals) - MIN(goals)) > 20;
SELECT s.resultid, s.raceid, d.driverid FROM results AS s INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = s.driverid WHERE s.raceid = 42 AND s.points > 125 AND d.nationality = 'Swiss'

SELECT bond_type, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN bond_seq END) AS bond_seq_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN bond_seq END) AS bond_seq_2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN bond_seq END) AS bond_seq_3 FROM (SELECT bond_type, bond_seq, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bond_type ORDER BY bond_seq ASC) AS rn FROM bond_ref) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 5 GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY bond_type
SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.amount) AS Budget_Allocated FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.status = 'Planned' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.amount) > 1200
SELECT constructorid, COUNT(*) FROM qualifying GROUP BY constructorid HAVING COUNT(*) > 8;
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Lio%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 240000 AND height > 180 AND weight < 85);
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Pet%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 420000);

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN bond_list AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type LIKE 'h%' AND b.transact_dt_tm < '2023-01-01' ORDER BY m.label NULLS LAST, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST

SELECT t1.team_long_name, t2.buildupplaydribblingclass FROM team t1 INNER JOIN team_attributes t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.buildupplaydribbling BETWEEN 25 AND 45 AND t2.chancecreationcrossing > 50

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_id, bl.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'H' AND bl.transact_dt_tm > '2023-06-01' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, bl.bond_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(b.spent) AS Total_Spent_On_Volunteer_Events FROM member AS m JOIN budget AS b ON m.member_id = b.link_to_event JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.type = 'Volunteer' AND e.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 500

SELECT m.member_id, e.expense_description, b.category, e.cost FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN expense AS e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id WHERE e.cost > 100 ORDER BY e.cost DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, av.cnt FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN atom_view AS av ON a.atom_id = av.atom_id WHERE a.element = 'Ne' AND av.cnt BETWEEN 6 AND 9 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS combined_result, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS molecule_name, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property_info FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond AS b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'He%' OR b.bond_type IN ('hydrogen', 'covalent') ORDER BY combined_result ASC, molecule_name DESC
SELECT C.name, C.types FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Modern' AND C.convertedmanacost BETWEEN 2.0 AND 5.0

SELECT raceid, q3 FROM (SELECT raceid, q3, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM qualifying GROUP BY raceid, q3) subq WHERE rank = 1 AND q3 IS NOT NULL AND q3 <> '0' AND q3 LIKE '5%' AND q3 NOT LIKE '1%' AND q3 NOT LIKE '2%' AND q3 NOT LIKE '3%' AND q3 NOT LIKE '4%' AND q3 NOT LIKE '6%' AND q3 NOT LIKE '7%'

SELECT s.district, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numge1500 FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.county = 'San Diego' AND sa.rtype = 'S' ORDER BY sa.avgscrwrite DESC LIMIT 6;
SELECT bond_type, bond_seq FROM bond_ref WHERE bond_type LIKE 'W%' ORDER BY bond_seq ASC NULLS LAST

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS combined_entity, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS entity_id, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property_desc FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond AS b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'K%' OR b.bond_type IN ('resonant', 'conjugated') ORDER BY combined_entity ASC, entity_id DESC

SELECT TA.ID, TA.BUILDUPPLAYSPEED, TA.CHANCECREATIONSHOOTING, TA.DEFENCEPRESSURE, TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH FROM team_attributes AS TA WHERE TA.BUILDUPPLAYSPEED > (SELECT AVG(BUILDUPPLAYSPEED) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.CHANCECREATIONSHOOTING < (SELECT AVG(CHANCECREATIONSHOOTING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCEPRESSURE > (SELECT AVG(DEFENCEPRESSURE) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH < (SELECT AVG(DEFENCETEAMWIDTH) FROM team_attributes)
SELECT MAX(a14) FROM (SELECT a14, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a14 DESC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM district) AS E WHERE (Rank = 5)

SELECT s.dname AS district, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.6 + s.avgscrread * 0.2 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.2) AS balanced_sat_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.dname IN (SELECT s.dname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.dname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.6 + s.avgscrread * 0.2 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.2) DESC nulls last LIMIT 5) GROUP BY s.dname, sch.school ORDER BY s.dname, balanced_sat_score DESC;
SELECT * FROM expense WHERE cost >= 200.0 AND cost <= 600.0 AND link_to_budget = 'recggMW2eyCYceNcy' ORDER BY expense_description NULLS FIRST
SELECT s.superhero_name, a.alignment, p.publisher_name FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE s.height_cm < 170 AND s.gender_id = 1

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS van_der_waals_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'van_der_waals' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'V%' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY van_der_waals_bonds ASC

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS hair_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.hair_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Mahogany%' AND sh.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190 ORDER BY sh.id DESC

SELECT raceid, positiontext AS modal_positiontext FROM (SELECT raceid, positiontext, COUNT(*) AS freq, MIN(resultid) AS first_occurrence, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(resultid) ASC) AS rn FROM results GROUP BY raceid, positiontext) sub WHERE rn = 1 AND positiontext NOT IN ('1', '2', '3', '4', '5') ORDER BY raceid;
SELECT bond_type, bond_seq FROM bond_ref WHERE bond_type LIKE 'Z%' ORDER BY bond_seq ASC NULLS FIRST

WITH event_attendance AS (SELECT link_to_event, link_to_member, SUM(hours) AS total_hours, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_event ORDER BY SUM(hours) DESC) AS rank, 'Event Top Hours' AS result_type FROM attendance GROUP BY link_to_event, link_to_member), member_attendance AS (SELECT link_to_event, link_to_member, SUM(hours) AS total_hours, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_member ORDER BY SUM(hours) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top Hours' AS result_type FROM attendance GROUP BY link_to_event, link_to_member) SELECT link_to_event, link_to_member, total_hours, result_type FROM event_attendance WHERE rank <= 2 UNION ALL SELECT link_to_event, link_to_member, total_hours, result_type FROM member_attendance WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, link_to_event, link_to_member
SELECT a1.molecule_id, a2.molecule_id FROM atom AS a1 INNER JOIN atom AS a2 ON (a1.molecule_id, a2.molecule_id) IN (('MOL200', 'MOL201'), ('MOL200', 'MOL202'), ('MOL201', 'MOL202'))

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq BETWEEN 7 AND 9 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT C.name, C.artist FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Standard' AND C.convertedmanacost BETWEEN 2.0 AND 4.0
SELECT * FROM cards WHERE 2 = (CASE WHEN artist LIKE 'F%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN convertedmanacost = 0.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN hasfoil = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);

WITH SUPERHEROLIST AS (SELECT ID, SUPERHERO_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ID NULLS FIRST) AS ROWNUMBER FROM superhero) SELECT S1.SUPERHERO_NAME AS CURRENTSUPERHERO, S2.SUPERHERO_NAME AS SUPERHEROAFTER4 FROM superherolist AS S1 LEFT JOIN superherolist AS S2 ON S2.ROWNUMBER = S1.ROWNUMBER + 4

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond_list.bond_id) AS recent_sulfur_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond_list ON molecule.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE bond_list.bond_type = 'sulfur' AND bond_list.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY recent_sulfur_bonds DESC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'B' AND br.bond_seq > 2 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, br.bond_seq DESC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Rb' ORDER BY m.label DESC, a.atom_id DESC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS FIRST
SELECT driverid, COUNT(*) FROM qualifying GROUP BY driverid HAVING COUNT(*) > 25;
SELECT s.resultid, s.raceid, d.driverid FROM results AS s INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = s.driverid WHERE s.raceid = 48 AND s.points > 160 AND d.nationality = 'Swedish'

SELECT p.player_name, p.height, COUNT(pa.id) AS defensive_count FROM player p JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.interceptions > 73 AND p.height > 173 GROUP BY p.player_name, p.height HAVING COUNT(pa.id) > 6;
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Luk%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 290000 AND height > 180 AND weight < 85);

SELECT m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(a.hours) AS Total_Charity_Hours FROM member AS m JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.type = 'Charity' GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING SUM(a.hours) > 18
SELECT C.name, C.artist FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Brawl' AND C.convertedmanacost BETWEEN 1.0 AND 3.0

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_id, bl.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Cl' AND bl.transact_dt_tm > '2023-06-01' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, bl.bond_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'G' AND power = '4' AND toughness = '3') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7074') WHEN (colors = 'U' AND power = '3' AND toughness = '2') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7075') WHEN (colors = 'R' AND power = '2' AND toughness = '1') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7076') WHEN (colors = 'W' AND power = '1' AND toughness = '0') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7077') END) AS watermark FROM cards

SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.country LIKE 'H%') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.name LIKE '%Highlands%')

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS skin_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.skin_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Blue%' AND sh.weight_kg < 100 ORDER BY sh.id DESC

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.location AS circuitlocation, d.number AS drivernumber, co.nationality AS constructornationality, res.positiontext AS positiontext, res.fastestlapspeed FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2017 AND 2022 AND res.points > 15 AND res.positionorder <= 3 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.fastestlapspeed DESC

WITH SUPERHERO_RANK AS (SELECT ID, SUPERHERO_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY WEIGHT_KG ASC NULLS FIRST) AS RANK FROM SUPERHERO) SELECT S1.SUPERHERO_NAME AS CURRENT_HERO, S2.SUPERHERO_NAME AS HERO_BEFORE_3 FROM SUPERHERO_RANK AS S1 LEFT JOIN SUPERHERO_RANK AS S2 ON S2.RANK = S1.RANK - 3

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.ethnicity, clinical_status.person_neoplasm_cancer_status, COUNT(person_neoplasm_cancer_status) AS cancer_status_count FROM patients JOIN clinical_status ON patients.patient_id = clinical_status.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = FALSE AND clinical_status.person_neoplasm_cancer_status = 'With Tumor' GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.ethnicity, clinical_status.person_neoplasm_cancer_status ORDER BY patients.patient_id;
SELECT cards.artist, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT * FROM card_type WHERE card_type.cardid = cards.id AND card_type.type = 'Creature') THEN 'creature' ELSE 'not creature' END FROM cards

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Sr' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 2 AND 5 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_list ON atom.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Be' AND bond_list.bond_type = 'single' ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id ASC
SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id WHERE c.district_id BETWEEN 300 AND 400 AND d.type = 'OWNER' LIMIT 1700;
SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS Total_Expenditure FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.status = 'Cancelled' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 1200

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, a.attribute_name AS hero_attribute FROM superhero AS sh JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON sh.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE a.attribute_name LIKE '%Strength%' AND ha.attribute_value > 80 ORDER BY sh.id DESC

SELECT p.player_id, p.match_id, p.minutes_played FROM player_stats p JOIN player_rate pr ON p.player_id = pr.id WHERE p.minutes_played > 75 AND pr.overall_rating BETWEEN 85 AND 95 AND pr.potential_rating > 88 LIMIT 180;

SELECT bond_type, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN molecule_id END) AS molecule_id_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN molecule_id END) AS molecule_id_2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN molecule_id END) AS molecule_id_3 FROM (SELECT bond_type, molecule_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bond_type ORDER BY molecule_id ASC) AS rn FROM bond_list) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 4 GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY bond_type
SELECT C.name, C.types FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Legacy' AND C.convertedmanacost BETWEEN 2.0 AND 4.0 AND C.rarity = 'Mythic' AND C.hasfoil = 1

SELECT raceid, fastestlapspeed AS modal_fastestlapspeed FROM (SELECT raceid, fastestlapspeed, COUNT(*) AS freq, MIN(resultid) AS first_occurrence, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(resultid) ASC) AS rn FROM results GROUP BY raceid, fastestlapspeed) sub WHERE rn = 1 AND fastestlapspeed BETWEEN '200' AND '250' ORDER BY raceid;

SELECT s.city, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numge1500 FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.county = 'San Diego' AND sa.rtype = 'S' ORDER BY sa.avgscrwrite ASC LIMIT 4;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Zn' AND b.bond_type = 'ionic' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.bond_type DESC

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, COUNT(r.raceid) AS race_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.raceid) > 30 THEN 'Legendary' WHEN COUNT(r.raceid) > 15 THEN 'Established' ELSE 'Developing' END AS circuit_status FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid WHERE r.year > 2008 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country HAVING COUNT(r.raceid) > 10

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.interceptions FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.interceptions > 75

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.hct FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'APS' AND l.hct < 30 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.hct HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.hct = j.hct)

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, COUNT(r.raceid) AS race_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.raceid) > 20 THEN 'Historic' WHEN COUNT(r.raceid) > 10 THEN 'Classic' ELSE 'Modern' END AS circuit_era FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid WHERE r.year > 2000 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country HAVING COUNT(r.raceid) > 7

SELECT * FROM member WHERE zip >= 25000 AND zip <= 35000 AND link_to_major = 'recggMW2eyCYceNcy' ORDER BY phone NULLS FIRST

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplaydribbling, ta.buildupplaydribblingclass, ta.chancecreationcrossing, ta.chancecreationcrossingclass, ta.defencepressure, ta.defencepressureclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2025-11-15 00:00:00'

SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.spent) AS avg_expense_per_event FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND e.type = 'Conference' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING AVG(b.spent) > 1000 ORDER BY avg_expense_per_event DESC LIMIT 4

SELECT * FROM cards WHERE 2 = (CASE WHEN artist LIKE 'B%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN convertedmanacost = 10.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN hasnonfoil = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);

WITH member_events AS (
    SELECT
        link_to_member,
        link_to_event,
        COUNT(1) AS total,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_member ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank,
        'Member Top 2' AS result_type
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY link_to_member, link_to_event
),
event_members AS (
    SELECT
        link_to_member,
        link_to_event,
        COUNT(1) AS total,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_event ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank,
        'Event Top 1' AS result_type
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY link_to_member, link_to_event
)
SELECT
    link_to_member,
    link_to_event,
    total,
    result_type
FROM member_events
WHERE rank <= 2

UNION ALL

SELECT
    link_to_member,
    link_to_event,
    total,
    result_type
FROM event_members
WHERE rank = 1

ORDER BY result_type, link_to_member, link_to_event

SELECT sqP.publisher_count AS total_by_publisher, P.publisher_name AS publisher, C.colour AS hair_colour, sqPC.publisher_colour_count AS count_by_publisher_colour FROM (SELECT publisher_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_count FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id) sqP INNER JOIN (SELECT publisher_id, hair_colour_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_colour_count FROM superhero WHERE hair_colour_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id, hair_colour_id) sqPC ON sqP.publisher_id = sqPC.publisher_id INNER JOIN publisher P ON sqP.publisher_id = P.id INNER JOIN colour C ON sqPC.hair_colour_id = C.id WHERE C.colour LIKE 'Green%' ORDER BY P.publisher_name, C.colour;

SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.country LIKE 'A%') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.name LIKE '%Arena%')

SELECT sqP.publisher_count AS total_by_publisher, P.publisher_name AS publisher, C.colour AS skin_colour, sqPC.publisher_colour_count AS count_by_publisher_colour FROM (SELECT publisher_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_count FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id) sqP INNER JOIN (SELECT publisher_id, skin_colour_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_colour_count FROM superhero WHERE skin_colour_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id, skin_colour_id) sqPC ON sqP.publisher_id = sqPC.publisher_id INNER JOIN publisher P ON sqP.publisher_id = P.id INNER JOIN colour C ON sqPC.skin_colour_id = C.id WHERE C.colour LIKE 'Maroon%' ORDER BY P.publisher_name, C.colour;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Au' AND b.bond_type = 'triple' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.bond_type DESC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'H' AND b.bond_type = 'single' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, b.bond_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_list ON atom.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Bi' AND bond_list.bond_type = 'coordinate' ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id ASC

SELECT molecule_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN transact_dt_tm END) AS transact_dt_tm_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN transact_dt_tm END) AS transact_dt_tm_2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN transact_dt_tm END) AS transact_dt_tm_3 FROM (SELECT molecule_id, transact_dt_tm, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY molecule_id ORDER BY transact_dt_tm DESC) AS rn FROM bond_list) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 3 GROUP BY molecule_id ORDER BY molecule_id

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_id, bl.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Cu' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, bl.bond_id NULLS LAST
SELECT raceid, constructorid FROM (SELECT raceid, constructorid, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM qualifying GROUP BY raceid, constructorid) subq WHERE rank = 1

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id ORDER BY m.molecule_id NULLS FIRST, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, b.bond_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.lat AS circuitlatitude, d.code AS drivercode, co.nationality AS constructornationality, res.position AS finishposition, res.fastestlapspeed FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2020 AND res.points > 18 AND res.positionorder <= 3 ORDER BY r.raceid DESC, res.fastestlapspeed ASC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_type, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE bl.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2024-06-01' AND '2024-12-31' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, bl.transact_dt_tm ASC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_id, bl.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Fe' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, bl.bond_id NULLS LAST

SELECT year_created, profileimageurl, cnt_users FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(u.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.profileimageurl, COUNT(u.id) AS cnt_users, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(u.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(u.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM users AS u WHERE u.profileimageurl IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(u.creationdate AS DATE)), u.profileimageurl) AS u WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_users DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT TA.ID, TA.BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING, TA.CHANCECREATIONPASSING, TA.DEFENCEPRESSURE, TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH FROM team_attributes AS TA WHERE TA.BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING > (SELECT AVG(BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.CHANCECREATIONPASSING < (SELECT AVG(CHANCECREATIONPASSING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH < (SELECT AVG(DEFENCETEAMWIDTH) FROM team_attributes)

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 1003 THEN 1003 WHEN s.id = 1004 THEN 1004 WHEN s.id = 1005 THEN 1005 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, sp.power_name FROM superhero AS s JOIN hero_power AS hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE s.id IN (1003, 1004, 1005) AND sp.power_name LIKE 'Electric%'
SELECT p.id, p.sex, p.birthday, AVG(l.c3) AS avg_complement_c3_level FROM patient AS p INNER JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id GROUP BY p.id, p.sex, p.birthday

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.lat AS circuitlatitude, d.code AS drivercode, co.nationality AS constructornationality, res.position AS finishposition, res.fastestlapspeed FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2020 AND res.points > 15 AND res.positionorder <= 3 ORDER BY r.raceid DESC, res.fastestlapspeed ASC
SELECT cdscode, COUNT(fundingtype) FROM schools WHERE county = 'Solano County' GROUP BY cdscode LIMIT 19
SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS total_budget FROM budget WHERE amount < 300 GROUP BY link_to_event HAVING SUM(amount) > 800

SELECT raceid, q1 AS modal_q1 FROM (SELECT raceid, q1, COUNT(*) AS freq, MIN(qualifyid) AS first_occurrence, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(qualifyid) ASC) AS rn FROM qualifying GROUP BY raceid, q1) sub WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY raceid;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq <> 2 AND br.bond_seq <> 4 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.country LIKE 'P%') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.name LIKE '%Park%')

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.free_kick_accuracy FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.free_kick_accuracy > 90

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Cd' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, b.bond_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT year_created, displayname, cnt_postlinks FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(pl.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.displayname, COUNT(pl.id) AS cnt_postlinks, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(pl.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(pl.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM postlinks AS pl INNER JOIN users AS u ON pl.relatedpostid = u.id WHERE u.displayname LIKE 'V%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(pl.creationdate AS DATE)), u.id, u.displayname) AS pl WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_postlinks DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT e.event_name, COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS Total_Attendees FROM event AS e LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event WHERE e.type = 'Seminar' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING COUNT(a.link_to_member) > 7
SELECT cdscode, COUNT(admemail3) FROM schools WHERE county = 'Inyo County' GROUP BY cdscode LIMIT 47

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN hgb < 10 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Severe_Anemia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN plt < 100 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_Low_Platelets, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN wbc > 15 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_WBC FROM laboratory GROUP BY id
SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'hydrogen' AND molecule.label LIKE 'Base%'

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN got > 200 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Critical_High_GOT, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN gpt > 200 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Critical_High_GPT, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN ldh > 1000 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Critical_High_LDH FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

SELECT TA.ID, TA.BUILDUPPLAYSPEED, TA.CHANCECREATIONPASSING, TA.DEFENCEPRESSURE, TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH FROM team_attributes AS TA WHERE TA.BUILDUPPLAYSPEED > (SELECT AVG(BUILDUPPLAYSPEED) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.CHANCECREATIONPASSING < (SELECT AVG(CHANCECREATIONPASSING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCEPRESSURE > (SELECT AVG(DEFENCEPRESSURE) FROM team_attributes)

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence, AVG(demographics.weight) AS avg_weight FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence = TRUE AND demographics.gender = 'Female' AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_ihc > 3 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence ORDER BY patients.patient_id;
SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS hair_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.hair_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Auburn%' ORDER BY sh.id ASC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_id, bl.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'B' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, bl.bond_id NULLS LAST
SELECT b1.bond_type, b2.bond_type FROM bond_ref AS b1 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS b2 ON (b1.bond_type, b2.bond_type) IN (('BT100', 'BT101'), ('BT100', 'BT102'), ('BT101', 'BT102'))

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS eye_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Aquamarine%' AND sh.height_cm BETWEEN 180 AND 200 ORDER BY sh.id DESC
SELECT account_id FROM trans GROUP BY account_id HAVING COUNT(trans_id) > 8 AND (MAX(balance) - MIN(balance)) > 75000;
SELECT c1.atom_id, c2.atom_id2 FROM connected AS c1 INNER JOIN connected AS c2 ON (c1.atom_id, c2.atom_id2) IN (('AT2300', 'AT2301'), ('AT2300', 'AT2302'), ('AT2301', 'AT2302'))

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS composite_key, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS molecule_ref, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond_list AS b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Os%' OR b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' ORDER BY composite_key DESC, molecule_ref ASC
SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.bond_id DESC) AS rnk FROM bond_list a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 5

SELECT s.superhero_name, g.gender, p.power_name FROM superhero s JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower p ON hp.power_id = p.id WHERE s.alignment_id = 3 AND s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq BETWEEN 2 AND 4 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id ASC, br.bond_seq DESC

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplayspeed, ta.buildupplayspeedclass, ta.chancecreationcrossing, ta.chancecreationcrossingclass, ta.defenceaggression, ta.defenceaggressionclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2026-09-15 00:00:00'

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS fusion_key, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS substance_code, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS characteristic_type FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Kr%' OR b.bond_type IN ('covalent', 'ionic') ORDER BY fusion_key ASC, substance_code DESC

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS Total_Event_Costs FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.event_status = 'Approved' AND b.category = 'Charity' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 1000
SELECT * FROM legalities WHERE 2 = (CASE WHEN format = 'Vintage' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN status = 'Restricted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);
SELECT t1.* FROM cards t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM cards GROUP BY ispromo, isreprint) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_list ON atom.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Cu' AND bond_list.bond_type = 'hydrogen' ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id ASC

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, a.attribute_name AS hero_trait FROM superhero AS sh JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON sh.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE a.attribute_name LIKE '%Speed%' AND ha.attribute_value > 90 ORDER BY sh.id DESC

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Notable Question' WHERE u.reputation >= 40000 AND u.creationdate > '2019-01-01'

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.plt FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'RA' AND l.plt > 150000 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.plt HAVING COUNT(*) > 2) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.plt = j.plt)

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Ni' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 6 AND 9 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, br.bond_seq DESC

SELECT sqA.alignment_count AS total_by_alignment, A.alignment AS alignment, C.colour AS eye_colour, sqAC.alignment_colour_count AS count_by_alignment_colour FROM (SELECT alignment_id, COUNT(*) AS alignment_count FROM superhero WHERE alignment_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY alignment_id) sqA INNER JOIN (SELECT alignment_id, eye_colour_id, COUNT(*) AS alignment_colour_count FROM superhero WHERE eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY alignment_id, eye_colour_id) sqAC ON sqA.alignment_id = sqAC.alignment_id INNER JOIN alignment A ON sqA.alignment_id = A.id INNER JOIN colour C ON sqAC.eye_colour_id = C.id WHERE C.colour LIKE 'Blue%' ORDER BY A.alignment, C.colour;

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 700 THEN 700 WHEN s.id = 701 THEN 701 WHEN s.id = 702 THEN 702 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, a.attribute_name FROM superhero AS s JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE s.id IN (700, 701, 702) AND a.attribute_name LIKE 'Leadership%'

SELECT TA.ID, TA.BUILDUPPLAYSPEED, TA.CHANCECREATIONPASSING, TA.DEFENCEAGGRESSION, TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH FROM team_attributes AS TA WHERE TA.CHANCECREATIONPASSING > (SELECT AVG(CHANCECREATIONPASSING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCEAGGRESSION < (SELECT AVG(DEFENCEAGGRESSION) FROM team_attributes)
SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'ba' THEN 1 END) AS ba_atoms, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element IN ('sr', 'cs') THEN molecule_id END) AS sr_atoms FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.aggression FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.aggression > 85 AND Player_Attributes.strength > 80

WITH SUPERHERO_GROUP_RANK AS (SELECT ID, SUBGROUP1, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUBGROUP2 ASC NULLS FIRST) AS RANK FROM SUPERHERO_GROUP) SELECT S1.SUBGROUP1 AS CURRENT_SUBGROUP, S2.SUBGROUP1 AS SUBGROUP_AFTER_8 FROM SUPERHERO_GROUP_RANK AS S1 LEFT JOIN SUPERHERO_GROUP_RANK AS S2 ON S2.RANK = S1.RANK + 8

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = 'van der Waals' AND m.label LIKE 'CO2%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.bond_type DESC
SELECT m.member_id, SUM(i.amount) AS Total_Income FROM member AS m JOIN income AS i ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member WHERE i.source = 'Donation' GROUP BY m.member_id HAVING SUM(i.amount) > 1000

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS Social_Events_Organized FROM member AS m JOIN event AS e ON m.member_id = e.event_id WHERE e.type = 'Social' AND e.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 1

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count, COUNT(primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count) AS lymph_node_examined_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count BETWEEN 20 AND 40 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count ORDER BY patients.patient_id;
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Ser%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 520000 AND height > 175);

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Ne' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 5 AND 8 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond_ref WHERE bond_seq = 2) AS bond_seq_count, bond_type, COUNT(*) AS bond_type_count FROM bond_ref GROUP BY ROLLUP (bond_type)

SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.country LIKE 'V%') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.name LIKE '%Village%')
SELECT m.member_id FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN major AS maj ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id WHERE maj.major_id IS NULL AND maj.college = 'Engineering'

SELECT s.superhero_name, a.alignment, c.colour FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.gender_id = 3 AND s.weight_kg BETWEEN 50 AND 70 AND s.height_cm > 190

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Sr' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST
SELECT raceid, fastestlap FROM (SELECT raceid, fastestlap, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM results GROUP BY raceid, fastestlap) subq WHERE rank = 1

SELECT raceid, fastestlapspeed FROM (SELECT raceid, fastestlapspeed, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM results GROUP BY raceid, fastestlapspeed) subq WHERE rank = 1

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Archaeologist' WHERE u.reputation >= 2000 AND u.creationdate < '2014-01-01'

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.aptt FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'APS' AND l.aptt > 45 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.aptt HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.aptt = j.aptt)

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'S' AND br.bond_seq < 2 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, br.bond_seq DESC

SELECT year_created, displayname, cnt_postlinks FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(pl.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.displayname, COUNT(pl.id) AS cnt_postlinks, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(pl.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(pl.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM postlinks AS pl INNER JOIN users AS u ON pl.postid = u.id WHERE u.displayname LIKE 'X%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(pl.creationdate AS DATE)), u.id, u.displayname) AS pl WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_postlinks DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT sqP.publisher_count AS total_by_publisher, P.publisher_name AS publisher, C.colour AS skin_colour, sqPC.publisher_colour_count AS count_by_publisher_colour FROM (SELECT publisher_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_count FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id) sqP INNER JOIN (SELECT publisher_id, skin_colour_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_colour_count FROM superhero WHERE skin_colour_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id, skin_colour_id) sqPC ON sqP.publisher_id = sqPC.publisher_id INNER JOIN publisher P ON sqP.publisher_id = P.id INNER JOIN colour C ON sqPC.skin_colour_id = C.id WHERE C.colour LIKE 'Gold%' ORDER BY P.publisher_name, C.colour;

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'B' AND power = '5' AND toughness = '3') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '8082') WHEN (colors = 'W' AND power = '4' AND toughness = '2') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '8083') WHEN (colors = 'U' AND power = '3' AND toughness = '1') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '8084') WHEN (colors = 'R' AND power = '2' AND toughness = '0') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '8085') END) AS watermark FROM cards
SELECT constructorid, COUNT(*) FROM constructors GROUP BY constructorid HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

SELECT bond_type, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN bond_seq END) AS bond_seq_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN bond_seq END) AS bond_seq_2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN bond_seq END) AS bond_seq_3 FROM (SELECT bond_type, bond_seq, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bond_type ORDER BY bond_seq DESC) AS rn FROM bond_ref) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 6 GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY bond_type

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Taxonomist' WHERE u.reputation >= 1000 AND u.creationdate > '2021-01-01'

SELECT m.email, e.event_name, b.spent, z.state FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.spent BETWEEN 600 AND 900 ORDER BY b.spent DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.marking FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.marking > 85

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN cre > 1.5 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_Creatinine, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN ua > 8.0 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_Uric_Acid, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN un > 25 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_Urea FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Fe' AND b.bond_type = 'triple' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, b.bond_id NULLS FIRST
SELECT atom_id, atom_id2 FROM connected ORDER BY bond_id ASC NULLS FIRST

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.defensive_work_rate FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.defensive_work_rate = 'normal'
SELECT player_id FROM player_stats_temp GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) > 6 AND (MAX(red_cards) - MIN(red_cards)) > 2;
SELECT atom_id, element FROM atom WHERE element LIKE 'C%' ORDER BY atom_id DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id ORDER BY m.molecule_id NULLS FIRST, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, b.bond_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.location AS circuitlocation, d.code AS drivercode, co.nationality AS constructornationality, res.position AS finishposition, res.laps AS totallaps FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2020 AND res.points > 12 AND res.positionorder <= 5 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.position DESC

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'R' AND power = '5' AND toughness = '4') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '8088') WHEN (colors = 'G' AND power = '4' AND toughness = '3') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '8089') WHEN (colors = 'B' AND power = '3' AND toughness = '2') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '8090') WHEN (colors = 'W' AND power = '2' AND toughness = '1') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '8091') END) AS watermark FROM cards
SELECT district_id FROM district GROUP BY district_id HAVING COUNT(a14) > 3 AND (MAX(a16) - MIN(a16)) > 2000;

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.lng AS circuitlongitude, d.code AS drivercode, co.nationality AS constructornationality, res.position AS finishposition, res.fastestlaptime FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2014 AND 2019 AND res.points > 15 AND res.positionorder <= 4 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.fastestlaptime DESC

SELECT sqP.publisher_count AS total_by_publisher, P.publisher_name AS publisher, C.colour AS skin_colour, sqPC.publisher_colour_count AS count_by_publisher_colour FROM (SELECT publisher_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_count FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id) sqP INNER JOIN (SELECT publisher_id, skin_colour_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_colour_count FROM superhero WHERE skin_colour_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id, skin_colour_id) sqPC ON sqP.publisher_id = sqPC.publisher_id INNER JOIN publisher P ON sqP.publisher_id = P.id INNER JOIN colour C ON sqPC.skin_colour_id = C.id WHERE C.colour LIKE 'Black%' ORDER BY P.publisher_name, C.colour;

SELECT sqP.publisher_count AS total_by_publisher, P.publisher_name AS publisher, C.colour AS skin_colour, sqPC.publisher_colour_count AS count_by_publisher_colour FROM (SELECT publisher_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_count FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id) sqP INNER JOIN (SELECT publisher_id, skin_colour_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_colour_count FROM superhero WHERE skin_colour_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id, skin_colour_id) sqPC ON sqP.publisher_id = sqPC.publisher_id INNER JOIN publisher P ON sqP.publisher_id = P.id INNER JOIN colour C ON sqPC.skin_colour_id = C.id WHERE C.colour LIKE 'Copper%' ORDER BY P.publisher_name, C.colour;

SELECT atom_id, element FROM atom ORDER BY element DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.lat AS circuitlatitude, d.code AS drivercode, co.nationality AS constructornationality, res.position AS finishposition, res.fastestlapspeed FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2014 AND 2018 AND res.points > 10 AND res.positionorder <= 6 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.fastestlapspeed DESC

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.aptt FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'SLE' AND l.aptt > 48 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.aptt HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.aptt = j.aptt)

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplayspeed, ta.buildupplayspeedclass, ta.chancecreationshooting, ta.chancecreationshootingclass, ta.defenceteamwidth, ta.defenceteamwidthclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2025-06-15 00:00:00'

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond.bond_type FROM atom LEFT JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'covalent' AND atom.element = 'Carbon' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'CHEM%'
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MIN(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Joe%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 390000);

SELECT m.phone, e.location, b.category, z.short_state FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.amount BETWEEN 1100 AND 1900 ORDER BY b.amount DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT '2024-09-01' AS reporting_date, COUNT(CASE WHEN opendate < '2024-09-01' AND (closeddate IS NULL OR closeddate >= '2024-09-01') THEN 1 END) AS active_schools_in_ventura FROM schools WHERE county = 'Ventura';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Rb' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 8 AND 12 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, br.bond_seq DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 700 THEN 700 WHEN s.id = 701 THEN 701 WHEN s.id = 702 THEN 702 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, sp.power_name FROM superhero AS s JOIN hero_power AS hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE s.id IN (700, 701, 702) AND sp.power_name LIKE 'Fire%'
SELECT t1.* FROM cards t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM cards GROUP BY multiverseid) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id

SELECT m.email, e.event_name, b.spent, z.county FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.spent > 800 ORDER BY b.spent DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS total_elements FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 6 AND 18;
SELECT MAX(loan_amount) FROM (SELECT loan_amount, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY loan_amount DESC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM loan) AS E WHERE (Rank = 4)

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Cl' AND br.bond_seq > 2 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, br.bond_seq DESC

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS merged_key, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS compound_code, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS feature_type FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Cr%' OR b.bond_type IN ('hydrogen', 'metallic') ORDER BY merged_key ASC, compound_code DESC

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS hair_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.hair_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Violet%' AND sh.weight_kg BETWEEN 60 AND 80 ORDER BY sh.id DESC

SELECT atom_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN atom_id2 END) AS atom_id2_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN atom_id2 END) AS atom_id2_2 FROM (SELECT atom_id, atom_id2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY atom_id ORDER BY atom_id2 ASC) AS rn FROM connected) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 2 GROUP BY atom_id ORDER BY atom_id

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Zr' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 4 AND 7 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, br.bond_seq ASC

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date > '2023-06-01' AND e.type = 'Conference' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 1000 ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Precision' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 25 AND 45)

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS Total_Event_Expenditure FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.event_status = 'Approved' AND b.category = 'Networking' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 900

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq BETWEEN 17 AND 19 AND m.label LIKE 'P%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT * FROM packages WHERE 3 = (CASE WHEN status = 'shipped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN weight_kg > 1.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN is_fragile = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, AVG(a.hours) AS Avg_Hours FROM member AS m JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member WHERE a.hours > 5 GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING AVG(a.hours) > 8

SELECT s.school FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('San Francisco', 'Alameda') AND s.charter = 1 AND s.magnet = 1 GROUP BY s.school HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 2;
