SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.amount) AS total_budget FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-06-30' AND e.type = 'Workshop' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.amount) > 3000 ORDER BY total_budget ASC LIMIT 4

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Hg' AND b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-07-01' AND '2023-12-31' ORDER BY m.label ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Cu' AND br.bond_seq < 3 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, br.bond_seq NULLS FIRST

SELECT * FROM major WHERE major_name >= 'English' AND major_name <= 'History' AND college = 'Arts' ORDER BY department NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Pb' AND br.bond_seq > 4 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, br.bond_seq DESC

SELECT m.email, e.event_name, b.spent, z.city FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.spent BETWEEN 500 AND 1000 ORDER BY b.spent DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.aptt FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'SLE' AND l.aptt > 35 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.aptt HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.aptt = j.aptt)
SELECT b1.bond_seq, b2.bond_seq FROM bond_ref AS b1 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS b2 ON (b1.bond_seq, b2.bond_seq) IN ((16, 17), (16, 18), (17, 18))
SELECT m1.molecule_id, m2.molecule_id FROM molecule AS m1 INNER JOIN molecule AS m2 ON (m1.molecule_id, m2.molecule_id) IN (('TR900', 'TR901'), ('TR900', 'TR902'), ('TR901', 'TR902'))

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Cu' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_list ON atom.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Ir' AND bond_list.bond_type = 'coordinate' ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id ASC

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(b.spent) AS Total_Spent_On_Conferences FROM member AS m JOIN budget AS b ON m.member_id = b.link_to_event JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.type = 'Conference' AND e.status = 'Approved' AND b.spent > 450 GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 2800
SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS total_atoms FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 7;
SELECT p.player_id, p.match_id, p.goals FROM player_stats p JOIN player_rate pr ON p.player_id = pr.id WHERE p.goals > 5 AND pr.overall_rating > 95 LIMIT 300;
SELECT C.name, C.artist FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Modern' AND C.convertedmanacost BETWEEN 1.0 AND 3.0

SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.country LIKE 'I%') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.name LIKE '%Isle%')
SELECT raceid, q1 FROM (SELECT raceid, q1, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM qualifying GROUP BY raceid, q1) subq WHERE rank = 1 AND q1 IS NOT NULL AND q1 <> '0'

SELECT raceid, milliseconds AS modal_milliseconds FROM (SELECT raceid, milliseconds, COUNT(*) AS freq, MIN(resultid) AS first_occurrence, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(resultid) ASC) AS rn FROM results GROUP BY raceid, milliseconds) sub WHERE rn = 1 AND milliseconds > 90000 ORDER BY raceid;
SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.bond_type DESC) AS rnk FROM bond_list a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 5
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond_list WHERE bond_type = 'POLAR') AS bond_type_count, transact_dt_tm, COUNT(*) AS transact_dt_tm_count FROM bond_list GROUP BY ROLLUP (transact_dt_tm)

WITH member_privileges_analysis AS (SELECT privilege_level, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total_privileges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY privilege_level ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Privilege Top 4' AS result_type FROM member_privileges WHERE is_active = true AND privilege_scope = 'Events' GROUP BY privilege_level, member_id), privilege_members AS (SELECT privilege_level, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total_privileges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top Privilege' AS result_type FROM member_privileges WHERE is_active = true AND privilege_scope = 'Events' GROUP BY privilege_level, member_id) SELECT privilege_level, member_id, total_privileges, result_type FROM member_privileges_analysis WHERE rank <= 4 UNION ALL SELECT privilege_level, member_id, total_privileges, result_type FROM privilege_members WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, privilege_level, member_id

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplaydribbling, ta.buildupplaydribblingclass, ta.chancecreationcrossing, ta.chancecreationcrossingclass, ta.defencepressure, ta.defencepressureclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2028-01-01 00:00:00'

SELECT p.player_name, p.height, COUNT(pa.id) AS gk_skill_count FROM player p JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.gk_positioning > 80 AND pa.gk_reflexes > 85 AND p.height > 185 GROUP BY p.player_name, p.height HAVING COUNT(pa.id) > 8;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'U' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 10 AND 15 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, br.bond_seq DESC

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence, AVG(demographics.height) AS avg_height FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence = TRUE AND demographics.gender = 'Male' AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_he > 6 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.tp FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'SLE' AND l.tp < 6.0 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.tp HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.tp = j.tp)
SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Precision' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 35 AND 55)

SELECT p.player_id, p.match_id, p.assists FROM player_stats p JOIN player_rate pr ON p.player_id = pr.id WHERE p.assists > 1 AND pr.overall_rating BETWEEN 75 AND 85 AND pr.potential_rating > 82 LIMIT 170;

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS unified_key, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS compound_code, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS feature_type FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond_list AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Y%' OR b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-04-15' AND '2023-09-15' ORDER BY unified_key ASC, compound_code DESC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'B' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT raceid, q3 FROM (SELECT raceid, q3, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM qualifying GROUP BY raceid, q3) subq WHERE rank = 1 AND q3 IS NOT NULL AND q3 <> '0' AND q3 LIKE '8%' AND q3 NOT LIKE '1%' AND q3 NOT LIKE '2%' AND q3 NOT LIKE '3%' AND q3 NOT LIKE '4%' AND q3 NOT LIKE '5%' AND q3 NOT LIKE '6%' AND q3 NOT LIKE '7%'
SELECT t1.team_short_name, t2.buildupplayspeed FROM team t1 INNER JOIN team_attributes t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.buildupplayspeed BETWEEN 65 AND 85

SELECT s.dname AS district, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 1.1 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.9) AS weighted_math_write_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.dname IN (SELECT s.dname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.dname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 1.1 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.9) DESC nulls last LIMIT 5) GROUP BY s.dname, sch.school ORDER BY s.dname, weighted_math_write_score DESC;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'I' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.lat AS circuitlatitude, d.code AS drivercode, co.nationality AS constructornationality, res.position AS finishposition, res.fastestlapspeed FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2015 AND res.points > 12 AND res.positionorder <= 5 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.fastestlapspeed DESC

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond_ref.bond_type, bond_ref.bond_seq FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref ON bond.bond_type = bond_ref.bond_type WHERE atom.element = 'Pt' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id DESC, atom.atom_id ASC, bond_ref.bond_seq NULLS FIRST

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond_list.bond_id) AS recent_copper_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond_list ON molecule.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE bond_list.bond_type = 'metallic' AND bond_list.transact_dt_tm > '2024-01-01' AND bond_list.molecule_id LIKE 'Cu%' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY recent_copper_bonds DESC

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, p.publisher_name AS comic_publisher FROM superhero AS sh JOIN publisher AS p ON sh.publisher_id = p.id WHERE p.publisher_name LIKE '%DC%' ORDER BY sh.id ASC

SELECT TA.ID, TA.BUILDUPPLAYSPEED, TA.CHANCECREATIONPASSING, TA.DEFENCEAGGRESSION, TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH FROM team_attributes AS TA WHERE TA.BUILDUPPLAYSPEED > (SELECT AVG(BUILDUPPLAYSPEED) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.CHANCECREATIONPASSING < (SELECT AVG(CHANCECREATIONPASSING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCEAGGRESSION > (SELECT AVG(DEFENCEAGGRESSION) FROM team_attributes)
SELECT MIN(yellow_cards) FROM (SELECT yellow_cards, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY yellow_cards ASC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM player_stats_temp) AS E WHERE (Rank = 3)
SELECT driverid, COUNT(*) FROM results GROUP BY driverid HAVING COUNT(*) > 15;

SELECT e.event_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS Unique_Volunteers FROM event AS e JOIN attendance AS a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event WHERE e.type = 'Volunteer' AND e.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) > 3

SELECT r.raceid, r.name, COUNT(p.driverid) AS pitstop_count, AVG(p.milliseconds) AS avg_pitstop_time FROM races r JOIN pitstops p ON r.raceid = p.raceid WHERE r.year > 2018 GROUP BY r.raceid, r.name HAVING COUNT(p.driverid) > 5

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id ORDER BY m.molecule_id NULLS FIRST, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, b.bond_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT year_created, displayname, cnt_postlinks FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(pl.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.displayname, COUNT(pl.id) AS cnt_postlinks, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(pl.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(pl.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM postlinks AS pl INNER JOIN users AS u ON pl.postid = u.id WHERE u.displayname LIKE 'W%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(pl.creationdate AS DATE)), u.id, u.displayname) AS pl WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_postlinks DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN igg > 23 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_IgG, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN iga > 23 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_IgA, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN igm > 23 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_IgM FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 180 THEN 180 WHEN s.id = 181 THEN 181 WHEN s.id = 182 THEN 182 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, c.colour FROM superhero AS s JOIN colour AS c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.id IN (180, 181, 182) AND c.colour = 'Brown'

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN hgb < 11.4 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Moderate_Anemia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN plt < 106 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Mild_Thrombocytopenia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN wbc > 12.7 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Leukocytosis FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_type, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE bl.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-12-31' AND m.label LIKE 'CO2%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, bl.transact_dt_tm DESC
SELECT MIN(a12) FROM (SELECT a12, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a12 ASC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM district) AS E WHERE (Rank = 5)

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Cu' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 1 AND 4 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT p.player_id, p.match_id, p.goals FROM player_stats p JOIN player_rate pr ON p.player_id = pr.id WHERE p.goals > 3 AND pr.overall_rating BETWEEN 92 AND 97 AND pr.potential_rating > 93 AND p.minutes_played > 85 LIMIT 250;
SELECT nationality, COUNT(*) FROM drivers GROUP BY nationality HAVING COUNT(*) > 8;

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 500 THEN 500 WHEN s.id = 501 THEN 501 WHEN s.id = 502 THEN 502 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, a.alignment FROM superhero AS s JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id WHERE s.id IN (500, 501, 502) AND a.alignment = 'Chaotic'

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_list ON atom.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Tc' AND bond_list.bond_type = 'coordinate' ORDER BY molecule.label ASC, atom.atom_id DESC

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplaypassing, ta.buildupplaypassingclass, ta.chancecreationpassing, ta.chancecreationpassingclass, ta.defencepressure, ta.defencepressureclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2015-02-28 00:00:00'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Pt' AND br.bond_seq > 5 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, br.bond_seq NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.phone, e.location, b.category, z.state FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.amount BETWEEN 1100 AND 1900 ORDER BY b.amount DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Au' AND b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-12-31' ORDER BY m.label DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST
SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'ionic' AND molecule.label LIKE 'Crystal%'

SELECT s.district, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numge1500 FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.county = 'Monterey' AND sa.rtype = 'D' ORDER BY sa.avgscrread DESC LIMIT 4;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Cl' AND br.bond_seq > 5 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, br.bond_seq DESC
SELECT driverid, COUNT(*) FROM laptimes GROUP BY driverid HAVING COUNT(*) > 10;

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS hair_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.hair_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Blonde%' AND sh.weight_kg BETWEEN 65 AND 85 ORDER BY sh.id DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 700 THEN 700 WHEN s.id = 701 THEN 701 WHEN s.id = 702 THEN 702 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, a.attribute_name FROM superhero AS s JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE s.id IN (700, 701, 702) AND a.attribute_name LIKE 'Charisma%'
SELECT br1.bond_seq, br2.bond_seq FROM bond_ref AS br1 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br2 ON (br1.bond_seq, br2.bond_seq) IN ((4, 5), (4, 6), (5, 6))

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_he, SUM(primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_he) AS total_positive_lymph_nodes FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_he > 4 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_he ORDER BY patients.patient_id;
SELECT s.school FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('Sacramento', 'Placer') GROUP BY s.school HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 2;

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.ethnicity, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count, COUNT(primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count) AS lymph_node_examined_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count BETWEEN 40 AND 50 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.ethnicity, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count ORDER BY patients.patient_id;
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.stamina FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 170 AND 180 AND PA.stamina > 85

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS composite_key, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS molecule_ref, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond_list AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Rn%' OR b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-11-01' AND '2023-12-31' ORDER BY composite_key DESC, molecule_ref ASC

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(atom.element) AS element_count FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'C' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY element_count DESC
SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond.bond_type FROM atom LEFT JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'ionic'

WITH member_privileges_analysis AS (SELECT privilege_level, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total_privileges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY privilege_level ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Privilege Top 3' AS result_type FROM member_privileges GROUP BY privilege_level, member_id), privilege_members AS (SELECT privilege_level, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total_privileges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top Privilege' AS result_type FROM member_privileges GROUP BY privilege_level, member_id) SELECT privilege_level, member_id, total_privileges, result_type FROM member_privileges_analysis WHERE rank <= 3 UNION ALL SELECT privilege_level, member_id, total_privileges, result_type FROM privilege_members WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, privilege_level, member_id

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS Total_Event_Expenses FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.event_status = 'Approved' AND b.category = 'Retreat' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 2000
SELECT * FROM (SELECT c.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.atom_id ORDER BY c.atom_id2) AS rnk FROM connected c) subquery WHERE rnk <= 3

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond_list.bond_id, bond_list.bond_type FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list ON connected.bond_id = bond_list.bond_id WHERE atom.element = 'Ne' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id DESC, atom.atom_id ASC, bond_list.bond_id NULLS FIRST
SELECT t1.team_long_name, t2.defenceaggressionclass FROM team t1 INNER JOIN team_attributes t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.defenceaggression BETWEEN 70 AND 90

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_list ON atom.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Pb' AND bond_list.bond_type = 'quadruple' ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id ASC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Pt' AND b.bond_type = 'ionic' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.bond_type DESC

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.country AS circuitcountry, d.forename AS driverfirstname, d.surname AS driverlastname, co.name AS teamname, res.grid AS qualifyingposition, res.fastestlaptime FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2008 AND 2013 AND res.points > 8 AND res.positionorder <= 5 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.fastestlaptime DESC

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.remaining) AS Total_Unused_Funds FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.event_status = 'Completed' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.remaining) > 2000
