SELECT nationality, COUNT(*) FROM constructors GROUP BY nationality HAVING COUNT(*) > 6;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, av.cnt FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN atom_view AS av ON a.atom_id = av.atom_id WHERE av.cnt > 5 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, av.cnt DESC

SELECT m.email, e.event_name, b.spent, z.county FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.spent BETWEEN 50 AND 150 ORDER BY b.spent DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.country LIKE 'H%') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.name LIKE '%Speed%')
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Vin%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 500000 AND weight > 75);

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS fusion_id, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS substance_id, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS quality FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond AS b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'P%' OR b.bond_type IN ('van der Waals', 'dipole') ORDER BY fusion_id ASC, substance_id DESC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, bl.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Ar' AND bl.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-02-01' AND '2023-05-31' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, bl.bond_type DESC

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond_list.bond_id) AS recent_hydrogen_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond_list ON molecule.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE bond_list.bond_type = 'hydrogen' AND bond_list.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-06-01' AND '2023-12-31' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY recent_hydrogen_bonds DESC

SELECT raceid, statusid AS modal_statusid FROM (SELECT raceid, statusid, COUNT(*) AS freq, MIN(resultid) AS first_occurrence, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(resultid) ASC) AS rn FROM results GROUP BY raceid, statusid) sub WHERE rn = 1 AND statusid BETWEEN 3 AND 8 ORDER BY raceid;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq < 3 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, br.bond_seq ASC

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond.bond_id, bond.bond_type FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id INNER JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE atom.element = 'Ca' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id ASC, atom.atom_id DESC, bond.bond_id ASC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Ti' AND br.bond_seq < 3 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, br.bond_seq NULLS FIRST

SELECT sqA.alignment_count AS total_by_alignment, A.alignment AS alignment, C.colour AS skin_colour, sqAC.alignment_colour_count AS count_by_alignment_colour FROM (SELECT alignment_id, COUNT(*) AS alignment_count FROM superhero WHERE alignment_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY alignment_id) sqA INNER JOIN (SELECT alignment_id, skin_colour_id, COUNT(*) AS alignment_colour_count FROM superhero WHERE skin_colour_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY alignment_id, skin_colour_id) sqAC ON sqA.alignment_id = sqAC.alignment_id INNER JOIN alignment A ON sqA.alignment_id = A.id INNER JOIN colour C ON sqAC.skin_colour_id = C.id WHERE C.colour LIKE 'Green%' ORDER BY A.alignment, C.colour;
SELECT raceid, COUNT(*) FROM results GROUP BY raceid HAVING COUNT(*) > 40;

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN alp > 120 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS High_ALP, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN cpk > 200 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS High_CPK, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN glu < 70 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Low_Glucose FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_list ON atom.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Zr' AND bond_list.bond_type = 'quadruple' ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 7 THEN 7 WHEN s.id = 8 THEN 8 WHEN s.id = 9 THEN 9 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, a.alignment FROM superhero AS s JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id WHERE s.id IN (7, 8, 9)

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Sage' WHERE u.reputation >= 28000 AND u.creationdate > '2018-01-01'

SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.country LIKE 'I%') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.name LIKE '%City%')

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Ne' AND br.bond_seq > 3 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, br.bond_seq NULLS FIRST

WITH SUPERHERO_GROUP_RANK AS (SELECT ID, SUBGROUP1, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUBGROUP2 DESC NULLS LAST) AS RANK FROM SUPERHERO_GROUP) SELECT S1.SUBGROUP1 AS CURRENT_SUBGROUP, S2.SUBGROUP1 AS SUBGROUP_BEFORE_1 FROM SUPERHERO_GROUP_RANK AS S1 LEFT JOIN SUPERHERO_GROUP_RANK AS S2 ON S2.RANK = S1.RANK - 1

SELECT s.superhero_name, a.alignment, p.power_name FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower p ON hp.power_id = p.id WHERE s.weight_kg BETWEEN 95 AND 115 AND s.gender_id = 2

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'B' AND power = '1') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '1040') WHEN (colors = 'W' AND power = '0') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '1041') WHEN (colors = 'G' AND power = '2') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '1042') WHEN (colors = 'U' AND power = '3') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '1043') END) AS watermark FROM cards

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = 'ionic' AND m.label LIKE 'NaCl%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.bond_type ASC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Sn' AND b.bond_type = 'double' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.bond_type ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS member_count, zip_code.state FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'active' AND zip_code.type = 'standard' AND member.t_shirt_size = 'XXXL' GROUP BY zip_code.state

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 700 THEN 700 WHEN s.id = 701 THEN 701 WHEN s.id = 702 THEN 702 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, a.attribute_name FROM superhero AS s JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE s.id IN (700, 701, 702) AND a.attribute_name LIKE 'Reflexes%'

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence, COUNT(pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence) AS metastasis_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence = TRUE AND demographics.gender = 'Female' AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_he > 5 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS total_expenses FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-06-30' AND e.type = 'Conference' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 2500 ORDER BY total_expenses DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'P' AND bl.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'O' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.bond_id DESC

SELECT RACEID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 1 THEN DRIVERID END) AS WINNER, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 2 THEN DRIVERID END) AS RUNNER_UP, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 3 THEN DRIVERID END) AS THIRD_PLACE FROM results WHERE POSITIONORDER <= 3 AND LAPS BETWEEN 5 AND 15 AND POINTS > 15 GROUP BY RACEID
SELECT * FROM member_privileges WHERE privilege_level >= 'Member' AND privilege_level <= 'Officer' AND member_id = 'recggMW2eyCYceNcy' ORDER BY expiry_date DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT * FROM packages WHERE 3 = (CASE WHEN status = 'processing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN weight_kg > 1.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN is_fragile = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);

SELECT s.district, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numge1500 FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.county = 'Alpine' AND sa.rtype = 'D' ORDER BY sa.avgscrmath DESC LIMIT 3;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'N' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, b.bond_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT year_created, tagname, cnt_votes FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(v.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created, t.tagname, COUNT(v.id) AS cnt_votes, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(v.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(v.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM votes AS v INNER JOIN posts_backup AS p ON v.postid = p.id INNER JOIN tags AS t ON p.tags LIKE '%' || t.tagname || '%' WHERE t.tagname LIKE 'D%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(v.creationdate AS DATE)), t.id, t.tagname) AS v WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_votes DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Nice Answer' WHERE u.reputation >= 6000

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_id, bl.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'H' AND bl.transact_dt_tm > '2023-01-01' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, bl.bond_id NULLS LAST

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS skin_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.skin_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Olive%' AND sh.weight_kg BETWEEN 60 AND 80 ORDER BY sh.id DESC
SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, p.publisher_name AS publisher FROM superhero AS sh JOIN publisher AS p ON sh.publisher_id = p.id WHERE p.publisher_name LIKE '%Marvel%' ORDER BY sh.id DESC
SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS total_budget FROM budget WHERE amount > 300 GROUP BY link_to_event HAVING SUM(amount) > 1200
SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.bond_type DESC) AS rnk FROM bond a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 6
SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.transact_dt_tm DESC) AS rnk FROM bond_list a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 23

SELECT sqP.publisher_count AS total_by_publisher, P.publisher_name AS publisher, A.alignment AS alignment, sqPA.publisher_alignment_count AS count_by_publisher_alignment FROM (SELECT publisher_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_count FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id) sqP INNER JOIN (SELECT publisher_id, alignment_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_alignment_count FROM superhero WHERE alignment_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id, alignment_id) sqPA ON sqP.publisher_id = sqPA.publisher_id INNER JOIN publisher P ON sqP.publisher_id = P.id INNER JOIN alignment A ON sqPA.alignment_id = A.id WHERE A.alignment LIKE 'Neutral%' ORDER BY P.publisher_name, A.alignment;
SELECT cdscode, COUNT(gsoffered) FROM schools WHERE county = 'Santa Barbara County' GROUP BY cdscode LIMIT 22

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Fe' AND b.bond_type = 'hydrogen' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.bond_type ASC

SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.country LIKE 'W%') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.name LIKE '%Wet%')

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'K' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 1 AND 4 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST
SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS bond_count FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, av.cnt FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN atom_view AS av ON a.atom_id = av.atom_id WHERE a.element = 'Sn' AND av.cnt BETWEEN 3 AND 6 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.defensive_work_rate FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 150 AND 160 AND PA.defensive_work_rate = 'Low'

SELECT p.player_name, p.height, COUNT(pa.id) AS defensive_count FROM player p JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.interceptions > 75 AND p.height > 175 AND pa.marking > 70 GROUP BY p.player_name, p.height HAVING COUNT(pa.id) > 5;

SELECT year_created, tagname, cnt_postlinks FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(pl.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created, t.tagname, COUNT(pl.id) AS cnt_postlinks, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(pl.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(pl.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM postlinks AS pl INNER JOIN tags AS t ON pl.postid = t.excerptpostid GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(pl.creationdate AS DATE)), t.id, t.tagname) AS pl WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_postlinks DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, av.cnt FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN atom_view AS av ON a.atom_id = av.atom_id WHERE a.element = 'Ga' AND av.cnt BETWEEN 3 AND 7 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.aptt FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'PSS' AND l.aptt > 130 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.aptt HAVING COUNT(*) > 2) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.aptt = j.aptt)

SELECT year_created, displayname, cnt_posts FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.displayname, COUNT(p.id) AS cnt_posts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(p.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM posts_backup AS p INNER JOIN users AS u ON p.owneruserid = u.id WHERE u.displayname LIKE 'G%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS DATE)), u.id, u.displayname) AS p WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_posts DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT s.cname AS county, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrread + s.avgscrmath + s.avgscrwrite) / 3 AS avg_total_sat FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.cname IN (SELECT s.cname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.cname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrread + s.avgscrmath + s.avgscrwrite) / 3 DESC nulls last LIMIT 5) GROUP BY s.cname, sch.school ORDER BY s.cname, avg_total_sat DESC;

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.gk_positioning FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.gk_positioning > 95 AND Player_Attributes.gk_reflexes > 90

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq BETWEEN 3 AND 6 AND m.label LIKE 'N%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.crossing FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 160 AND 170 AND PA.crossing > 85

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.amount) AS Total_Budget FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.event_status = 'Approved' AND b.category = 'Outreach' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.amount) > 2200
SELECT MAX(a8) FROM (SELECT a8, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a8 ASC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM district) AS E WHERE (Rank = 4)

SELECT s.superhero_name, a.alignment, p.power_name FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower p ON hp.power_id = p.id WHERE s.weight_kg BETWEEN 80 AND 100 AND s.gender_id = 2 AND s.height_cm > 190

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.country AS circuitcountry, d.forename AS driverfirstname, d.surname AS driverlastname, co.name AS teamname, res.grid AS qualifyingposition, res.fastestlaptime FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2013 AND 2018 AND res.points > 12 AND res.positionorder <= 5 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.fastestlaptime ASC

SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.defensive_work_rate FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 160 AND 170 AND PA.defensive_work_rate = 'High'

SELECT e.event_name, COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS Total_Volunteers FROM event AS e LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event WHERE e.type = 'Volunteer' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING COUNT(a.link_to_member) > 8
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MIN(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Ede%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 650000 AND height > 185 AND weight < 90);
SELECT link_to_event, AVG(hours) AS avg_hours FROM attendance JOIN member ON attendance.link_to_member = member.member_id WHERE hours > 2 AND member.position = 'President' GROUP BY link_to_event

SELECT
    molecule_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'na' THEN 1 END)         AS na_atoms,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element IN ('c', 'cl') THEN molecule_id END) AS c_atoms
FROM atom
GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN hgb < 12.0 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Moderate_Anemia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN plt < 140 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Mild_Thrombocytopenia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN wbc > 11.0 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Leukocytosis FROM laboratory GROUP BY id
SELECT p.player_id, p.match_id, p.yellow_cards FROM player_stats p JOIN player_rate pr ON p.player_id = pr.id WHERE p.yellow_cards > 2 AND pr.overall_rating > 88 LIMIT 135;

SELECT m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(a.hours) AS Total_Meeting_Hours FROM member AS m JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.type = 'Meeting' GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING SUM(a.hours) > 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS member_count, zip_code.state FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'volunteer' AND zip_code.type = 'standard' AND member.t_shirt_size = 'XXXL' GROUP BY zip_code.state

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS active_members_by_state, zip_code.short_state FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'active' AND zip_code.type = 'standard' GROUP BY zip_code.short_state

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'He' ORDER BY m.label DESC, a.atom_id DESC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST
SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond.bond_type FROM atom LEFT JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'double'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Fe' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 4 AND 7 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST
SELECT t1.team_short_name, t2.chancecreationpassing FROM team t1 INNER JOIN team_attributes t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.chancecreationpassing BETWEEN 65 AND 85

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN bond_list AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type LIKE 'm%' AND b.transact_dt_tm < '2023-01-01' ORDER BY m.label NULLS LAST, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST

SELECT s.superhero_name, a.attribute_name, ha.attribute_value FROM superhero s JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE ha.attribute_value BETWEEN 110 AND 130 AND s.alignment_id = 2 AND s.height_cm > 200
SELECT t1.* FROM cards t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM cards GROUP BY coloridentity) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id

SELECT bl1.transact_dt_tm, bl2.transact_dt_tm FROM bond_list AS bl1 INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl2 ON (bl1.transact_dt_tm, bl2.transact_dt_tm) IN (('2023-04-01', '2023-04-02'), ('2023-04-01', '2023-04-03'), ('2023-04-02', '2023-04-03'))

SELECT p.player_name, p.height, COUNT(pa.id) AS defensive_count FROM player p JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.standing_tackle > 78 AND p.height > 178 GROUP BY p.player_name, p.height HAVING COUNT(pa.id) > 6;
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id WHERE atom.element = 'neon' AND atom.molecule_id LIKE 'GAS%'
SELECT p.player_id, p.match_id, p.assists FROM player_stats p JOIN player_rate pr ON p.player_id = pr.id WHERE p.assists > 0 AND pr.potential_rating BETWEEN 80 AND 90 LIMIT 160;

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_list ON atom.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Ni' AND bond_list.bond_type = 'metallic' ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id ASC

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplaydribbling, ta.buildupplaydribblingclass, ta.chancecreationpassing, ta.chancecreationpassingclass, ta.defencepressure, ta.defencepressureclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2019-05-20 00:00:00'
SELECT t1.* FROM cards t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM cards GROUP BY isstarter) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id
SELECT raceid, url FROM (SELECT raceid, url, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC) AS rank FROM races GROUP BY raceid, url) subq WHERE rank = 1

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'He' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, br.bond_seq NULLS FIRST
SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Reflexes' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 35 AND 55)
SELECT s.school FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('San Joaquin', 'Stanislaus') GROUP BY s.school HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 2;

SELECT RACEID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 1 THEN CONSTRUCTORID END) AS TOP_TEAM, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 2 THEN CONSTRUCTORID END) AS SECOND_TEAM, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 3 THEN CONSTRUCTORID END) AS THIRD_TEAM FROM results WHERE POSITIONORDER <= 5 AND LAPS > 25 GROUP BY RACEID

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, bl.bond_id, bl.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE bl.transact_dt_tm > '2024-01-01' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST
SELECT s.district FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('San Luis Obispo', 'Santa Barbara') AND s.charter = 0 AND s.magnet = 1 AND s.virtual = 'Y' GROUP BY s.district HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 3;
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected WHERE bond_id = 'TR000_2_3') AS bond_id_count, atom_id2, COUNT(*) AS atom_id2_count FROM connected GROUP BY ROLLUP (atom_id2)
SELECT t1.* FROM packages t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM packages GROUP BY name, status, priority, weight_kg, is_fragile, estimated_delivery_date, last_scanned_location) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id
SELECT link_to_member, SUM(cost) AS total_expense FROM expense WHERE cost > 35 GROUP BY link_to_member HAVING SUM(cost) > 120

WITH member_attendance_analysis AS (SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, SUM(hours) AS total_hours, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_member ORDER BY SUM(hours) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top Hours' AS result_type FROM attendance WHERE hours > 2.0 GROUP BY link_to_member, link_to_event), event_attendance AS (SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, SUM(hours) AS total_hours, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_event ORDER BY SUM(hours) DESC) AS rank, 'Event Top Hours' AS result_type FROM attendance WHERE hours > 2.0 GROUP BY link_to_member, link_to_event) SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, total_hours, result_type FROM member_attendance_analysis WHERE rank <= 3 UNION ALL SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, total_hours, result_type FROM event_attendance WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, link_to_member, link_to_event

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS volunteer_count, zip_code.city FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'volunteer' AND zip_code.type = 'standard' GROUP BY zip_code.city
SELECT s.district FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('San Francisco', 'Alameda') AND s.charter = 1 GROUP BY s.district HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 2;
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = 'ETHANE') AS label_count, molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS molecule_id_count FROM molecule GROUP BY ROLLUP (molecule_id)

SELECT raceid, fastestlaptime AS modal_fastestlaptime FROM (SELECT raceid, fastestlaptime, COUNT(*) AS freq, MIN(resultid) AS first_occurrence, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(resultid) ASC) AS rn FROM results GROUP BY raceid, fastestlaptime) sub WHERE rn = 1 AND fastestlaptime BETWEEN '1:25.000' AND '1:35.000' ORDER BY raceid;

SELECT m.member_id FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN expense AS e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member WHERE e.link_to_member IS NULL AND e.cost > 300 AND e.approved = 'approved' AND m.position = 'Vice President'

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'sc' THEN 1 END) AS sc_atoms, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element IN ('ti', 'v') THEN molecule_id END) AS transition_metals FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Zn' AND br.bond_seq > 4 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, br.bond_seq DESC

SELECT atom_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN molecule_id END) AS molecule_id_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN molecule_id END) AS molecule_id_2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN molecule_id END) AS molecule_id_3 FROM (SELECT atom_id, molecule_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY atom_id ORDER BY molecule_id DESC) AS rn FROM atom) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 5 GROUP BY atom_id ORDER BY atom_id
SELECT c1.atom_id, c2.atom_id2 FROM connected AS c1 INNER JOIN connected AS c2 ON (c1.atom_id, c2.atom_id2) IN (('AT2000', 'AT2001'), ('AT2000', 'AT2002'), ('AT2001', 'AT2002'))

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq BETWEEN 8 AND 10 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, clinical_status.has_new_tumor_events_information, COUNT(has_new_tumor_events_information) AS new_tumor_events_count FROM patients JOIN clinical_status ON patients.patient_id = clinical_status.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND clinical_status.has_new_tumor_events_information = TRUE GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, clinical_status.has_new_tumor_events_information ORDER BY patients.patient_id;
SELECT m.member_id FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN major AS maj ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id WHERE maj.major_id IS NULL AND maj.department = 'Electrical Engineering'

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, connected.bond_id FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id WHERE atom.element = 'Xe' AND connected.atom_id2 IS NULL ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id ASC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN bond_list AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type LIKE 'x%' AND b.transact_dt_tm < '2023-01-01' ORDER BY m.label NULLS LAST, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST

SELECT c.circuitId, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) AS wet_races FROM circuits c LEFT JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId LEFT JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId WHERE res.statusid IN (SELECT statusid FROM status WHERE status LIKE '%wet%') AND r.year BETWEEN 2018 AND 2022 GROUP BY c.circuitId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) > 1
SELECT t1.team_long_name, t2.buildupplaypositioningclass FROM team t1 INNER JOIN team_attributes t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.buildupplayspeed BETWEEN 85 AND 100
SELECT p.player_id, p.match_id, p.assists FROM player_stats p JOIN player_rate pr ON p.player_id = pr.id WHERE p.assists > 3 AND pr.overall_rating > 90 LIMIT 200;

SELECT p.player_name, p.weight, COUNT(pa.id) AS stamina_count FROM player p JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.stamina > 80 AND p.weight > 75 GROUP BY p.player_name, p.weight HAVING COUNT(pa.id) > 6;
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE element = 'LITHIUM') AS element_count, molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS molecule_id_count FROM atom GROUP BY ROLLUP (molecule_id)

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = 'single' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id DESC, b.bond_type DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 400 THEN 400 WHEN s.id = 401 THEN 401 WHEN s.id = 402 THEN 402 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, sp.power_name FROM superhero AS s JOIN hero_power AS hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE s.id IN (400, 401, 402) AND sp.power_name LIKE 'Healing%'

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.country AS circuitcountry, d.forename AS driverfirstname, d.surname AS driverlastname, co.name AS teamname, res.grid AS qualifyingposition, res.fastestlap FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2012 AND 2016 AND res.points > 12 AND res.positionorder <= 4 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.grid DESC

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'R' AND power = '5' AND toughness = '3') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '5058') WHEN (colors = 'G' AND power = '4' AND toughness = '2') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '5059') WHEN (colors = 'B' AND power = '3' AND toughness = '1') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '5060') WHEN (colors = 'W' AND power = '2' AND toughness = '0') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '5061') END) AS watermark FROM cards

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, bl.bond_id, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Au' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(b.spent) AS Total_Spent_On_Workshops FROM member AS m JOIN budget AS b ON m.member_id = b.link_to_event JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.type = 'Workshop' AND e.status = 'Approved' AND b.spent > 250 GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 1800
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = 'PROPANE') AS label_count, molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS molecule_id_count FROM molecule GROUP BY ROLLUP (molecule_id)

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'W' AND power = '4' AND toughness = '6') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '4040') WHEN (colors = 'U' AND power = '3' AND toughness = '5') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '4041') WHEN (colors = 'B' AND power = '2' AND toughness = '4') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '4042') WHEN (colors = 'R' AND power = '1' AND toughness = '3') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '4043') END) AS watermark FROM cards

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS member_count, zip_code.county FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'active' AND zip_code.type = 'military' GROUP BY zip_code.county
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected WHERE atom_id2 = 'ATOM007') AS atom_id2_count, bond_id, COUNT(*) AS bond_id_count FROM connected GROUP BY ROLLUP (bond_id)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS member_count, zip_code.state FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'active' AND zip_code.type = 'standard' AND member.t_shirt_size = 'XXL' GROUP BY zip_code.state, member.position, zip_code.type, member.t_shirt_size, member.email

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.lat AS circuitlatitude, c.lng AS circuitlongitude, d.dob AS driverbirthdate, co.nationality AS constructornationality, res.milliseconds AS racetime, res.rank FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year = 2012 AND res.positionorder <= 3 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.rank ASC

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(b.spent) AS Total_Spent_On_Social_Events FROM member AS m JOIN budget AS b ON m.member_id = b.link_to_event JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.type = 'Social' AND e.status = 'Approved' AND b.spent > 100 GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 800

SELECT TA.ID, TA.BUILDUPPLAYSPEED, TA.CHANCECREATIONCROSSING, TA.DEFENCEPRESSURE, TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH FROM team_attributes AS TA WHERE TA.BUILDUPPLAYSPEED < (SELECT AVG(BUILDUPPLAYSPEED) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.CHANCECREATIONCROSSING > (SELECT AVG(CHANCECREATIONCROSSING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCEPRESSURE > (SELECT AVG(DEFENCEPRESSURE) FROM team_attributes)

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond_list.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond_list ON molecule.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE bond_list.bond_type = 'peptide' AND bond_list.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-07-01' AND '2023-12-31'
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected WHERE atom_id2 = 'ATOM013') AS atom_id2_count, bond_id, COUNT(*) AS bond_id_count FROM connected GROUP BY ROLLUP (bond_id)

SELECT year_created, displayname, cnt_badges FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.displayname, COUNT(b.id) AS cnt_badges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(b.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM badges AS b INNER JOIN users AS u ON b.userid = u.id WHERE u.displayname LIKE 'F%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)), u.id, u.displayname) AS b WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_badges DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, bl.bond_id, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Ag' AND bl.transact_dt_tm < '2023-06-01' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST
SELECT link_to_member, SUM(hours) AS total_volunteer_time FROM attendance WHERE hours > 2 GROUP BY link_to_member HAVING SUM(hours) > 15
SELECT atom_id, molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element LIKE 'Ga%' ORDER BY atom_id ASC NULLS LAST

SELECT p.player_name, p.height, COUNT(pa.id) AS defensive_count FROM player p JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.standing_tackle > 80 AND p.height > 175 GROUP BY p.player_name, p.height HAVING COUNT(pa.id) > 7;

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplayspeed, ta.buildupplayspeedclass, ta.chancecreationpassing, ta.chancecreationpassingclass, ta.defencepressure, ta.defencepressureclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2024-10-15 00:00:00'

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.remaining) AS Total_Unused_Budget FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.event_status = 'Approved' AND b.category = 'Workshop' AND e.status = 'Cancelled' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.remaining) > 1000

SELECT bond_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN atom_id2 END) AS atom_id2_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN atom_id2 END) AS atom_id2_2 FROM (SELECT bond_id, atom_id2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bond_id ORDER BY atom_id2 ASC) AS rn FROM connected) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 2 GROUP BY bond_id ORDER BY bond_id
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.overall_rating FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height < 165 AND PA.overall_rating > 85

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_he, MIN(primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_he) AS min_positive_lymph_nodes FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_he > 2 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_he ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT e.event_name, COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS attendance_count FROM event e LEFT JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-12-31' AND e.type = 'Training' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING COUNT(a.link_to_member) > 2 ORDER BY attendance_count DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT molecule_id, bond_type FROM bond WHERE bond_type LIKE 'T%' ORDER BY molecule_id ASC NULLS FIRST
SELECT player_id FROM player_stats_temp GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) > 90 AND (MAX(goals) - MIN(goals)) > 80;
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'dative' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'INORG%'
SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM member WHERE zip > 70000 GROUP BY link_to_major HAVING COUNT(*) > 4

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.long_shots FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.long_shots > 90 AND Player_Attributes.vision > 85

SELECT sqP.publisher_count AS total_by_publisher, P.publisher_name AS publisher, G.gender AS gender, sqPG.publisher_gender_count AS count_by_publisher_gender FROM (SELECT publisher_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_count FROM superhero GROUP BY publisher_id) sqP INNER JOIN (SELECT publisher_id, gender_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_gender_count FROM superhero GROUP BY publisher_id, gender_id) sqPG ON sqP.publisher_id = sqPG.publisher_id INNER JOIN publisher P ON sqP.publisher_id = P.id INNER JOIN gender G ON sqPG.gender_id = G.id ORDER BY P.publisher_name, G.gender;

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS total_expenses FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2023-10-01' AND '2024-03-31' AND e.type = 'Social' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 600 ORDER BY total_expenses ASC LIMIT 4

SELECT year_created, displayname, cnt_postlinks FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(pl.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.displayname, COUNT(pl.id) AS cnt_postlinks, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(pl.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(pl.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM postlinks AS pl INNER JOIN users AS u ON pl.postid = u.id WHERE u.displayname LIKE 'K%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(pl.creationdate AS DATE)), u.id, u.displayname) AS pl WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_postlinks DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT p.player_id, p.match_id, p.minutes_played FROM player_stats p JOIN player_rate pr ON p.player_id = pr.id WHERE p.minutes_played > 45 AND pr.overall_rating BETWEEN 70 AND 80 LIMIT 110;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'aromatic' AND molecule.label LIKE 'Hydrocarbon%'
SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.bond_id ASC) AS rnk FROM bond a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 4
SELECT p.id, p.sex, p.admission, AVG(l.igm) AS avg_igm_level FROM patient AS p INNER JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.igm > 10 GROUP BY p.id, p.sex, p.admission

SELECT year_created, websiteurl, cnt_badges FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.websiteurl, COUNT(b.id) AS cnt_badges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(b.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM badges AS b INNER JOIN users AS u ON b.userid = u.id WHERE u.websiteurl LIKE '%.edu%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)), u.websiteurl) AS b WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_badges DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Pt%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS FIRST, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST

WITH member_privileges_analysis AS (SELECT privilege_level, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total_privileges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY privilege_level ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Privilege Top 3' AS result_type FROM member_privileges WHERE is_active = true AND privilege_scope = 'Cultural' GROUP BY privilege_level, member_id), privilege_members AS (SELECT privilege_level, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total_privileges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top Privilege' AS result_type FROM member_privileges WHERE is_active = true AND privilege_scope = 'Cultural' GROUP BY privilege_level, member_id) SELECT privilege_level, member_id, total_privileges, result_type FROM member_privileges_analysis WHERE rank <= 3 UNION ALL SELECT privilege_level, member_id, total_privileges, result_type FROM privilege_members WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, privilege_level, member_id
SELECT cdscode, COUNT(mailstreet) FROM schools WHERE county = 'Lake County' GROUP BY cdscode LIMIT 36
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MIN(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Kar%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 240000 AND height > 178 AND weight < 82);

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'n' THEN 1 END) AS nitrogen_atoms, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element IN ('o', 'c') THEN molecule_id END) AS organic_elements FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id;
SELECT bond_type, bond_seq FROM bond_ref WHERE bond_type LIKE 'C%' ORDER BY bond_seq DESC NULLS FIRST
SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.bond_type DESC) AS rnk FROM bond a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 3
SELECT player_id FROM player_stats GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) > 25 AND (MAX(assists) - MIN(assists)) > 15;

SELECT p.player_id, p.match_id, p.goals FROM player_stats p JOIN player_rate pr ON p.player_id = pr.id WHERE p.goals > 3 AND pr.overall_rating BETWEEN 88 AND 92 AND pr.potential_rating > 89 AND p.minutes_played > 65 LIMIT 205;
SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS total_atoms FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 5 AND 10;
SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member WHERE zip BETWEEN 50000 AND 90000 GROUP BY link_to_major HAVING COUNT(*) > 4

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.amount) AS Total_Event_Budget FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.event_status = 'Approved' AND b.category = 'Conference' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.amount) > 5000

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN bond_list AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type LIKE 'm%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS FIRST, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS FIRST

SELECT atom_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN atom_id2 END) AS atom_id2_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN atom_id2 END) AS atom_id2_2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN atom_id2 END) AS atom_id2_3 FROM (SELECT atom_id, atom_id2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY atom_id ORDER BY atom_id2 ASC) AS rn FROM connected) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 4 GROUP BY atom_id ORDER BY atom_id

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = 'van der Waals' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.bond_type ASC

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'R' AND toughness = '5') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7074') WHEN (colors = 'G' AND toughness = '4') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7075') WHEN (colors = 'B' AND toughness = '3') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7076') WHEN (colors = 'W' AND toughness = '2') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7077') END) AS watermark FROM cards

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence, AVG(demographics.weight) AS avg_weight FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence = TRUE AND demographics.gender = 'Male' AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_ihc > 5 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

WITH PUBLISHER_RANK AS (SELECT ID, PUBLISHER_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY PUBLISHER_NAME ASC NULLS FIRST) AS RANK FROM PUBLISHER) SELECT P1.PUBLISHER_NAME AS CURRENT_PUBLISHER, P2.PUBLISHER_NAME AS PUBLISHER_AFTER_5 FROM PUBLISHER_RANK AS P1 LEFT JOIN PUBLISHER_RANK AS P2 ON P2.RANK = P1.RANK + 5

SELECT raceid, q3 FROM (SELECT raceid, q3, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM qualifying GROUP BY raceid, q3) subq WHERE rank = 1 AND q3 IS NOT NULL AND q3 <> '0' AND q3 LIKE '6%' AND q3 NOT LIKE '1%' AND q3 NOT LIKE '2%' AND q3 NOT LIKE '3%' AND q3 NOT LIKE '4%' AND q3 NOT LIKE '5%'

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT i.income_id) AS Total_Donations FROM member AS m JOIN income AS i ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member WHERE i.amount > 100 GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.income_id) > 2

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count, AVG(primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count) AS avg_lymph_nodes_examined FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count BETWEEN 20 AND 30 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.ethnicity, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count, COUNT(primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count) AS lymph_node_examined_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count BETWEEN 1 AND 5 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.ethnicity, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Au' AND br.bond_seq > 4 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, br.bond_seq NULLS FIRST

SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex, COALESCE(l.aptt, 0) AS aptt_level FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND l.aptt > 50 ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence, COUNT(pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence) AS metastasis_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence = TRUE AND demographics.gender = 'Female' AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_ihc > 3 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT raceid, fastestlap AS modal_fastestlap FROM (SELECT raceid, fastestlap, COUNT(*) AS freq, MIN(resultid) AS first_occurrence, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(resultid) ASC) AS rn FROM results GROUP BY raceid, fastestlap) sub WHERE rn = 1 AND fastestlap BETWEEN 3 AND 8 ORDER BY raceid;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.fastestlapspeed FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL AND r.position <= 5 ORDER BY r.fastestlaptime DESC LIMIT 6;

SELECT RACEID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 1 THEN DRIVERID END) AS WINNER, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 2 THEN DRIVERID END) AS RUNNER_UP, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 3 THEN DRIVERID END) AS THIRD_PLACE FROM results WHERE POSITIONORDER <= 3 AND LAPS BETWEEN 191 AND 200 GROUP BY RACEID
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE element = 'MAGNESIUM') AS element_count, molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS molecule_id_count FROM atom GROUP BY ROLLUP (molecule_id)

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplayspeed, ta.buildupplayspeedclass, ta.chancecreationpassing, ta.chancecreationpassingclass, ta.defenceteamwidth, ta.defenceteamwidthclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2027-03-15 00:00:00'

SELECT s.superhero_name, a.alignment, p.publisher_name FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE s.height_cm > 190 AND s.gender_id = 1 AND s.weight_kg < 80

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.country AS circuitcountry, d.code AS drivercode, co.url AS constructorurl, res.position AS finishposition, res.fastestlaptime FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2011 AND 2016 AND res.points > 10 AND res.positionorder <= 4 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.position DESC

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_list ON atom.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Pd' AND bond_list.bond_type = 'dative' ORDER BY molecule.label ASC, atom.atom_id DESC
SELECT * FROM member WHERE zip >= 60000 AND zip <= 80000 AND link_to_major = 'recggMW2eyCYceNcy' ORDER BY first_name DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT sqA.alignment_count AS total_by_alignment, A.alignment AS alignment, C.colour AS eye_colour, sqAC.alignment_colour_count AS count_by_alignment_colour FROM (SELECT alignment_id, COUNT(*) AS alignment_count FROM superhero WHERE alignment_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY alignment_id) sqA INNER JOIN (SELECT alignment_id, eye_colour_id, COUNT(*) AS alignment_colour_count FROM superhero WHERE eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY alignment_id, eye_colour_id) sqAC ON sqA.alignment_id = sqAC.alignment_id INNER JOIN alignment A ON sqA.alignment_id = A.id INNER JOIN colour C ON sqAC.eye_colour_id = C.id WHERE C.colour LIKE 'Gold%' ORDER BY A.alignment, C.colour;

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.ethnicity, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_columnar_mucosa_goblet_cell_present, COUNT(primary_pathology_columnar_mucosa_goblet_cell_present) AS goblet_cell_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = FALSE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_columnar_mucosa_goblet_cell_present = TRUE GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.ethnicity, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_columnar_mucosa_goblet_cell_present ORDER BY patients.patient_id;
SELECT p.player_id, p.match_id, p.goals FROM player_stats p JOIN player_rate pr ON p.player_id = pr.id WHERE p.goals > 2 AND pr.potential_rating BETWEEN 85 AND 95 LIMIT 190;

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS composite_key, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS molecule_ref, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond_list AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'At%' OR b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-02-15' AND '2023-07-15' ORDER BY composite_key ASC, molecule_ref DESC

SELECT s.district, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numge1500 FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.county = 'Fresno' AND sa.rtype = 'S' ORDER BY sa.avgscrmath ASC LIMIT 5;

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS combined_identifier, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS molecule_reference, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property_description FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Mg%' OR b.bond_type IN ('hydrogen', 'ionic') ORDER BY combined_identifier DESC, molecule_reference ASC

SELECT s.cname AS county, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.5 + s.avgscrread * 0.3 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.2) AS balanced_sat_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.cname IN (SELECT s.cname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.cname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.5 + s.avgscrread * 0.3 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.2) DESC nulls last LIMIT 5) GROUP BY s.cname, sch.school ORDER BY s.cname, balanced_sat_score DESC;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond_list.bond_id, bond_list.bond_type FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list ON connected.bond_id = bond_list.bond_id WHERE atom.element = 'C' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id ASC, atom.atom_id DESC, bond_list.bond_id NULLS FIRST
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Jos%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 400000 AND height > 180 AND weight < 85);

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Ag' AND b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-06-30' ORDER BY m.label ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.c4 FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'SLE' AND l.c4 < 10 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.c4 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.c4 = j.c4)

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_type, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE bl.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2027-01-01' AND '2027-12-31' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, bl.transact_dt_tm ASC

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, clinical_status.vital_status, COUNT(vital_status) AS vital_status_count FROM patients JOIN clinical_status ON patients.patient_id = clinical_status.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND clinical_status.vital_status = 'Alive' GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, clinical_status.vital_status ORDER BY patients.patient_id;
SELECT t1.team_short_name, t2.chancecreationpassing FROM team t1 INNER JOIN team_attributes t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.chancecreationpassing BETWEEN 60 AND 80

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.shot_power FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.shot_power > 85

SELECT p.player_id, p.match_id, p.goals FROM player_stats p JOIN player_rate pr ON p.player_id = pr.id WHERE p.goals > 2 AND pr.overall_rating BETWEEN 85 AND 95 AND pr.potential_rating > 90 AND p.minutes_played > 80 LIMIT 210;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_id, bl.bond_type, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Li' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, bl.transact_dt_tm DESC

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'G' AND power = '4' AND toughness = '3') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7074') WHEN (colors = 'B' AND power = '3' AND toughness = '2') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7075') WHEN (colors = 'U' AND power = '2' AND toughness = '1') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7076') WHEN (colors = 'W' AND power = '1' AND toughness = '0') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7077') END) AS watermark FROM cards
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'ester' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'BIO%'

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence, AVG(demographics.weight) AS avg_weight FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence = FALSE AND demographics.gender = 'Female' AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_ihc > 1 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS total_expenses FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-06-30' AND e.type = 'Social' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 1000 ORDER BY total_expenses DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT year_created, websiteurl, cnt_badges FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.websiteurl, COUNT(b.id) AS cnt_badges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(b.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM badges AS b INNER JOIN users AS u ON b.userid = u.id WHERE u.websiteurl IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)), u.websiteurl) AS b WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_badges DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS hair_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.hair_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Raven%' AND sh.height_cm BETWEEN 160 AND 180 ORDER BY sh.id DESC
SELECT link_to_member, SUM(hours) AS total_hours FROM attendance WHERE hours > 2 GROUP BY link_to_member HAVING SUM(hours) > 10

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, av.cnt FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN atom_view AS av ON a.atom_id = av.atom_id WHERE a.element = 'Ne' AND av.cnt BETWEEN 2 AND 5 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT s.school, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numtsttakr FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.county = 'Sonoma' AND sa.rtype = 'S' ORDER BY sa.avgscrmath DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT * FROM superhero JOIN hero_power ON hero_power.hero_id = superhero.id WHERE NOT (superhero_name = 'Superman' AND height_cm BETWEEN 190 AND 210)

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'ar' THEN 1 END) AS ar_atoms, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element IN ('kr', 'xe') THEN molecule_id END) AS noble_gas_atoms FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id;
SELECT * FROM event WHERE event_date >= '2023-01-01' AND event_date <= '2023-12-31' AND status = 'Completed' ORDER BY event_name NULLS FIRST

SELECT atom_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN molecule_id END) AS molecule_id_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN molecule_id END) AS molecule_id_2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN molecule_id END) AS molecule_id_3 FROM (SELECT atom_id, molecule_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY atom_id ORDER BY molecule_id ASC) AS rn FROM atom) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 2 GROUP BY atom_id ORDER BY atom_id

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond_list.bond_id) AS recent_sulfur_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond_list ON molecule.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE bond_list.bond_type = 'sulfur' AND bond_list.transact_dt_tm > '2024-01-01' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY recent_sulfur_bonds DESC

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplayspeed, ta.buildupplayspeedclass, ta.chancecreationshooting, ta.chancecreationshootingclass, ta.defenceteamwidth, ta.defenceteamwidthclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2024-12-15 00:00:00'
SELECT link_to_member, SUM(hours) AS total_volunteer_hours FROM attendance WHERE hours > 3 GROUP BY link_to_member HAVING SUM(hours) > 15

SELECT raceid, q2 FROM (SELECT raceid, q2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM qualifying GROUP BY raceid, q2) subq WHERE rank = 1 AND q2 IS NOT NULL AND q2 <> '0' AND q2 LIKE '1%'
SELECT s.district FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('San Diego', 'Imperial') AND s.charter = 1 AND s.magnet = 1 AND s.virtual = 'N' GROUP BY s.district HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 2;

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, e.event_name, b.spent FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.spent BETWEEN 400 AND 900 ORDER BY b.spent DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_list ON atom.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Pt' AND bond_list.bond_type = 'triple' ORDER BY molecule.label ASC, atom.atom_id DESC

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN igg > 20 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS High_IgG, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN iga > 20 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS High_IgA, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN igm > 20 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS High_IgM FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.fastestlaptime FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.fastestlaptime IS NOT NULL AND r.position <= 5 AND r.points > 30 ORDER BY r.fastestlaptime ASC LIMIT 12;

SELECT bond_type, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN molecule_id END) AS molecule_id_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN molecule_id END) AS molecule_id_2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN molecule_id END) AS molecule_id_3 FROM (SELECT bond_type, molecule_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bond_type ORDER BY molecule_id DESC) AS rn FROM bond_list) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 3 GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY bond_type
SELECT t1.team_short_name, t2.buildupplaypositioningclass FROM team t1 INNER JOIN team_attributes t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.buildupplayspeed BETWEEN 95 AND 100

SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Rob%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 190000 AND height > 175 AND weight < 80);

SELECT cards.asciiname, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT * FROM legalities WHERE legalities.format = cards.setcode AND legalities.status = 'Banned' AND legalities.uuid = cards.uuid AND legalities.id = cards.id AND legalities.format = 'Brawl') THEN 'banned_in_brawl' ELSE 'legal_in_brawl' END FROM cards

WITH member_attendance_analysis AS (SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, SUM(hours) AS total_hours, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_member ORDER BY SUM(hours) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top Hours' AS result_type FROM attendance WHERE hours > 4.0 GROUP BY link_to_member, link_to_event), event_attendance AS (SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, SUM(hours) AS total_hours, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_event ORDER BY SUM(hours) DESC) AS rank, 'Event Top Hours' AS result_type FROM attendance WHERE hours > 4.0 GROUP BY link_to_member, link_to_event) SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, total_hours, result_type FROM member_attendance_analysis WHERE rank <= 2 UNION ALL SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, total_hours, result_type FROM event_attendance WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, link_to_member, link_to_event
SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.transact_dt_tm DESC) AS rnk FROM bond_list a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 18

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN hgb < 8.0 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Critical_Anemia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN plt < 40 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Severe_Thrombocytopenia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN wbc > 28 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Extreme_Leukocytosis FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

WITH atom_bonds AS (SELECT atom_id AS atom FROM connected UNION ALL SELECT atom_id2 AS atom FROM connected) SELECT atom AS id, COUNT(*) AS num FROM atom_bonds GROUP BY atom HAVING COUNT(*) <= (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM atom_bonds GROUP BY atom) AS avg_bonds);
SELECT cards.manacost, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT * FROM legalities WHERE legalities.uuid = cards.uuid) THEN 'legal' ELSE 'not legal' END FROM cards

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Fe' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Constable' WHERE u.reputation >= 6000 AND u.creationdate > '2017-01-01'
SELECT MIN(interest_rate) FROM (SELECT interest_rate, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY interest_rate DESC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM loan) AS E WHERE (Rank = 4)

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, av.cnt FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN atom_view AS av ON a.atom_id = av.atom_id WHERE a.element = 'Xe' AND av.cnt BETWEEN 1 AND 4 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST
SELECT bond_id as current_bond, LEAD(bond_id) OVER (ORDER BY bond_id) as next_bond, bond_type as bond_type FROM bond b
SELECT link_to_member, SUM(hours) AS total_volunteer_hours FROM attendance WHERE hours BETWEEN 5 AND 10 GROUP BY link_to_member HAVING SUM(hours) > 40

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS composite_key, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS molecule_ref, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Pb%' OR b.bond_type IN ('hydrogen', 'metallic') ORDER BY composite_key DESC, molecule_ref ASC
SELECT atom_id, atom_id2 FROM connected WHERE bond_id LIKE 'E%' ORDER BY atom_id DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT atom_id2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN bond_id END) AS bond_id_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN bond_id END) AS bond_id_2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN bond_id END) AS bond_id_3 FROM (SELECT atom_id2, bond_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY atom_id2 ORDER BY bond_id) AS rn FROM connected) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 3 GROUP BY atom_id2 ORDER BY atom_id2

SELECT year_created, displayname, cnt_posts FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.displayname, COUNT(p.id) AS cnt_posts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(p.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM posts_backup AS p INNER JOIN users AS u ON p.owneruserid = u.id WHERE u.displayname LIKE 'Z%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS DATE)), u.id, u.displayname) AS p WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_posts DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_list ON atom.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Au' AND bond_list.bond_type = 'triple' ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id ASC

SELECT TA.ID, TA.BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING, TA.CHANCECREATIONSHOOTING, TA.DEFENCEPRESSURE, TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH FROM team_attributes AS TA WHERE TA.BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING < (SELECT AVG(BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.CHANCECREATIONSHOOTING > (SELECT AVG(CHANCECREATIONSHOOTING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCEPRESSURE < (SELECT AVG(DEFENCEPRESSURE) FROM team_attributes)

SELECT sqP.publisher_count AS total_by_publisher, P.publisher_name AS publisher, S.superhero_name AS superhero, sqPS.publisher_superhero_count AS count_by_publisher_superhero FROM (SELECT publisher_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_count FROM superhero GROUP BY publisher_id) sqP INNER JOIN (SELECT publisher_id, id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_superhero_count FROM superhero GROUP BY publisher_id, id) sqPS ON sqP.publisher_id = sqPS.publisher_id INNER JOIN publisher P ON sqP.publisher_id = P.id INNER JOIN superhero S ON sqPS.id = S.id ORDER BY P.publisher_name, S.superhero_name;

SELECT cards.uuid, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT * FROM legalities WHERE legalities.uuid = cards.uuid AND legalities.status = 'Banned') THEN 'banned_card' ELSE 'legal_card' END FROM cards
SELECT p.id AS patientid, p.diagnosis, COALESCE(e.thrombosis, 0) AS thrombosisstatus FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN examination AS e ON p.id = e.id ORDER BY p.id NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq = 3 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Stamina' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 90 AND 110)

SELECT p.player_name, p.weight, COUNT(pa.id) AS balance_count FROM player p JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.balance > 80 AND p.weight > 70 GROUP BY p.player_name, p.weight HAVING COUNT(pa.id) > 5;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq >= 2 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, br.bond_seq ASC
SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.element DESC) AS rnk FROM atom a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 15

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(atom.element) AS silicon_atoms FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Si' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY silicon_atoms DESC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = 'peptide' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.bond_type ASC
SELECT driverid, COUNT(*) FROM laptimes GROUP BY driverid HAVING COUNT(*) > 75;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = 'single' AND m.label LIKE 'O2%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.bond_type DESC
