SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Electorate' WHERE u.reputation >= 10000 AND u.creationdate > '2018-01-01'

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS total_expenses FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2023-10-01' AND '2024-03-31' AND e.type = 'Fundraiser' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 2500 ORDER BY total_expenses DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT a1.molecule_id, a2.molecule_id FROM atom AS a1 INNER JOIN atom AS a2 ON (a1.molecule_id, a2.molecule_id) IN (('MOL1200', 'MOL1201'), ('MOL1200', 'MOL1202'), ('MOL1201', 'MOL1202'))

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_type, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE bl.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND m.label LIKE 'CH4%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, bl.transact_dt_tm ASC

WITH member_expenses AS (SELECT link_to_member, expense_id, SUM(cost) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_member ORDER BY SUM(cost) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top 3' AS result_type FROM expense WHERE approved = 'No' AND cost < 50 GROUP BY link_to_member, expense_id), expense_members AS (SELECT link_to_member, expense_id, SUM(cost) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY expense_id ORDER BY SUM(cost) DESC) AS rank, 'Expense Top Member' AS result_type FROM expense WHERE approved = 'No' AND cost < 50 GROUP BY link_to_member, expense_id) SELECT link_to_member, expense_id, total_cost, result_type FROM member_expenses WHERE rank <= 3 UNION ALL SELECT link_to_member, expense_id, total_cost, result_type FROM expense_members WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, link_to_member, expense_id

SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex, COALESCE(l.cpk, 0) AS creatine_phosphokinase_status FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT cdscode, COUNT(eilname) FROM schools WHERE county = 'Del Norte County' GROUP BY cdscode LIMIT 43
SELECT player_id FROM player_stats GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) > 5 AND (MAX(assists) - MIN(assists)) > 4;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_id, bl.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'P' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id ASC, bl.transact_dt_tm DESC
SELECT MAX(a16) FROM (SELECT a16, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a16 DESC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM district) AS E WHERE (Rank = 3)

SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.element ASC) AS rnk FROM atom a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 6

SELECT t1.team_short_name, t2.defencepressureclass FROM team t1 INNER JOIN team_attributes t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.defencepressure BETWEEN 45 AND 65 AND t2.buildupplayspeed > 70

  molecule.molecule_id,
  MIN(atom.atom_id) AS first_atom_id

    patients.patient_id,
    demographics.height,
    treatment_and_followup.primary_pathology_karnofsky_performance_score,

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, t.atom_id FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN test AS t ON a.atom_id = t.atom_id WHERE a.element = 'S' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, t.atom_id ASC

SELECT m.phone, e.location, b.category, z.city FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.amount BETWEEN 400 AND 900 ORDER BY b.amount DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT p.player_id, p.match_id, p.goals FROM player_stats p JOIN player_rate pr ON p.player_id = pr.id WHERE p.goals > 2 AND pr.overall_rating > 80 LIMIT 200;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Ag' AND b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-06-30' ORDER BY m.label DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST

SELECT cards.asciiname, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT * FROM legalities WHERE legalities.format = cards.setcode AND legalities.status = 'Legal') THEN 'legal_format' ELSE 'not_legal_format' END FROM cards

SELECT * FROM member_privileges WHERE privilege_level >= 'Consultant' AND privilege_level <= 'Executive' AND member_id = 'recggMW2eyCYceNcy' ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT s.cname AS county, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.7 + s.avgscrread * 0.3) AS weighted_math_emphasis FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.cname IN (SELECT s.cname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.cname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.7 + s.avgscrread * 0.3) DESC nulls last LIMIT 5) GROUP BY s.cname, sch.school ORDER BY s.cname, weighted_math_emphasis DESC;

SELECT p.id, p.sex, p.admission, AVG(l.alp) AS avg_alkaline_phosphatase FROM patient AS p INNER JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.alp > 100 GROUP BY p.id, p.sex, p.admission

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'single' AND molecule.label LIKE 'Organic%'
SELECT MIN(cost) AS min_cost, link_to_member FROM expense WHERE approved = 'false' GROUP BY link_to_member

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count, COUNT(primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count) AS lymph_node_examined_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count BETWEEN 75 AND 85 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = 'hydrogen' AND m.label LIKE 'C6H12O6%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.bond_type ASC

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS silicon_phosphorus_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'phosphorus' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'Si%' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY silicon_phosphorus_bonds ASC

SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MIN(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Dav%' AND player_fifa_api_id < 180000);

SELECT m.phone, e.location, b.category, z.short_state FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.amount BETWEEN 1000 AND 2000 ORDER BY b.amount ASC NULLS FIRST

SELECT molecule_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN bond_type END) AS bond_type_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN bond_type END) AS bond_type_2 FROM (SELECT molecule_id, bond_type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY molecule_id ORDER BY bond_type DESC) AS rn FROM bond) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 2 GROUP BY molecule_id ORDER BY molecule_id

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Co' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, b.bond_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT bond_type, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN bond_seq END) AS bond_seq_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN bond_seq END) AS bond_seq_2 FROM (SELECT bond_type, bond_seq, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bond_type ORDER BY bond_seq DESC) AS rn FROM bond_ref) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 2 GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY bond_type

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, bl.bond_id, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Cu' AND bl.transact_dt_tm > '2024-01-01' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex, COALESCE(l.aptt, 0) AS aptt_level FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND l.aptt BETWEEN 40 AND 50 ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Cl' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id ASC, c.atom_id2 DESC

SELECT P.player_name, P.height, P.weight FROM player AS P WHERE P.height > 180 AND P.weight < 80
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'ionic' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'MINERAL%'
SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Stamina' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 45 AND 65)
SELECT t1.team_short_name, t2.buildupplaypassing FROM team t1 INNER JOIN team_attributes t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.buildupplaypassing BETWEEN 40 AND 60

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_list ON atom.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Pt' AND bond_list.bond_type = 'quadruple' ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id ASC

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond_list.bond_id) AS recent_covalent_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond_list ON molecule.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE bond_list.bond_type = 'covalent' AND bond_list.transact_dt_tm > '2024-01-01' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY recent_covalent_bonds DESC
SELECT MAX(a4) FROM (SELECT a4, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a4 DESC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM district) AS E WHERE (Rank = 3)
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'C' ORDER BY m.label NULLS LAST, a.atom_id NULLS LAST
SELECT * FROM packages WHERE 2 = (CASE WHEN status = 'shipped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN weight_kg < 1.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN is_fragile = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);
SELECT atom_id, element FROM atom WHERE element LIKE 'P%' ORDER BY element ASC NULLS LAST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Li' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 3 AND 5 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST
SELECT account_id FROM trans GROUP BY account_id HAVING COUNT(trans_id) > 15 AND (MAX(balance) - MIN(balance)) > 125000;
SELECT s.school FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('San Francisco', 'Santa Clara') AND s.charter = 1 GROUP BY s.school HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 2;

SELECT RACEID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 1 THEN CONSTRUCTORID END) AS TOP_CONSTRUCTOR, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 2 THEN CONSTRUCTORID END) AS SECOND_CONSTRUCTOR, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 3 THEN CONSTRUCTORID END) AS THIRD_CONSTRUCTOR FROM results WHERE POSITIONORDER <= 5 AND LAPS > 40 GROUP BY RACEID
SELECT t1.* FROM cards t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM cards GROUP BY originaltext) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS unified_id, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS chemical_code, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property_value FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond_list AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Ga%' OR b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-01-15' AND '2023-06-15' ORDER BY unified_id ASC, chemical_code DESC

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.aptt FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'PSS' AND l.aptt > 42 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.aptt HAVING COUNT(*) > 2) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.aptt = j.aptt)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE element = 'COPPER') AS element_count, molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS molecule_id_count FROM atom GROUP BY ROLLUP (molecule_id)
SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Stamina' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 60 AND 80)

SELECT sqA.alignment_count AS total_by_alignment, A.alignment AS alignment, S.superhero_name AS superhero, sqAS.alignment_superhero_count AS count_by_alignment_superhero FROM (SELECT alignment_id, COUNT(*) AS alignment_count FROM superhero WHERE alignment_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY alignment_id) sqA INNER JOIN (SELECT alignment_id, id, COUNT(*) AS alignment_superhero_count FROM superhero WHERE id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY alignment_id, id) sqAS ON sqA.alignment_id = sqAS.alignment_id INNER JOIN alignment A ON sqA.alignment_id = A.id INNER JOIN superhero S ON sqAS.id = S.id WHERE A.alignment = 'Good' AND S.superhero_name LIKE 'Wonder%' ORDER BY A.alignment, S.superhero_name;

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type = 'aromatic' THEN 1 END) AS aromatic_bonds, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type IN ('ionic', 'metallic') THEN molecule_id END) AS special_bonds FROM bond GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'S' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 2 AND 4 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.overall_rating FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 180 AND 190 AND PA.overall_rating > 85
SELECT * FROM cards WHERE 3 = (CASE WHEN artist LIKE 'Y%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN convertedmanacost = 5.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN hasfoil = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_id, bl.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'N' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, bl.bond_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT RACEID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 1 THEN DRIVERID END) AS WINNER, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 2 THEN DRIVERID END) AS RUNNER_UP, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 3 THEN DRIVERID END) AS THIRD_PLACE FROM results WHERE POSITIONORDER <= 3 AND LAPS > 85 GROUP BY RACEID

WITH SUPERHERO_RANK AS (SELECT ID, SUPERHERO_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY HEIGHT_CM DESC NULLS LAST) AS RANK FROM SUPERHERO) SELECT S1.SUPERHERO_NAME AS CURRENT_HERO, S2.SUPERHERO_NAME AS HERO_AFTER_10 FROM SUPERHERO_RANK AS S1 LEFT JOIN SUPERHERO_RANK AS S2 ON S2.RANK = S1.RANK + 10

SELECT m.email, e.event_name, b.remaining, z.city FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.remaining > 1800 ORDER BY b.remaining DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN bond_list AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type LIKE 'a%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS FIRST, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS FIRST
SELECT player_id FROM player_stats GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) > 7 AND (MAX(assists) - MIN(assists)) > 3;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_type, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE bl.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' AND m.label LIKE 'CH4%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, bl.transact_dt_tm ASC

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplaypassing, ta.buildupplaypassingclass, ta.chancecreationshooting, ta.chancecreationshootingclass, ta.defenceaggression, ta.defenceaggressionclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2024-05-15 00:00:00'

WITH member_expenses AS (SELECT link_to_member, expense_id, SUM(cost) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_member ORDER BY SUM(cost) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top 3' AS result_type FROM expense WHERE approved = 'No' GROUP BY link_to_member, expense_id), expense_members AS (SELECT link_to_member, expense_id, SUM(cost) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY expense_id ORDER BY SUM(cost) DESC) AS rank, 'Expense Top Member' AS result_type FROM expense WHERE approved = 'No' GROUP BY link_to_member, expense_id) SELECT link_to_member, expense_id, total_cost, result_type FROM member_expenses WHERE rank <= 3 UNION ALL SELECT link_to_member, expense_id, total_cost, result_type FROM expense_members WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, link_to_member, expense_id

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond_list.bond_id, bond_list.bond_type, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list ON connected.bond_id = bond_list.bond_id WHERE atom.element = 'Rn' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id ASC, atom.atom_id DESC, bond_list.transact_dt_tm NULLS FIRST
SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race, a.alignment FROM superhero s JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id WHERE s.weight_kg > 130 AND s.gender_id = 1

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS total_expenses FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2024-04-01' AND '2024-09-30' AND e.type = 'Fundraiser' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 2000 ORDER BY total_expenses DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.country LIKE 'A%') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.name LIKE '%Alpine%')

SELECT raceid, q3 FROM (SELECT raceid, q3, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM qualifying GROUP BY raceid, q3) subq WHERE rank = 1 AND q3 IS NOT NULL AND q3 <> '0' AND q3 LIKE '2%' AND q3 NOT LIKE '1%' AND q3 NOT LIKE '3%' AND q3 NOT LIKE '4%' AND q3 NOT LIKE '5%'

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond_ref.bond_type, bond_ref.bond_seq FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list ON connected.bond_id = bond_list.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref ON bond_list.bond_type = bond_ref.bond_type WHERE atom.element = 'Pt' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id DESC, atom.atom_id ASC, bond_ref.bond_seq NULLS FIRST
SELECT * FROM bond_ref LEFT JOIN molecule ON bond_ref.bond_type = molecule.label WHERE bond_ref.bond_seq < 10

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Fe' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, b.bond_id NULLS LAST

SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.country LIKE 'G%') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.name LIKE '%Garden%')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS member_count, zip_code.state FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'volunteer' AND zip_code.type = 'standard' AND member.t_shirt_size = 'M' GROUP BY zip_code.state, member.position, zip_code.type, member.t_shirt_size, member.email, member.phone, member.first_name, member.last_name

SELECT year_created, displayname, cnt_votes FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(v.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.displayname, COUNT(v.id) AS cnt_votes, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(v.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(v.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM votes AS v INNER JOIN users AS u ON v.userid = u.id WHERE u.displayname LIKE 'X%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(v.creationdate AS DATE)), u.id, u.displayname) AS v WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_votes DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT raceid, q3 FROM (SELECT raceid, q3, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM qualifying GROUP BY raceid, q3) subq WHERE rank = 1

SELECT TA.ID, TA.BUILDUPPLAYSPEED, TA.CHANCECREATIONPASSING, TA.DEFENCEAGGRESSION, TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH FROM team_attributes AS TA WHERE TA.BUILDUPPLAYSPEED < (SELECT AVG(BUILDUPPLAYSPEED) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH > (SELECT AVG(DEFENCETEAMWIDTH) FROM team_attributes)

SELECT TA.ID, TA.BUILDUPPLAYPASSING, TA.CHANCECREATIONSHOOTING, TA.DEFENCEPRESSURE, TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH FROM team_attributes AS TA WHERE TA.BUILDUPPLAYPASSING < (SELECT AVG(BUILDUPPLAYPASSING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.CHANCECREATIONSHOOTING > (SELECT AVG(CHANCECREATIONSHOOTING) FROM team_attributes)

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Zn' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT atom.atom_id) AS unique_sodium_atoms FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Na' GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id;
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Pd%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS LAST, a.atom_id NULLS LAST

SELECT sqP.publisher_count AS total_by_publisher, P.publisher_name AS publisher, C.colour AS hair_colour, sqPC.publisher_colour_count AS count_by_publisher_colour FROM (SELECT publisher_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_count FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id) sqP INNER JOIN (SELECT publisher_id, hair_colour_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_colour_count FROM superhero WHERE hair_colour_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id, hair_colour_id) sqPC ON sqP.publisher_id = sqPC.publisher_id INNER JOIN publisher P ON sqP.publisher_id = P.id INNER JOIN colour C ON sqPC.hair_colour_id = C.id WHERE C.colour LIKE 'Blonde%' ORDER BY P.publisher_name, C.colour;

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN got > 70 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_GOT, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN gpt > 70 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_GPT, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN ldh > 400 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_LDH FROM laboratory GROUP BY id
SELECT cdscode, COUNT(admlname3) FROM schools WHERE county = 'Ventura County' GROUP BY cdscode LIMIT 15

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'P' AND br.bond_seq > 2 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, br.bond_seq DESC
SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS skin_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.skin_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Black%' ORDER BY sh.id DESC

SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex, COALESCE(l.crp, 'Negative') AS crp_result FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.date BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.glu FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'SLE' AND l.glu > 120 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.glu HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.glu = j.glu)

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq BETWEEN 7 AND 10 AND m.label LIKE 'Ar%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count, COUNT(primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count) AS lymph_node_examined_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count BETWEEN 8 AND 12 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.country LIKE 'C%') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.name LIKE '%Coastal%')
SELECT raceid, name FROM (SELECT raceid, name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM races GROUP BY raceid, name) subq WHERE rank = 1

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN igg > 34 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Extremely_High_IgG, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN iga > 34 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Extremely_High_IgA, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN igm > 34 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Extremely_High_IgM FROM laboratory GROUP BY id
SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 50 AND 70)

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.remaining) AS unused_funds FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-12-31' AND e.type = 'Conference' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.remaining) > 1000 ORDER BY unused_funds ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'K' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, b.bond_id NULLS LAST

SELECT M.member_id, M.first_name, M.last_name FROM member AS M WHERE M.member_id IN (SELECT link_to_member FROM expense WHERE cost BETWEEN 200 AND 500 AND approved = 'No') AND M.position = 'Financial Analyst'
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond_list WHERE bond_type = 'IONIC') AS bond_type_count, transact_dt_tm, COUNT(*) AS transact_dt_tm_count FROM bond_list GROUP BY ROLLUP (transact_dt_tm)
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id2 = atom.atom_id WHERE atom.element = 'aluminum' AND atom.molecule_id LIKE 'INORG%'

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(atom.element) AS chlorine_atoms FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Cl' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY chlorine_atoms DESC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Au' AND b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-06-30' ORDER BY m.label DESC, a.atom_id DESC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS FIRST
SELECT * FROM card_choice WHERE 2 = (CASE WHEN card_id < 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN non_valid_cards IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 700 THEN 700 WHEN s.id = 701 THEN 701 WHEN s.id = 702 THEN 702 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, a.attribute_name FROM superhero AS s JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE s.id IN (700, 701, 702) AND a.attribute_name LIKE 'Speed%'

WITH SUPERHERO_GROUP_RANK AS (SELECT ID, SUBGROUP1, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ID DESC NULLS LAST) AS RANK FROM SUPERHERO_GROUP) SELECT S1.SUBGROUP1 AS CURRENT_SUBGROUP, S2.SUBGROUP1 AS SUBGROUP_AFTER_3 FROM SUPERHERO_GROUP_RANK AS S1 LEFT JOIN SUPERHERO_GROUP_RANK AS S2 ON S2.RANK = S1.RANK + 3

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence, AVG(demographics.height) AS avg_height FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence = FALSE AND demographics.gender = 'Male' GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence ORDER BY patients.patient_id;
SELECT * FROM member WHERE zip >= 30000 AND zip <= 50000 AND link_to_major = 'recggMW2eyCYceNcy' ORDER BY first_name NULLS FIRST

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS merged_identifier, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS chemical_code, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property_value FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond_list AS b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Ce%' OR b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-04-15' AND '2023-10-15' ORDER BY merged_identifier DESC, chemical_code ASC
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'As%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS FIRST, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq BETWEEN 34 AND 40 AND m.label LIKE 'Au%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

WITH MEMBER_PRIVILEGES_RANK AS (SELECT PRIVILEGE_ID, MEMBER_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY PRIVILEGE_ID DESC NULLS LAST) AS RANK FROM MEMBER_PRIVILEGES) SELECT M1.MEMBER_ID AS CURRENT_MEMBER, M2.MEMBER_ID AS MEMBER_BEFORE_6 FROM MEMBER_PRIVILEGES_RANK AS M1 LEFT JOIN MEMBER_PRIVILEGES_RANK AS M2 ON M2.RANK = M1.RANK - 6

SELECT p.player_name, p.height, COUNT(pa.id) AS defensive_count FROM player p JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.sliding_tackle > 75 AND p.height > 180 GROUP BY p.player_name, p.height HAVING COUNT(pa.id) > 8;

SELECT year_created, profileimageurl, cnt_posthistory FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ph.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.profileimageurl, COUNT(ph.id) AS cnt_posthistory, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ph.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(ph.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM posthistory AS ph INNER JOIN users AS u ON ph.userid = u.id WHERE u.profileimageurl IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ph.creationdate AS DATE)), u.profileimageurl) AS ph WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_posthistory DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT
    patients.patient_id,

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.hgb FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'RA' AND l.hgb < 12 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.hgb HAVING COUNT(*) > 2) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.hgb = j.hgb)

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Investor' WHERE u.reputation >= 20000 AND u.creationdate > '2013-01-01'
SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Strength' AND attribute_value < 30)

SELECT sqA.alignment_count AS total_by_alignment, A.alignment AS alignment, S.superhero_name AS superhero, sqAS.alignment_superhero_count AS count_by_alignment_superhero FROM (SELECT alignment_id, COUNT(*) AS alignment_count FROM superhero GROUP BY alignment_id) sqA INNER JOIN (SELECT alignment_id, id, COUNT(*) AS alignment_superhero_count FROM superhero GROUP BY alignment_id, id) sqAS ON sqA.alignment_id = sqAS.alignment_id INNER JOIN alignment A ON sqA.alignment_id = A.id INNER JOIN superhero S ON sqAS.id = S.id WHERE A.alignment = 'Evil' ORDER BY A.alignment, S.superhero_name;

SELECT molecule_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN atom_id END) AS atom_id_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN atom_id END) AS atom_id_2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN atom_id END) AS atom_id_3 FROM (SELECT molecule_id, atom_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY molecule_id ORDER BY atom_id DESC) AS rn FROM atom) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 6 GROUP BY molecule_id ORDER BY molecule_id

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond.bond_id, bond.bond_type FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id INNER JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE atom.element = 'W' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id ASC, atom.atom_id DESC, bond.bond_id NULLS LAST

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS total_races, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.resultid) > 50 THEN 'Veteran' WHEN COUNT(r.resultid) > 25 THEN 'Experienced' ELSE 'Rookie' END AS experience_level FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(r.resultid) > 10

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq BETWEEN 6 AND 8 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT p.player_name, p.weight, COUNT(pa.id) AS gk_skill_count FROM player p JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.gk_reflexes > 80 AND p.weight > 75 GROUP BY p.player_name, p.weight HAVING COUNT(pa.id) > 5;

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type = 'single' THEN 1 END) AS single_bonds, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type IN ('double', 'triple') THEN molecule_id END) AS multiple_bonds FROM bond GROUP BY molecule_id;
SELECT t1.team_short_name, t2.chancecreationshooting FROM team t1 INNER JOIN team_attributes t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.chancecreationshooting BETWEEN 65 AND 85

SELECT atom_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN bond_id END) AS bond_id_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN bond_id END) AS bond_id_2 FROM (SELECT atom_id, bond_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY atom_id ORDER BY bond_id DESC) AS rn FROM connected) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 2 GROUP BY atom_id ORDER BY atom_id

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type = 'peptide' THEN 1 END) AS peptide_bonds, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type IN ('disulfide', 'amide') THEN molecule_id END) AS complex_bonds FROM bond GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 1009 THEN 1009 WHEN s.id = 1010 THEN 1010 WHEN s.id = 1011 THEN 1011 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, sp.power_name FROM superhero AS s JOIN hero_power AS hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE s.id IN (1009, 1010, 1011) AND sp.power_name LIKE 'Darkness%'
SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Intuition' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 85 AND 105)

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.ldh FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'SLE' AND l.ldh > 300 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.ldh HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.ldh = j.ldh)

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type = 'hydrophobic' THEN 1 END) AS hydrophobic_bonds, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type IN ('electrostatic', 'stacking') THEN molecule_id END) AS noncovalent_bonds FROM bond_list GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT raceid, fastestlapspeed AS modal_fastestlapspeed FROM (SELECT raceid, fastestlapspeed, COUNT(*) AS freq, MIN(resultid) AS first_occurrence, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(resultid) ASC) AS rn FROM results GROUP BY raceid, fastestlapspeed) sub WHERE rn = 1 AND fastestlapspeed BETWEEN '220' AND '260' ORDER BY raceid;

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS fusion_key, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS substance_code, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS characteristic_type FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Pt%' OR b.bond_type IN ('covalent', 'ionic') ORDER BY fusion_key DESC, substance_code ASC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Ni' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 3 AND 5 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT atom.atom_id) AS unique_bromine_atoms FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Br' GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_id, bl.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Ar' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, bl.bond_id NULLS LAST

SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'coordinate' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'INORG%'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, av.cnt FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN atom_view AS av ON a.atom_id = av.atom_id WHERE av.cnt BETWEEN 3 AND 5 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, av.cnt DESC

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence, COUNT(pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence) AS metastasis_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence = TRUE AND demographics.gender = 'Male' AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_ihc > 3 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence ORDER BY patients.patient_id;
SELECT C.name, C.artist FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Brawl' AND C.convertedmanacost BETWEEN 2.0 AND 5.0
SELECT s.district FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('San Mateo', 'Santa Clara') AND s.charter = 1 AND s.magnet = 0 AND s.virtual = 'Y' GROUP BY s.district HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 3;
SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.bond_id ASC) AS rnk FROM bond_list a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 8
SELECT a1.atom_id, a2.atom_id FROM atom AS a1 INNER JOIN atom AS a2 ON (a1.atom_id, a2.atom_id) IN (('AT100', 'AT101'), ('AT100', 'AT102'), ('AT101', 'AT102'))
SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.label DESC) AS rnk FROM molecule a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 3

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN hct > 50 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS High_Hematocrit, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rbc > 6.0 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS High_RBC, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN wbc < 2 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_Low_WBC FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS member_count, zip_code.state FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'active' AND zip_code.type = 'standard' AND member.t_shirt_size = 'XXL' GROUP BY zip_code.state, member.position
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Rah%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 750000 AND height > 181 AND weight < 84 AND weight > 80);

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN got > 75 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_GOT, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN gpt > 75 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_GPT, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN ldh > 500 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_LDH FROM laboratory GROUP BY id
SELECT c.circuitId, COUNT(r.raceId) AS race_count FROM circuits c LEFT JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2020 GROUP BY c.circuitId HAVING COUNT(r.raceId) > 3

WITH PrintsSummary AS (SELECT name, COUNT(printings) AS Prints FROM cards GROUP BY name), TopPrints AS (SELECT name, Prints FROM printssummary ORDER BY Prints DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3), Others AS (SELECT 'Others' AS name, SUM(Prints) AS Prints FROM printssummary WHERE NOT name IN (SELECT name FROM topprints)) SELECT name, Prints FROM topprints UNION ALL SELECT name, Prints FROM others

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, a.attribute_name AS hero_attribute FROM superhero AS sh JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON sh.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE a.attribute_name LIKE '%Intelligence%' ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC

SELECT TA.ID, TA.BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING, TA.CHANCECREATIONCROSSING, TA.DEFENCEPRESSURE, TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH FROM team_attributes AS TA WHERE TA.BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING > (SELECT AVG(BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.CHANCECREATIONCROSSING < (SELECT AVG(CHANCECREATIONCROSSING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCEPRESSURE > (SELECT AVG(DEFENCEPRESSURE) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH < (SELECT AVG(DEFENCETEAMWIDTH) FROM team_attributes)

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS silicon_double_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'double' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'Si%' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY silicon_double_bonds DESC
SELECT * FROM budget WHERE spent >= 300.0 AND spent <= 800.0 AND link_to_event = 'recggMW2eyCYceNcy' ORDER BY event_status NULLS FIRST

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN hgb < 13 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Mild_Anemia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN plt < 130 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Mild_Thrombocytopenia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN wbc > 11 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Mild_Leukocytosis FROM laboratory GROUP BY id
SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex, COALESCE(l.c3, 0) AS complement_c3_status FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT s.superhero_name, p.publisher_name, a.alignment FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id WHERE s.weight_kg > 120 AND s.gender_id = 2
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.gk_handling FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 185 AND 195 AND PA.gk_handling > 90

SELECT s.superhero_name, c.colour, p.power_name FROM superhero s JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower p ON hp.power_id = p.id JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.gender_id = 2 AND s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190

WITH bond_connections AS (SELECT bond_id AS bond FROM connected UNION ALL SELECT bond_id AS bond FROM bond) SELECT bond AS id, COUNT(*) AS num FROM bond_connections GROUP BY bond HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM bond_connections GROUP BY bond) AS avg_connections);

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.fastestlaptime FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.fastestlaptime IS NOT NULL AND r.position <= 5 AND r.points > 50 ORDER BY r.fastestlaptime DESC LIMIT 15;

SELECT TA.ID, TA.BUILDUPPLAYPASSING, TA.CHANCECREATIONPASSING, TA.DEFENCEAGGRESSION, TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH FROM team_attributes AS TA WHERE TA.CHANCECREATIONPASSING > (SELECT AVG(CHANCECREATIONPASSING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCEAGGRESSION < (SELECT AVG(DEFENCEAGGRESSION) FROM team_attributes)
SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex, COALESCE(e.diagnosis, 'No diagnosis') AS diagnosis_status FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN examination AS e ON p.id = e.id ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'glycosidic' AND molecule.label LIKE 'Polysaccharide%'

SELECT RACEID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 1 THEN CONSTRUCTORID END) AS WINNER, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 2 THEN CONSTRUCTORID END) AS RUNNER_UP, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 3 THEN CONSTRUCTORID END) AS THIRD_PLACE FROM results WHERE POSITIONORDER <= 5 GROUP BY RACEID
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'MOL012') AS molecule_id_count, bond_type, COUNT(*) AS bond_type_count FROM bond GROUP BY ROLLUP (bond_type)

SELECT s.constructorstandingsid, s.raceid, c.constructorid FROM constructorstandings AS s INNER JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorid = s.constructorid WHERE s.raceid = 75 AND s.points > 320 AND c.nationality = 'Mexican'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, bl.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'F' AND bl.transact_dt_tm > '2023-07-01' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, c.atom_id2 DESC

SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex, COALESCE(l.c3, 0) AS complement_c3_level FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT year_created, displayname, cnt_posts FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.displayname, COUNT(p.id) AS cnt_posts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(p.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM posts_backup AS p INNER JOIN users AS u ON p.owneruserid = u.id WHERE u.displayname LIKE 'V%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS DATE)), u.id, u.displayname) AS p WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_posts DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT link_to_budget, MIN(cost) AS min_expense FROM expense JOIN budget ON expense.link_to_budget = budget.budget_id WHERE cost > 150 AND budget.event_status = 'Active' GROUP BY link_to_budget

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count, COUNT(primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count) AS lymph_node_examined_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count BETWEEN 80 AND 120 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT m.member_id FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN income AS i ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member WHERE i.link_to_member IS NULL AND i.amount > 150 AND i.source = 'fundraiser' AND m.position = 'Vice President'
SELECT atom_id, molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element LIKE 'Al%' ORDER BY molecule_id ASC NULLS LAST

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 34 THEN 34 WHEN s.id = 35 THEN 35 WHEN s.id = 36 THEN 36 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, a.attribute_value FROM superhero AS s JOIN hero_attribute AS a ON s.id = a.hero_id WHERE s.id IN (34, 35, 36)
SELECT link_to_member, SUM(hours) AS total_volunteer_hours FROM attendance WHERE hours > 3.5 GROUP BY link_to_member HAVING SUM(hours) > 18

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN bond_list AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type LIKE 'x%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS FIRST, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS FIRST

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond.bond_id, bond.bond_type FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id INNER JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id NULLS FIRST, atom.atom_id NULLS FIRST, bond.bond_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN hgb < 16.5 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Mild_Anemia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN plt < 155 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Mild_Thrombocytopenia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN wbc > 7.5 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Mild_Leukocytosis FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond_ref.bond_type, bond_ref.bond_seq FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list ON connected.bond_id = bond_list.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref ON bond_list.bond_type = bond_ref.bond_type WHERE atom.element = 'Mo' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id DESC, atom.atom_id ASC, bond_ref.bond_seq NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(e.cost) AS Total_Rejected_Expenses FROM member AS m JOIN expense AS e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member WHERE e.approved = 'No' AND e.cost > 75 GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING SUM(e.cost) > 400

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.aptt FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'SLE' AND l.aptt > 52 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.aptt HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.aptt = j.aptt)
SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.element DESC) AS rnk FROM atom a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 13

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS member_count, zip_code.city FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'inactive' AND zip_code.type = 'standard' GROUP BY zip_code.city

SELECT m.email, e.event_name, b.spent, z.city FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.spent BETWEEN 300 AND 700 ORDER BY b.spent ASC NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Fe' ORDER BY m.label DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST
SELECT atom_id as previous_atom, LAG(atom_id) OVER (ORDER BY element) as current_atom, molecule_id as molecule_category FROM atom a
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.gk_kicking FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 190 AND 200 AND PA.gk_kicking > 90

SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.country LIKE 'D%') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.name LIKE '%Downtown%')
SELECT MAX(a10) FROM (SELECT a10, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a10 ASC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM district) AS E WHERE (Rank = 3)
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.overall_rating FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height > 175 AND PA.overall_rating > 80

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS van_der_waals_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'van_der_waals' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'V%' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY van_der_waals_bonds DESC

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bond.bond_id) AS unique_nitrogen_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id INNER JOIN atom ON (bond.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id AND atom.element = 'N') GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id;
SELECT MIN(a6) FROM (SELECT a6, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a6 ASC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM district) AS E WHERE (Rank = 3)

WITH member_privileges_analysis AS (SELECT privilege_level, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total_privileges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY privilege_level ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Privilege Top 3' AS result_type FROM member_privileges WHERE is_active = true AND privilege_scope = 'Mentorship' GROUP BY privilege_level, member_id), privilege_members AS (SELECT privilege_level, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total_privileges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top Privilege' AS result_type FROM member_privileges WHERE is_active = true AND privilege_scope = 'Mentorship' GROUP BY privilege_level, member_id) SELECT privilege_level, member_id, total_privileges, result_type FROM member_privileges_analysis WHERE rank <= 3 UNION ALL SELECT privilege_level, member_id, total_privileges, result_type FROM privilege_members WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, privilege_level, member_id

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond_ref.bond_type FROM atom LEFT JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_ref ON connected.bond_id = bond_ref.bond_type WHERE bond_ref.bond_seq BETWEEN 3 AND 5
SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id WHERE c.district_id BETWEEN 130 AND 140 AND d.type = 'OWNER' LIMIT 1100;
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Lew%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 720000 AND height > 185 AND weight < 89);

WITH SUPERHERO_RANK AS (SELECT ID, SUPERHERO_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY HEIGHT_CM DESC NULLS LAST) AS RANK FROM SUPERHERO) SELECT S1.SUPERHERO_NAME AS CURRENT_HERO, S2.SUPERHERO_NAME AS HERO_AFTER_16 FROM SUPERHERO_RANK AS S1 LEFT JOIN SUPERHERO_RANK AS S2 ON S2.RANK = S1.RANK + 16

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.remaining) AS remaining_funds FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2024-04-01' AND '2024-09-30' AND e.type = 'Workshop' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.remaining) > 1800 ORDER BY remaining_funds DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT s.district FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('San Francisco', 'San Mateo') AND s.charter = 1 AND s.magnet = 0 GROUP BY s.district HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 2;
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'ester' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'ORG%'

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.aptt FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'PSS' AND l.aptt > 80 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.aptt HAVING COUNT(*) > 2) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.aptt = j.aptt)

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.url AS circuitwebsite, d.dob AS driverbirthdate, co.nationality AS constructornationality, res.milliseconds AS racetime, res.statusid FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2008 AND 2012 AND res.positionorder <= 6 AND res.points > 8 ORDER BY r.raceid DESC, res.milliseconds ASC
SELECT C.name, C.artist FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Vintage' AND C.convertedmanacost BETWEEN 4.0 AND 6.0

SELECT bond_type, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN molecule_id END) AS molecule_id_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN molecule_id END) AS molecule_id_2 FROM (SELECT bond_type, molecule_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bond_type ORDER BY molecule_id DESC) AS rn FROM bond) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 3 GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY bond_type

SELECT p.player_name, p.height, COUNT(pa.id) AS defensive_count FROM player p JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.standing_tackle > 85 AND p.height > 185 GROUP BY p.player_name, p.height HAVING COUNT(pa.id) > 10;
SELECT constructorid, COUNT(*) FROM constructorstandings GROUP BY constructorid HAVING COUNT(*) > 6;

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'B' AND power = '5' AND toughness = '4') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7074') WHEN (colors = 'U' AND power = '4' AND toughness = '3') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7075') WHEN (colors = 'R' AND power = '3' AND toughness = '2') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7076') WHEN (colors = 'G' AND power = '2' AND toughness = '1') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7077') END) AS watermark FROM cards

SELECT t1.team_short_name, t2.buildupplaypositioningclass FROM team t1 INNER JOIN team_attributes t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.buildupplayspeed BETWEEN 65 AND 85 AND t2.chancecreationcrossing > 70

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence, AVG(demographics.height) AS avg_height FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence = FALSE AND demographics.gender = 'Male' AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_ihc > 2 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence ORDER BY patients.patient_id;
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE element = 'ARGON') AS element_count, molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS molecule_id_count FROM atom GROUP BY ROLLUP (molecule_id)
SELECT MIN(a11) FROM (SELECT a11, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a11 ASC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM district) AS E WHERE (Rank = 4)

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_ref.bond_seq FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_ref ON atom.element = 'Xe' AND bond_ref.bond_type = 'dative' ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id ASC

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.ball_control FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.ball_control > 90

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.remaining) AS unused_budget FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-06-30' AND e.type = 'Seminar' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.remaining) > 1500 ORDER BY unused_budget ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Ne' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, br.bond_seq NULLS LAST

SELECT e.event_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS Unique_Participants FROM event AS e JOIN attendance AS a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event WHERE e.type = 'Training' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) > 6

SELECT s.dname AS district, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.4 + s.avgscrread * 0.5 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.1) AS reading_weighted_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.dname IN (SELECT s.dname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.dname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.4 + s.avgscrread * 0.5 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.1) DESC nulls last LIMIT 6) GROUP BY s.dname, sch.school ORDER BY s.dname, reading_weighted_score DESC;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_id, bl.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Fe' AND bl.transact_dt_tm < '2023-01-01' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, bl.bond_id NULLS LAST

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS Total_Event_Expenses FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.event_status = 'Approved' AND b.category = 'Workshop' AND e.status = 'Active' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 1500

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Cu' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex, COALESCE(l.aptt, 0) AS aptt_level FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31' AND l.aptt BETWEEN 40 AND 50 ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT s.driverStandingsId, s.raceId, d.driverId FROM driverstandings AS s INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = s.driverId WHERE s.raceId = 29 AND s.points > 60

SELECT
    sqA.alignment_count     AS total_by_alignment,
    A.alignment             AS alignment,
    R.race                  AS race,
    sqAR.alignment_race_count AS count_by_alignment_race
FROM
    (
       SELECT
           alignment_id,
           COUNT(*) AS alignment_count
       FROM superhero
       GROUP BY alignment_id
    ) sqA

    INNER JOIN
    (
       SELECT
           alignment_id,
           race_id,
           COUNT(*) AS alignment_race_count
       FROM superhero
       GROUP BY alignment_id, race_id
    ) sqAR ON sqA.alignment_id = sqAR.alignment_id

    INNER JOIN alignment A ON sqA.alignment_id = A.id

    INNER JOIN race R ON sqAR.race_id = R.id
ORDER BY
    A.alignment,
