SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Resilience' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 95)

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.lat AS circuitlatitude, d.code AS drivercode, co.nationality AS constructornationality, res.position AS finishposition, res.fastestlapspeed FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023 AND res.points > 25 AND res.positionorder <= 2 ORDER BY r.raceid DESC, res.fastestlapspeed ASC

SELECT raceid, fastestlapspeed AS modal_fastestlapspeed FROM (SELECT raceid, fastestlapspeed, COUNT(*) AS freq, MIN(resultid) AS first_occurrence, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(resultid) ASC) AS rn FROM results GROUP BY raceid, fastestlapspeed) sub WHERE rn = 1 AND fastestlapspeed BETWEEN '225' AND '255' ORDER BY raceid;
SELECT cdscode, COUNT(admemail1) FROM schools WHERE county = 'Shasta County' GROUP BY cdscode LIMIT 27
SELECT player_id FROM player_stats_temp GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) > 70 AND (MAX(goals) - MIN(goals)) > 60;

SELECT cards.asciiname, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT * FROM legalities WHERE legalities.format = cards.setcode AND legalities.status = 'Banned' AND legalities.uuid = cards.uuid AND legalities.id = cards.id AND legalities.format = 'Pauper') THEN 'pauper_banned' ELSE 'pauper_legal' END FROM cards
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.milliseconds FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND r.position <= 3 ORDER BY r.milliseconds ASC LIMIT 6;

SELECT raceid, fastestlaptime AS modal_fastestlaptime FROM (SELECT raceid, fastestlaptime, COUNT(*) AS freq, MIN(resultid) AS first_occurrence, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(resultid) ASC) AS rn FROM results GROUP BY raceid, fastestlaptime) sub WHERE rn = 1 AND fastestlaptime BETWEEN '1:18.000' AND '1:28.000' ORDER BY raceid;

SELECT raceid, laps AS modal_laps FROM (SELECT raceid, laps, COUNT(*) AS freq, MIN(resultid) AS first_occurrence, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(resultid) ASC) AS rn FROM results GROUP BY raceid, laps) sub WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY raceid;
SELECT s.resultid, s.raceid, d.driverid FROM results AS s INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = s.driverid WHERE s.raceid = 52 AND s.points > 180 AND d.nationality = 'Indian'

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.strength FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.strength > 95

SELECT raceid, points AS modal_points FROM (SELECT raceid, points, COUNT(*) AS freq, MIN(driverstandingsid) AS first_occurrence, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(driverstandingsid) ASC) AS rn FROM driverstandings GROUP BY raceid, points) sub WHERE rn = 1 AND points > 15 ORDER BY raceid;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Au' AND b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-06-30' ORDER BY m.label ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.long_shots FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 175 AND 185 AND PA.long_shots > 80

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(b.spent) AS Total_Spent_On_Training FROM member AS m JOIN budget AS b ON m.member_id = b.link_to_event JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.type = 'Training' AND e.status = 'Planned' GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 400

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplaypassing, ta.buildupplaypassingclass, ta.chancecreationshooting, ta.chancecreationshootingclass, ta.defenceteamwidth, ta.defenceteamwidthclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2016-09-15 00:00:00'

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond_list.bond_id, bond_list.bond_type, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list ON connected.bond_id = bond_list.bond_id WHERE atom.element = 'Rn' AND bond_list.transact_dt_tm < '2023-01-01' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id ASC, atom.atom_id DESC, bond_list.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST
SELECT bl1.bond_id, bl2.bond_id FROM bond_list AS bl1 INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl2 ON (bl1.bond_id, bl2.bond_id) IN (('BL400', 'BL401'), ('BL400', 'BL402'), ('BL401', 'BL402'))

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.ball_control FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.ball_control > 70
SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'hydrogen'
SELECT * FROM budget WHERE category >= 'Food' AND category <= 'Speaker Gifts' AND link_to_event = 'recggMW2eyCYceNcy' ORDER BY category NULLS FIRST

WITH SUPERHERO_RANK AS (SELECT ID, SUPERHERO_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY HEIGHT_CM DESC NULLS LAST) AS RANK FROM SUPERHERO) SELECT S1.SUPERHERO_NAME AS CURRENT_HERO, S2.SUPERHERO_NAME AS HERO_BEFORE_5 FROM SUPERHERO_RANK AS S1 LEFT JOIN SUPERHERO_RANK AS S2 ON S2.RANK = S1.RANK - 5
SELECT s.superhero_name, g.gender, c.colour FROM superhero s JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.alignment_id = 1 AND s.height_cm BETWEEN 160 AND 180

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS member_count, zip_code.state FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'active' AND zip_code.type = 'standard' AND member.t_shirt_size = 'XS' GROUP BY zip_code.state

SELECT m.t_shirt_size, e.location, b.category, z.county FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.amount BETWEEN 500 AND 1500 ORDER BY b.amount DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT atom_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN element END) AS element_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN element END) AS element_2 FROM (SELECT atom_id, element, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY atom_id ORDER BY element ASC) AS rn FROM atom) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 2 GROUP BY atom_id ORDER BY atom_id
SELECT p.id, p.sex, p.admission, AVG(l.hgb) AS avg_hemoglobin FROM patient AS p INNER JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.hgb < 12 GROUP BY p.id, p.sex, p.admission

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count, SUM(primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count) AS total_lymph_nodes_examined FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count > 0 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

WITH member_attendance_analysis AS (SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, SUM(hours) AS total_hours, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_member ORDER BY SUM(hours) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top Hours' AS result_type FROM attendance WHERE hours > 1.0 GROUP BY link_to_member, link_to_event), event_attendance AS (SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, SUM(hours) AS total_hours, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_event ORDER BY SUM(hours) DESC) AS rank, 'Event Top Hours' AS result_type FROM attendance WHERE hours > 1.0 GROUP BY link_to_member, link_to_event) SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, total_hours, result_type FROM member_attendance_analysis WHERE rank <= 3 UNION ALL SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, total_hours, result_type FROM event_attendance WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, link_to_member, link_to_event

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT atom.atom_id) AS unique_potassium_atoms FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'K' GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id;
SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Willpower' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 70 AND 90)
SELECT client_id FROM disp GROUP BY client_id HAVING COUNT(account_id) > 4 AND (MAX(disp_id) - MIN(disp_id)) > 1000;

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN igg > 30 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS High_IgG, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN iga > 30 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS High_IgA, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN igm > 30 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS High_IgM FROM laboratory GROUP BY id
SELECT s.superhero_name, c.colour, p.publisher_name FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.gender_id = 3 AND s.weight_kg < 80

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN hgb < 11 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Moderate_Anemia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN plt < 120 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Mild_Thrombocytopenia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN wbc > 12 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Leukocytosis FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

SELECT s.superhero_name, a.attribute_name, ha.attribute_value FROM superhero s JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE ha.attribute_value BETWEEN 25 AND 45 AND s.alignment_id = 2 AND s.height_cm > 170

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.cpk FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'PSS' AND l.cpk > 350 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.cpk HAVING COUNT(*) > 2) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.cpk = j.cpk)

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.ball_control FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.ball_control > 85 AND Player_Attributes.dribbling > 85

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS composite_key, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS molecule_ref, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond_list AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Rb%' OR b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-04-01' AND '2023-09-30' ORDER BY composite_key DESC, molecule_ref ASC
SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS total_elements FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 14;
SELECT * FROM member WHERE zip >= 15000 AND zip <= 35000 AND link_to_major = 'recggMW2eyCYceNcy' ORDER BY t_shirt_size DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Xe' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, br.bond_seq ASC

SELECT sqP.publisher_count AS total_by_publisher, P.publisher_name AS publisher, C.colour AS hair_colour, sqPC.publisher_colour_count AS count_by_publisher_colour FROM (SELECT publisher_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_count FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id) sqP INNER JOIN (SELECT publisher_id, hair_colour_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_colour_count FROM superhero WHERE hair_colour_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id, hair_colour_id) sqPC ON sqP.publisher_id = sqPC.publisher_id INNER JOIN publisher P ON sqP.publisher_id = P.id INNER JOIN colour C ON sqPC.hair_colour_id = C.id WHERE C.colour LIKE 'Red%' ORDER BY P.publisher_name, C.colour;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS alumni_count, zip_code.county FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'alumni' AND zip_code.type = 'military' GROUP BY zip_code.county

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.aptt FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'SLE' AND l.aptt > 65 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.aptt HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.aptt = j.aptt)

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Y' AND b.bond_type = 'aromatic' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.bond_type DESC
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Ga%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS FIRST, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT raceid, fastestlap AS modal_fastestlap FROM (SELECT raceid, fastestlap, COUNT(*) AS freq, MIN(resultid) AS first_occurrence, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(resultid) ASC) AS rn FROM results GROUP BY raceid, fastestlap) sub WHERE rn = 1 AND fastestlap BETWEEN 5 AND 10 ORDER BY raceid;
SELECT * FROM packages WHERE 3 = (CASE WHEN status = 'delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN weight_kg BETWEEN 1.5 AND 3.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN is_fragile = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);
SELECT C.name, C.artist FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Pioneer' AND C.convertedmanacost BETWEEN 2.0 AND 5.0
SELECT MIN(a13) FROM (SELECT a13, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a13 DESC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM district) AS E WHERE (Rank = 2)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = 'FORMALDEHYDE') AS label_count, molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS molecule_id_count FROM molecule GROUP BY ROLLUP (molecule_id)
SELECT * FROM major WHERE major_name >= 'Nursing' AND major_name <= 'Pharmacy' AND college = 'Health Sciences' ORDER BY department DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond_list.bond_id, bond_list.bond_type, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list ON connected.bond_id = bond_list.bond_id WHERE atom.element = 'Rb' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id DESC, atom.atom_id ASC, bond_list.transact_dt_tm NULLS FIRST
SELECT C.name, C.artist FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Modern' AND C.convertedmanacost BETWEEN 3.0 AND 5.0 AND C.rarity = 'Rare'

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(e.cost) AS Total_Expenses FROM member AS m JOIN expense AS e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member WHERE e.approved = 'Yes' GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING SUM(e.cost) > 200

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond_list.bond_id) AS recent_phosphorus_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond_list ON molecule.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE bond_list.bond_type = 'phosphorus' AND bond_list.transact_dt_tm > '2024-01-01' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY recent_phosphorus_bonds DESC

SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.defensive_work_rate FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 185 AND 195 AND PA.defensive_work_rate = 'High'

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.lat AS circuitlatitude, d.code AS drivercode, co.nationality AS constructornationality, res.position AS finishposition, res.fastestlapspeed FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2020 AND res.points > 12 AND res.positionorder <= 5 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.fastestlapspeed DESC

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'nb' THEN 1 END) AS nb_atoms, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element IN ('ta', 'db') THEN molecule_id END) AS transition_metals FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, bl.bond_id, bl.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE bl.transact_dt_tm > '2024-06-01' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST
SELECT C.name, C.flavortext FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Historic' AND C.convertedmanacost BETWEEN 1.0 AND 3.0 AND C.rarity = 'Common'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = 'polar covalent' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.bond_type DESC
SELECT e.event_id FROM event AS e LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.link_to_event IS NULL AND e.type = 'workshop' AND e.status = 'planned'

SELECT RACEID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 1 THEN DRIVERID END) AS WINNER, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 2 THEN DRIVERID END) AS RUNNER_UP, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 3 THEN DRIVERID END) AS THIRD_PLACE FROM results WHERE POSITIONORDER <= 3 AND LAPS BETWEEN 261 AND 270 GROUP BY RACEID

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'B' AND power = '3' AND toughness = '2') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '5563') WHEN (colors = 'R' AND power = '2' AND toughness = '1') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '5564') WHEN (colors = 'G' AND power = '1' AND toughness = '0') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '5565') WHEN (colors = 'W' AND power = '0' AND toughness = '1') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '5566') END) AS watermark FROM cards
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.dribbling FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height > 180 AND PA.dribbling > 80

SELECT s.cname AS county, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.9 + s.avgscrread * 0.6 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.5) AS balanced_composite_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.cname IN (SELECT s.cname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.cname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.9 + s.avgscrread * 0.6 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.5) DESC nulls last LIMIT 5) GROUP BY s.cname, sch.school ORDER BY s.cname, balanced_composite_score DESC;

WITH molecule_atoms AS (SELECT molecule_id AS mol FROM atom UNION ALL SELECT molecule_id AS mol FROM molecule) SELECT mol AS id, COUNT(*) AS num FROM molecule_atoms GROUP BY mol HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM molecule_atoms GROUP BY mol) AS avg_atoms);
SELECT cdscode, COUNT(magnet) FROM schools WHERE county = 'Contra Costa County' GROUP BY cdscode LIMIT 8

SELECT s.cname AS county, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.5 + s.avgscrread * 0.25 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.25) AS balanced_sat_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.cname IN (SELECT s.cname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.cname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.5 + s.avgscrread * 0.25 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.25) ASC nulls last LIMIT 5) GROUP BY s.cname, sch.school ORDER BY s.cname, balanced_sat_score ASC;

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race, p.power_name FROM superhero s JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower p ON hp.power_id = p.id WHERE s.gender_id = 2 AND s.weight_kg BETWEEN 110 AND 130 AND s.alignment_id = 2
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.short_passing FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 175 AND 185 AND PA.short_passing > 85

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond.bond_id, bond.bond_type FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE atom.element = 'Pb' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id DESC, atom.atom_id ASC, bond.bond_id NULLS FIRST
SELECT s.district FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('San Diego', 'Imperial') AND s.charter = 0 AND s.magnet = 1 AND s.virtual = 'Y' GROUP BY s.district HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 3;

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.aggression FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.aggression > 80

SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.attacking_work_rate FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 175 AND 185 AND PA.attacking_work_rate = 'High'

SELECT s.superhero_name, a.alignment, p.power_name FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower p ON hp.power_id = p.id WHERE s.weight_kg BETWEEN 75 AND 95 AND s.gender_id = 2 AND s.height_cm > 185
SELECT raceid, statusid FROM (SELECT raceid, statusid, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM results GROUP BY raceid, statusid) subq WHERE rank = 1
SELECT atom_id, molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element LIKE 'Mn%' ORDER BY atom_id DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Ga' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, b.bond_id NULLS FIRST
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.gk_positioning FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 185 AND 195 AND PA.gk_positioning > 90

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence, AVG(demographics.height) AS avg_height FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence = TRUE AND demographics.gender = 'Female' AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_ihc > 2 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Al' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 1 AND 3 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS ionic_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'ionic' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'I%' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY ionic_bonds DESC

SELECT s.dname AS district, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 1.2 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.8) AS weighted_math_write_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.dname IN (SELECT s.dname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.dname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 1.2 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.8) DESC nulls last LIMIT 6) GROUP BY s.dname, sch.school ORDER BY s.dname, weighted_math_write_score DESC;

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_list ON atom.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Rn' AND bond_list.bond_type = 'ionic' ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id ASC
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Sc%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS FIRST, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bond.bond_id) AS unique_silver_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id INNER JOIN atom ON (bond.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id AND atom.element = 'Ag') GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id;
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = 'AMMONIA') AS label_count, molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS molecule_id_count FROM molecule GROUP BY ROLLUP (molecule_id)

SELECT c.circuitId, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) AS sprint_races FROM circuits c LEFT JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId LEFT JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId WHERE res.statusid IN (SELECT statusid FROM status WHERE status LIKE '%sprint%') AND r.year BETWEEN 2021 AND 2023 GROUP BY c.circuitId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) > 1
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Dav%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 180000 AND height > 175 AND weight < 80);

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq BETWEEN 10 AND 15 AND m.label LIKE 'Ne%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST
SELECT t1.* FROM legalities t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM legalities GROUP BY format) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'B' AND power = '5' AND toughness = '4') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7074') WHEN (colors = 'G' AND power = '4' AND toughness = '3') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7075') WHEN (colors = 'U' AND power = '3' AND toughness = '2') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7076') WHEN (colors = 'W' AND power = '2' AND toughness = '1') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7077') END) AS watermark FROM cards

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.country AS circuitcountry, d.forename AS driverfirstname, d.surname AS driverlastname, co.name AS teamname, res.grid AS qualifyingposition, res.fastestlaptime FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2019 AND res.points > 10 AND res.positionorder <= 5 ORDER BY r.raceid DESC, res.grid ASC
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE element = 'POTASSIUM') AS element_count, molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS molecule_id_count FROM atom GROUP BY ROLLUP (molecule_id)
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Jad%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 760000 AND height > 178 AND weight < 82);

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, COUNT(r.raceid) AS total_events, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.raceid) > 18 THEN 'Premier' WHEN COUNT(r.raceid) > 9 THEN 'Standard' ELSE 'Limited' END AS event_scale FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid WHERE r.year > 2019 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country HAVING COUNT(r.raceid) > 6

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.ethnicity, clinical_status.days_to_last_followup, MAX(demographics.height) AS max_height FROM patients JOIN clinical_status ON patients.patient_id = clinical_status.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = FALSE AND clinical_status.days_to_last_followup IS NOT NULL GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.ethnicity, clinical_status.days_to_last_followup ORDER BY patients.patient_id;
SELECT account_id FROM trans GROUP BY account_id HAVING COUNT(trans_id) > 25 AND (MAX(balance) - MIN(balance)) > 200000;
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Ge%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS FIRST, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS peptide_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'peptide' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'P%' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY peptide_bonds DESC

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS silicon_dative_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'dative' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'Si%' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY silicon_dative_bonds DESC

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'G' AND power = '3' AND toughness = '2') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7078') WHEN (colors = 'U' AND power = '2' AND toughness = '1') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7079') WHEN (colors = 'B' AND power = '1' AND toughness = '0') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7080') WHEN (colors = 'R' AND power = '0' AND toughness = '1') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7081') END) AS watermark FROM cards

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'H' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, br.bond_seq NULLS LAST
SELECT * FROM cards WHERE 3 = (CASE WHEN artist LIKE 'G%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN convertedmanacost = 2.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN hasfoil = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS member_count, zip_code.county FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'volunteer' AND zip_code.type = 'military' AND member.t_shirt_size = 'L' GROUP BY zip_code.county
SELECT player_id FROM player_stats_temp GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) > 35 AND (MAX(goals) - MIN(goals)) > 30;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond_ref.bond_type, bond_ref.bond_seq FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list ON connected.bond_id = bond_list.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref ON bond_list.bond_type = bond_ref.bond_type WHERE atom.element = 'I' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id ASC, atom.atom_id DESC, bond_ref.bond_seq NULLS FIRST
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'pi' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'CHEM%'

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT atom.atom_id) AS unique_germanium_atoms FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Ge' GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id;

SELECT s.resultid, s.raceid, d.driverid FROM results AS s INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = s.driverid WHERE s.raceid = 49 AND s.points > 165 AND d.nationality = 'Danish'

SELECT s.cname AS county, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.5 + s.avgscrread * 0.3 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.2) AS balanced_sat_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.cname IN (SELECT s.cname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.cname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.5 + s.avgscrread * 0.3 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.2) ASC nulls last LIMIT 5) GROUP BY s.cname, sch.school ORDER BY s.cname, balanced_sat_score ASC;

SELECT s.district, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numge1500 FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.county = 'San Diego' AND sa.rtype = 'S' ORDER BY sa.avgscrmath ASC LIMIT 5;

SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.potential FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height > 175 AND PA.potential BETWEEN 80 AND 90

SELECT c.name, c.nationality, cs.wins FROM constructors c INNER JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE cs.points > 200 AND cs.wins > 10 ORDER BY cs.wins DESC LIMIT 8;

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplayspeed, ta.buildupplayspeedclass, ta.chancecreationshooting, ta.chancecreationshootingclass, ta.defencepressure, ta.defencepressureclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2019-12-31 00:00:00'

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS total_elements FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 6;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond_ref.bond_type, bond_ref.bond_seq FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list ON connected.bond_id = bond_list.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref ON bond_list.bond_type = bond_ref.bond_type WHERE atom.element = 'Re' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id DESC, atom.atom_id ASC, bond_ref.bond_seq NULLS FIRST
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected WHERE atom_id2 = 'ATOM008') AS atom_id2_count, atom_id, COUNT(*) AS atom_id_count FROM connected GROUP BY ROLLUP (atom_id)

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, av.cnt FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN atom_view AS av ON a.atom_id = av.atom_id WHERE a.element = 'Ne' AND av.cnt < 3 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS composite_key, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS molecule_ref, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Pt%' OR b.bond_type IN ('covalent', 'ionic') ORDER BY composite_key ASC, molecule_ref DESC

SELECT raceid, rank AS modal_rank FROM (SELECT raceid, rank, COUNT(*) AS freq, MIN(resultid) AS first_occurrence, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(resultid) ASC) AS rn FROM results GROUP BY raceid, rank) sub WHERE rn = 1 AND rank BETWEEN 3 AND 7 ORDER BY raceid;

SELECT atom_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN atom_id2 END) AS atom_id2_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN atom_id2 END) AS atom_id2_2 FROM (SELECT atom_id, atom_id2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY atom_id ORDER BY atom_id2 DESC) AS rn FROM connected) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 2 GROUP BY atom_id ORDER BY atom_id
SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Stamina' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 80 AND 100)

SELECT '2023-07-01' AS reporting_date, COUNT(CASE WHEN opendate < '2023-07-01' AND (closeddate IS NULL OR closeddate >= '2023-07-01') THEN 1 END) AS active_schools_in_san_bernardino FROM schools WHERE county = 'San Bernardino' AND charter = 1;

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS combined_key, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS molecule_ref, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property_type FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Au%' OR b.bond_type IN ('hydrogen', 'covalent') ORDER BY combined_key DESC, molecule_ref ASC
SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.admission, COALESCE(l.crp, 'Unknown') AS crp_status FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT sqA.alignment_count AS total_by_alignment, A.alignment AS alignment, P.publisher_name AS publisher, sqAP.alignment_publisher_count AS count_by_alignment_publisher FROM (SELECT alignment_id, COUNT(*) AS alignment_count FROM superhero GROUP BY alignment_id) sqA INNER JOIN (SELECT alignment_id, publisher_id, COUNT(*) AS alignment_publisher_count FROM superhero GROUP BY alignment_id, publisher_id) sqAP ON sqA.alignment_id = sqAP.alignment_id INNER JOIN alignment A ON sqA.alignment_id = A.id INNER JOIN publisher P ON sqAP.publisher_id = P.id ORDER BY A.alignment, P.publisher_name;

SELECT p.player_name, p.height, COUNT(pa.id) AS attribute_count FROM player p JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.overall_rating > 80 AND p.height > 180 GROUP BY p.player_name, p.height HAVING COUNT(pa.id) > 10;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq BETWEEN 3 AND 6 AND m.label LIKE 'B%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT e.event_name, COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS Attendee_Count FROM event AS e JOIN attendance AS a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event WHERE e.type = 'Workshop' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING COUNT(a.link_to_member) > 5

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplaypositioningclass, ta.chancecreationpositioningclass, ta.defencedefenderlineclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2023-12-15 00:00:00'
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected WHERE atom_id = 'ATOM004') AS atom_id_count, atom_id2, COUNT(*) AS atom_id2_count FROM connected GROUP BY ROLLUP (atom_id2)
SELECT m.member_id FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN income AS i ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member WHERE i.link_to_member IS NULL AND i.amount > 200 AND i.source = 'donation' AND m.position = 'Secretary'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Ca' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 3 AND 6 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST
SELECT cards.keywords, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT * FROM card_type WHERE card_type.cardid = cards.id) THEN 'typed' ELSE 'not typed' END FROM cards

SELECT sqA.alignment_count AS total_by_alignment, A.alignment AS alignment, C.colour AS skin_colour, sqAC.alignment_colour_count AS count_by_alignment_colour FROM (SELECT alignment_id, COUNT(*) AS alignment_count FROM superhero WHERE alignment_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY alignment_id) sqA INNER JOIN (SELECT alignment_id, skin_colour_id, COUNT(*) AS alignment_colour_count FROM superhero WHERE skin_colour_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY alignment_id, skin_colour_id) sqAC ON sqA.alignment_id = sqAC.alignment_id INNER JOIN alignment A ON sqA.alignment_id = A.id INNER JOIN colour C ON sqAC.skin_colour_id = C.id WHERE C.colour LIKE 'Orange%' ORDER BY A.alignment, C.colour;
SELECT atom_id as current_atom, LEAD(atom_id) OVER (ORDER BY element) as next_atom, molecule_id as molecule_type FROM atom a

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS total_expenses FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2023-07-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND e.type = 'Fundraiser' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 3000 ORDER BY total_expenses DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS total_bonds FROM bond GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 5;

SELECT cards.asciiname, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT * FROM legalities WHERE legalities.format = cards.setcode AND legalities.status = 'Banned' AND legalities.uuid = cards.uuid AND legalities.id = cards.id AND legalities.format = 'Legacy') THEN 'legacy_banned' ELSE 'legacy_legal' END FROM cards

SELECT year_created, displayname, cnt_badges FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.displayname, COUNT(b.id) AS cnt_badges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(b.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM badges AS b INNER JOIN users AS u ON b.userid = u.id WHERE u.displayname LIKE 'P%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)), u.id, u.displayname) AS b WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_badges DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'G' AND power = '4' AND toughness = '3') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7074') WHEN (colors = 'R' AND power = '3' AND toughness = '2') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7075') WHEN (colors = 'W' AND power = '2' AND toughness = '1') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7076') WHEN (colors = 'B' AND power = '1' AND toughness = '0') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7077') END) AS watermark FROM cards

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_id, bl.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Cl' AND bl.transact_dt_tm > '2023-06-01' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, bl.bond_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_list ON atom.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Ti' AND bond_list.bond_type = 'pi' ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id ASC
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.stamina FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 160 AND 170 AND PA.stamina > 85
SELECT player_id FROM player_stats GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) > 14 AND (MAX(yellow_cards) - MIN(yellow_cards)) > 6;

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence, AVG(demographics.height) AS avg_height FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence = TRUE AND demographics.gender = 'Male' AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_he > 8 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Ne' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.bond_type ASC

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.tg FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'SLE' AND l.tg > 150 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.tg HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.tg = j.tg)
SELECT C.asciiname, C.availability FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Commander' AND C.convertedmanacost BETWEEN 1.0 AND 3.0
SELECT C.name, C.rarity FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Historic' AND C.convertedmanacost = 11.0
SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS total_income FROM income WHERE amount > 150 GROUP BY link_to_member HAVING SUM(amount) > 750

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplayspeed, ta.buildupplayspeedclass, ta.chancecreationcrossing, ta.chancecreationcrossingclass, ta.defenceaggression, ta.defenceaggressionclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2023-07-15 00:00:00'

SELECT s.cname AS county, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.7 + s.avgscrread * 0.2 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.1) AS math_weighted_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.cname IN (SELECT s.cname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.cname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.7 + s.avgscrread * 0.2 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.1) DESC nulls last LIMIT 5) GROUP BY s.cname, sch.school ORDER BY s.cname, math_weighted_score DESC;

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS fusion_id, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS substance_ref, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS characteristic FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Se%' OR b.bond_type IN ('hydrogen', 'metallic') ORDER BY fusion_id ASC, substance_ref DESC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = 'hydrogen' AND m.label LIKE 'H2O%' AND a.element = 'O' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.bond_type ASC

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplaydribbling, ta.buildupplaydribblingclass, ta.chancecreationpassing, ta.chancecreationpassingclass, ta.defenceteamwidth, ta.defenceteamwidthclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2017-07-15 00:00:00'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id ORDER BY m.molecule_id NULLS FIRST, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex, COALESCE(l.aptt, 0) AS aptt_level FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND l.aptt BETWEEN 50 AND 60 ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond.bond_type FROM atom LEFT JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'covalent' AND atom.element = 'Oxygen' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'MOL%'

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond_ref.bond_type, bond_ref.bond_seq FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id INNER JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref ON bond.bond_type = bond_ref.bond_type WHERE atom.element = 'Co' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id ASC, atom.atom_id DESC, bond_ref.bond_seq NULLS FIRST

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond_list.bond_id) AS recent_silicon_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond_list ON molecule.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE bond_list.bond_type = 'silicon' AND bond_list.transact_dt_tm > '2024-01-01' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY recent_silicon_bonds DESC

SELECT year_created, displayname, cnt_posthistory FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ph.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.displayname, COUNT(ph.id) AS cnt_posthistory, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ph.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(ph.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM posthistory AS ph INNER JOIN users AS u ON ph.userid = u.id WHERE u.displayname LIKE 'I%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ph.creationdate AS DATE)), u.id, u.displayname) AS ph WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_posthistory DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'S' ORDER BY m.label NULLS FIRST, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST
SELECT cdscode, COUNT(charter) FROM schools WHERE county = 'Santa Clara County' GROUP BY cdscode LIMIT 4
SELECT s.resultid, s.raceid, d.driverid FROM results AS s INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = s.driverid WHERE s.raceid = 43 AND s.points > 130 AND d.nationality = 'Russian'

SELECT MAX(a5) FROM (SELECT a5, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a5 DESC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM district) AS E WHERE (Rank = 3)

SELECT s.district, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numge1500 FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.county = 'San Diego' AND sa.rtype = 'S' ORDER BY sa.avgscrwrite ASC LIMIT 5;

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.remaining) AS available_funds FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-06-30' AND e.type = 'Training' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.remaining) > 1800 ORDER BY available_funds DESC LIMIT 4

SELECT sqP.publisher_count AS total_by_publisher, P.publisher_name AS publisher, C.colour AS eye_colour, sqPC.publisher_colour_count AS count_by_publisher_colour FROM (SELECT publisher_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_count FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id) sqP INNER JOIN (SELECT publisher_id, eye_colour_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_colour_count FROM superhero WHERE eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id, eye_colour_id) sqPC ON sqP.publisher_id = sqPC.publisher_id INNER JOIN publisher P ON sqP.publisher_id = P.id INNER JOIN colour C ON sqPC.eye_colour_id = C.id WHERE C.colour LIKE 'Green%' ORDER BY P.publisher_name, C.colour;

SELECT MIN(a4) FROM (SELECT a4, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a4 DESC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM district) AS E WHERE (Rank = 3)

SELECT t1.* FROM cards t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM cards GROUP BY artist, asciiname, name, setcode, rarity, convertedmanacost, power, toughness, colors, keywords, subtypes, types, layout, frameversion, bordercolor, watermark, multiverseid, originaltype, originaltext) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 173 THEN 173 WHEN s.id = 174 THEN 174 WHEN s.id = 175 THEN 175 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, sp.power_name FROM superhero AS s JOIN hero_power AS hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE s.id IN (173, 174, 175) AND sp.power_name LIKE 'Energy%'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Be' ORDER BY m.label ASC, a.atom_id ASC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'B' AND br.bond_seq > 2 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, br.bond_seq ASC

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.lat AS circuitlatitude, d.code AS drivercode, co.nationality AS constructornationality, res.position AS finishposition, res.fastestlapspeed FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2014 AND 2019 AND res.points > 14 AND res.positionorder <= 4 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.fastestlapspeed DESC
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.crossing FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 175 AND 185 AND PA.crossing > 85

SELECT molecule_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN bond_id END) AS bond_id_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN bond_id END) AS bond_id_2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN bond_id END) AS bond_id_3 FROM (SELECT molecule_id, bond_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY molecule_id ORDER BY bond_id ASC) AS rn FROM bond_list) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 5 GROUP BY molecule_id ORDER BY molecule_id

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, bl.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Xe' AND bl.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-10-01' AND '2023-12-31' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, bl.bond_type DESC
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.balance FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 170 AND 180 AND PA.balance > 85

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Illuminator' WHERE u.reputation >= 35000 AND u.creationdate > '2020-01-01'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq BETWEEN 4 AND 7 AND m.label LIKE 'Ar%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_id, bl.bond_type, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'I' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, bl.transact_dt_tm NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, bl.bond_id, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Au' AND bl.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Na' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 2 AND 5 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS composite_id, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS chemical_code, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond_list AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Cr%' OR b.transact_dt_tm = '2023-07-01' ORDER BY composite_id ASC, chemical_code DESC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Pt' AND b.bond_type = 'covalent' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.bond_type ASC

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS carbon_aromatic_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'aromatic' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'C%' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY carbon_aromatic_bonds DESC

WITH member_attendance_analysis AS (SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, SUM(hours) AS total_hours, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_member ORDER BY SUM(hours) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top Hours' AS result_type FROM attendance WHERE hours > 2.3 GROUP BY link_to_member, link_to_event), event_attendance AS (SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, SUM(hours) AS total_hours, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_event ORDER BY SUM(hours) DESC) AS rank, 'Event Top Hours' AS result_type FROM attendance WHERE hours > 2.3 GROUP BY link_to_member, link_to_event) SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, total_hours, result_type FROM member_attendance_analysis WHERE rank <= 3 UNION ALL SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, total_hours, result_type FROM event_attendance WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, link_to_member, link_to_event

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN kct = 'Positive' THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS KCT_Positive, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rvvt = 'Positive' THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS RVVT_Positive, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN lac = 'Positive' THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS LAC_Positive FROM examination GROUP BY id

WITH member_privileges_analysis AS (SELECT privilege_level, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total_privileges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY privilege_level ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Privilege Top 2' AS result_type FROM member_privileges WHERE is_active = true AND privilege_scope = 'Admin' GROUP BY privilege_level, member_id), privilege_members AS (SELECT privilege_level, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total_privileges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top Privilege' AS result_type FROM member_privileges WHERE is_active = true AND privilege_scope = 'Admin' GROUP BY privilege_level, member_id) SELECT privilege_level, member_id, total_privileges, result_type FROM member_privileges_analysis WHERE rank <= 2 UNION ALL SELECT privilege_level, member_id, total_privileges, result_type FROM privilege_members WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, privilege_level, member_id

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS id, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS molecule_id, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS val FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond AS b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id ORDER BY id NULLS FIRST, molecule_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'As' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, br.bond_seq ASC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = 'hydrogen' AND m.label LIKE 'NH3%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.bond_type DESC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq BETWEEN 12 AND 18 AND m.label LIKE 'Zn%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, bl.bond_id, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'I' AND bl.transact_dt_tm < '2023-01-01' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond_ref.bond_type, bond_ref.bond_seq FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id INNER JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref ON bond.bond_type = bond_ref.bond_type WHERE atom.element = 'Mn' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id DESC, atom.atom_id ASC, bond_ref.bond_seq NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Cl' AND br.bond_seq > 3 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, br.bond_seq DESC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Co' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 4 AND 8 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, br.bond_seq ASC
