SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.aptt FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'APS' AND l.aptt > 40 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.aptt HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.aptt = j.aptt)
SELECT MAX(a8) FROM (SELECT a8, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a8 DESC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM district) AS E WHERE (Rank = 2)
SELECT s.school FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('San Francisco', 'Santa Clara') GROUP BY s.school HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 2;

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(b.spent) AS Total_Spent_On_Conferences FROM member AS m JOIN budget AS b ON m.member_id = b.link_to_event JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.type = 'Conference' AND e.status = 'Approved' AND b.spent > 600 GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 3500
SELECT cdscode, COUNT(virtual) FROM schools WHERE county = 'Kern County' GROUP BY cdscode LIMIT 17

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN hct > 45 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS High_Hematocrit, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rbc > 5.5 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS High_RBC, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN wbc < 4 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Low_WBC FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond_ref.bond_type, bond_ref.bond_seq FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list ON connected.bond_id = bond_list.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref ON bond_list.bond_type = bond_ref.bond_type WHERE atom.element = 'V' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id ASC, atom.atom_id DESC, bond_ref.bond_seq NULLS FIRST

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Favorite Question' WHERE u.reputation >= 10000 AND u.creationdate > '2018-01-01'

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'cl' THEN 1 END) AS chlorine_atoms, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element IN ('f', 'br') THEN molecule_id END) AS halogen_atoms FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS unified_key, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS chemical_reference, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property_description FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond_list AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Cs%' OR b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-06-30' ORDER BY unified_key DESC, chemical_reference ASC
SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS total_income FROM income WHERE amount BETWEEN 150 AND 300 GROUP BY link_to_member HAVING SUM(amount) > 800

SELECT raceid, fastestlapspeed AS modal_fastestlapspeed FROM (SELECT raceid, fastestlapspeed, COUNT(*) AS freq, MIN(resultid) AS first_occurrence, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(resultid) ASC) AS rn FROM results GROUP BY raceid, fastestlapspeed) sub WHERE rn = 1 AND fastestlapspeed BETWEEN '210' AND '250' ORDER BY raceid;
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id2 = atom.atom_id WHERE atom.element = 'rhodium' AND atom.molecule_id LIKE 'TRANSITION%'

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'glycosidic' AND molecule.label LIKE 'Fiber%' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'CHEM%'
SELECT C.name, C.flavortext FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Pioneer' AND C.convertedmanacost BETWEEN 4.0 AND 6.0

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS hair_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.hair_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Copper%' AND sh.weight_kg BETWEEN 60 AND 80 ORDER BY sh.id ASC

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.got FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'SLE' AND l.got > 40 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.got HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.got = j.got)

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS hair_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.hair_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Ginger%' AND sh.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190 ORDER BY sh.id DESC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Ar' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 4 AND 6 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, br.bond_seq DESC

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence, COUNT(pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence) AS metastasis_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence = FALSE AND demographics.gender = 'Male' GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Cl' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 3 AND 6 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS skin_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.skin_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Gray%' AND sh.weight_kg BETWEEN 80 AND 100 ORDER BY sh.id DESC

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN hgb < 8.5 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Severe_Anemia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN plt < 85 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Critical_Thrombocytopenia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN wbc > 19 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Extreme_Leukocytosis FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

SELECT s.superhero_name, a.attribute_name, ha.attribute_value FROM superhero s JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE ha.attribute_value BETWEEN 55 AND 75 AND s.alignment_id = 2
SELECT s.district FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('San Francisco', 'Alameda') AND s.charter = 1 AND s.magnet = 0 GROUP BY s.district HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 2;

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.curve FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.curve > 80

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_type, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE bl.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND m.label LIKE 'C6H12O6%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, bl.transact_dt_tm DESC
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'amide' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'BIO%'

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence, COUNT(pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence) AS metastasis_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence = TRUE GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(a.hours) AS Total_Committee_Hours FROM member AS m JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.type = 'Committee' GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING SUM(a.hours) > 8

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond_list.bond_id, bond_list.bond_type, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list ON connected.bond_id = bond_list.bond_id WHERE atom.element = 'Rn' AND bond_list.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id ASC, atom.atom_id DESC, bond_list.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST
SELECT atom_id, molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element LIKE 'Au%' ORDER BY molecule_id ASC NULLS LAST

SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex, COALESCE(l.aptt, 0) AS aptt_level FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND l.aptt BETWEEN 45 AND 55 ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS member_count, zip_code.state FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'active' AND zip_code.type = 'standard' AND member.t_shirt_size = 'XXL' GROUP BY zip_code.state, member.position, zip_code.type, member.t_shirt_size, member.email, member.phone, member.first_name, member.last_name, member.link_to_major

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Illuminator' WHERE u.reputation >= 30000 AND u.creationdate > '2019-01-01'

SELECT e.event_name, COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS attendance_count FROM event e LEFT JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2023-04-01' AND '2023-09-30' AND e.type = 'Workshop' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING COUNT(a.link_to_member) > 3 ORDER BY attendance_count DESC LIMIT 4
SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.bond_id DESC) AS rnk FROM bond a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 7

SELECT s.superhero_name, a.attribute_name, ha.attribute_value FROM superhero s JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE ha.attribute_value BETWEEN 65 AND 85 AND s.alignment_id = 2
SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex, COALESCE(l.alb, 0) AS albumin_status FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT TA.ID, TA.BUILDUPPLAYSPEED, TA.BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING, TA.DEFENCEAGGRESSION, TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH FROM team_attributes AS TA WHERE TA.BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING > (SELECT AVG(BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCEAGGRESSION < (SELECT AVG(DEFENCEAGGRESSION) FROM team_attributes)
SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS total_bonds FROM bond GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 25;

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplaydribbling, ta.buildupplaydribblingclass, ta.chancecreationcrossing, ta.chancecreationcrossingclass, ta.defencepressure, ta.defencepressureclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2020-01-15 00:00:00'

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_list ON atom.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'S' AND bond_list.bond_type = 'single' ORDER BY molecule.label ASC, atom.atom_id DESC
SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'ester' AND molecule.label LIKE 'Ester%'

SELECT '2025-02-01' AS reporting_date, COUNT(CASE WHEN opendate < '2025-02-01' AND (closeddate IS NULL OR closeddate >= '2025-02-01') THEN 1 END) AS active_schools_in_solano FROM schools WHERE county = 'Solano';

SELECT s.cname AS county, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.4 + s.avgscrread * 0.4 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.2) AS balanced_weighted_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.cname IN (SELECT s.cname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.cname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.4 + s.avgscrread * 0.4 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.2) DESC nulls last LIMIT 5) GROUP BY s.cname, sch.school ORDER BY s.cname, balanced_weighted_score DESC;

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, connected.atom_id2 FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id WHERE atom.element = 'Sn' AND connected.bond_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id ASC
SELECT t1.* FROM packages t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM packages GROUP BY name) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.potential FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height > 190 AND PA.potential > 90

SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.country LIKE 'T%') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.name LIKE '%Tunnel%')
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond_list WHERE bond_type = 'TRIPLE') AS bond_type_count, transact_dt_tm, COUNT(*) AS transact_dt_tm_count FROM bond_list GROUP BY ROLLUP (transact_dt_tm)

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.remaining) AS Total_Available_Funds FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.event_status = 'Approved' AND b.category = 'Workshop' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.remaining) > 1500

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(ps.stop) AS pitstop_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(ps.stop) > 30 THEN 'High' WHEN COUNT(ps.stop) > 15 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS pitstop_frequency FROM drivers d JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE ps.milliseconds > 5000 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(ps.stop) > 5

SELECT TA.ID, TA.BUILDUPPLAYPASSING, TA.CHANCECREATIONSHOOTING, TA.DEFENCEPRESSURE, TA.DEFENCEAGGRESSION FROM team_attributes AS TA WHERE TA.BUILDUPPLAYPASSING < (SELECT AVG(BUILDUPPLAYPASSING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCEAGGRESSION > (SELECT AVG(DEFENCEAGGRESSION) FROM team_attributes)

WITH ATTRIBUTE_RANK AS (SELECT ID, ATTRIBUTE_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ID DESC NULLS LAST) AS RANK FROM ATTRIBUTE) SELECT A1.ATTRIBUTE_NAME AS CURRENT_ATTRIBUTE, A2.ATTRIBUTE_NAME AS ATTRIBUTE_AFTER_5 FROM ATTRIBUTE_RANK AS A1 LEFT JOIN ATTRIBUTE_RANK AS A2 ON A2.RANK = A1.RANK + 5
SELECT link_to_event, SUM(hours) AS total_attendance_hours FROM attendance WHERE hours > 5 GROUP BY link_to_event HAVING SUM(hours) > 25
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'metallic' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'ALLOY%' AND connected.atom_id2 LIKE 'ATM%'

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN got > 40 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS High_GOT, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN gpt > 40 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS High_GPT, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN ldh > 250 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS High_LDH FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

SELECT p.player_id, p.match_id, p.goals FROM player_stats p JOIN player_rate pr ON p.player_id = pr.id WHERE p.goals > 3 AND pr.overall_rating BETWEEN 90 AND 95 AND pr.potential_rating > 92 AND p.minutes_played > 85 LIMIT 235;

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN examination AS e ON (p.id = e.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, e.lac FROM patient AS p JOIN examination AS e ON (p.id = e.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'APS' AND e.lac = 'Positive' GROUP BY p.diagnosis, e.lac HAVING COUNT(*) > 2) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND e.lac = j.lac)

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq BETWEEN 20 AND 25 AND m.label LIKE 'F%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT raceid, q3 FROM (SELECT raceid, q3, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC) AS rank FROM qualifying GROUP BY raceid, q3) subq WHERE rank = 1 AND q3 IS NOT NULL AND q3 <> '0' AND q3 NOT LIKE '1%'

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS skin_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.skin_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Lavender%' AND sh.weight_kg BETWEEN 65 AND 85 ORDER BY sh.id DESC
SELECT s.resultid, s.raceid, d.driverid FROM results AS s INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = s.driverid WHERE s.raceid = 34 AND s.points > 85 AND d.nationality = 'Spanish'
SELECT cards_info.name, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT * FROM card_choice WHERE card_choice.card_id = cards_info.id) THEN 'chosen' ELSE 'not chosen' END FROM cards_info

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN bond_list AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type LIKE 'f%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS LAST, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Caucus' WHERE u.reputation >= 19000 AND u.creationdate > '2019-01-01'

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS composite_key, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS molecule_ref, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond_list AS b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Pt%' OR b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-06-30' ORDER BY composite_key ASC, molecule_ref DESC

SELECT s.dname AS district, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 2 + s.avgscrwrite) / 3 AS weighted_math_write_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.dname IN (SELECT s.dname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.dname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 2 + s.avgscrwrite) / 3 DESC nulls last LIMIT 5) GROUP BY s.dname, sch.school ORDER BY s.dname, weighted_math_write_score DESC;

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS merged_identifier, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS chemical_reference, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property_value FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond_list AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Zr%' OR b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-09-01' AND '2023-11-30' ORDER BY merged_identifier DESC, chemical_reference ASC
SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'mn' THEN 1 END) AS mn_atoms, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element IN ('fe', 'co') THEN molecule_id END) AS fe_atoms FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'van der Waals' AND molecule.label LIKE 'Protein%'

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.fastestlaptime FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.fastestlaptime IS NOT NULL AND r.position <= 5 AND r.points > 25 ORDER BY r.fastestlaptime DESC LIMIT 12;
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id2 = atom.atom_id WHERE atom.element = 'ruthenium' AND atom.molecule_id LIKE 'TRANSITION%'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Ag' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, br.bond_seq NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, bl.bond_id, bl.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE bl.transact_dt_tm = '2023-09-01' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT t1.team_short_name, t2.buildupplaypositioningclass FROM team t1 INNER JOIN team_attributes t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.buildupplayspeed BETWEEN 85 AND 100 AND t2.chancecreationcrossing > 75

SELECT s.district FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('Siskiyou', 'Modoc') GROUP BY s.district HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 2;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond_list.bond_id, bond_list.bond_type FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list ON connected.bond_id = bond_list.bond_id WHERE atom.element = 'Fe' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id ASC, atom.atom_id DESC, bond_list.bond_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN cpk > 300 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS High_CPK, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN alp > 150 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS High_ALP, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN glu > 180 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS High_Glucose FROM laboratory GROUP BY id
SELECT atom_id, atom_id2 FROM connected WHERE bond_id LIKE 'B%' ORDER BY atom_id ASC NULLS LAST

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS total_expenses FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-06-30' AND e.type = 'Workshop' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 750 ORDER BY total_expenses ASC LIMIT 4
SELECT C.name, C.flavortext FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Commander' AND C.convertedmanacost BETWEEN 4.0 AND 6.0
SELECT cdscode, COUNT(soctype) FROM schools WHERE county = 'Monterey County' GROUP BY cdscode LIMIT 18

SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.country LIKE 'X%') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.name LIKE '%Xenon%')
SELECT s.district FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('San Bernardino', 'Riverside') AND s.charter = 1 AND s.magnet = 1 AND s.virtual = 'Y' GROUP BY s.district HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 3;

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence, AVG(demographics.weight) AS avg_weight FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence = TRUE GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.lng AS circuitlongitude, d.code AS drivercode, co.nationality AS constructornationality, res.position AS finishposition, res.fastestlaptime FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2015 AND res.points > 10 AND res.positionorder <= 5 ORDER BY r.raceid DESC, res.fastestlaptime ASC

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.volleys FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.volleys > 70
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Mar%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 300000 AND weight > 75 AND height < 185);
SELECT cdscode, COUNT(admfname3) FROM schools WHERE county = 'Nevada County' GROUP BY cdscode LIMIT 41
SELECT C.name, C.artist FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Pauper' AND C.convertedmanacost BETWEEN 1.0 AND 3.0 AND C.rarity = 'Common' AND C.hasnonfoil = 1
SELECT * FROM member_privileges WHERE privilege_level >= 'Assistant' AND privilege_level <= 'Coordinator' AND member_id = 'recggMW2eyCYceNcy' ORDER BY created_at DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT link_to_member, SUM(cost) AS total_expense FROM expense WHERE cost BETWEEN 30 AND 100 GROUP BY link_to_member HAVING SUM(cost) > 200

SELECT raceid, round AS modal_round FROM (SELECT raceid, round, COUNT(*) AS freq, MIN(raceid) AS first_occurrence, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(raceid) ASC) AS rn FROM races GROUP BY raceid, round) sub WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY raceid;
SELECT cdscode, COUNT(ncesdist) FROM schools WHERE county = 'Los Angeles County' GROUP BY cdscode LIMIT 5

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_ref.bond_seq FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_ref ON atom.element = 'Ar' AND bond_ref.bond_type = 'dipolar' ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Inquisitor' WHERE u.reputation >= 22000 AND u.creationdate > '2018-01-01'
SELECT * FROM cards WHERE 3 = (CASE WHEN artist LIKE 'X%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN convertedmanacost = 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN hasfoil = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);
SELECT s.school FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('San Francisco', 'San Mateo') AND s.charter = 1 AND s.virtual = 'Y' GROUP BY s.school HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 2;
SELECT c1.atom_id, c2.atom_id FROM connected AS c1 INNER JOIN connected AS c2 ON (c1.atom_id, c2.atom_id) IN (('AT400', 'AT401'), ('AT400', 'AT402'), ('AT401', 'AT402'))

SELECT year_created, aboutme, cnt_votes FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(v.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.aboutme, COUNT(v.id) AS cnt_votes, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(v.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(v.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM votes AS v INNER JOIN users AS u ON v.userid = u.id WHERE u.aboutme LIKE 'S%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(v.creationdate AS DATE)), u.aboutme) AS v WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_votes DESC NULLS LAST

WITH major_members AS (SELECT link_to_major, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_major ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Major Top 3' AS result_type FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major, member_id), member_majors AS (SELECT link_to_major, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top 1' AS result_type FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major, member_id) SELECT link_to_major, member_id, total, result_type FROM major_members WHERE rank <= 3 UNION ALL SELECT link_to_major, member_id, total, result_type FROM member_majors WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, link_to_major, member_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS member_count, zip_code.state FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'volunteer' AND zip_code.type = 'standard' AND member.t_shirt_size = 'XXL' GROUP BY zip_code.state, member.position, zip_code.type, member.t_shirt_size, member.email, member.phone, member.first_name, member.last_name
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'ATOM001') AS atom_id_count, element, COUNT(*) AS element_count FROM atom GROUP BY ROLLUP (element)

SELECT sqP.publisher_count AS total_by_publisher, P.publisher_name AS publisher, G.gender AS gender, sqPG.publisher_gender_count AS count_by_publisher_gender FROM (SELECT publisher_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_count FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id) sqP INNER JOIN (SELECT publisher_id, gender_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_gender_count FROM superhero WHERE gender_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id, gender_id) sqPG ON sqP.publisher_id = sqPG.publisher_id INNER JOIN publisher P ON sqP.publisher_id = P.id INNER JOIN gender G ON sqPG.gender_id = G.id WHERE G.gender LIKE 'Female%' ORDER BY P.publisher_name, G.gender;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_id, bl.bond_type, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Br' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, bl.transact_dt_tm DESC

SELECT s.constructorstandingsid, s.raceid, c.constructorid FROM constructorstandings AS s INNER JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorid = s.constructorid WHERE s.raceid = 68 AND s.points > 280 AND c.nationality = 'Dutch'

SELECT sqP.publisher_count AS total_by_publisher, P.publisher_name AS publisher, C.colour AS skin_colour, sqPC.publisher_colour_count AS count_by_publisher_colour FROM (SELECT publisher_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_count FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id) sqP INNER JOIN (SELECT publisher_id, skin_colour_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_colour_count FROM superhero WHERE skin_colour_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id, skin_colour_id) sqPC ON sqP.publisher_id = sqPC.publisher_id INNER JOIN publisher P ON sqP.publisher_id = P.id INNER JOIN colour C ON sqPC.skin_colour_id = C.id WHERE C.colour LIKE 'Red%' ORDER BY P.publisher_name, C.colour;

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.remaining) AS unused_budget FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-06-30' AND e.type = 'Social' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.remaining) > 1200 ORDER BY unused_budget DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'hydrophobic' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'BIO%'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'P' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 3 AND 6 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected WHERE atom_id = 'ATOM014') AS atom_id_count, bond_id, COUNT(*) AS bond_id_count FROM connected GROUP BY ROLLUP (bond_id)

SELECT MAX(cost) AS max_cost, link_to_member FROM expense WHERE approved = 'true' GROUP BY link_to_member

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'sm' THEN 1 END) AS sm_atoms, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element IN ('eu', 'gd') THEN molecule_id END) AS lanthanide_atoms FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS total_expenses FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2024-04-01' AND '2024-09-30' AND e.type = 'Social' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 900 ORDER BY total_expenses ASC LIMIT 4
SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Dexterity' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 40 AND 60)

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS eye_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Amethyst%' AND sh.height_cm BETWEEN 165 AND 195 ORDER BY sh.id DESC

SELECT s.district, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numge1500 FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.county = 'San Diego' AND sa.rtype = 'S' ORDER BY sa.avgscrwrite DESC LIMIT 4;

SELECT sqP.publisher_count AS total_by_publisher, P.publisher_name AS publisher, C.colour AS skin_colour, sqPC.publisher_colour_count AS count_by_publisher_colour FROM (SELECT publisher_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_count FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id) sqP INNER JOIN (SELECT publisher_id, skin_colour_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_colour_count FROM superhero WHERE skin_colour_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id, skin_colour_id) sqPC ON sqP.publisher_id = sqPC.publisher_id INNER JOIN publisher P ON sqP.publisher_id = P.id INNER JOIN colour C ON sqPC.skin_colour_id = C.id WHERE C.colour LIKE 'Silver%' ORDER BY P.publisher_name, C.colour;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Au' AND b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-06-30' ORDER BY m.label ASC, a.atom_id ASC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST
SELECT MIN(a7) FROM (SELECT a7, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a7 ASC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM district) AS E WHERE (Rank = 4)

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, bl.bond_id, bl.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE bl.transact_dt_tm = '2023-06-15' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

WITH HERO_POWER_RANK AS (SELECT HERO_ID, POWER_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY POWER_ID DESC NULLS LAST) AS RANK FROM HERO_POWER) SELECT H1.HERO_ID AS CURRENT_HERO, H2.HERO_ID AS HERO_AFTER_8 FROM HERO_POWER_RANK AS H1 LEFT JOIN HERO_POWER_RANK AS H2 ON H2.RANK = H1.RANK + 8

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = 'hydrogen' AND m.label LIKE 'HF%' AND a.element = 'F' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.bond_type DESC
SELECT b1.bond_id, b2.bond_id FROM bond AS b1 INNER JOIN bond AS b2 ON (b1.bond_id, b2.bond_id) IN (('BD400', 'BD401'), ('BD400', 'BD402'), ('BD401', 'BD402'))

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, bl.bond_id, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'H' AND bl.transact_dt_tm < '2023-01-01' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS carbon_single_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'single' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'C%' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY carbon_single_bonds DESC
SELECT M.id, M.date, M.overall_rating FROM player_rate AS M WHERE M.date = (SELECT MAX(M2.date) FROM player_rate AS M2 WHERE M2.id = M.id)

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN igg > 33 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Extremely_High_IgG, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN iga > 33 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Extremely_High_IgA, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN igm > 33 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Extremely_High_IgM FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT atom.atom_id) AS unique_phosphorus_atoms FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'P' GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id;

SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Energy' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 25 AND 45)

SELECT
    link_to_event,
    CASE
        WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN event_status = 'Closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'Closed'
        WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN event_status = 'Open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AND MAX(CASE WHEN event_status = 'Planning' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'Open'
        WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN event_status = 'Open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'Open'
        WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN event_status = 'Planning' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'Planning'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS event_status,
    CASE
        WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN event_status = 'Closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN MAX(CASE WHEN event_status = 'Closed' THEN remaining END)
        WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN event_status = 'Open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AND MAX(CASE WHEN event_status = 'Planning' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN MAX(CASE WHEN event_status = 'Open' THEN spent END) + MAX(CASE WHEN event_status = 'Planning' THEN spent END)
        WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN event_status = 'Open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN MAX(CASE WHEN event_status = 'Open' THEN spent END)
        WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN event_status = 'Planning' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN MAX(CASE WHEN event_status = 'Planning' THEN spent END)
    END AS remaining
FROM budget
GROUP BY link_to_event
