SELECT RACEID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 1 THEN DRIVERID END) AS WINNER, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 2 THEN DRIVERID END) AS RUNNER_UP, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 3 THEN DRIVERID END) AS THIRD_PLACE FROM results WHERE POSITIONORDER <= 3 AND LAPS > 65 GROUP BY RACEID

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Si' ORDER BY m.label ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.bond_type NULLS LAST

WITH SUPERHERO_RANK AS (SELECT ID, SUPERHERO_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY HEIGHT_CM ASC NULLS FIRST) AS RANK FROM SUPERHERO) SELECT S1.SUPERHERO_NAME AS CURRENT_HERO, S2.SUPERHERO_NAME AS HERO_AFTER_11 FROM SUPERHERO_RANK AS S1 LEFT JOIN SUPERHERO_RANK AS S2 ON S2.RANK = S1.RANK + 11

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Autobiographer' WHERE u.reputation >= 1000 AND u.aboutme IS NOT NULL
SELECT p.id, p.sex, p.admission, AVG(l.rbc) AS avg_red_blood_cells FROM patient AS p INNER JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id GROUP BY p.id, p.sex, p.admission

SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.defensive_work_rate FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 180 AND 190 AND PA.defensive_work_rate = 'Medium'

SELECT atom_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN atom_id2 END) AS atom_id2_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN atom_id2 END) AS atom_id2_2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN atom_id2 END) AS atom_id2_3 FROM (SELECT atom_id, atom_id2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY atom_id ORDER BY atom_id2 DESC) AS rn FROM connected) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 4 GROUP BY atom_id ORDER BY atom_id

SELECT molecule_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN bond_id END) AS bond_id_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN bond_id END) AS bond_id_2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN bond_id END) AS bond_id_3 FROM (SELECT molecule_id, bond_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY molecule_id ORDER BY bond_id DESC) AS rn FROM bond) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 4 GROUP BY molecule_id ORDER BY molecule_id
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.strength FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 180 AND 190 AND PA.strength > 85
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Na%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS FIRST, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT p.player_id, p.match_id, p.goals FROM player_stats p JOIN player_rate pr ON p.player_id = pr.id WHERE p.goals > 2 AND pr.overall_rating BETWEEN 85 AND 95 AND pr.potential_rating > 90 AND p.minutes_played > 60 LIMIT 210;

SELECT c.circuitId, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) AS night_races FROM circuits c LEFT JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL AND r.year BETWEEN 2017 AND 2022 GROUP BY c.circuitId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) > 2

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(b.spent) AS Total_Spent_On_Workshops FROM member AS m JOIN budget AS b ON m.member_id = b.link_to_event JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.type = 'Workshop' AND e.status = 'Approved' AND b.spent > 400 GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 2000
SELECT driverid, COUNT(*) FROM qualifying GROUP BY driverid HAVING COUNT(*) > 20;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Ag' AND br.bond_seq < 2 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, br.bond_seq NULLS FIRST

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.fastestlaptime FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.fastestlaptime IS NOT NULL AND r.position <= 5 AND r.points > 15 ORDER BY r.fastestlaptime ASC LIMIT 9;

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN hgb < 7 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Critical_Anemia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN plt < 30 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Severe_Thrombocytopenia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN wbc > 30 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Extreme_Leukocytosis FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

WITH molecule_bond_elements AS (SELECT molecule_id AS mol FROM bond_list UNION ALL SELECT molecule_id AS mol FROM bond_ref) SELECT mol AS id, COUNT(*) AS num FROM molecule_bond_elements GROUP BY mol HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM molecule_bond_elements GROUP BY mol) AS max_elements);

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.igg FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'APS' AND l.igg > 150 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.igg HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.igg = j.igg)

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS hair_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.hair_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Chestnut%' AND sh.weight_kg BETWEEN 60 AND 80 ORDER BY sh.id DESC

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN kct = 'Negative' THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS KCT_Negative, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rvvt = 'Negative' THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS RVVT_Negative, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN lac = 'Negative' THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS LAC_Negative FROM examination GROUP BY id

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'W' AND power = '6' AND toughness = '5') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7074') WHEN (colors = 'U' AND power = '5' AND toughness = '4') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7075') WHEN (colors = 'B' AND power = '4' AND toughness = '3') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7076') WHEN (colors = 'R' AND power = '3' AND toughness = '2') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7077') END) AS watermark FROM cards
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond_list WHERE bond_type = 'HYDROGEN') AS bond_type_count, transact_dt_tm, COUNT(*) AS transact_dt_tm_count FROM bond_list GROUP BY ROLLUP (transact_dt_tm)

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_id, bl.bond_type, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Ca' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, bl.transact_dt_tm DESC

SELECT driverid, positionorder FROM (SELECT driverid, positionorder, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY driverid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM results GROUP BY driverid, positionorder) subq WHERE rank = 1

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS combined_id, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS molecule_name, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond_list AS b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Zn%' OR b.bond_type IN ('hydrogen', 'coordinate') ORDER BY combined_id DESC, molecule_name ASC

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.gk_reflexes FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.gk_reflexes > 95 AND Player_Attributes.gk_positioning > 90
SELECT C.name, C.flavortext FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Standard' AND C.convertedmanacost BETWEEN 4.0 AND 6.0 AND C.rarity = 'Rare'

SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.country LIKE 'H%') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.name LIKE '%Harbor%')
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MIN(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Gio%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 560000 AND weight > 85 AND height < 190);

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = 'metallic' AND m.label LIKE 'Fe%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.bond_type DESC
SELECT C.name, C.rarity FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Historic' AND C.convertedmanacost = 17.0
SELECT MAX(yellow_cards) FROM (SELECT yellow_cards, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY yellow_cards DESC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM player_stats) AS E WHERE (Rank = 3)

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplayspeed, ta.buildupplayspeedclass, ta.chancecreationpassing, ta.chancecreationpassingclass, ta.defenceaggression, ta.defenceaggressionclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2018-11-05 00:00:00'

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type = 'phosphoanhydride' THEN 1 END) AS phosphoanhydride_bonds, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type IN ('glycosidic', 'peptide') THEN molecule_id END) AS biochemical_bonds FROM bond_list GROUP BY molecule_id;
SELECT s.qualifyid, s.raceid, d.driverid FROM qualifying AS s INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = s.driverid WHERE s.raceid = 71 AND s.position < 8 AND d.nationality = 'Hungarian'

SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.country LIKE 'Z%') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.name LIKE '%Zenith%')

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, lifestyle_and_risk_factors.history_of_esophageal_cancer, AVG(demographics.weight) AS avg_weight FROM patients JOIN lifestyle_and_risk_factors ON patients.patient_id = lifestyle_and_risk_factors.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND lifestyle_and_risk_factors.history_of_esophageal_cancer = FALSE GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, lifestyle_and_risk_factors.history_of_esophageal_cancer ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, av.cnt FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN atom_view AS av ON a.atom_id = av.atom_id WHERE a.element = 'Kr' AND av.cnt BETWEEN 4 AND 7 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.ball_control FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 160 AND 170 AND PA.ball_control > 80

SELECT year_created, aboutme, cnt_comments FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.aboutme, COUNT(c.id) AS cnt_comments, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(c.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM comments AS c INNER JOIN users AS u ON c.userid = u.id WHERE u.aboutme LIKE 'B%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.creationdate AS DATE)), u.aboutme) AS c WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_comments DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_tumor_tissue_site, COUNT(primary_pathology_tumor_tissue_site) AS tumor_site_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_tumor_tissue_site = 'Esophagus' GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_tumor_tissue_site ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Necromancer' WHERE u.reputation >= 1000 AND u.views >= 5000
SELECT MIN(assists) FROM (SELECT assists, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY assists DESC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM player_stats) AS E WHERE (Rank = 5)

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.defensive_work_rate FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.defensive_work_rate = 'high' AND Player_Attributes.sliding_tackle > 80

SELECT s.school, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numge1500 FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.county = 'Kern' AND sa.rtype = 'D' ORDER BY sa.avgscrread DESC LIMIT 3;

WITH molecule_bond_dates AS (SELECT molecule_id AS mol, transact_dt_tm AS bdate FROM bond_list UNION ALL SELECT molecule_id AS mol, NULL AS bdate FROM bond) SELECT mol AS id, COUNT(*) AS num FROM molecule_bond_dates WHERE bdate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mol HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM molecule_bond_dates WHERE bdate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mol) AS avg_dates);

WITH POWER_RANK AS (SELECT ID, POWER_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ID DESC NULLS LAST) AS RANK FROM SUPERPOWER) SELECT P1.POWER_NAME AS CURRENT_POWER, P2.POWER_NAME AS POWER_BEFORE_10 FROM POWER_RANK AS P1 LEFT JOIN POWER_RANK AS P2 ON P2.RANK = P1.RANK - 10
SELECT player_id FROM player_stats_temp GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) > 21 AND (MAX(assists) - MIN(assists)) > 9;

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS merged_key, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS compound_code, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS feature_type FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Ar%' OR b.bond_type IN ('hydrogen', 'metallic') ORDER BY merged_key DESC, compound_code ASC
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Mn%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS FIRST, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_tumor_tissue_site, COUNT(pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_tumor_tissue_site) AS tumor_site_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_tumor_tissue_site IS NOT NULL GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_tumor_tissue_site ORDER BY patients.patient_id;
SELECT * FROM cards WHERE 3 = (CASE WHEN artist LIKE 'F%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN convertedmanacost = 3.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN hasfoil = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);

select t1.*
    from cards t1
    join
    (
        SELECT min(id) as id
        FROM cards
        GROUP BY artist
    ) t2 on t1.id = t2.id

SELECT s.cname AS county, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 1.2 + s.avgscrread * 0.6 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.2) AS composite_sat_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.cname IN (SELECT s.cname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.cname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 1.2 + s.avgscrread * 0.6 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.2) DESC nulls last LIMIT 5) GROUP BY s.cname, sch.school ORDER BY s.cname, composite_sat_score DESC;

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond.bond_type FROM atom LEFT JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'covalent' AND atom.element = 'Nitrogen' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'CHEM%'

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond_ref.bond_type, bond_ref.bond_seq FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list ON connected.bond_id = bond_list.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref ON bond_list.bond_type = bond_ref.bond_type WHERE atom.element = 'Cl' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id DESC, atom.atom_id DESC, bond_ref.bond_seq ASC

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'G' AND toughness = '8') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '9000') WHEN (colors = 'W' AND toughness = '7') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '9001') WHEN (colors = 'U' AND toughness = '6') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '9002') WHEN (colors = 'B' AND toughness = '5') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '9003') END) AS watermark FROM cards

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.lat AS circuitlatitude, d.code AS drivercode, co.nationality AS constructornationality, res.position AS finishposition, res.fastestlapspeed FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2011 AND 2016 AND res.points > 14 AND res.positionorder <= 4 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.fastestlapspeed DESC

SELECT s.city, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numge1500 FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.county = 'Sutter' AND sa.rtype = 'D' ORDER BY sa.avgscrmath DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Ni%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS FIRST, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.remaining) AS available_funds FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-12-31' AND e.type = 'Conference' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.remaining) > 1500 ORDER BY available_funds DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT t1.team_short_name, t2.defenceteamwidth FROM team t1 INNER JOIN team_attributes t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.defenceteamwidth BETWEEN 40 AND 60

SELECT constructorid, nationality FROM (SELECT constructorid, nationality, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY constructorid ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC) AS rank FROM constructors GROUP BY constructorid, nationality) subq WHERE rank = 1
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.gk_reflexes FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height > 195 AND PA.gk_reflexes > 90

SELECT s.district, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numge1500 FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.county = 'Lassen' AND sa.rtype = 'D' ORDER BY sa.avgscrmath ASC LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.city, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numtsttakr FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.county = 'San Diego' AND sa.rtype = 'S' ORDER BY sa.avgscrmath ASC LIMIT 5;

SELECT s.city, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numtsttakr FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.county = 'Tehama' AND sa.rtype = 'D' ORDER BY sa.avgscrmath ASC LIMIT 3;

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN hgb < 12.2 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Moderate_Anemia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN plt < 112 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Mild_Thrombocytopenia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN wbc > 12.1 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Leukocytosis FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count, COUNT(primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count) AS lymph_node_examined_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count BETWEEN 5 AND 15 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count, COUNT(primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count) AS lymph_node_examined_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count BETWEEN 5 AND 10 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.remaining) AS Total_Unused_Funds FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.event_status = 'Approved' AND b.category = 'Retreat' AND e.status = 'Active' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.remaining) > 2000

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id ORDER BY m.molecule_id NULLS FIRST, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, b.bond_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Popular Question' WHERE u.reputation >= 50000

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN igg > 16 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Elevated_IgG, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN iga > 16 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Elevated_IgA, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN igm > 16 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Elevated_IgM FROM laboratory GROUP BY id
SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.sprint_speed FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 165 AND 175 AND PA.sprint_speed > 80

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(atom.element) AS carbon_atoms FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'C' AND atom.atom_id LIKE 'C%' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY carbon_atoms DESC
SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.bond_id ASC) AS rnk FROM bond a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 5
SELECT link_to_member, SUM(cost) AS total_expense FROM expense WHERE cost BETWEEN 20 AND 80 GROUP BY link_to_member HAVING SUM(cost) > 120

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 700 THEN 700 WHEN s.id = 701 THEN 701 WHEN s.id = 702 THEN 702 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, a.attribute_name FROM superhero AS s JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE s.id IN (700, 701, 702) AND a.attribute_name LIKE 'Endurance%'
SELECT driverid, duration FROM (SELECT driverid, duration, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY driverid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM pitstops GROUP BY driverid, duration) subq WHERE rank = 1

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(ps.stop) AS pitstop_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(ps.stop) > 35 THEN 'Very High' WHEN COUNT(ps.stop) > 20 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Moderate' END AS pitstop_frequency FROM drivers d JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE ps.milliseconds > 4000 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(ps.stop) > 12

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS total_expenses FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-06-30' AND e.type = 'Seminar' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 1500 ORDER BY total_expenses ASC LIMIT 4

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplayspeed, ta.buildupplayspeedclass, ta.chancecreationpassing, ta.chancecreationpassingclass, ta.defenceaggression, ta.defenceaggressionclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2025-04-15 00:00:00'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, bl.bond_id, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Si' AND bl.transact_dt_tm > '2023-06-01' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST
SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'hydrogen' AND molecule.label LIKE 'Acid%'

SELECT year_created, displayname, cnt_comments FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.displayname, COUNT(c.id) AS cnt_comments, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(c.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM comments AS c INNER JOIN users AS u ON c.userid = u.id WHERE u.displayname LIKE 'W%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.creationdate AS DATE)), u.id, u.displayname) AS c WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_comments DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Au' AND b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-06-30' ORDER BY m.label DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Ne' AND br.bond_seq < 2 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, br.bond_seq NULLS FIRST

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS silicon_covalent_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'covalent' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'Si%' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY silicon_covalent_bonds DESC
SELECT C.name, C.rarity FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Pioneer' AND C.convertedmanacost = 5.0
SELECT atom_id as previous_atom, LAG(atom_id) OVER (ORDER BY molecule_id) as current_atom, element as atom_element FROM atom a

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.aptt FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'PSS' AND l.aptt > 100 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.aptt HAVING COUNT(*) > 2) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.aptt = j.aptt)

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN hgb < 13.5 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Mild_Anemia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN plt < 145 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Mild_Thrombocytopenia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN wbc > 10.5 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Mild_Leukocytosis FROM laboratory GROUP BY id
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS officer_count, major.college FROM member JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id WHERE member.position = 'officer' GROUP BY major.college

SELECT molecule_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN bond_type END) AS bond_type_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN bond_type END) AS bond_type_2 FROM (SELECT molecule_id, bond_type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY molecule_id ORDER BY bond_type ASC) AS rn FROM bond) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 2 GROUP BY molecule_id ORDER BY molecule_id
SELECT SUM(cost) AS total_cost, link_to_member FROM expense GROUP BY link_to_member
SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id WHERE c.district_id BETWEEN 20 AND 25 AND d.type = 'OWNER' LIMIT 600;

WITH member_attendance_analysis AS (SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, SUM(hours) AS total_hours, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_member ORDER BY SUM(hours) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top Hours' AS result_type FROM attendance WHERE hours > 1.2 GROUP BY link_to_member, link_to_event), event_attendance AS (SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, SUM(hours) AS total_hours, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_event ORDER BY SUM(hours) DESC) AS rank, 'Event Top Hours' AS result_type FROM attendance WHERE hours > 1.2 GROUP BY link_to_member, link_to_event) SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, total_hours, result_type FROM member_attendance_analysis WHERE rank <= 3 UNION ALL SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, total_hours, result_type FROM event_attendance WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, link_to_member, link_to_event

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS composite_key, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS molecule_ref, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond_list AS b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Lu%' OR b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-06-30' ORDER BY composite_key ASC, molecule_ref DESC
SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS total_bonds FROM bond_list GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 25 AND 35;
SELECT t1.* FROM packages t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM packages GROUP BY is_fragile) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id

WITH member_privileges_analysis AS (SELECT privilege_level, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total_privileges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY privilege_level ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Privilege Top 4' AS result_type FROM member_privileges WHERE is_active = true AND privilege_scope = 'Alumni' AND approval_status = 'Pending' GROUP BY privilege_level, member_id), privilege_members AS (SELECT privilege_level, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total_privileges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top Privilege' AS result_type FROM member_privileges WHERE is_active = true AND privilege_scope = 'Alumni' AND approval_status = 'Pending' GROUP BY privilege_level, member_id) SELECT privilege_level, member_id, total_privileges, result_type FROM member_privileges_analysis WHERE rank <= 4 UNION ALL SELECT privilege_level, member_id, total_privileges, result_type FROM privilege_members WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, privilege_level, member_id

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Benefactor' WHERE u.reputation >= 10000 AND u.creationdate > '2014-01-01'

SELECT year_created, aboutme, cnt_posts FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.aboutme, COUNT(p.id) AS cnt_posts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(p.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM posts_backup AS p INNER JOIN users AS u ON p.owneruserid = u.id WHERE u.aboutme LIKE 'C%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS DATE)), u.aboutme) AS p WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_posts DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'U' AND power = '3' AND toughness = '2') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7078') WHEN (colors = 'B' AND power = '2' AND toughness = '1') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7079') WHEN (colors = 'R' AND power = '1' AND toughness = '0') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7080') WHEN (colors = 'G' AND power = '0' AND toughness = '1') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7081') END) AS watermark FROM cards

SELECT molecule_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN atom_id END) AS atom_id_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN atom_id END) AS atom_id_2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN atom_id END) AS atom_id_3 FROM (SELECT molecule_id, atom_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY molecule_id ORDER BY atom_id ASC) AS rn FROM atom) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 4 GROUP BY molecule_id ORDER BY molecule_id
SELECT driverid, code FROM (SELECT driverid, code, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY driverid ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC) AS rank FROM drivers GROUP BY driverid, code) subq WHERE rank = 1 AND code IS NOT NULL

SELECT TA.ID, TA.BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING, TA.CHANCECREATIONCROSSING, TA.DEFENCEAGGRESSION, TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH FROM team_attributes AS TA WHERE TA.BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING < (SELECT AVG(BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.CHANCECREATIONCROSSING > (SELECT AVG(CHANCECREATIONCROSSING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCEAGGRESSION > (SELECT AVG(DEFENCEAGGRESSION) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH < (SELECT AVG(DEFENCETEAMWIDTH) FROM team_attributes)

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND m.label LIKE 'H%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST
SELECT C.name, C.rarity FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Brawl' AND C.convertedmanacost = 6.0

SELECT s.cname AS county, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.3 + s.avgscrread * 0.5 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.2) AS reading_weighted_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.cname IN (SELECT s.cname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.cname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.3 + s.avgscrread * 0.5 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.2) ASC nulls last LIMIT 5) GROUP BY s.cname, sch.school ORDER BY s.cname, reading_weighted_score ASC;

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.aptt FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'SLE' AND l.aptt > 70 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.aptt HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.aptt = j.aptt)

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence, AVG(demographics.weight) AS avg_weight FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence = TRUE AND demographics.gender = 'Male' AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_he > 7 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Sn' AND br.bond_seq < 4 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, br.bond_seq NULLS LAST

SELECT '2023-05-01' AS reporting_date, COUNT(CASE WHEN opendate < '2023-05-01' AND (closeddate IS NULL OR closeddate >= '2023-05-01') THEN 1 END) AS active_schools_in_san_joaquin FROM schools WHERE county = 'San Joaquin';
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Chr%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 550000 AND height > 180 AND weight < 85);

SELECT s.school, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numge1500 FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.county = 'Butte' AND sa.rtype = 'D' ORDER BY sa.avgscrmath ASC LIMIT 3;

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS Unique_Events_Organized FROM member AS m JOIN event AS e ON m.member_id = e.event_id WHERE e.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 2
SELECT * FROM cards WHERE 3 = (CASE WHEN artist LIKE 'Z%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN convertedmanacost = 7.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN hasfoil = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.stamina FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.stamina > 90

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bond.bond_id) AS unique_sulfur_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id INNER JOIN atom ON (bond.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id AND atom.element = 'S') GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id;
SELECT s.qualifyid, s.raceid, d.driverid FROM qualifying AS s INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = s.driverid WHERE s.raceid = 85 AND s.position < 15 AND d.nationality = 'Irish'
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MIN(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Rob%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 190000);
SELECT MAX(a14) FROM (SELECT a14, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a14 DESC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM district) AS E WHERE (Rank = 3)

SELECT s.superhero_name, a.alignment, p.power_name FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower p ON hp.power_id = p.id WHERE s.weight_kg BETWEEN 120 AND 140 AND s.gender_id = 3 AND s.height_cm > 200

SELECT bond_type, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN transact_dt_tm END) AS transact_dt_tm_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN transact_dt_tm END) AS transact_dt_tm_2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN transact_dt_tm END) AS transact_dt_tm_3 FROM (SELECT bond_type, transact_dt_tm, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bond_type ORDER BY transact_dt_tm ASC) AS rn FROM bond_list) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 5 GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY bond_type

SELECT s.cname AS county, sch.school, AVG(s.numge1500 * 100.0 / s.numtsttakr) AS avg_percent_high_scorers FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.cname IN (SELECT s.cname FROM satscores s WHERE s.numtsttakr > 0 GROUP BY s.cname ORDER BY AVG(s.numge1500 * 100.0 / s.numtsttakr) DESC nulls last LIMIT 5) GROUP BY s.cname, sch.school ORDER BY s.cname, avg_percent_high_scorers DESC;
SELECT bond_type, bond_seq FROM bond_ref WHERE bond_type LIKE 'B%' ORDER BY bond_seq DESC NULLS FIRST

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type = 'hydrogen' THEN 1 END) AS hydrogen_bonds, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type IN ('covalent', 'ionic') THEN molecule_id END) AS strong_bonds FROM bond_list GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT m.email, e.event_name, b.amount, z.county FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.amount BETWEEN 500 AND 1500 ORDER BY b.amount DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT driverid, url FROM (SELECT driverid, url, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY driverid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM drivers GROUP BY driverid, url) subq WHERE rank = 1

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.amount) AS Total_Event_Budget FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.event_status = 'Approved' AND b.category = 'Retreat' AND e.status = 'Planned' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.amount) > 4500
SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS total_elements FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 4;

SELECT RACEID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 1 THEN DRIVERID END) AS WINNER, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 2 THEN DRIVERID END) AS RUNNER_UP, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 3 THEN DRIVERID END) AS THIRD_PLACE FROM results WHERE POSITIONORDER <= 3 AND LAPS BETWEEN 251 AND 260 GROUP BY RACEID
SELECT MAX(a13) FROM (SELECT a13, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a13 DESC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM district) AS E WHERE (Rank = 2)
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Ant%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 270000);
SELECT driverid, COUNT(*) FROM laptimes GROUP BY driverid HAVING COUNT(*) > 50;
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Raf%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 490000 AND height > 185);
SELECT p.id, p.sex, p.admission, MAX(l.cre) AS max_creatinine_level FROM patient AS p INNER JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id GROUP BY p.id, p.sex, p.admission

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.c4 FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'RA' AND l.c4 < 15 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.c4 HAVING COUNT(*) > 2) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.c4 = j.c4)

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN hgb < 11.7 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Moderate_Anemia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN plt < 109 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Mild_Thrombocytopenia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN wbc > 12.6 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Leukocytosis FROM laboratory GROUP BY id
SELECT * FROM packages WHERE 3 = (CASE WHEN status = 'processing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN weight_kg < 1.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN is_fragile = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT atom.atom_id) AS unique_fluorine_atoms FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'F' GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id;

SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex, COALESCE(l.hct, 0) AS hematocrit_level FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.date BETWEEN '2020-07-01' AND '2023-06-30' ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Ca' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_list ON atom.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Xe' AND bond_list.bond_type = 'dative' ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id ASC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Si' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, b.bond_id NULLS LAST

SELECT year_created, tagname, cnt_badges FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)) AS year_created, t.tagname, COUNT(b.id) AS cnt_badges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(b.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM badges AS b INNER JOIN posts_backup AS p ON b.userid = p.owneruserid INNER JOIN tags AS t ON p.tags LIKE '%' || t.tagname || '%' WHERE t.tagname LIKE 'S%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)), t.id, t.tagname) AS b WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_badges DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT m.email, e.event_name, b.spent, z.county FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.spent BETWEEN 50 AND 250 ORDER BY b.spent DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT cards.toughness, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT * FROM legalities WHERE legalities.format = cards.setcode AND legalities.status = 'Banned') THEN 'banned' ELSE 'not banned' END FROM cards
SELECT M.member_id, M.first_name, M.last_name FROM member AS M WHERE M.member_id IN (SELECT link_to_member FROM attendance WHERE hours BETWEEN 2 AND 4) AND M.position = 'Event Volunteer'

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond_list.bond_id, bond_list.bond_type, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list ON connected.bond_id = bond_list.bond_id WHERE atom.element = 'Rn' AND bond_list.transact_dt_tm > '2026-01-01' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id DESC, atom.atom_id ASC, bond_list.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST
SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS eye_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Gold%' ORDER BY sh.id DESC

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(e.amount) AS Total_Sponsorship FROM member AS m JOIN income AS e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member WHERE e.source = 'Sponsorship' AND e.amount > 250 GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING SUM(e.amount) > 1200

SELECT s.superhero_name, c.colour, p.power_name FROM superhero s JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower p ON hp.power_id = p.id JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.gender_id = 2 AND s.height_cm BETWEEN 160 AND 180 AND s.alignment_id = 2

SELECT s.cname AS county, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 1.5 + s.avgscrread) AS weighted_math_read_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.cname IN (SELECT s.cname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.cname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 1.5 + s.avgscrread) DESC nulls last LIMIT 5) GROUP BY s.cname, sch.school ORDER BY s.cname, weighted_math_read_score DESC;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq > 3 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, br.bond_seq DESC

SELECT p.player_id, p.match_id, p.goals FROM player_stats p JOIN player_rate pr ON p.player_id = pr.id WHERE p.goals > 4 AND pr.overall_rating BETWEEN 93 AND 97 AND pr.potential_rating > 94 AND p.minutes_played > 85 LIMIT 240;
SELECT link_to_member, SUM(hours) AS total_volunteer_hours FROM attendance WHERE hours > 4 GROUP BY link_to_member HAVING SUM(hours) > 25

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS skin_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.skin_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Tan%' AND sh.weight_kg BETWEEN 70 AND 90 ORDER BY sh.id DESC

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond_ref.bond_type, bond_ref.bond_seq FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref ON bond.bond_type = bond_ref.bond_type WHERE atom.element = 'Se' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id ASC, atom.atom_id DESC, bond_ref.bond_seq NULLS LAST

SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex, COALESCE(l.c3, 0) AS complement_c3_level FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND l.c3 > 120 ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT driverid, COUNT(*) FROM qualifying GROUP BY driverid HAVING COUNT(*) > 10;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bond.bond_id) AS unique_hydrogen_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'hydrogen' GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id;
SELECT * FROM budget WHERE remaining >= 300.0 AND remaining <= 900.0 AND link_to_event = 'recggMW2eyCYceNcy' ORDER BY amount NULLS FIRST

SELECT atom_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN molecule_id END) AS molecule_id_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN molecule_id END) AS molecule_id_2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN molecule_id END) AS molecule_id_3 FROM (SELECT atom_id, molecule_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY atom_id ORDER BY molecule_id DESC) AS rn FROM atom) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 3 GROUP BY atom_id ORDER BY atom_id
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Si%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS LAST, a.atom_id NULLS LAST

SELECT molecule_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN atom_id END) AS atom_id_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN atom_id END) AS atom_id_2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN atom_id END) AS atom_id_3 FROM (SELECT molecule_id, atom_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY molecule_id ORDER BY atom_id DESC) AS rn FROM atom) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 5 GROUP BY molecule_id ORDER BY molecule_id

SELECT atom_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN cnt END) AS cnt_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN cnt END) AS cnt_2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN cnt END) AS cnt_3 FROM (SELECT atom_id, cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY atom_id ORDER BY cnt ASC) AS rn FROM atom_view) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 4 GROUP BY atom_id ORDER BY atom_id

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'be' THEN 1 END) AS be_atoms, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element IN ('b', 'c') THEN molecule_id END) AS light_elements FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT RACEID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 1 THEN DRIVERID END) AS WINNER, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 2 THEN DRIVERID END) AS RUNNER_UP, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 3 THEN DRIVERID END) AS THIRD_PLACE FROM results WHERE POSITIONORDER <= 3 AND LAPS > 20 GROUP BY RACEID
SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race, p.publisher_name FROM superhero s JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE s.weight_kg < 100 AND s.alignment_id = 2
SELECT driverid, COUNT(*) FROM laptimes GROUP BY driverid HAVING COUNT(*) > 40;

WITH SUPERHERO_RANK AS (SELECT ID, SUPERHERO_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY HEIGHT_CM DESC NULLS LAST) AS RANK FROM SUPERHERO) SELECT S1.SUPERHERO_NAME AS CURRENT_HERO, S2.SUPERHERO_NAME AS HERO_BEFORE_7 FROM SUPERHERO_RANK AS S1 LEFT JOIN SUPERHERO_RANK AS S2 ON S2.RANK = S1.RANK - 7

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type = 'glycosidic' THEN 1 END) AS glycosidic_bonds, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type IN ('phosphodiester', 'peptide') THEN molecule_id END) AS complex_bonds FROM bond GROUP BY molecule_id;
SELECT s.qualifyid, s.raceid, d.driverid FROM qualifying AS s INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = s.driverid WHERE s.raceid = 65 AND s.position < 6 AND d.nationality = 'Norwegian'

SELECT s.dname AS district, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.6 + s.avgscrread * 0.3 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.1) AS weighted_sat_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.dname IN (SELECT s.dname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.dname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.6 + s.avgscrread * 0.3 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.1) ASC nulls last LIMIT 5) GROUP BY s.dname, sch.school ORDER BY s.dname, weighted_sat_score ASC;
SELECT * FROM cards WHERE 3 = (CASE WHEN artist LIKE 'E%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN convertedmanacost = 4.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN hasfoil = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);
SELECT s.superhero_name, a.alignment, r.race FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id WHERE s.weight_kg > 110 AND s.gender_id = 2

SELECT M.member_id, M.first_name, M.last_name FROM member AS M WHERE M.member_id IN (SELECT link_to_member FROM expense WHERE cost BETWEEN 100 AND 300 AND approved = 'Pending') AND M.position = 'Purchasing Coordinator'

SELECT s.district, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numge1500 FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.county = 'San Bernardino' AND sa.rtype = 'S' ORDER BY sa.avgscrwrite DESC LIMIT 4;
SELECT s.district FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('Lassen', 'Plumas') GROUP BY s.district HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 2;

SELECT atom_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN bond_id END) AS bond_id_1,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN bond_id END) AS bond_id_2,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN bond_id END) AS bond_id_3
FROM (
    SELECT atom_id, bond_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY atom_id ORDER BY bond_id) AS rn
    FROM connected
) AS subquery
WHERE rn <= 3
GROUP BY atom_id
ORDER BY atom_id

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'K' AND br.bond_seq > 1 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, br.bond_seq DESC
SELECT * FROM packages WHERE 3 = (CASE WHEN status = 'shipped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN weight_kg < 1.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN is_fragile = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);

WITH molecule_bond_elements AS (SELECT molecule_id AS mol FROM bond_list UNION ALL SELECT molecule_id AS mol FROM atom) SELECT mol AS id, COUNT(*) AS num FROM molecule_bond_elements GROUP BY mol HAVING COUNT(*) < (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM molecule_bond_elements GROUP BY mol) AS avg_elements);

SELECT RACEID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 1 THEN DRIVERID END) AS WINNER, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 2 THEN DRIVERID END) AS RUNNER_UP, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 3 THEN DRIVERID END) AS THIRD_PLACE FROM results WHERE POSITIONORDER <= 3 AND LAPS BETWEEN 20 AND 30 GROUP BY RACEID

SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.country LIKE 'O%') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.name LIKE '%Olympic%')

SELECT '2023-08-15' AS reporting_date, COUNT(CASE WHEN opendate < '2023-08-15' AND (closeddate IS NULL OR closeddate >= '2023-08-15') THEN 1 END) AS active_schools_in_marin FROM schools WHERE county = 'Marin';
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MIN(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Gio%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 560000 AND weight > 85);

SELECT t1.team_long_name, t2.buildupplaydribblingclass FROM team t1 INNER JOIN team_attributes t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.buildupplaydribbling BETWEEN 40 AND 60 AND t2.chancecreationpassing > 50

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Au' AND b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-12-31' ORDER BY m.label ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS FIRST

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Supporter' WHERE u.reputation >= 2500
SELECT district_id FROM district GROUP BY district_id HAVING COUNT(a11) > 4 AND (MAX(a13) - MIN(a13)) > 1500;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq BETWEEN 11 AND 15 AND m.label LIKE 'Na%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 25 THEN 25 WHEN s.id = 26 THEN 26 WHEN s.id = 27 THEN 27 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, sg.subgroup1 FROM superhero AS s JOIN superhero_group AS sg ON s.id = sg.id WHERE s.id IN (25, 26, 27)

SELECT RACEID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 1 THEN DRIVERID END) AS WINNER, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 2 THEN DRIVERID END) AS RUNNER_UP, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 3 THEN DRIVERID END) AS THIRD_PLACE FROM results WHERE POSITIONORDER <= 3 AND LAPS BETWEEN 31 AND 40 AND POINTS > 18 GROUP BY RACEID

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_columnar_mucosa_goblet_cell_present, COUNT(primary_pathology_columnar_mucosa_goblet_cell_present) AS goblet_cell_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_columnar_mucosa_goblet_cell_present = TRUE GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_columnar_mucosa_goblet_cell_present ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'hydrogen' AND molecule.label LIKE 'Protein%' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'CHEM%'
SELECT raceid, fastestlap FROM (SELECT raceid, fastestlap, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC) AS rank FROM results GROUP BY raceid, fastestlap) subq WHERE rank = 1

SELECT s.constructorresultsid, s.raceid, c.constructorid FROM constructorresults AS s INNER JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorid = s.constructorid WHERE s.raceid = 66 AND s.points > 260 AND c.nationality = 'Spanish'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Ba' AND b.bond_type = 'ionic' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.bond_type DESC

SELECT c.name, c.nationality, cs.points FROM constructors c INNER JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE cs.points > 200 AND cs.wins > 3 ORDER BY cs.points DESC LIMIT 4;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'triple' AND molecule.label LIKE 'Inorganic%'

SELECT RACEID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 1 THEN DRIVERID END) AS WINNER, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 2 THEN DRIVERID END) AS RUNNER_UP, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 3 THEN DRIVERID END) AS THIRD_PLACE FROM results WHERE POSITIONORDER <= 3 AND LAPS BETWEEN 131 AND 140 GROUP BY RACEID
SELECT bl1.bond_type, bl2.bond_type FROM bond_list AS bl1 INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl2 ON (bl1.bond_type, bl2.bond_type) IN (('AROMATIC', 'IONIC'), ('AROMATIC', 'METALLIC'), ('IONIC', 'METALLIC'))
